You can use this card only if your opponent has 3 or fewer Prize cards remaining.

rules:
You must play 2 Transformation Tome cards at once. (This effect works one time for 2 cards.)
 
Choose a Basic Pokémon in your discard pile and switch it with 1 of your Basic Pokémon in play. Any attached cards, damage counters, Special Conditions, turns in play, and any other effects remain on the new Pokémon.

rules:
As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides Water Energy.

The Water Pokémon this card is attached to recovers from all Special Conditions and can't be affected by any Special Conditions.

As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides Metal Energy.

The Metal Pokémon this card is attached to has no Retreat Cost.

data.name: Nitro Fire Energy
rules:
As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides Fire Energy.
 
If this card is discarded by an effect of an attack used by the Fire Pokémon this card is attached to, put this card into your hand after attack damage and effects.

attacks.text: Search your deck for a Supporter card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

data.flavorText: A poor walker, it often falls down. However, its strong pride makes it puff up its chest without a care.

data.name: Prinplup

attacks.name: Targeted Dive
attacks.text: This attack does 70 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.flavorText: It lives a solitary life. Its wings deliver wicked blows that can snap even the thickest of trees in half with a single hit.

data.name: Rotom ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Multi Adapter
abilities.text: Each of your Pokémon that has "Rotom" in its name may have up to 2 Pokémon Tool cards attached. If this Ability goes away, discard Pokémon Tools from those Pokémon until only 1 remains on each.

attacks.name: Thunderbolt
attacks.text: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon.

data.name: Yamper

attacks.name: Play Rough
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

data.flavorText: This gluttonous Pokémon only assists people with their work because it wants treats. As it runs, it crackles with electricity.

data.name: Boltund

attacks.name: Electric Run
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 70 more damage.

data.flavorText: It sends electricity through its legs to boost their strength. Running at top speed, it easily breaks 50 mph.

data.name: Pawmi

attacks.name: Growl
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, attacks used by the Defending Pokémon do 30 less damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

data.flavorText: It has underdeveloped electric sacs on its cheeks. These sacs can produce electricity only if Pawmi rubs them furiously with the pads on its forepaws.

data.name: Pawmo
data.flavorText: When its group is attacked, Pawmo is the first to leap into battle, defeating enemies with a fighting technique that utilizes electric shocks.

data.name: Pawmot

attacks.name: Voltaic Fist
attacks.text: You may have this Pokémon also do 60 damage to itself and make your opponent's Active Pokémon Paralyzed.

data.flavorText: This Pokémon normally is slow to react, but once it enters battle, it will strike down its enemies with lightning-fast movements.

data.name: Misdreavus
data.flavorText: This Pokémon startles people in the middle of the night. It gathers fear as its energy.

data.name: Mismagius ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Swirling Prose
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, whenever your opponent's Active Pokémon moves to the Bench during their turn, their new Active Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Hexa-Magic
attacks.text: You may draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand.

data.name: Snubbull
data.flavorText: In truth, it is a cowardly Pokémon. It growls eagerly in order to hide its fear from its opponent.

data.name: Granbull

attacks.name: Finishing Blow
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon already has any damage counters on it, this attack does 90 more damage.

data.flavorText: It is actually timid and easily spooked. If attacked, it desperately flails its limbs about in an attempt to repel its opponent.

data.name: Cresselia

attacks.name: Swelling Light
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Psychic Energy cards and attach them to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

data.flavorText: Shiny particles are released from its wings like a veil. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

data.name: Meloetta

attacks.name: Soothing Melody
attacks.text: Heal 120 damage from 1 of your Benched Psychic Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.

data.name: Mega Diancie ex
rules: Mega Evolution ex Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Diamond Coat
abilities.text: This Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Garland Ray
attacks.text: Discard up to 2 Energy cards from this Pokémon, and this attack does 120 damage for each card you discarded in this way.

data.name: Mimikyu

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

data.flavorText: This Pokémon lives in dark places untouched by sunlight. When it appears before humans, it hides itself under a cloth that resembles a Pikachu.

data.name: Milcery

attacks.name: Draining Kiss
attacks.text: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: The more sweet aromas it absorbs, the more its body swells. Milcery will deflate when its energy level drops.

data.name: Alcremie

attacks.name: Sweet Circle
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each of your Pokémon in play.

data.flavorText: Desserts that Alcremie have decorated with their cream have a rich, sweet flavor and bring happiness to all who eat them.

data.name: Zacian

attacks.name: Limit Break
attacks.text: If your opponent has 3 or fewer Prize cards remaining, this attack does 90 more damage.

data.flavorText: Able to cut down anything with a single strike, it became known as the Fairy King's Sword, and it inspired awe in friend and foe alike.

data.name: Bramblin

attacks.name: Sneaky Placement
attacks.text: Place 1 damage counter on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

data.flavorText: A soul unable to move on to the afterlife was blown around by the wind until it got tangled up with dried grass and became a Pokémon.

data.name: Brambleghast

abilities.name: Prison Panic
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may use this Ability. Make your opponent's Active Pokémon Confused.

data.flavorText: It will open the branches of its head to envelop its prey. Once it absorbs all the life energy it needs, it expels the prey and discards it.

data.name: Paldean Tauros

attacks.name: Raging Charge
attacks.text: This attack does 40 damage for each of your Pokémon that has "Tauros" in its name that has any damage counters on it.

attacks.name: Double-Edge
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 20 damage to itself.

data.flavorText: This Pokémon has a muscular body and excels at close-quarters combat. It uses its short horns to strike the opponent's weak spots.

data.name: Gligar

attacks.name: Poison Jab
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

data.flavorText: It builds its nest on a steep cliff. When it is done gliding, it hops along the ground back to its nest.

data.name: Gliscor

attacks.name: Poison Ring
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. During your opponent's next turn, that Pokémon can't retreat.

data.flavorText: If it succeeds in catching even a faint breeze properly, it can circle the globe without flapping once.

data.name: Trapinch

attacks.name: Double Headbutt
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.

data.flavorText: This Pokémon lives in arid deserts. It patiently awaits prey inside its funnel- shaped nest.

data.name: Vibrava
data.flavorText: Rather than using its underdeveloped wings for flight, it rubs them together, emitting ultrasonic waves to attack its enemies.

data.name: Flygon

abilities.name: Sandy Flapping
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may use this Ability. You may also use this Ability if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon. Discard the top 2 cards of your opponent's deck.

data.flavorText: Known as the Desert Spirit, this Pokémon hides in the sandstorms it causes by beating its wings.

data.name: Gastly
data.flavorText: It wraps its opponent in its gas-like body, slowly weakening its prey by poisoning it through the skin.

data.name: Haunter
data.flavorText: It likes to lurk in the dark and tap shoulders with a gaseous hand. Its touch causes endless shuddering.

data.name: Mega Gengar ex
rules: Mega Evolution ex Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Shadowy Concealment
abilities.text: If 1 of your Darkness Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon ex, that player takes 1 fewer Prize card. The effect of Shadowy Concealment doesn't stack.

attacks.name: Void Gale
attacks.text: Move an Energy from this Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

data.name: Murkrow

attacks.name: Ambush
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

data.flavorText: Feared and loathed by many, it is believed to bring misfortune to all those who see it at night.

data.name: Honchkrow

attacks.name: Sniping Feathers
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon, and this attack does 120 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.flavorText: It is merciless by nature. It is said that it never forgives the mistakes of its Murkrow followers.

data.name: Sableye

attacks.name: Cocky Claw
attacks.text: If you have any Stage 2 Darkness Pokémon on your Bench, this attack does 70 more damage.

data.flavorText: It dwells in the darkness of caves. It uses its sharp claws to dig up gems to nourish itself.

data.name: Carvanha

attacks.name: Reckless Charge
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

data.flavorText: These Pokémon have sharp fangs and powerful jaws. Sailors avoid Carvanha dens at all costs.

rules: Mega Evolution ex Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Greedy Fang
attacks.text: Draw 2 cards.

attacks.name: Hungry Jaws
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has any damage counters on it, this attack does 150 more damage.

data.name: Seviper

abilities.name: Excited Power
abilities.text: If you have any Darkness Mega Evolution Pokémon ex in play, attacks used by this Pokémon do 120 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

data.flavorText: It sharpens its swordlike tail on hard rocks. It hides in tall grass and strikes unwary prey with venomous fangs.

data.name: Absol

attacks.name: Allure
attacks.text: Draw 2 cards.

data.flavorText: Because of this Pokémon's ability to detect danger, people mistook Absol as a bringer of doom.

data.name: Sandile
data.flavorText: It submerges itself in sand and moves as if swimming. This wise behavior keeps its enemies from finding it and maintains its temperature.

data.name: Krokorok
data.flavorText: Protected by thin membranes, their eyes can see even in the dead of night. They live in groups of a few individuals.

data.name: Krookodile

attacks.name: Vengeful Fang
attacks.text: If any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out by damage from an attack during your opponent's last turn, this attack does 160 more damage.

data.flavorText: After clamping down with its powerful jaws, it twists its body around to rip its prey in half.

data.name: Toxel

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

data.flavorText: It has no problem drinking dirty water. An organ inside Toxel's body filters such water into a poisonous liquid that is harmless to Toxel.

data.name: Toxtricity

abilities.name: Sinister Surge
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. Search your deck for a Basic Darkness Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Benched Darkness Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck. If you attached Energy to a Pokémon in this way, place 2 damage counters on that Pokémon.

data.flavorText: As it scatters toxic sweat and emits electricity, a melody that sounds like it came from a guitar reverberates through the surrounding area.

data.name: Eternatus

attacks.name: Shatter
attacks.text: Discard a Stadium in play.

attacks.name: Power Rush
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, during your next turn, this Pokémon can't use attacks.

data.flavorText: The core on its chest absorbs energy emanating from the lands of the Galar region. This energy is what allows Eternatus to stay active.

data.name: Empoleon ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Emperor's Stance
abilities.text: Prevent all effects of attacks used by your opponent's Pokémon done to this Pokémon. (Damage is not an effect.)

attacks.name: Iron Feathers
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 60 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

data.name: Bronzor

attacks.name: Iron Defense
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks.

data.flavorText: Ancient people believed that the pattern on Bronzor's back contained a mysterious power.

data.name: Bronzong

attacks.name: Triple Draw
attacks.text: Draw 3 cards.

attacks.name: Tool Drop
attacks.text: This attack does 40 damage for each Pokémon Tool attached to all Pokémon.

data.flavorText: In ages past, this Pokémon was revered as a bringer of rain. It was found buried in the ground.

data.name: Togedemaru

attacks.name: Find a Friend
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

data.flavorText: When it's in trouble, it curls up into a ball, makes its fur spikes stand on end, and then discharges electricity indiscriminately.

data.name: Duraludon

attacks.name: Hyper Beam
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Duraludon's body is comprised of a special metal that's lightweight and scratch resistant. It's also smooth, as though it was given a mirror finish.

data.name: Archaludon

attacks.name: Coated Attack
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from Basic Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It gathers static electricity from its surroundings. The beams it launches when down on all fours are tremendously powerful.

data.name: Jigglypuff

attacks.name: Ball Roll
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.

data.flavorText: When its huge eyes waver, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.

data.name: Wigglytuff

attacks.name: Round
attacks.text: This attack does 40 damage for each of your Pokémon in play that has the Round attack.

data.flavorText: It has a very fine fur. Take care not to make it angry, or it may inflate steadily and hit with a body slam.

data.name: Aipom

attacks.name: Astonish
attacks.text: Choose a random card from your opponent's hand, and your opponent reveals that card and shuffles it into their deck.

data.flavorText: It lives atop tall trees. When leaping from branch to branch, it deftly uses its tail for balance.

data.name: Ambipom

attacks.name: Dual Tail
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon, and this attack does 60 damage to each of 2 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.flavorText: They live on large trees. They are said to communicate by connecting their tails to those of others.

data.name: Smeargle

attacks.name: Energizing Sketch
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. Attach an amount of Basic Energy up to the number of heads from your discard pile to your Benched Pokémon in any way you like.

data.flavorText: Once a Smeargle reaches adulthood, it will have other members of its species leave paw prints on its back.

data.name: Zigzagoon

attacks.name: Surprise Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

data.flavorText: A Pokémon with abundant curiosity. It shows an interest in everything, so it always zigzags.

data.name: Linoone

abilities.name: Excited Dash
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is on your Bench, and if you have any Mega Evolution Pokémon ex in play, you may use this Ability. Switch this Pokémon with your Active Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It uses its explosive speed and razor-sharp claws to bring down prey. Running along winding paths is not its strong suit.

data.name: Buneary

attacks.name: Run Around
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Buneary can attack by rolling up their ears and then striking with the force created by unrolling them. This attack becomes stronger with training.

You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

data.name: Snivy
data.flavorText: It is very intelligent and calm. Being exposed to lots of sunlight makes its movements swifter.

data.name: Servine

attacks.name: Wrap
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

data.flavorText: It moves along the ground as if sliding. Its swift movements befuddle its foes, and it then attacks with a vine whip.

data.name: Serperior ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Regal Cheer
abilities.text: Attacks used by your Pokémon do 20 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Command the Grass
attacks.text: You may search your deck for up to 3 cards and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

data.name: Pansage

attacks.name: Collect
attacks.text: Draw a card.

data.flavorText: This Pokémon dwells deep in the forest. Eating a leaf from its head whisks weariness away as if by magic.

data.name: Simisage
data.flavorText: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.

data.name: Petilil

attacks.name: Hide
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: The leaves on its head are very bitter. Eating one of these leaves is known to refresh a tired body.

data.name: Lilligant

attacks.name: Bemusing Aroma
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed and Poisoned. If tails, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

data.flavorText: Even veteran Trainers face a challenge in getting its beautiful flower to bloom. This Pokémon is popular with celebrities.

data.name: Maractus

attacks.name: Lively Needles
attacks.text: If this Pokémon was healed during this turn, this attack does 100 more damage.

data.flavorText: It uses an up-tempo song and dance to drive away the bird Pokémon that prey on its flower seeds.

data.name: Karrablast

abilities.name: Stimulated Evolution
abilities.text: If you have Shelmet in play, this Pokémon can evolve during your first turn or the turn you play it.

data.flavorText: These mysterious Pokémon evolve when they receive electrical stimulation while they are in the same place as Shelmet.

data.name: Foongus

attacks.name: Toxic Spore
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

data.flavorText: It lures people in with its Poké Ball pattern, then releases poison spores. Why it resembles a Poké Ball is unknown.

data.name: Amoonguss

attacks.name: Dangerous Reaction
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is affected by a Special Condition, this attack does 120 more damage.

data.flavorText: It lures prey close by dancing and waving its arm caps, which resemble Poké Balls, in a swaying motion.

data.name: Victini

attacks.name: V-Force
attacks.text: If you have 4 or fewer Benched Pokémon, this attack does nothing.

data.flavorText: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

data.name: Darumaka
data.flavorText: When its internal fire is burning, it cannot calm down and it runs around. When the fire diminishes, it falls asleep.

data.name: Darmanitan

attacks.name: Searing Flame
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

attacks.name: Smashing Headbutt
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Its internal fire burns at 2,500° F, making enough power that it can destroy a dump truck with one punch.

data.name: Larvesta

attacks.name: Peck Off
attacks.text: Before doing damage, discard all Pokémon Tools from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

data.flavorText: This Pokémon was believed to have been born from the sun. When it evolves, its entire body is engulfed in flames.

data.name: Volcarona

abilities.name: Torrid Scales
abilities.text: You must discard a Basic Fire Energy card from your hand in order to use this Ability. Once during your turn, you may make your opponent's Active Pokémon Burned.

data.flavorText: When volcanic ash darkened the atmosphere, it is said that Volcarona's fire provided a replacement for the sun.

data.name: Panpour

attacks.name: Collect
attacks.text: Draw a card.

data.flavorText: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.

data.name: Simipour
data.flavorText: The tuft on its head holds water. When the level runs low, it replenishes the tuft by siphoning up water with its tail.

data.name: Tympole

attacks.name: Round
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each of your Pokémon in play that has the Round attack.

data.flavorText: They warn others of danger by vibrating their cheeks to create a high-pitched sound.

data.name: Palpitoad

attacks.name: Round
attacks.text: This attack does 40 damage for each of your Pokémon in play that has the Round attack.

data.flavorText: When they vibrate the bumps on their heads, they can make waves in water or earthquake-like vibrations on land.

data.name: Seismitoad

attacks.name: Round
attacks.text: This attack does 70 damage for each of your Pokémon in play that has the Round attack.

data.flavorText: They shoot paralyzing liquid from their head bumps. They use vibration to hurt their opponents.

data.name: Tirtouga

attacks.name: Ancient Seaweed
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage for each Item card in your opponent's discard pile.

data.flavorText: Restored from a fossil, this Pokémon can dive to depths beyond half a mile.

data.name: Carracosta

abilities.name: Mighty Shell
abilities.text: Prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon by your opponent's Pokémon that have any Special Energy attached.

attacks.name: Big Bite
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

data.flavorText: They can live both in the ocean and on land. A slap from one of them is enough to open a hole in the bottom of a tanker.

data.name: Alomomola

abilities.name: Gentle Fin
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may put a Basic Pokémon with 70 HP or less from your discard pile onto your Bench.

data.flavorText: The special membrane enveloping Alomomola has the ability to heal wounds.

data.name: Cubchoo

attacks.name: Snotted Up
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't use attacks.

data.flavorText: When it is not feeling well, its mucus gets watery and the power of its Ice-type moves decreases.

data.name: Beartic

attacks.name: Continuous Headbutt
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 50 damage for each heads.

attacks.name: Sheer Cold
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't use attacks.

data.flavorText: It can make its breath freeze at will. Very able in the water, it swims around in northern seas and catches prey.

data.name: Cryogonal

attacks.name: Drag Off
attacks.text: Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot. This attack does 20 damage to the new Active Pokémon.

data.flavorText: When its body temperature goes up, it turns into steam and vanishes. When its temperature lowers, it returns to ice.

data.name: Kyurem ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Blizzard Burst
attacks.text: This attack also does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon for each Prize card your opponent has taken. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.name: Emolga

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

data.flavorText: The energy made in its cheeks' electric pouches is stored inside its membrane and released while it is gliding.

data.name: Tynamo

attacks.name: Hold Still
attacks.text: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: While one alone doesn't have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.

data.name: Eelektrik

abilities.name: Dynamotor
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may attach a Basic Lightning Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

data.flavorText: They coil around foes and shock them with electricity-generating organs that seem simply to be circular patterns.

data.name: Eelektross

attacks.name: Thunder Fang
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Buzz Flip
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 100 damage for each heads.

data.flavorText: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.

data.name: Thundurus

attacks.name: Charge
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Basic Lightning Energy card and attach it to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Disaster Volt
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Countless charred remains mar the landscape of places through which Thundurus has passed.

data.name: Zekrom ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Voltage Burst
attacks.text: This attack does 50 more damage for each Prize card your opponent has taken. This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

data.name: Munna

attacks.name: Rest
attacks.text: This Pokémon is now Asleep. Heal 30 damage from it.

data.flavorText: Munna always float in the air. People whose dreams are eaten by them forget what the dreams had been about.

data.name: Musharna

attacks.name: Dream Calling
attacks.text: You may search your deck for any number of Fennel cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Sleep Pulse
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

data.flavorText: The mist emanating from their foreheads is packed with the dreams of people and Pokémon.

data.name: Solosis
data.flavorText: They drive away attackers by unleashing psychic power. They can use telepathy to talk with others.

data.name: Duosion

attacks.name: Cellular Evolution
attacks.text: Search your deck for a card that evolves from 1 of your Pokémon and put it onto that Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.

data.flavorText: Since they have two divided brains, at times they suddenly try to take two different actions at once.

data.name: Reuniclus

attacks.name: Cellular Ascension
attacks.text: For each of your Benched Pokémon, search your deck for a card that evolves from that Pokémon and put it onto that Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Evo-Lariat
attacks.text: This attack does 40 more damage for each of your Evolution Pokémon in play.

data.flavorText: When Reuniclus shake hands, a network forms between their brains, increasing their psychic power.

data.name: Elgyem

attacks.name: Slight Shift
attacks.text: Move an Energy from 1 of your opponent's Pokémon to another of their Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It uses its strong psychic power to squeeze its opponent's brain, causing unendurable headaches.

data.name: Beheeyem

attacks.name: Calm Mind
attacks.text: Heal 40 damage from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Psychic
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It can manipulate an opponent's memory. Apparently, it communicates by flashing its three different-colored fingers.

data.name: Golett

attacks.name: Best Punch
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

data.flavorText: The energy that burns inside it enables it to move, but no one has yet been able to identify this energy.

data.name: Golurk

attacks.name: Double Smash
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 80 damage for each heads.

data.flavorText: It flies across the sky at Mach speeds. Removing the seal on its chest makes its internal energy go out of control.

data.name: Meloetta ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Debut Performance
abilities.text: If you go first, this Pokémon can use attacks during your first turn.

attacks.name: Echoed Voice
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon's Echoed Voice attack does 80 more damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

data.name: Drilbur
data.flavorText: It can dig through the ground at a speed of 30 mph. It could give a car running aboveground a good race.

data.name: Excadrill ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Piercing Drill
attacks.text: This attack also does 60 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon that has any damage counters on it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Rock Tumble
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

data.name: Timburr
data.flavorText: It fights by swinging a piece of lumber around. It is close to evolving when it can handle the lumber without difficulty.

data.name: Gurdurr

attacks.name: Hammer Arm
attacks.text: Discard the top card of your opponent's deck.

data.flavorText: This Pokémon is so muscular and strongly built that even a group of wrestlers could not make it budge an inch.

data.name: Conkeldurr

abilities.name: Craftsmanship
abilities.text: This Pokémon gets +40 HP for each Fighting Energy attached to it.

attacks.name: Swing Around
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 50 more damage for each heads.

data.flavorText: It is thought that Conkeldurr taught humans how to make concrete more than 2,000 years ago.

data.name: Throh

attacks.name: Shoulder Throw
attacks.text: This attack does 30 less damage for each Colorless in your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost.

data.flavorText: When it tightens its belt, it becomes stronger. Wild Throh use vines to weave their own belts.

data.name: Dwebble

attacks.name: Flail
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: This Pokémon can easily melt holes in hard rocks with a liquid secreted from its mouth.

data.name: Crustle

abilities.name: Sturdy
abilities.text: If this Pokémon has full HP and would be Knocked Out by damage from an attack, it is not Knocked Out, and its remaining HP becomes 10.

attacks.name: Stone Edge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 60 more damage.

data.flavorText: Competing for territory, Crustle fight viciously. The one whose boulder is broken is the loser of the battle.

data.name: Landorus

attacks.name: Abundant Harvest
attacks.text: Attach a Basic Fighting Energy card from your discard pile to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Earthquake
attacks.text: This attack also does 10 damage to each of your Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.flavorText: Lands visited by Landorus grant such bountiful crops that it has been hailed as “The Guardian of the Fields.”

data.name: Venipede

attacks.name: Poison Spray
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

data.flavorText: Its bite injects a potent poison, enough to paralyze large bird Pokémon that try to prey on it.

data.name: Whirlipede

attacks.name: Venoshock
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Poisoned, this attack does 60 more damage.

data.flavorText: Protected by a hard shell, it spins its body like a wheel and crashes furiously into its enemies.

data.name: Scolipede

abilities.name: Poison Point
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), the Attacking Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Venoshock
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Poisoned, this attack does 90 more damage.

data.flavorText: With quick movements, it chases down its foes, attacking relentlessly with its horns until it prevails.

data.name: Sandile

attacks.name: Tighten Up
attacks.text: Your opponent discards a card from their hand.

data.flavorText: They live buried in the sands of the desert. The sun-warmed sands prevent their body temperature from dropping.

data.name: Krokorok

attacks.name: Tighten Up
attacks.text: Your opponent discards 2 cards from their hand.

data.flavorText: They live in groups of a few individuals. Protective membranes shield their eyes from sandstorms.

data.name: Krookodile

attacks.name: Tighten Up
attacks.text: Your opponent discards 2 cards from their hand.

attacks.name: Cursed Slug
attacks.text: If your opponent has 3 or fewer cards in their hand, this attack does 120 more damage.

data.flavorText: They never allow prey to escape. Their jaws are so powerful, they can crush the body of an automobile.

data.name: Escavalier

attacks.name: Wild Lances
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

data.flavorText: They fly around at high speed, striking with their pointed spears. Even when in trouble, they face opponents bravely.

data.name: Antique Cover Fossil
rules: Play this card as if it were a 60-HP Basic Colorless Pokémon. This card can't be affected by any Special Conditions and can't retreat.  At any time during your turn, you may discard this card from play.
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

abilities.name: Protective Cover
abilities.text: Prevent all effects of attacks used by your opponent's Pokémon done to this Pokémon. (Damage is not an effect.)

data.flavorText: They fly around at high speed, striking with their pointed spears. Even when in trouble, they face opponents bravely.

data.name: Klink

attacks.name: Hard Gears
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 10 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

data.flavorText: The two minigears that mesh together are predetermined. Each will rebound from other minigears without meshing.

data.name: Klang

attacks.name: Hard Gears
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 20 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

data.flavorText: By changing the direction in which it rotates, it communicates its feelings to others. When angry, it rotates faster.

data.name: Klinklang

abilities.name: Gear Coating
abilities.text: All of your Pokémon that have any Metal Energy attached take 20 less damage from attacks from your opponent's Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

data.flavorText: Its red core functions as an energy tank. It fires the charged energy through its spikes into an area.

data.name: Pawniard

attacks.name: Corner
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

data.flavorText: Blades comprise this Pokémon's entire body. If battling dulls the blades, it sharpens them on stones by the river.

data.name: Bisharp

attacks.name: Finishing Blow
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon already has any damage counters on it, this attack does 60 more damage.

data.flavorText: It leads a group of Pawniard. It battles to become the boss, but will be driven from the group if it loses.

data.name: Cobalion

attacks.name: Righteous Edge
attacks.text: Discard a Special Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Metal Arms
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool attached, this attack does 40 more damage.

data.flavorText: This legendary Pokémon battled against humans to protect Pokémon. Its personality is calm and composed.

data.name: Genesect ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Metallic Signal
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may search your deck for up to 2 Evolution Metal Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Protect Charge
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

data.name: Axew

attacks.name: Gather Strength
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

data.flavorText: They use their tusks to crush the berries they eat. Repeated regrowth makes their tusks strong and sharp.

data.name: Fraxure

attacks.name: Boundless Power
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use attacks.

data.flavorText: Since a broken tusk will not grow back, they diligently sharpen their tusks on river rocks after they've been fighting.

data.name: Haxorus

attacks.name: Cross-Cut
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is an Evolution Pokémon, this attack does 80 more damage.

attacks.name: Axe Blast
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Basic Pokémon, it is Knocked Out.

data.flavorText: They are kind but can be relentless when defending territory. They challenge foes with tusks that can cut steel.

data.name: Pidove

attacks.name: Scout
attacks.text: Your opponent reveals their hand.

data.flavorText: Each follows its Trainer's orders as best it can, but they sometimes fail to understand complicated commands.

data.name: Tranquill

attacks.name: Fly
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It can return to its Trainer's location regardless of the distance separating them.

data.name: Unfezant

attacks.name: Add On
attacks.text: Draw 4 cards.

attacks.name: Swift Flight
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Males swing their head plumage to threaten opponents. The females' flying abilities surpass those of the males.

data.name: Audino

attacks.name: Return
attacks.text: You may draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand.

data.flavorText: It touches others with the feelers on its ears, using the sound of their heartbeats to tell how they are feeling.

data.name: Minccino

attacks.name: Tail Slap
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.

data.flavorText: They greet one another by rubbing each other with their tails, which are always kept well groomed and clean.

data.name: Cinccino

attacks.name: Do the Wave
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each of your Benched Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Their white fur is coated in a special oil that makes it easy for them to deflect attacks.

data.name: Rufflet
data.flavorText: They crush berries with their talons. They bravely stand up to any opponent, no matter how strong it is.

data.name: Braviary

attacks.name: Aerial Ace
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 40 more damage.

data.flavorText: They fight for their friends without any thought about danger to themselves. One can carry a car while flying.

data.name: Air Balloon
rules: The Retreat Cost of the Pokémon this card is attached to is ColorlessColorless less.
You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached.
Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached.

data.name: Energy Coin
rules: Flip 2 coins. If both of them are heads, search your deck for a Basic Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

data.name: Fennel
rules: Heal 40 damage from each of your Pokémon.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

data.name: N's Plan
rules: Move up to 2 Energy from your Benched Pokémon to your Active Pokémon.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

data.name: Pokégear 3.0
rules: Look at the top 7 cards of your deck. You may reveal a Supporter card you find there and put it into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

data.name: Professor's Research
rules: Discard your hand and draw 7 cards.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

data.name: Prism Energy
rules: As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides Colorless Energy.  If this card is attached to a Basic Pokémon, this card provides every type of Energy but provides only 1 Energy at a time.

data.name: Snivy
data.flavorText: It is very intelligent and calm. Being exposed to lots of sunlight makes its movements swifter.

data.name: Servine

attacks.name: Wrap
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

data.flavorText: It moves along the ground as if sliding. Its swift movements befuddle its foes, and it then attacks with a vine whip.

data.name: Pansage

attacks.name: Collect
attacks.text: Draw a card.

data.flavorText: This Pokémon dwells deep in the forest. Eating a leaf from its head whisks weariness away as if by magic.

data.name: Simisage
data.flavorText: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.

data.name: Petilil

attacks.name: Hide
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: The leaves on its head are very bitter. Eating one of these leaves is known to refresh a tired body.

data.name: Lilligant

attacks.name: Bemusing Aroma
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed and Poisoned. If tails, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

data.flavorText: Even veteran Trainers face a challenge in getting its beautiful flower to bloom. This Pokémon is popular with celebrities.

data.name: Maractus

attacks.name: Lively Needles
attacks.text: If this Pokémon was healed during this turn, this attack does 100 more damage.

data.flavorText: It uses an up-tempo song and dance to drive away the bird Pokémon that prey on its flower seeds.

data.name: Karrablast

abilities.name: Stimulated Evolution
abilities.text: If you have Shelmet in play, this Pokémon can evolve during your first turn or the turn you play it.

data.flavorText: These mysterious Pokémon evolve when they receive electrical stimulation while they are in the same place as Shelmet.

data.name: Foongus

attacks.name: Toxic Spore
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

data.flavorText: It lures people in with its Poké Ball pattern, then releases poison spores. Why it resembles a Poké Ball is unknown.

data.name: Amoonguss

attacks.name: Dangerous Reaction
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is affected by a Special Condition, this attack does 120 more damage.

data.flavorText: It lures prey close by dancing and waving its arm caps, which resemble Poké Balls, in a swaying motion.

data.name: Darumaka
data.flavorText: When its internal fire is burning, it cannot calm down and it runs around. When the fire diminishes, it falls asleep.

data.name: Darmanitan

attacks.name: Searing Flame
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

attacks.name: Smashing Headbutt
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Its internal fire burns at 2,500° F, making enough power that it can destroy a dump truck with one punch.

data.name: Larvesta

attacks.name: Peck Off
attacks.text: Before doing damage, discard all Pokémon Tools from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

data.flavorText: This Pokémon was believed to have been born from the sun. When it evolves, its entire body is engulfed in flames.

data.name: Volcarona

abilities.name: Torrid Scales
abilities.text: You must discard a Basic Fire Energy card from your hand in order to use this Ability. Once during your turn, you may make your opponent's Active Pokémon Burned.

data.flavorText: When volcanic ash darkened the atmosphere, it is said that Volcarona's fire provided a replacement for the sun.

data.name: Panpour

attacks.name: Collect
attacks.text: Draw a card.

data.flavorText: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.

data.name: Simipour
data.flavorText: The tuft on its head holds water. When the level runs low, it replenishes the tuft by siphoning up water with its tail.

data.name: Tympole

attacks.name: Round
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each of your Pokémon in play that has the Round attack.

data.flavorText: They warn others of danger by vibrating their cheeks to create a high-pitched sound.

data.name: Palpitoad

attacks.name: Round
attacks.text: This attack does 40 damage for each of your Pokémon in play that has the Round attack.

data.flavorText: When they vibrate the bumps on their heads, they can make waves in water or earthquake-like vibrations on land.

data.name: Seismitoad

attacks.name: Round
attacks.text: This attack does 70 damage for each of your Pokémon in play that has the Round attack.

data.flavorText: They shoot paralyzing liquid from their head bumps. They use vibration to hurt their opponents.

data.name: Tirtouga

attacks.name: Ancient Seaweed
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage for each Item card in your opponent's discard pile.

data.flavorText: Restored from a fossil, this Pokémon can dive to depths beyond half a mile.

data.name: Carracosta

abilities.name: Mighty Shell
abilities.text: Prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon by your opponent's Pokémon that have any Special Energy attached.

attacks.name: Big Bite
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

data.flavorText: They can live both in the ocean and on land. A slap from one of them is enough to open a hole in the bottom of a tanker.

data.name: Alomomola

abilities.name: Gentle Fin
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may put a Basic Pokémon with 70 HP or less from your discard pile onto your Bench.

data.flavorText: The special membrane enveloping Alomomola has the ability to heal wounds.

data.name: Cubchoo

attacks.name: Snotted Up
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't use attacks.

data.flavorText: When it is not feeling well, its mucus gets watery and the power of its Ice-type moves decreases.

data.name: Beartic

attacks.name: Continuous Headbutt
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 50 damage for each heads.

attacks.name: Sheer Cold
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't use attacks.

data.flavorText: It can make its breath freeze at will. Very able in the water, it swims around in northern seas and catches prey.

data.name: Cryogonal

attacks.name: Drag Off
attacks.text: Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot. This attack does 20 damage to the new Active Pokémon.

data.flavorText: When its body temperature goes up, it turns into steam and vanishes. When its temperature lowers, it returns to ice.

data.name: Emolga

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

data.flavorText: The energy made in its cheeks' electric pouches is stored inside its membrane and released while it is gliding.

data.name: Tynamo

attacks.name: Hold Still
attacks.text: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: While one alone doesn't have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.

data.name: Eelektrik

abilities.name: Dynamotor
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may attach a Basic Lightning Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

data.flavorText: They coil around foes and shock them with electricity-generating organs that seem simply to be circular patterns.

data.name: Eelektross

attacks.name: Thunder Fang
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Buzz Flip
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 100 damage for each heads.

data.flavorText: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.

data.name: Munna

attacks.name: Rest
attacks.text: This Pokémon is now Asleep. Heal 30 damage from it.

data.flavorText: Munna always float in the air. People whose dreams are eaten by them forget what the dreams had been about.

data.name: Musharna

attacks.name: Dream Calling
attacks.text: You may search your deck for any number of Fennel cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Sleep Pulse
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

data.flavorText: The mist emanating from their foreheads is packed with the dreams of people and Pokémon.

data.name: Solosis
data.flavorText: They drive away attackers by unleashing psychic power. They can use telepathy to talk with others.

data.name: Duosion

attacks.name: Cellular Evolution
attacks.text: Search your deck for a card that evolves from 1 of your Pokémon and put it onto that Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.

data.flavorText: Since they have two divided brains, at times they suddenly try to take two different actions at once.

data.name: Elgyem

attacks.name: Slight Shift
attacks.text: Move an Energy from 1 of your opponent's Pokémon to another of their Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It uses its strong psychic power to squeeze its opponent's brain, causing unendurable headaches.

data.name: Beheeyem

attacks.name: Calm Mind
attacks.text: Heal 40 damage from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Psychic
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It can manipulate an opponent's memory. Apparently, it communicates by flashing its three different-colored fingers.

data.name: Golett

attacks.name: Best Punch
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

data.flavorText: The energy that burns inside it enables it to move, but no one has yet been able to identify this energy.

data.name: Golurk

attacks.name: Double Smash
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 80 damage for each heads.

data.flavorText: It flies across the sky at Mach speeds. Removing the seal on its chest makes its internal energy go out of control.

data.name: Drilbur
data.flavorText: It can dig through the ground at a speed of 30 mph. It could give a car running aboveground a good race.

data.name: Timburr
data.flavorText: It fights by swinging a piece of lumber around. It is close to evolving when it can handle the lumber without difficulty.

data.name: Gurdurr

attacks.name: Hammer Arm
attacks.text: Discard the top card of your opponent's deck.

data.flavorText: This Pokémon is so muscular and strongly built that even a group of wrestlers could not make it budge an inch.

data.name: Conkeldurr

abilities.name: Craftsmanship
abilities.text: This Pokémon gets +40 HP for each Fighting Energy attached to it.

attacks.name: Swing Around
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 50 more damage for each heads.

data.flavorText: It is thought that Conkeldurr taught humans how to make concrete more than 2,000 years ago.

data.name: Throh

attacks.name: Shoulder Throw
attacks.text: This attack does 30 less damage for each Colorless in your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost.

data.flavorText: When it tightens its belt, it becomes stronger. Wild Throh use vines to weave their own belts.

data.name: Dwebble

attacks.name: Flail
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: This Pokémon can easily melt holes in hard rocks with a liquid secreted from its mouth.

data.name: Crustle

abilities.name: Sturdy
abilities.text: If this Pokémon has full HP and would be Knocked Out by damage from an attack, it is not Knocked Out, and its remaining HP becomes 10.

attacks.name: Stone Edge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 60 more damage.

data.flavorText: Competing for territory, Crustle fight viciously. The one whose boulder is broken is the loser of the battle.

data.name: Landorus

attacks.name: Abundant Harvest
attacks.text: Attach a Basic Fighting Energy card from your discard pile to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Earthquake
attacks.text: This attack also does 10 damage to each of your Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.flavorText: Lands visited by Landorus grant such bountiful crops that it has been hailed as “The Guardian of the Fields.”

data.name: Venipede

attacks.name: Poison Spray
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

data.flavorText: Its bite injects a potent poison, enough to paralyze large bird Pokémon that try to prey on it.

data.name: Whirlipede

attacks.name: Venoshock
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Poisoned, this attack does 60 more damage.

data.flavorText: Protected by a hard shell, it spins its body like a wheel and crashes furiously into its enemies.

data.name: Scolipede

abilities.name: Poison Point
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), the Attacking Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Venoshock
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Poisoned, this attack does 90 more damage.

data.flavorText: With quick movements, it chases down its foes, attacking relentlessly with its horns until it prevails.

data.name: Sandile

attacks.name: Tighten Up
attacks.text: Your opponent discards a card from their hand.

data.flavorText: They live buried in the sands of the desert. The sun-warmed sands prevent their body temperature from dropping.

data.name: Krokorok

attacks.name: Tighten Up
attacks.text: Your opponent discards 2 cards from their hand.

data.flavorText: They live in groups of a few individuals. Protective membranes shield their eyes from sandstorms.

data.name: Krookodile

attacks.name: Tighten Up
attacks.text: Your opponent discards 2 cards from their hand.

attacks.name: Cursed Slug
attacks.text: If your opponent has 3 or fewer cards in their hand, this attack does 120 more damage.

data.flavorText: They never allow prey to escape. Their jaws are so powerful, they can crush the body of an automobile.

data.name: Escavalier

attacks.name: Wild Lances
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

data.flavorText: They fly around at high speed, striking with their pointed spears. Even when in trouble, they face opponents bravely.

data.name: Klink

attacks.name: Hard Gears
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 10 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

data.flavorText: The two minigears that mesh together are predetermined. Each will rebound from other minigears without meshing.

data.name: Klang

attacks.name: Hard Gears
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 20 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

data.flavorText: By changing the direction in which it rotates, it communicates its feelings to others. When angry, it rotates faster.

data.name: Klinklang

abilities.name: Gear Coating
abilities.text: All of your Pokémon that have any Metal Energy attached take 20 less damage from attacks from your opponent's Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

data.flavorText: Its red core functions as an energy tank. It fires the charged energy through its spikes into an area.

data.name: Pawniard

attacks.name: Corner
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

data.flavorText: Blades comprise this Pokémon's entire body. If battling dulls the blades, it sharpens them on stones by the river.

data.name: Bisharp

attacks.name: Finishing Blow
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon already has any damage counters on it, this attack does 60 more damage.

data.flavorText: It leads a group of Pawniard. It battles to become the boss, but will be driven from the group if it loses.

data.name: Cobalion

attacks.name: Righteous Edge
attacks.text: Discard a Special Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Metal Arms
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool attached, this attack does 40 more damage.

data.flavorText: This legendary Pokémon battled against humans to protect Pokémon. Its personality is calm and composed.

data.name: Victini

attacks.name: V-Force
attacks.text: If you have 4 or fewer Benched Pokémon, this attack does nothing.

data.flavorText: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.
