You may play only 1 Stadium card during your turn. Put it next to the Active Spot, and discard it if another Stadium comes into play. A Stadium with the same name can't be played.

data.name: Caterpie
data.flavorText: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.

data.name: Metapod

attacks.name: Harden
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks if that damage is 60 or less.

data.flavorText: Even though it is encased in a sturdy shell, the body inside is tender. It can't withstand a harsh attack.

data.name: Butterfree

attacks.name: Scale Hurricane
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 60 damage for each heads. If at least 2 of them are heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

data.flavorText: It collects honey every day. It rubs honey onto the hairs on its legs to carry it back to its nest.

data.name: Paras

attacks.name: Leech Life
attacks.text: Heal from this Pokémon the same amount of damage you did to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Burrows under the ground to gnaw on tree roots. The mushrooms on its back absorb most of the nutrition.

data.name: Parasect

attacks.name: Spore
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Scissor Swing
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 more damage for each heads.

data.flavorText: The larger the mushroom on its back grows, the stronger the mushroom spores it scatters.

data.name: Petilil
data.flavorText: If the leaves on its head are pruned with regularity, this Pokémon can be grown into a fine plump shape.

data.name: Lilligant

abilities.name: Sunny Day
abilities.text: Attacks used by your Grass Pokémon and Fire Pokémon do 20 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

data.flavorText: No matter how much time and money is spent raising it, its flowers are the most beautiful when they bloom in the wild.

data.name: Maractus

abilities.name: Exploding Needles
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, put 6 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon.

attacks.name: Corner
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

data.flavorText: Once each year, this Pokémon scatters its seeds. They're jam-packed with nutrients, making them a precious food source out in the desert.

data.name: Karrablast

attacks.name: Push Down
attacks.text: Switch out your opponent's Active Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.)

data.flavorText: It spits a liquid from its mouth to melt through Shelmet's shell. Karrablast doesn't eat the shell— it eats only the contents.

data.name: Foongus

attacks.name: Spore Ball
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

data.flavorText: This Pokémon prefers damp places. It spurts out poison spores to repel approaching enemies.

data.name: Amoonguss ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Spore Ball
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Champignon's Swing
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 80 more damage.

data.name: Shelmet

attacks.name: Shell Smack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks.

data.flavorText: It has a strange physiology that responds to electricity. When together with Karrablast, Shelmet evolves for some reason.

data.name: Accelgor

attacks.name: Poisonous Ploy
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused and Poisoned. Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Discarding its shell made it nimble. To keep itself from dehydrating, it wraps its body in bands of membrane.

data.name: Durant

attacks.name: Crunch
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

data.flavorText: They lay their eggs deep inside their nests. When attacked by Heatmor, they retaliate using their massive mandibles.

data.name: Virizion

attacks.name: Leaf Drain
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: A legend tells of this Pokémon working together with Cobalion and Terrakion to protect the Pokémon of the Unova region.

data.name: Sprigatito

attacks.name: Tons of Treading
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.

data.flavorText: Its fluffy fur is similar in composition to plants. This Pokémon frequently washes its face to keep it from drying out.

data.name: Floragato

attacks.name: Magical Leaf
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage, and heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Floragato deftly wields the vine hidden beneath its long fur, slamming the hard flower bud against its opponents.

data.name: Meowscarada

abilities.name: Showtime
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is on your Bench, you may switch it with your Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Rising Bloom
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Pokémon ex, this attack does 90 more damage.

data.flavorText: This Pokémon uses the reflective fur lining its cape to camouflage the stem of its flower, creating the illusion that the flower is floating.

data.name: Nymble
data.flavorText: It's highly skilled at a fighting style in which it uses its jumping capabilities to dodge incoming attacks while also dealing damage to opponents.

data.name: Magmar

attacks.name: Searing Flame
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

data.flavorText: Found near the mouth of a volcano. This fire-breather's body temperature is nearly 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit.

data.name: Magmortar

abilities.name: Magma Surge
abilities.text: During Pokémon Checkup, put 3 more damage counters on your opponent's Burned Pokémon.

attacks.name: Searing Flame
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

data.flavorText: When shooting 3,600 degree Fahrenheit fireballs from its arms, its body takes on a whitish hue from the intense heat.

data.name: Torchic
data.flavorText: In its belly, it has a sac filled with burning fire, meaning that Torchic feels as warm as a hot-water bottle if you hug it.

data.name: Combusken
data.flavorText: When it enters battle, the flame inside its body burns stronger. Its kicks have outstanding destructive power.

data.name: Blaziken ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Seething Spirit
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may attach a Basic Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Smolder-sault
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

data.name: Torkoal
data.flavorText: Coal is the source of Torkoal's energy. Large amounts of coal can be found in the mountains where they live.

data.name: N's Darumaka
data.flavorText: This popular symbol of good fortune will never fall over in its sleep, no matter how it's pushed or pulled.

data.name: N's Darmanitan

attacks.name: Back Draft
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage for each Basic Energy card in your opponent's discard pile.

attacks.name: Flamebody Cannon
attacks.text: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon, and this attack also does 90 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.flavorText: This Pokémon's power level rises along with the temperature of its fire, which can reach 2,500 degrees Fahrenheit.

data.name: Larvesta
data.flavorText: In ancient times, Larvesta was worshiped as the emissary of the sun. However, it was also viewed as a burden since it often caused forest fires.

data.name: Volcarona
data.flavorText: This Pokémon scatters burning scales. Most of the danger of these scales is not in their heat—it's in the way they rob the surrounding air of oxygen.

data.name: Reshiram ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Scorching Fire
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

data.name: Volcanion ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Scalding Steam
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may make your opponent's Active Pokémon Burned.

attacks.name: Scorching Cyclone
attacks.text: Move an Energy from this Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

data.name: Articuno

attacks.name: Frigid Fluttering
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Water Energy cards and attach them to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

data.flavorText: This Pokémon can control ice at will. Articuno is said to live in snowy mountains riddled with permafrost.

data.name: Remoraid

attacks.name: Flail
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Using its dorsal fin as a suction pad, it clings to a Mantine's underside to scavenge for leftovers.

data.name: Octillery

attacks.name: Aqua Wash
attacks.text: You may put an Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon into their hand.

attacks.name: Octo Beatdown
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 90 damage for each heads.

data.flavorText: It traps enemies with its suction-cupped tentacles, then smashes them with its rock-hard head.

data.name: Lotad
data.flavorText: The leaf on its head is naturally dirt repellent and will stay clean even after transporting Pokémon that are covered in mud.

data.name: Lombre

attacks.name: Aqua Slash
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

data.flavorText: Old folklore in Kitakami tells of a mischievous child who was reborn as a Pokémon.

data.name: Ludicolo

abilities.name: Vibrant Dance
abilities.text: All of your Pokémon in play get +40 HP. The effect of Vibrant Dance doesn't stack.

data.flavorText: There are structures throughout its whole body that produce energy when hit by sound waves with a cheerful rhythm.

data.name: Wingull
data.flavorText: It rides upon ocean winds as if it were a glider. In the winter, it hides food around its nest.

data.name: Pelipper
data.flavorText: It protects its young in its beak. It bobs on waves, resting on them on days when the waters are calm.

data.name: Wailmer
data.flavorText: When it sucks in a large volume of seawater, it becomes like a big, bouncy ball. It eats a ton of food daily.

data.name: Wailord

attacks.name: Hydro Pump
attacks.text: This attack does 50 more damage for each Water Energy attached to this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Its immense size is the reason for its popularity. Wailord watching is a favorite sightseeing activity in various parts of the world.

data.name: Regice

attacks.name: Blizzard
attacks.text: This attack also does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.flavorText: With cold air that can reach temperatures as low as −328 degrees Fahrenheit, Regice instantly freezes any creature that approaches it.

data.name: Veluza ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Purging Strike
attacks.text: You may discard your hand. If you discarded any cards in this way, this attack does 120 more damage.

data.name: Alolan Geodude
data.flavorText: If you step on a Geodude sleeping on the ground, you'll hear a zapping sound and feel a tingling shock throughout your entire body.

data.name: Alolan Graveler
data.flavorText: Graveler's entire body is electrically charged due to the stones it likes to eat. It is a very quick-tempered Pokémon.

data.name: Alolan Golem

attacks.name: Electromagnetic Catapult
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 70 damage for each heads.

attacks.name: Megaton Fall
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 40 damage to itself.

data.flavorText: It fires rocks charged with electricity. Even if the rock isn't fired that accurately, just grazing an opponent will cause numbness and fainting.

data.name: Iono's Voltorb

attacks.name: Voltaic Chain
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each Lightning Energy attached to all of your Iono's Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It rolls to move. If the ground is uneven, a sudden jolt from hitting a bump can cause it to explode.

data.name: Iono's Electrode

attacks.name: Thump-Thump Boom
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 100 damage to itself. Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is Knocked Out.

data.flavorText: The more energy it charges up, the faster it gets. But this also makes it more likely to explode.

data.name: N's Joltik

attacks.name: Zapping Short
attacks.text: Before doing damage, discard all Pokémon Tools from your opponent's Active Pokémon. If you discarded a Pokémon Tool in this way, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

data.flavorText: Since it can't generate its own electricity, it sticks onto large-bodied Pokémon and absorbs static electricity.

data.name: Togedemaru

attacks.name: Toge Spark
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: With the long hairs on its back, this Pokémon takes in electricity from other electric Pokémon. It stores what it absorbs in an electric sac.

data.name: Tapu Koko ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Linked Lightning
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each of your Benched Pokémon.

data.name: Iono's Tadbulb
data.flavorText: Tadbulb shakes its tail to generate electricity. If it senses danger, it will make its head blink on and off to alert its allies.

data.name: Iono's Bellibolt ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Electric Streamer
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn, you may attach a Basic Lightning Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Iono's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Thunderous Bolt
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

data.name: Iono's Wattrel

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

data.flavorText: When its wings catch the wind, the bones within produce electricity. This Pokémon dives into the ocean, catching prey by electrocuting them.

data.name: Iono's Kilowattrel

abilities.name: Flashing Draw
abilities.text: You must discard a Basic Lightning Energy from this Pokémon in order to use this Ability. Once during your turn, you may draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand.

data.flavorText: Kilowattrel inflates its throat sac to amplify its electricity. By riding the wind, this Pokémon can fly over 430 miles in a day.

data.name: Lillie's Clefairy ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Fairy Zone
abilities.text: The Weakness of each of your opponent's Dragon Pokémon in play is now Psychic. (Apply Weakness as ×2.)

attacks.name: Full Moon Rondo
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each Benched Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's).

data.name: Alolan Marowak

attacks.name: Retaliate
attacks.text: If any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out by damage from an attack during your opponent's last turn, this attack does 90 more damage.

data.flavorText: This Pokémon sets the bone it holds on fire and dances through the night as a way to mourn its fallen allies.

data.name: Mr. Mime

attacks.name: Mimic
attacks.text: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw a card for each card in your opponent's hand.

attacks.name: Psy Bolt
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

data.flavorText: It's known for its top-notch pantomime skills. It protects itself from all sorts of attacks by emitting auras from its fingers to create walls.

data.name: Shuppet
data.flavorText: It loves to feed on feelings like envy and malice. Its upright horn catches the emotions of people.

data.name: Banette

attacks.name: Cursed Words
attacks.text: Your opponent chooses 3 cards from their hand and shuffles those cards into their deck.

data.flavorText: This Pokémon developed from an abandoned doll that amassed a grudge. It is seen in dark alleys.

data.name: Beldum
data.flavorText: The magnetic force generated by its body repels the ground's natural magnetism, letting it float.

data.name: Metang
data.flavorText: It is formed by two Beldum joining together. Its two brains are linked, amplifying its psychic power.

data.name: Metagross

attacks.name: Conjoined Beams
attacks.text: If Beldum and Metang are on your Bench, this attack does 150 more damage.

data.flavorText: It folds its four legs when flying. Its four brains are said to be superior to a supercomputer.

data.name: N's Sigilyph

attacks.name: Victory Symbol
attacks.text: If you use this attack when you have exactly 1 Prize card remaining, you win this game.

data.flavorText: A discovery was made in the desert where Sigilyph fly. The ruins of what may have been an ancient city were found beneath the sands.

data.name: Oricorio

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

data.flavorText: This form of Oricorio has sipped purple nectar. It uses ethereal dance steps to call forth the spirits of the dead.

data.name: Lillie's Cutiefly

attacks.name: Hold Still
attacks.text: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: When it senses the auras of people or Pokémon who are having fun, it will draw close and give them a painful poke with its long proboscis.

data.name: Lillie's Ribombee

abilities.name: Inviting Wink
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may have your opponent reveal their hand and you put any number of Basic Pokémon you find there onto their Bench.

data.flavorText: Ribombee can sense when people or Pokémon are feeling down, and it will cheer them up with handmade pollen puffs.

data.name: Lillie's Comfey

attacks.name: Inviting Flowers
attacks.text: You may search your deck for any number of Basic Lillie's Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Fade Out
attacks.text: Put this Pokémon and all attached cards into your hand.

data.flavorText: It uses its vine to pick flowers. The flowers that Comfey attaches to itself develop healing properties.

data.name: Mimikyu ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Mischievous Hands
attacks.text: Choose 2 of your opponent's Pokémon and put 3 damage counters on each of them.

attacks.name: Ghostly Trip
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

data.name: Dhelmise

attacks.name: Bind Down
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

data.flavorText: After a piece of seaweed merged with debris from a sunken ship, it was reborn as this ghost Pokémon.

data.name: Impidimp
data.flavorText: They live in groups, pestering and playing pranks on each other to polish their troublemaking skills.

data.name: Morgrem
data.flavorText: This Pokémon absorbs negative emotions and turns them into energy. It's popular with people who tend to think gloomy thoughts.

data.name: Grimmsnarl

attacks.name: Shadowy Knot
attacks.text: This attack does 50 damage for each Colorless in your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost.

data.flavorText: It lives deep within the forest. Even after evolving into this splendid form, it hasn't given up on its petty misdeeds and pranks.

data.name: Milcery
data.flavorText: When attacked, it tackles its foe and covers them in cream. With its foe either blinded or astonished by deliciousness, Milcery flees.

data.name: Alcremie ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Confectionary Gift
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may heal 30 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.

data.name: Cubone
data.flavorText: When the memory of its departed mother brings it to tears, its cries echo mournfully within the skull it wears on its head.

data.name: Swinub

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

data.flavorText: It searches for food by digging into the ground with its snout. Even frozen ground doesn't give it any trouble.

data.name: Piloswine
data.flavorText: Covered by a shaggy coat, it is resistant to the cold. Its tusks of ice thicken when it snows.

data.name: Mamoswine ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Mammoth Hauler
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Rumbling March
attacks.text: This attack does 40 more damage for each Stage 2 Pokémon on your Bench.

data.name: Larvitar

attacks.name: Crunch
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Born deep underground, this Pokémon becomes a pupa after eating enough dirt to make a mountain.

data.name: Pupitar

attacks.name: Take Down
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 20 damage to itself.

data.flavorText: This pupa flies around wildly by venting with great force the gas pressurized inside its body.

data.name: Regirock

abilities.name: Rock Armor
abilities.text: If this Pokémon has any Energy attached, it takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Breaching Lariat
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

data.flavorText: Cutting-edge technology was used to study the internals of this Pokémon's rock body, but nothing was found—not even a brain or a heart.

data.name: Pancham

attacks.name: Focus Fist
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

data.flavorText: Wanting to make sure it's taken seriously, Pancham's always giving others a glare. But if it's not focusing, it ends up smiling.

data.name: Rockruff

attacks.name: Dig It Up
attacks.text: Look at the top card of your deck. You may discard that card.

data.flavorText: This Pokémon is very friendly when it's young. Its disposition becomes vicious once it matures, but it never forgets the kindness of its master.

data.name: Lycanroc

abilities.name: Spike-Clad
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may attach up to 2 Spiky Energy cards from your discard pile to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Clamping Fangs
attacks.text: This attack does 40 more damage for each damage counter on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Lycanroc attacks its prey with its sharp claws and fangs. It loyally obeys the instructions of a Trainer it trusts.

data.name: Hop's Silicobra

attacks.name: Turf Maker
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Stadium card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

data.flavorText: Silicobra's neck pouch, which can inflate and deflate like a balloon, gets more elastic each time Silicobra sheds its skin.

data.name: Hop's Sandaconda

attacks.name: Rumble
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

attacks.name: Break Ground
attacks.text: This attack also does 20 damage to each of your Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.flavorText: It will expand its body as much as it can and then contract itself, blasting out sand with enough force to wash away a dump truck.

data.name: Toedscool
data.flavorText: Though it looks like Tentacool, Toedscool is a completely different species. Its legs may be thin, but it can run at a speed of 30 mph.

data.name: Toedscruel

abilities.name: Secret Forest Path
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, your Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost is ColorlessColorless less.

data.flavorText: It coils its 10 tentacles around prey and sucks out their nutrients, causing the prey pain. The folds along the rim of its head are a popular delicacy.

data.name: Klawf

attacks.name: Snipping Pincers
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. For each heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Klawf hangs upside-down from cliffs, waiting for prey. But Klawf can't remain in this position for long because its blood rushes to its head.

data.name: Koffing
data.flavorText: Toxic gas is held within its thin, balloon-shaped body, so it can cause massive explosions.

data.name: Weezing

attacks.name: Pervasive Gas
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Crazy Blast
attacks.text: If this Pokémon used Pervasive Gas during your last turn, this attack does 120 more damage.

data.flavorText: Top-grade perfume is made using its internal poison gases by diluting them to the highest level.

data.name: Paldean Wooper

attacks.name: Trip Over
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

data.flavorText: It's dangerous for Wooper to travel alone. They line up in groups of three or four and help each other as they walk around the wetlands.

data.name: Paldean Clodsire ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Poison Ring
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. During your opponent's next turn, that Pokémon can't retreat.

attacks.name: Giga Impact
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

data.name: Tyranitar

abilities.name: Daunting Gaze
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, your opponent can't play any Item cards from their hand.

attacks.name: Cracking Stomp
attacks.text: Discard the top 2 cards of your opponent's deck.

data.flavorText: Extremely strong, it can change the landscape. It is so insolent that it doesn't care about others.

data.name: N's Purrloin

attacks.name: Thieving Swipe
attacks.text: Your opponent reveals their hand, and you choose a card you find there and put it on the bottom of their deck.

data.flavorText: Opponents that get drawn in by its adorable behavior come away with stinging scratches from its claws and stinging pride from its laughter.

data.name: N's Zorua
data.flavorText: It changes into the forms of others to surprise them. Apparently, it often transforms into a silent child.

data.name: N's Zoroark ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Trade
abilities.text: You must discard a card from your hand in order to use this Ability. Once during your turn, you may draw 2 cards.

attacks.name: Night Joker
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your Benched N's Pokémon's attacks and use it as this attack.

data.name: Pangoro

attacks.name: Torment
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Active Pokémon's attacks. During your opponent's next turn, that Pokémon can't use that attack.

attacks.name: Power Tackle
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

data.flavorText: Using its leaf, Pangoro can predict the moves of its opponents. It strikes with punches that can turn a dump truck into scrap with just one hit.

data.name: Lokix
data.flavorText: It uses its normally folded third set of legs when in Showdown Mode. This places a huge burden on its body, so it can't stay in this mode for long.

data.name: Bombirdier

attacks.name: Drop Shot
attacks.text: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon, and this attack does 120 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.flavorText: Bombirdier uses the apron on its chest to bundle up food, which it carries back to its nest. It enjoys dropping things that make loud noises.

data.name: Escavalier

attacks.name: Iron Buster
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

data.flavorText: It charges its enemies, lances at the ready. An image of one of its duels is captured in a famous painting of Escavalier clashing with Sirfetch'd.

data.name: N's Klink

attacks.name: Double Spin
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.

data.flavorText: The two minigears that compose this Pokémon are closer than twins. They mesh well only with each other.

data.name: N's Klang

attacks.name: Spinning Gears
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

data.flavorText: When Klang goes all out, the minigear links up perfectly with the outer part of the big gear, and this Pokémon's rotation speed increases sharply.

data.name: N's Klinklang

attacks.name: Triple Smash
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 120 damage for each heads.

data.flavorText: From its spikes, it launches powerful blasts of electricity. Its red core contains an enormous amount of energy.

data.name: Galarian Stunfisk

attacks.name: Bounding Bite
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

data.flavorText: Living in mud with a high iron content has given it a strong steel body.

data.name: Magearna

abilities.name: Auto Heal
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, whenever you attach an Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon, heal 90 damage from that Pokémon.

attacks.name: Spike Draw
attacks.text: Draw 2 cards.

data.flavorText: Built roughly 500 years ago by a scientist, the part called the Soul-Heart is the actual life-form.

data.name: Hop's Corviknight

attacks.name: Shoot Through
attacks.text: This attack also does 50 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Steel Wing
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 60 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

data.flavorText: Although its wings have partly turned to steel and become heavy as a result, this Pokémon flies through the skies with ease.

data.name: Cufant
data.flavorText: Cufant can lift loads weighing five tons. In the mornings, it heads into caves with its herd, in search of the ore on which these Pokémon feed.

data.name: Copperajah
data.flavorText: Copperajah are prideful, cantankerous Pokémon. Specimens with vibrant green skin command the respect of others of their kind.

attacks.text: This attack also does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Brave Slash
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Brave Slash.

data.name: Bagon

attacks.name: Reckless Charge
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

data.flavorText: Its steel-hard head can shatter boulders. It longingly hopes for wings to grow so it can fly.

data.name: Shelgon

attacks.name: Guard Press
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

data.flavorText: The cells within its shell transform with explosive speed, preparing it for evolution.

attacks.text: This attack does 50 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Dragon Impact
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon.

data.name: Druddigon

attacks.name: Dragon's Fury
attacks.text: Attach a Basic Fire Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Dragon Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Druddigon are vicious and cunning. They take up residence in nests dug out by other Pokémon, treating the stolen nests as their own lairs.

data.name: N's Reshiram

attacks.name: Powerful Rage
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: According to myth, if people ignore truth and let themselves become consumed by greed, Reshiram will arrive to burn their kingdoms down.

data.name: Hop's Snorlax

abilities.name: Extra Helpings
abilities.text: Attacks used by your Hop's Pokémon do 30 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance). The effect of Extra Helpings doesn't stack.

attacks.name: Dynamic Press
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 80 damage to itself.

data.flavorText: This gluttonous Pokémon eats constantly, apart from when it's asleep. It devours nearly 900 pounds of food per day.

data.name: Sentret
data.flavorText: This Pokémon is extremely cautious. Its supple tail is well muscled and firm to the touch.

data.name: Furret
data.flavorText: It raises its offspring inside a long, narrow nest. Once they're old enough, it takes them outside the nest to prepare them for independence.

data.name: Dunsparce

attacks.name: Trading Places
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It creates mazes in dark locations. When spotted, it flees into the ground by digging with its tail.

data.name: Dudunsparce ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Tenacious Tail
attacks.text: This attack does 60 damage for each of your opponent's Pokémon ex in play.

attacks.name: Destructive Drill
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

data.name: Kecleon

attacks.name: Stealth Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It changes its hue to blend into its surroundings. If no one takes notice of it for too long, it will pout and never reveal itself.

data.name: Tropius

attacks.name: Fruit Bearing
attacks.text: Discard a card from your hand. If you do, draw 3 cards.

data.flavorText: Delicious fruits grew out from around its neck because it always ate the same kind of fruit.

data.name: Audino

attacks.name: Beckon
attacks.text: Put a Supporter card from your discard pile into your hand.

data.flavorText: Audino's sense of hearing is superb. Not even a pebble rolling along over a mile away will escape Audino's ears.

data.name: Minccino
data.flavorText: These Pokémon like things neat and tidy. They are always sweeping and dusting their habitat, using their tails as brooms.

data.name: Cinccino
data.flavorText: The oil that seeps from its body is really smooth. For people troubled by bad skin, this oil is an effective treatment.

data.name: Noibat

attacks.name: Rapid Draw
attacks.text: Draw a card.

data.flavorText: This Pokémon emits ultrasonic waves from its large ears to search for fruit to eat. It mistakes Applin for its food.

data.name: Noivern

abilities.name: Tuning Echo
abilities.text: If you have the same number of cards in your hand as your opponent, ignore all Energy in the cost of Frightening Howl used by this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Frightening Howl
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

data.flavorText: Ultrasonic waves emitted by a Noivern can pulverize a large boulder. This Pokémon has a cruel disposition.

data.name: Komala

attacks.name: Slumbering Smack
attacks.text: Both Active Pokémon are now Asleep. During your next turn, attacks used by this Pokémon do 100 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

data.flavorText: Komala spends its entire life sleeping. It feeds on leaves that contain a potent poison only Komala can break down.

data.name: Drampa
data.flavorText: The mountains it calls home are nearly two miles in height. On rare occasions, it descends to play with the children living in the towns below.

data.name: Skwovet

attacks.name: Collect
attacks.text: Draw a card.

data.flavorText: No matter how much it stuffs its belly with food, it is always anxious about getting hungry again. So, it stashes berries in its cheeks and tail.

data.name: Greedent

attacks.name: Gluttonous Tail
attacks.text: Draw 2 cards.

data.flavorText: This Pokémon makes off with heaps of fallen berries by wrapping them in its tail, which is roughly twice the length of its body.

data.name: Hop's Rookidee

attacks.name: Intimidating Stare
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, attacks used by the Defending Pokémon do 20 less damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

data.flavorText: The females are fussier than the males. If another creature dirties a female Rookidee's wings, it'll peck the offender relentlessly in a burning rage.

data.name: Hop's Corvisquire
data.flavorText: This intelligent Pokémon will quickly learn how to use any tool it can hold in its beak or its talons.

data.name: Hop's Wooloo
data.flavorText: If its fleece grows too long, Wooloo won't be able to move. Cloth made with the wool of this Pokémon is surprisingly strong.

data.name: Hop's Dubwool

abilities.name: Defiant Horn
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot.

data.flavorText: Its majestic horns are meant only to impress the opposite gender. They never see use in battle.

data.name: Cramorant

attacks.name: Ceaseless Spitting
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 50 damage for each heads.

data.flavorText: It's an incredibly poor learner because it uses the bare minimum amount of energy for its brain. It focuses on battling instead.

data.name: Hop's Cramorant

attacks.name: Fickle Spitting
attacks.text: If your opponent doesn't have exactly 3 or 4 Prize cards remaining, this attack does nothing.

data.flavorText: Cramorant instinctively swallow everything whole. They're at their most formidable when they're struggling to swallow overly large prey.

data.name: Lechonk
data.flavorText: This Pokémon spurns all but the finest of foods. Its body gives off an herblike scent that bug Pokémon detest.

data.name: Oinkologne

attacks.name: Aromatic Stomps
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't attack.

data.flavorText: This is a meticulous Pokémon that likes to keep things tidy. It shrouds itself in a floral aroma that soothes the Pokémon around it.

data.name: Squawkabilly

attacks.name: Add On
attacks.text: Draw 2 cards.

data.flavorText: Green-feathered flocks hold the most sway. When they're out searching for food in the mornings and evenings, it gets very noisy.

data.name: Maractus

abilities.name: Exploding Needles

attacks.name: Corner
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

data.flavorText: Once each year, this Pokémon scatters its seeds. They're jam-packed with nutrients, making them a precious food source out in the desert.

data.name: Articuno

attacks.name: Frigid Fluttering
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Water Energy cards and attach them to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

data.flavorText: This Pokémon can control ice at will. Articuno is said to live in snowy mountains riddled with permafrost.

data.name: Wailord

attacks.name: Hydro Pump
attacks.text: This attack does 50 more damage for each Water Energy attached to this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Its immense size is the reason for its popularity. Wailord watching is a favorite sightseeing activity in various parts of the world.

data.name: Iono's Kilowattrel

abilities.name: Flashing Draw
abilities.text: You must discard a Basic Lightning Energy from this Pokémon in order to use this Ability. Once during your turn, you may draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand.

data.flavorText: Kilowattrel inflates its throat sac to amplify its electricity. By riding the wind, this Pokémon can fly over 430 miles in a day.

abilities.name: Inviting Wink

data.flavorText: Ribombee can sense when people or Pokémon are feeling down, and it will cheer them up with handmade pollen puffs.

If your opponent guessed right, they draw 4 cards. If they guessed wrong, you draw 4 cards. Then, return the Pokémon to your hand.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

data.name: Tangela
data.flavorText: Hidden beneath a tangle of vines that grows nonstop even if the vines are torn off, this Pokémon's true appearance remains a mystery.

abilities.name: Thicket Body

attacks.text: This attack does 10 less damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Tangrowth has two arms that it can extend as it pleases. Recent research has shown that these arms are, in fact, bundles of vines.

attacks.text: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon. At the end of your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon will be Knocked Out.

data.flavorText: These Pokémon judge one another based on pincers. Thicker, more impressive pincers make for more popularity with the opposite gender.

data.name: Spinarak

data.flavorText: It is very weak. Its only means of defense is to shake its leaves desperately at its attacker.

attacks.name: Mega Drain
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Since it converts sunlight into energy, it is always looking in the direction of the sun.

data.name: Heracross

data.flavorText: With its herculean powers, it can easily throw around an object that is 100 times its own weight.

data.name: Volbeat

attacks.name: Quick Sign
attacks.text: If you go first, you can use this attack during your first turn. Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Coordinated Strike
attacks.text: If Illumise is on your Bench, this attack does 60 more damage.

data.flavorText: It flashes the light on its rear to communicate with other Volbeat. It loves the sweet aroma given off by Illumise.

data.name: Illumise

attacks.name: Slowing Perfume
attacks.text: You can use this attack only if you go second, and only during your first turn. Shuffle 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon and all attached cards into their deck.

data.flavorText: It guides Volbeat to draw signs in the night sky. There are scholars who research the meaning of these signs.

data.name: Leafeon

attacks.name: Leaflet Blessings
attacks.text: Attach a Basic Grass Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Benched Pokémon. If you do, heal all damage from that Pokémon.

data.flavorText: The younger they are, the more they smell like fresh grass. With age, their fragrance takes on the odor of fallen leaves.

data.name: Phantump

attacks.name: Leech Seed
attacks.text: Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: This Pokémon came to be when the spirit of a deceased child possessed a tree stump. It now wanders the forest searching for friends.

data.name: Trevenant

attacks.name: Giga Drain
attacks.text: Heal from this Pokémon the same amount of damage you did to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Trevenant is very kind to Pokémon living in the forest. It doesn't even care if these Pokémon take up residence in the greenery on its head.

data.name: Grookey
data.flavorText: When it uses its special stick to strike up a beat, the sound waves produced carry revitalizing energy to the plants and flowers in the area.

data.name: Thwackey

abilities.name: Boom Boom Groove
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if your Active Pokémon has the Festival Lead Ability, you may search your deck for a card and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

data.flavorText: The faster a Thwackey can beat out a rhythm with its two sticks, the more respect it wins from its peers.

data.name: Rillaboom

attacks.name: Wood Hammer
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 50 damage to itself.

data.flavorText: By drumming, it taps into the power of its special tree stump. The roots of the stump follow its direction in battle.

attacks.name: Tumbling Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

data.flavorText: Applin lives inside an apple. When an Applin is separated from its apple, its body loses moisture and the Pokémon grows weak.

attacks.name: Do the Wave
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each of your Benched Pokémon.

data.flavorText: The head sticking out belongs to the fore-wyrm, while the tail belongs to the core-wyrm. The two share one apple and help each other out.

attacks.text: If any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out by damage from an attack during your opponent's last turn, this attack does 60 more damage.

attacks.name: Dynamic Blaze
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is an Evolution Pokémon, this attack does 140 more damage, and discard all Energy from this Pokémon.

data.name: Poliwag

attacks.name: Tail Rap
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.

data.flavorText: Its legs are newly grown, and it can't walk very well. It seems to prefer swimming through the water instead.

data.name: Poliwhirl

attacks.name: Hypnosis
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Double Slap
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage for each heads.

data.flavorText: Its skin is moist all over its body. The skin on its belly spiral also feels smooth.

data.name: Poliwrath

attacks.name: Hypnosis
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Jumping Uppercut
attacks.text: You may do 120 more damage. If you do, shuffle this Pokémon and all attached cards into your deck.

data.flavorText: It can use its well-developed arms and legs to run on the surface of the water for a split second.

data.name: Goldeen

abilities.name: Festival Lead
abilities.text: If Festival Grounds is in play, this Pokémon may use an attack it has twice. If the first attack Knocks Out your opponent's Active Pokémon, you may attack again after your opponent chooses a new Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Whirlpool
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Its dorsal, pectoral, and tail fins wave elegantly in water. That is why it is known as the Water Dancer.

data.name: Seaking

attacks.name: Peck Off
attacks.text: Before doing damage, discard all Pokémon Tools from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

data.flavorText: In autumn, its body becomes more fatty in preparing to propose to a mate. It takes on beautiful colors.

data.name: Jynx

attacks.name: Inviting Kiss
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck. If you put any Pokémon onto your Bench in this way, move an Energy from this Pokémon to the new Benched Pokémon.

data.flavorText: In certain parts of Galar, Jynx was once feared and worshiped as the Queen of Ice.

data.name: Corphish
data.flavorText: It can live in impure water, where it doesn't need to compete with other water Pokémon for food, so its numbers have steadily increased.

data.name: Crawdaunt

attacks.name: Snip Snip
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. For each heads, discard the top card of your opponent's deck.

attacks.name: Rampaging Hammer
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

data.flavorText: A rough customer that wildly flails its giant claws. It is said to be extremely hard to raise.

data.name: Feebas

attacks.name: Flail
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It is the shabbiest Pokémon of all. It forms schools and lives at the bottom of rivers that teem with plant life.

data.name: Milotic

abilities.name: Mentally Calm
abilities.text: Your opponent's Pokémon in play and all attached cards can't be put into your opponent's hand.

data.flavorText: It lives at the bottom of clear lakes. In times of war, it shows itself, which soothes people's minds and hearts.

data.name: Snorunt

attacks.name: Astonish
attacks.text: Choose a random card from your opponent's hand. Your opponent reveals that card and shuffles it into their deck.

data.flavorText: It is said that a home visited by a Snorunt will prosper. It can withstand cold of −150 degrees Fahrenheit.

data.name: Glalie

attacks.name: Damage Beat
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each damage counter on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Crazy Headbutt
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It prevents prey from escaping by instantaneously freezing moisture in the air.

data.name: Froslass

abilities.name: Freezing Shroud
abilities.text: During Pokémon Checkup, put 1 damage counter on each Pokémon that has an Ability (both yours and your opponent's), except any Froslass.

data.flavorText: It freezes prey by blowing its −58 degree Fahrenheit breath. It is said to then secretly display its prey.

data.name: Glaceon

attacks.name: Permeating Chill
attacks.text: At the end of your opponent's next turn, put 9 damage counters on the Defending Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It lowers its body heat to freeze its fur. The hairs then become like needles it can fire.

data.name: Phione

attacks.name: Beckon
attacks.text: Put a Supporter card from your discard pile into your hand.

attacks.name: Energy Press
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

data.flavorText: When the water warms, they inflate the flotation sac on their heads and drift languidly on the sea in packs.

data.name: Froakie

attacks.name: Flock
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Froakie and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

data.flavorText: It secretes flexible bubbles from its chest and back. The bubbles reduce the damage it would otherwise take when attacked.

data.name: Frogadier

attacks.name: Numbing Water
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

data.flavorText: It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with precise control, hitting empty cans up to a hundred feet away.

data.name: Cramorant

attacks.name: Spit Shot
attacks.text: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon. This attack does 120 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.flavorText: It's an incredibly poor learner because it uses the bare minimum amount of energy for its brain. It focuses on battling instead.

data.name: Finizen

attacks.name: Aqua Slash
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

data.flavorText: Its water ring is made from seawater mixed with a sticky fluid that Finizen secretes from its blowhole.

data.name: Palafin

abilities.name: Zero to Hero
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when this Pokémon moves from the Active Spot to the Bench, you may search your deck for a Palafin ex and switch it with this Pokémon. Any attached cards, damage counters, Special Conditions, turns in play, and any other effects remain on the new Pokémon. If you switched a Pokémon in this way, put this card into your deck. Then, shuffle your deck.

data.flavorText: Its physical capabilities are no different than a Finizen's, but when its allies are in danger, it transforms and powers itself up.

data.name: Palafin ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Hero's Spirit
abilities.text: Put this Pokémon into play only with the effect of Palafin's Zero to Hero Ability.

attacks.name: Giga Impact
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

data.name: Iron Bundle

attacks.name: Interjet
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. If you do, switch out your opponent's Active Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.)

data.flavorText: It resembles a mysterious object mentioned in an old book. There are only two reported sightings of this Pokémon.

data.name: Walking Wake

attacks.name: Aurora Gain
attacks.text: Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Undulating Slice
attacks.text: Put up to 9 damage counters on this Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage for each damage counter you placed in this way.

data.flavorText: This ferocious creature is shrouded in mystery. It's named after an aquatic monster mentioned in an old expedition journal.

data.name: Wellspring Mask Ogerpon ex
rules: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks (both yours and your opponent's).
Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.
Tera: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks (both yours and your opponent's).

attacks.name: Sob
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

attacks.name: Torrential Pump
attacks.text: You may shuffle 3 Energy attached to this Pokémon into your deck. If you do, this attack also does 120 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.name: Zapdos

attacks.name: Thunder Wave
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Thunderbolt
attacks.text: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: This Pokémon has complete control over electricity. There are tales of Zapdos nesting in the dark depths of pitch-black thunderclouds.

data.name: Shinx

attacks.name: Curiosity
attacks.text: Your opponent reveals their hand.

data.flavorText: The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. Its fur glows when it's in trouble.

data.name: Luxio

attacks.name: Big Bite
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

data.flavorText: By gathering their tails together, they collectively generate powerful electricity from their claws.

data.name: Luxray ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Piercing Gaze
attacks.text: Your opponent reveals their hand. Discard a card you find there.

attacks.name: Volt Strike
attacks.text: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon.

data.name: Emolga

attacks.name: Sky Wave
attacks.text: This attack also does 10 damage to each Benched Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's). (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.flavorText: As Emolga flutters through the air, it crackles with electricity. This Pokémon is cute, but it can cause a lot of trouble.

data.name: Helioptile

attacks.name: Collect
attacks.text: Draw a card.

data.flavorText: When spread, the frills on its head act like solar panels, generating the power behind this Pokémon's electric moves.

data.name: Heliolisk

attacks.name: Wild Charge
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 20 damage to itself.

data.flavorText: A now-vanished desert culture treasured these Pokémon. Appropriately, when Heliolisk came to the Galar region, treasure came with them.

data.name: Morpeko

abilities.name: Snack Seek
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may look at the top card of your deck. You may discard that card.

attacks.name: Pick and Stick
attacks.text: Attach up to 2 Basic Energy cards from your discard pile to your Pokémon in any way you like.

data.flavorText: It has a small stomach. If it isn't constantly eating the seeds it keeps in its pockets, it will get hungry immediately.

data.name: Tadbulb
data.flavorText: It floats using the electricity stored in its body. When thunderclouds are around, Tadbulb will float higher off the ground.

data.name: Bellibolt

attacks.name: Thunder Shock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

data.flavorText: What appear to be eyeballs are actually organs for discharging the electricity generated by Bellibolt's belly-button dynamo.

data.name: Wattrel

attacks.name: Thunder Shock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

data.flavorText: These Pokémon make their nests on coastal cliffs. The nests have a strange, crackling texture, and they're a popular delicacy.

data.name: Kilowattrel

attacks.name: Wind Power Charge
attacks.text: During your next turn, attacks used by this Pokémon do 120 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Strong Volt
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It uses its throat sac to store electricity generated by its wings. There's hardly any oil in its feathers, so it is a poor swimmer.

data.name: Iron Thorns ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Initialization
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, Pokémon with a Rule Box in play (both yours and your opponent's) have no Abilities, except for Future Pokémon. (Pokémon ex, Pokémon V, etc. have Rule Boxes.)

attacks.name: Volt Cyclone
attacks.text: Move an Energy from this Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

data.name: Clefairy
data.flavorText: On nights with a full moon, they gather together and dance. The surrounding area is enveloped in an abnormal magnetic field.

data.name: Clefable

attacks.name: Metronome
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Active Pokémon's attacks and use it as this attack.

data.flavorText: It has an acute sense of hearing. It can easily hear a pin being dropped nearly 1,100 yards away.

data.name: Abra

abilities.name: Teleporter
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may shuffle it and all attached cards into your deck.

data.flavorText: This Pokémon uses its psychic powers while it sleeps. The contents of Abra's dreams affect the powers that the Pokémon wields.

data.name: Kadabra

attacks.name: Psychic
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Using its psychic power, Kadabra levitates as it sleeps. It uses its springy tail as a pillow.

data.name: Alakazam

attacks.name: Strange Hacking
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused. You may move any number of damage counters from your opponent's Pokémon to their other Pokémon in any way you like.

attacks.name: Psychic
attacks.text: This attack does 50 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It has an incredibly high level of intelligence. Some say that Alakazam remembers everything that ever happens to it, from birth till death.

data.name: Girafarig

attacks.name: Dual Headbutt
attacks.text: This attack also does 10 damage to 1 of your Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.flavorText: Girafarig's tail has a small head. It instinctively bites at any foe that approaches the Pokémon from behind.

data.name: Farigiraf

attacks.name: One-derful Rumble
attacks.text: This attack does 40 damage for each of your Stage 1 Pokémon in play.

attacks.name: Eerie Wave
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

data.flavorText: The hardened head from the tail protects the head of the main body as Farigiraf whips its long neck around to headbutt enemies.

data.name: Chimecho

attacks.name: Homeward Chime
attacks.text: Shuffle 1 of your Benched Pokémon and all attached cards into your deck.

data.flavorText: Its cries echo inside its hollow body to emerge as beautiful notes for startling and repelling foes.

data.name: Flabébé

attacks.name: Bind Wound
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.

data.flavorText: This Flabébé rides a red flower. Immediately after birth, this Pokémon begins flying around in search of a flower it likes.

data.name: Floette

attacks.name: Minor Errand-Running
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 3 Basic Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

data.flavorText: This Pokémon uses red wavelengths of light to pour its own energy into flowers and draw forth their latent potential.

data.name: Florges

abilities.name: Captivating Invitation
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may flip a coin. If heads, switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot, and the new Active Pokémon is now Confused.

data.flavorText: They say that flower gardens created by Florges are constantly showered with a power that can heal both body and spirit.

data.name: Swirlix

abilities.name: Festival Lead
abilities.text: If Festival Grounds is in play, this Pokémon may use an attack it has twice. If the first attack Knocks Out your opponent's Active Pokémon, you may attack again after your opponent chooses a new Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Sneaky Placement
attacks.text: Put 2 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It eats its own weight in sugar every day. If it doesn't get enough sugar, it becomes incredibly grumpy.

data.name: Slurpuff

attacks.name: Slurp Slurp
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 90 damage for each heads. If both of them are tails,  your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

data.flavorText: By taking in a person's scent, it can sniff out their mental and physical condition. It's hoped that this skill will have many medical applications.

data.name: Sandygast

attacks.name: Sand Attack
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, if the Defending Pokémon tries to use an attack, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack doesn't happen.

data.flavorText: It flings sand into the eyes of its prey and tries to close in on them while they're blinded, but since Sandygast is so slow, the prey tends to escape.

data.name: Palossand

attacks.name: Sand Attack
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, if the Defending Pokémon tries to use an attack, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack doesn't happen.

data.flavorText: From the hollows in its arms, it fires the bones of its victims, which are all dried up after being drained of their vitality.

data.name: Enamorus

attacks.name: Love Resonance
attacks.text: If any of your Pokémon in play are the same type as any of your opponent's Pokémon in play, this attack does 120 more damage.

data.flavorText: When it flies to this land from across the sea, the bitter winter comes to an end. According to legend, this Pokémon's love gives rise to the budding of fresh life across Hisui.

data.name: Scream Tail ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Scream
attacks.text: You can use this attack only if you go second, and only during your first turn. Your opponent can't play any Supporter cards from their hand during their next turn.

attacks.name: Crunch
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

data.name: Munkidori

abilities.name: Adrena-Brain
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon has any Darkness Energy attached, you may move up to 3 damage counters from 1 of your Pokémon to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Mind Bend
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

data.flavorText: Munkidori keeps itself somewhere safe while it toys with its foes, using psychokinesis to induce intense dizziness.

data.name: Fezandipiti

abilities.name: Adrena-Pheromone
abilities.text: If this Pokémon has any Darkness Energy attached and is damaged by an attack, flip a coin. If heads, prevent that damage.

attacks.name: Energy Feather
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage for each Energy attached to this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Fezandipiti beats its glossy wings to scatter pheromones that captivate people and Pokémon.

data.name: Sandshrew

attacks.name: Double Scratch
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.

data.flavorText: No matter how high a place it falls from, this Pokémon can save itself by rolling into a ball and bouncing.

data.name: Sandslash

attacks.name: Earthquake
attacks.text: This attack also does 10 damage to each of your Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.flavorText: The spikes on its body are made up of its hardened hide. It rolls up and attacks foes with its spikes.

data.name: Hisuian Growlithe

attacks.name: Blazing Destruction
attacks.text: Discard a Stadium in play.

attacks.name: Take Down
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

data.flavorText: They patrol their territory in pairs. I believe the igneous rock components in the fur of this species are the result of volcanic activity in its habitat.

data.name: Hisuian Arcanine

attacks.name: Proud Fangs
attacks.text: If your Benched Pokémon have any damage counters on them, this attack does 90 more damage.

attacks.name: Searing Flame
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

data.flavorText: Snaps at its foes with fangs cloaked in blazing flame. Despite its bulk, it deftly feints every which way, leading opponents on a deceptively merry chase as it all but dances around them.

data.name: Nosepass

attacks.name: Power Rush
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, during your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

data.flavorText: When endangered, it may protect itself by increasing its magnetism and drawing nearby iron objects to its body.

data.name: Probopass

attacks.name: Assault Laser
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool attached, this attack does 80 more damage.

data.flavorText: Probopass radiates such a powerful magnetic field that nearby electrical appliances are rendered useless while it's around.

data.name: Timburr

attacks.name: Best Punch
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

data.flavorText: It fights by swinging a piece of lumber around. It is close to evolving when it can handle heavy lumber without difficulty.

data.name: Gurdurr

attacks.name: Superpower
attacks.text: You may do 30 more damage. If you do, this Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

data.flavorText: This Pokémon is so muscular and strongly built that even a group of wrestlers could not make it budge an inch.

data.name: Conkeldurr

attacks.name: Tantrum
attacks.text: This Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Gutsy Swing
attacks.text: If this Pokémon is affected by a Special Condition, ignore all Energy in this attack's cost.

data.flavorText: Rather than rely on their strength, they master moves that make good use of centrifugal force to swing around concrete.

data.name: Greninja ex
rules: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks (both yours and your opponent's).
Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.
Tera: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks (both yours and your opponent's).

attacks.name: Shinobi Blade
attacks.text: You may search your deck for a card and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Mirage Barrage
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon. This attack does 120 damage to 2 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.name: Hawlucha

attacks.name: Prize Count
attacks.text: If you have more Prize cards remaining than your opponent, this attack does 90 more damage.

data.flavorText: Hawlucha live quietly without flocking together. They fight constantly with their natural enemies: noisy groups of Primeape.

data.name: Glimmet

attacks.name: Rock Shot
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Glimmet's toxic mineral crystals look just like flower petals. This Pokémon scatters poisonous powder like pollen to protect itself.

data.name: Glimmora

attacks.name: Stun Poison
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed and Poisoned.

attacks.name: Venoshock
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Poisoned, this attack does 100 more damage.

data.flavorText: Glimmora's petals are made of crystallized poison energy. It has recently become evident that these petals resemble Tera Jewels.

data.name: Ting-Lu

attacks.name: Ground Crasher
attacks.text: If a Stadium is in play, this attack also does 30 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon, and discard that Stadium. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.flavorText: It slowly brings its exceedingly heavy head down upon the ground, splitting the earth open with huge fissures that run over 160 feet deep.

data.name: Okidogi

abilities.name: Adrena-Power
abilities.text: If this Pokémon has any Darkness Energy attached, it gets +100 HP, and the attacks it uses do 100 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

data.flavorText: Okidogi is a ruffian with a short temper. It can pulverize anything by swinging around the chain on its neck.

data.name: Cornerstone Mask Ogerpon ex
rules: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks (both yours and your opponent's).
Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.
Tera: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks (both yours and your opponent's).

abilities.name: Cornerstone Stance
abilities.text: Prevent all damage from attacks done to this Pokémon by your opponent's Pokémon that have an Ability.

attacks.name: Demolish
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance, or by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

data.name: Poochyena

attacks.name: Continuous Steps
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.

data.flavorText: Poochyena pursue their prey in packs. Once the prey is exhausted, the pack finishes it off. But sometimes the prey retaliates, and the pack flees.

data.name: Mightyena

attacks.name: Hunting Pack
attacks.text: If Mightyena is on your Bench, this attack does 90 more damage.

attacks.name: Corner
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

data.flavorText: Once it's caught the scent of faraway prey, the leader gives a signal, and the whole pack moves out.

data.name: Venipede

attacks.name: Spit Poison
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

data.flavorText: Venipede and Sizzlipede are similar species, but when the two meet, a huge fight ensues.

data.name: Whirlipede

attacks.name: Poison Ring
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

data.flavorText: This Pokémon spins itself rapidly and charges into its opponents. Its top speed is just over 60 mph.

data.name: Scolipede

attacks.name: Dastardly Jab
attacks.text: Put damage counters on your opponent's Active Pokémon until its remaining HP is 10.

data.flavorText: Scolipede latches on to its prey with the claws on its neck before slamming them into the ground and jabbing them with its claws' toxic spikes.

data.name: Brute Bonnet

attacks.name: Poison Spray
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Relentless Punches
attacks.text: This attack does 50 more damage for each damage counter on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It is possible that the creature listed as Brute Bonnet in a certain book could actually be this Pokémon.

data.name: Skarmory

attacks.name: Big Storm
attacks.text: Discard a Stadium in play.

data.flavorText: People fashion swords from Skarmory's shed feathers, so this Pokémon is a popular element in heraldic designs.

data.name: Aron

attacks.name: Double-Edge
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

data.flavorText: It eats iron ore—and sometimes railroad tracks— to build up the steel armor that protects its body.

data.name: Lairon

attacks.name: Steel Tackle
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 20 damage to itself.

data.flavorText: Lairon live in mountains brimming with spring water and iron ore, so these Pokémon often came into conflict with humans in the past.

data.name: Aggron

attacks.name: Angry Slam
attacks.text: This attack does 50 damage for each of your Pokémon that has any damage counters on it.

attacks.name: Guard Claw
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 50 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

data.flavorText: Aggron has a horn sharp enough to perforate thick iron sheets. It brings down its opponents by ramming into them horn first.

data.name: Heatran

abilities.name: Incandescent Body
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), the Attacking Pokémon is now Burned.

attacks.name: Steel Burst
attacks.text: Discard all Metal Energy from this Pokémon. This attack does 50 damage for each card you discarded in this way.

data.flavorText: It dwells in volcanic caves. It digs in with its cross-shaped feet to crawl on ceilings and walls.

data.name: Varoom

attacks.name: Metal Coating
attacks.text: Attach a Basic Metal Energy card from your discard pile to this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: The steel section is Varoom's actual body. This Pokémon clings to rocks and converts the minerals within into energy to fuel its activities.

data.name: Revavroom

attacks.name: Rally Back
attacks.text: If any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out by damage from an attack during your opponent's last turn, this attack does 90 more damage.

attacks.name: Running Charge
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 100 damage for each heads.

data.flavorText: Revavroom viciously threatens others with the sound of its exhaust. It sticks its tongue out from its cylindrical mouth and sprays toxic fluids.

data.name: Applin

attacks.name: Find a Friend
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

data.flavorText: Applin lives inside an apple. When an Applin is separated from its apple, its body loses moisture and the Pokémon grows weak.

data.name: Dipplin

attacks.name: Syrup Catcher
attacks.text: Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot. This attack does 70 damage to the new Active Pokémon.

data.flavorText: The head sticking out belongs to the fore-wyrm, while the tail belongs to the core-wyrm. The two share one apple and help each other out.

data.name: Dreepy
data.flavorText: It has a habit of biting at Clauncher even though it doesn't feed on them. This is said to be vestigial behavior from when Dreepy was alive.

data.name: Drakloak

abilities.name: Recon Directive
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may look at the top 2 cards of your deck and put 1 of them into your hand. Put the other card on the bottom of your deck.

data.flavorText: This Pokémon stores up energy in its lungs, then shoots it out. It takes care of Dreepy and battles alongside them until they're all grown up.

Tera: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks (both yours and your opponent's).

attacks.name: Phantom Dive
attacks.text: Put 6 damage counters on your opponent's Benched Pokémon in any way you like.

data.name: Tatsugiri

abilities.name: Attract Customers
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may look at the top 6 cards of your deck, reveal a Supporter card you find there, and put it into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.

data.flavorText: Tatsugiri is an extremely cunning Pokémon. It feigns weakness to lure in prey, then orders its partner to attack.

data.name: Farfetch'd

abilities.name: Impromptu Carrier
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may search your deck for a Pokémon Tool card and attach it to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Mach Cut
attacks.text: Discard a Special Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

data.flavorText: The stalk this Pokémon carries in its wings serves as a sword to cut down opponents. In a dire situation, the stalk can also serve as food.

data.name: Chansey

attacks.name: Lucky Attachment
attacks.text: Attach a Basic Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Boundless Power
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

data.flavorText: It walks carefully to prevent its egg from breaking. However, it is extremely fast at running away.

data.name: Blissey ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Happy Switch
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may move a Basic Energy from 1 of your Pokémon to another of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Return
attacks.text: You may draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand.

data.name: Eevee

attacks.name: Ascension
attacks.text: Search your deck for a card that evolves from this Pokémon and put it onto this Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

data.flavorText: Its genetic code is irregular. It may mutate if it is exposed to radiation from element stones.

data.name: Snorlax

attacks.name: But First, Food
attacks.text: Attach an Energy card from your hand to this Pokémon. If you do, heal 60 damage from this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Its stomach's digestive juices can dissolve any kind of poison. Eating things off the ground doesn't bother it at all.

data.name: Aipom
data.flavorText: Its tail moves with greater dexterity than its hands. Making deft use of this tail, Aipom lives high among the treetops.

data.name: Ambipom

abilities.name: Wicked Tail
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may flip 2 coins. For each heads, choose a random card from your opponent's hand. Your opponent reveals those cards and shuffles them into their deck.

data.flavorText: Split into two, the tails are so adept at handling and doing things that Ambipom rarely uses its hands.

data.name: Ducklett

attacks.name: Double Draw
attacks.text: Draw 2 cards.

data.flavorText: It strengthens its body by diving into the depths of ponds, swimming around while looking for bog moss to eat.

data.name: Swanna

attacks.name: Fighting Wings
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Pokémon ex or Pokémon V, this attack does 90 more damage.

data.flavorText: It's said that many artists have taken inspiration from the sight of a Swanna performing a beautiful dance in the light of dawn.

abilities.text: Blood Moon used by this Pokémon costs Colorless less for each Prize card your opponent has taken.
