attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

data.name: Accompanying Flute
rules: Reveal the top 5 cards of your opponent's deck. You may choose any number of Basic Pokémon you find there and put those Pokémon onto their Bench. Your opponent shuffles the other cards back into their deck.
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

data.name: Bug Catching Set

You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

data.name: Caretaker
rules: Draw 2 cards. If you drew any cards in this way and if Community Center is in play, shuffle this Caretaker into your deck instead of discarding it.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

data.name: Carmine
rules: If you go first, you may use this card during your first turn.    Discard your hand and draw 5 cards.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

data.name: Community Center
rules: Once during each player's turn, if they played a Supporter card from their hand this turn, they may heal 10 damage from each of their Pokémon.

You may play only 1 Stadium card during your turn. Put it into the Active Spot, and discard it if another Stadium comes into play. A Stadium with the same name can't be played.

attacks.text: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon. At the end of your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon will be Knocked Out.

data.flavorText: These Pokémon judge one another based on pincers. Thicker, more impressive pincers make for more popularity with the opposite gender.

data.name: Sunflora

attacks.text: This attack does 60 damage for each Fire Energy attached to all of your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Mega Drain
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Since it converts sunlight into energy, it is always looking in the direction of the sun.

data.flavorText: Poltchageist looks like a regional form of Sinistea, but it was recently discovered that the two Pokémon are entirely unrelated.

data.name: Torkoal

attacks.name: Ramming Shell
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Fire Spin
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Coal is the source of Torkoal's energy. Large amounts of coal can be found in the mountains where they live.

data.name: Infernape

abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may attach a Basic Fire Energy card, a Basic Fighting Energy card, or 1 of each from your hand to your Pokémon in any way you like.

attacks.name: Scorching Fire
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Its crown of fire is indicative of its fiery nature. It is beaten by none in terms of quickness.

data.name: Froslass

abilities.name: Freezing Shroud
abilities.text: During Pokémon Checkup, put 1 damage counter on each Pokémon that has an Ability (both yours and your opponent's), except any Froslass.

data.flavorText: It freezes prey by blowing its −58 degree Fahrenheit breath. It is said to then secretly display its prey.

data.name: Phione

attacks.name: Beckon

attacks.name: Energy Press
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

data.flavorText: When the water warms, they inflate the flotation sac on their heads and drift languidly on the sea in packs.

data.name: Cramorant

attacks.name: Spit Shot
attacks.text: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon. This attack does 120 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.flavorText: It's an incredibly poor learner because it uses the bare minimum amount of energy for its brain. It focuses on battling instead.

data.name: Heliolisk

attacks.name: Wild Charge
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 20 damage to itself.

data.flavorText: A now-vanished desert culture treasured these Pokémon. Appropriately, when Heliolisk came to the Galar region, treasure came with them.

data.name: Wattrel

attacks.name: Thunder Shock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

data.flavorText: These Pokémon make their nests on coastal cliffs. The nests have a strange, crackling texture, and they're a popular delicacy.

data.name: Chimecho

attacks.name: Homeward Chime
attacks.text: Shuffle 1 of your Benched Pokémon and all attached cards into your deck.

data.flavorText: Its cries echo inside its hollow body to emerge as beautiful notes for startling and repelling foes.

data.name: Enamorus

attacks.name: Love Resonance
attacks.text: If any of your Pokémon in play are the same type as any of your opponent's Pokémon in play, this attack does 120 more damage.

data.flavorText: When it flies to this land from across the sea, the bitter winter comes to an end. According to legend, this Pokémon's love gives rise to the budding of fresh life across Hisui.

data.name: Hisuian Growlithe

attacks.name: Blazing Destruction
attacks.text: Discard a Stadium in play.

attacks.name: Take Down
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

data.flavorText: They patrol their territory in pairs. I believe the igneous rock components in the fur of this species are the result of volcanic activity in its habitat.

data.name: Probopass

attacks.name: Assault Laser
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool attached, this attack does 80 more damage.

data.flavorText: Probopass radiates such a powerful magnetic field that nearby electrical appliances are rendered useless while it's around.

attacks.name: Best Punch
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

data.flavorText: It fights by swinging a piece of lumber around. It is close to evolving when it can handle heavy lumber without difficulty.

data.name: Lairon

attacks.name: Steel Tackle
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 20 damage to itself.

data.flavorText: Lairon live in mountains brimming with spring water and iron ore, so these Pokémon often came into conflict with humans in the past.

data.flavorText: The way it brushes away grime with its tail can be helpful when cleaning. But its focus on spotlessness can make cleaning more of a hassle.

data.name: Cinccino

attacks.name: Special Roll

data.flavorText: Its body secretes oil that this Pokémon spreads over its nest as a coating to protect it from dust. Cinccino won't tolerate even a speck of the stuff.

data.name: Bronzor

attacks.name: Mirror Attack
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Psychic Pokémon, this attack does 30 more damage.

data.flavorText: Ancient people believed that the pattern on Bronzor's back contained a mysterious power.

data.name: Reuniclus

attacks.name: Summoning Gate
attacks.text: Look at the top 8 cards of your deck. You may put any number of Pokémon you find there onto your Bench. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.

attacks.name: Brain Shake
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

data.flavorText: While it could use its psychic abilities in battle, this Pokémon prefers to swing its powerful arms around to beat opponents into submission.

data.name: Cutiefly

attacks.name: Mini Drain
attacks.text: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Nectar and pollen are its favorite fare. You can find Cutiefly hovering around Gossifleur, trying to get some of Gossifleur's pollen.

data.name: Relicanth

abilities.name: Memory Dive
abilities.text: Each of your evolved Pokémon can use any attack from its previous Evolutions. (You still need the necessary Energy to use each attack.)

data.flavorText: Rock-hard scales and oil-filled swim bladders allow this Pokémon to survive the intense water pressure of the deep sea.

data.name: Excadrill

attacks.name: Wild Tackle
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 50 damage to itself.

data.flavorText: It's not uncommon for tunnels that appear to have formed naturally to actually be a result of Excadrill's rampant digging.

data.name: Mudsdale

attacks.name: Mud Stock
attacks.text: Attach a Basic Fighting Energy card from your discard pile to each of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: High Horsepower
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 40 damage to itself.

data.flavorText: This Pokémon has been treasured not just for its physical labor but also because it produces high-quality mud used for making pottery.

data.name: Arbok

attacks.name: Panic Poison
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned, Confused, and Poisoned.

data.flavorText: The pattern on its belly appears to be a frightening face. Weak foes will flee just at the sight of the pattern.

data.name: Gastly

attacks.name: Mysterious Beam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It wraps its opponent in its gas-like body, slowly weakening its prey by poisoning it through the skin.

data.name: Metagross

attacks.name: Meteor Mash
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon's Meteor Mash attack does 60 more damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Luster Blast
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Because the magnetic powers of these Pokémon get stronger in freezing temperatures, Metagross living on snowy mountains are full of energy.

data.name: Meltan
data.flavorText: It dissolves and eats metal. Circulating liquid metal within its body is how it generates energy.

data.name: Lickitung

attacks.name: Tongue Pull
attacks.text: Your opponent reveals their hand. Put up to 2 Basic Pokémon you find there onto your opponent's Bench.

data.flavorText: If this Pokémon's sticky saliva gets on you and you don't clean it off, an intense itch will set in. The itch won't go away, either.

data.name: Chatot

attacks.name: A Cappella
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 3 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

data.flavorText: It mimics the cries of other Pokémon to trick them into thinking it's one of them. This way they won't attack it.

data.name: Minccino

attacks.name: Cleaning Up
attacks.text: Discard up to 2 Pokémon Tools from your opponent's Pokémon.

data.flavorText: The way it brushes away grime with its tail can be helpful when cleaning. But its focus on spotlessness can make cleaning more of a hassle.

data.name: Cinccino

attacks.name: Special Roll
attacks.text: This attack does 70 damage for each Special Energy card attached to this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Its body secretes oil that this Pokémon spreads over its nest as a coating to protect it from dust. Cinccino won't tolerate even a speck of the stuff.

data.name: Drampa

attacks.name: Raging Cannon
attacks.text: If all of your Benched Pokémon have at least 1 damage counter on them, this attack does 120 more damage.

data.flavorText: The mountains it calls home are nearly two miles in height. On rare occasions, it descends to play with the children living in the towns below.

attacks.name: Forest March
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage for each of your Grass Pokémon in play.

attacks.name: Jungle Hammer
attacks.text: Heal 50 damage from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Prism Edge
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

data.name: Surskit

attacks.name: Triple Spin
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.

data.flavorText: It secretes a thick, sweet-scented syrup from the tip of its head. It lives on weed-choked ponds.

data.name: Masquerain

attacks.name: Daunting Eyes
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. For each heads, shuffle an Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon into their deck.

data.flavorText: The antennae have distinctive patterns that look like eyes. When it rains, they grow heavy, making flight impossible.

data.name: Froslass ex
rules: Tera: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks (both yours and your opponent's).
Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Evanescent
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is Knocked Out, flip a coin. If heads, your opponent takes 1 fewer Prize card.

attacks.name: Frost Bullet
attacks.text: This attack also does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.name: Pansage

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Leech Seed
attacks.text: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It's good at finding berries and gathers them from all over. It's kind enough to share them with friends.

data.name: Simisage

abilities.name: Monkey Trio
abilities.text: If you have Simisage, Simisear, and Simipour in play, ignore all Colorless Energy in the costs of attacks used by this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Arm Thrust Needle
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from Pokémon that have an Ability, except any Simisage.

data.flavorText: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.

data.name: Dwebble
data.flavorText: It first tries to find a rock to live in, but if there are no suitable rocks to be found, Dwebble may move in to the ports of a Hippowdon.

data.name: Crustle

attacks.name: Crag Bash
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 100 less damage from attacks from Evolution Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

data.flavorText: Its thick claws are its greatest weapons. They're mighty enough to crack Rhyperior's carapace.

data.name: Bounsweet

attacks.name: Quick Blow
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

data.flavorText: Its sweat is sweet, like syrup made from boiled- down fruit. Because of this, Bounsweet was highly valued in the past, when sweeteners were scarce.

data.name: Steenee

attacks.name: Double Spin
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 40 damage for each heads.

data.flavorText: Steenee spreads a sweet scent that makes others feel invigorated. This same scent is popular for antiperspirants.

data.name: Blipbug

attacks.name: Surprise Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

data.flavorText: Often found in gardens, this Pokémon has hairs on its body that it uses to assess its surroundings.

data.name: Dottler

attacks.name: Protect
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: As it grows inside its shell, it uses its psychic abilities to monitor the outside world and prepare for evolution.

data.name: Orbeetle

attacks.name: Satellite Beam
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage for each Energy card in your opponent's discard pile.

attacks.name: Brain Shake
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

data.flavorText: It emits psychic energy to observe and study what's around it—and what's around it can include things over six miles away.

data.name: Nymble
data.flavorText: It has its third set of legs folded up. When it's in a tough spot, this Pokémon jumps over 30 feet using the strength of its legs.

data.name: Nymble
data.flavorText: It has its third set of legs folded up. When it's in a tough spot, this Pokémon jumps over 30 feet using the strength of its legs.

data.name: Toedscool

attacks.name: Clinging Spore
attacks.text: Attach a Basic Grass Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Though it looks like Tentacool, Toedscool is a completely different species. Its legs may be thin, but it can run at a speed of 30 mph.

data.name: Toedscool

attacks.name: Absorb
attacks.text: Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Though it looks like Tentacool, Toedscool is a completely different species. Its legs may be thin, but it can run at a speed of 30 mph.

data.name: Toedscruel

abilities.name: Slime Mold Colony
abilities.text: Cards in your opponent's discard pile can't be put into their hand by an effect of your opponent's Abilities or Trainer cards.

attacks.name: Mushroom Drain
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It coils its 10 tentacles around prey and sucks out their nutrients, causing the prey pain. The folds along the rim of its head are a popular delicacy.

data.name: Wo-Chien

attacks.name: Leaf Bringer
attacks.text: Attach up to 2 Basic Grass Energy cards from your discard pile to 1 of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Binding Greed
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, attacks used by the Defending Pokémon cost ColorlessColorless more.

data.flavorText: It drains the life-force from vegetation, causing nearby forests to instantly wither and fields to turn barren.

data.name: Magby

attacks.name: Scorching Heater
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, if this Pokémon is damaged by an attack (even if it is Knocked Out), put 6 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon.

data.flavorText: This Pokémon makes its home near volcanoes. At the end of the day, Magby soaks in magma, resting and recovering from the day's fatigue.

data.name: Pansear

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Searing Flame
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

data.flavorText: This Pokémon lives in caves in volcanoes. The fire within the tuft on its head can reach 600 degrees Fahrenheit.

data.name: Simisear

abilities.name: Monkey Trio
abilities.text: If you have Simisage, Simisear, and Simipour in play, ignore all Colorless Energy in the costs of attacks used by this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Heat Tackle
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

data.flavorText: When it gets excited, embers rise from its head and tail and it gets hot. For some reason, it loves sweets.

data.name: Volcanion

attacks.name: Dual Turbo
attacks.text: Choose up to 2 of your Benched Pokémon and attach a Basic Fire Energy card from your discard pile to each of them.

data.flavorText: It expels its internal steam from the arms on its back. It has enough power to blow away a mountain.

data.name: Fuecoco
data.flavorText: It lies on warm rocks and uses the heat absorbed by its square-shaped scales to create fire energy.

data.name: Crocalor

attacks.name: Rolling Fireball
attacks.text: Put an Energy attached to this Pokémon into your hand.

data.flavorText: The combination of Crocalor's fire energy and overflowing vitality has caused an egg-shaped fireball to appear on the Pokémon's head.

data.name: Charcadet

attacks.name: Protect
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.

data.name: Charcadet

attacks.name: Fiery Fighting Spirit
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Basic Fire Energy card and attach it to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

data.flavorText: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.

data.name: Armarouge ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Crimson Armor
abilities.text: If this Pokémon has full HP, it takes 80 less damage from attacks from your opponent's Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Scorching Bazooka
attacks.text: This attack does 40 more damage for each Fire Energy attached to this Pokémon.

data.name: Iron Moth

abilities.name: Thermal Reactor
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when this Pokémon moves from your Bench to the Active Spot, you may move any amount of Fire Energy from your other Pokémon to it.

attacks.name: Heat Ray
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Heat Ray.

data.flavorText: No records exist of this species being caught. Data is lacking, but the Pokémon's traits match up with an object described in an old book.

data.name: Chi-Yu

attacks.name: Flare Bringer
attacks.text: Attach up to 2 Basic Fire Energy cards from your discard pile to 1 of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Megafire of Envy
attacks.text: If any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out by damage from an attack during your opponent's last turn, this attack does 90 more damage.

data.flavorText: It controls flames burning at over 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit. It casually swims through the sea of lava it creates by melting rock and sand.

data.name: Horsea
data.flavorText: They swim with dance-like motions and cause whirlpools to form. Horsea compete to see which of them can generate the biggest whirlpool.

data.name: Seadra

attacks.name: Bubble Beam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

data.flavorText: Seadra's mouth is slender, but its suction power is strong. In an instant, Seadra can suck in food that's larger than the opening of its mouth.

data.name: Kingdra

attacks.name: Whirltide
attacks.text: Reveal the top 6 cards of your deck. This attack does 60 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon for each Energy card you find there. Then, discard those Energy cards and shuffle the other cards back into your deck. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.flavorText: Scales shed by this Pokémon have such a splendorous gleam to them that they've been given to royalty as gifts.

data.name: Remoraid
data.flavorText: Using its dorsal fin as a suction pad, it clings to a Mantine's underside to scavenge for leftovers.

data.name: Octillery

abilities.name: Suction Cup Draw
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may draw 3 cards.

attacks.name: Smokescreen Shot
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, if the Defending Pokémon tries to use an attack, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack doesn't happen.

data.flavorText: It traps enemies with its suction-cupped tentacles, then smashes them with its rock-hard head.

data.name: Feebas

attacks.name: Drawup Power
attacks.text: Search your deck for an Energy card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

data.flavorText: It is a shabby and ugly Pokémon. However, it is very hardy and can survive on little water.

data.name: Milotic

abilities.name: Lifeboat
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may use this Ability. Each player puts a Basic Pokémon from their discard pile onto their Bench. (Your opponent puts a Basic Pokémon onto their Bench first.)

attacks.name: Hypno Splash
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

data.flavorText: It's said that a glimpse of a Milotic and its beauty will calm any hostile emotions you're feeling.

data.name: Snorunt

attacks.name: Ice Shard
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Fighting Pokémon, this attack does 30 more damage.

data.flavorText: It is said that several Snorunt gather under giant leaves and live together in harmony.

data.name: Garchomp ex
rules: Tera: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks (both yours and your opponent's).
Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Hydro Lander
attacks.text: Attach up to 3 Basic Fighting Energy cards from your discard pile to your Benched Pokémon in any way you like.

attacks.name: Sonic Dive
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon. This attack does 120 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.name: Mantyke

attacks.name: Buoyant Healing

abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may flip a coin. If heads, attach up to 4 Basic Energy cards from your discard pile to this Pokémon. If tails, discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Energized Attack
attacks.text: This attack does 40 damage for each Energy attached to this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Some say an additional program made this Pokémon evolve, but even academics can't agree on whether Porygon-Z is really an evolution.

data.name: Cyclizar

attacks.name: Driving Buddy
attacks.text: If you played a Supporter card from your hand during this turn, this attack does 70 more damage.

data.flavorText: Apparently Cyclizar has been allowing people to ride on its back since ancient times. Depictions of this have been found in 10,000-year-old murals.

attacks.name: Homing Headbutt

attacks.name: Baryon Beam
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has a Future Booster Energy Capsule attached, this attack can be used for ColorlessColorlessColorless.

data.flavorText: It's possible that Iron Jugulis, an object described in an old book, may actually be this Pokémon.

rules: The Retreat Cost of each Basic Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent's) is Colorless less.

data.name: Counter Catcher
rules: You can use this card only if you have more Prize cards remaining than your opponent.  Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot.
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

data.name: Luxurious Cape
rules: If the Pokémon this card is attached to doesn't have a Rule Box, it gets +100 HP, and if it is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, that player takes 1 more Prize card. (Pokémon ex, Pokémon V, etc. have Rule Boxes.)
You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached.

data.name: Reversal Energy
rules: As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides Colorless Energy.    If you have more Prize cards remaining than your opponent, and if this card is attached to an Evolution Pokémon that doesn't have a Rule Box (Pokémon ex, Pokémon V, etc. have Rule Boxes), this card provides every type of Energy but provides only 3 Energy at a time.

data.name: Oddish

attacks.name: Feelin' Fine
attacks.text: Draw a card.

data.flavorText: During the day, it stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun. It grows by bathing in moonlight.

data.name: Gloom

attacks.name: Inviting Scent
attacks.text: Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot.

data.flavorText: What appears to be drool is actually sweet honey. It is very sticky and clings stubbornly if touched.

data.name: Bellossom

attacks.name: Sleep Powder
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Powerful Dance
attacks.text: Flip a coin for each Energy attached to this Pokémon. This attack does 90 damage for each heads.

data.flavorText: Bellossom gather at times and appear to dance. They say that the dance is a ritual to summon the sun.

data.name: Scyther

attacks.name: Agility
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It slashes through grass with its sharp scythes, moving too fast for the human eye to track.

data.name: Shuckle

attacks.name: Berry Scent
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Guard Press
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

data.flavorText: The berries stored in its vaselike shell eventually become a thick, pulpy juice.

data.name: Surskit

attacks.name: Lunge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

data.flavorText: They usually live on ponds, but after an evening shower, they may appear on puddles in towns.

data.name: Masquerain

attacks.name: Panic-Prompting Pattern
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. For each heads, discard a random card from your opponent's hand.

data.flavorText: It flaps its four wings to hover and fly freely in any direction—to and fro and sideways.

data.name: Combee

attacks.name: Share
attacks.text: Heal 20 damage from 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

data.flavorText: At night, Combee sleep in a group of about a hundred, packed closely together in a lump.

data.name: Foongus

attacks.name: Enticing Pattern
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Basic Grass Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

data.flavorText: There is a theory that the developer of the modern-day Poké Ball really liked Foongus, but this has not been confirmed.

data.name: Amoonguss

attacks.name: Dangerous Spores
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed and Poisoned.

data.flavorText: Be wary of the poisonous spores it releases. Mushrooms resembling Amoonguss's caps will grow out of anywhere the spores touch.

data.name: Phantump
data.flavorText: With a voice like a human child's, it cries out to lure adults deep into the forest, getting them lost among the trees.

data.name: Trevenant

abilities.name: Forest Miasma
abilities.text: During Pokémon Checkup, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, put 1 damage counter on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Lock Up
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

data.flavorText: Small roots that extend from the tips of this Pokémon's feet can tie into the trees of the forest and give Trevenant control over them.

data.name: Rowlet
data.flavorText: It feels relaxed in tight, dark places and has been known to use its Trainer's pocket or bag as a nest.

data.name: Dartrix

attacks.name: Shoot Through
attacks.text: This attack also does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.flavorText: Supremely sensitive to the presence of others, it can detect opponents standing behind it, flinging its sharp feathers to take them out.

data.name: Decidueye ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Total Freedom
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. If this Pokémon is on the Bench, switch it with your Active Pokémon. Or, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, switch it with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Hunting Arrow
attacks.text: This attack also does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.name: Bounsweet

attacks.name: Reckless Charge
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

data.flavorText: Its sweat is sweet, like syrup made from boiled-down fruit. Because of this, Bounsweet was highly valued in the past, when sweeteners were scarce.

data.name: Steenee

attacks.name: Aromatherapy
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from each of your Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Steenee spreads a sweet scent that makes others feel invigorated. This same scent is popular for antiperspirants.

data.name: Tsareena

attacks.name: Queenly Heel
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, Pokémon can't be played from your opponent's hand to evolve the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Spinning Kick
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 20 damage to itself.

data.flavorText: This Pokémon is proud and aggressive. However, it is said that a Tsareena will instantly become calm if someone touches the crown on its calyx.

data.name: Smoliv

attacks.name: Absorb
attacks.text: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It protects itself from enemies by emitting oil from the fruit on its head. This oil is bitter and astringent enough to make someone flinch.

data.name: Dolliv

attacks.name: Sunny Wind
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Dolliv shares its tasty, fresh-scented oil with others. This species has coexisted with humans since times long gone.

data.name: Arboliva

attacks.name: Healing Fruit
attacks.text: Heal all damage from 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

data.flavorText: This calm Pokémon is very compassionate. It will share its delicious, nutrient-rich oil with weakened Pokémon.

data.name: Toedscruel ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Protective Mycelium
abilities.text: Prevent all effects of attacks used by your opponent's Pokémon done to all of your Pokémon that have Energy attached. (Existing effects are not removed. Damage is not an effect.)

attacks.name: Colony Rush
attacks.text: This attack does 40 more damage for each of your Benched Pokémon that has any Grass Energy attached.

data.name: Capsakid

attacks.name: Reckless Charge
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

data.flavorText: The more sunlight this Pokémon bathes in, the more spicy chemicals are produced by its body, and thus the spicier its moves become.

data.name: Capsakid

attacks.name: Double Headbutt
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 50 damage for each heads.

data.flavorText: The more sunlight this Pokémon bathes in, the more spicy chemicals are produced by its body, and thus the spicier its moves become.

data.name: Scovillain

abilities.name: Double Type
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is in play, it is Grass and Fire type.

attacks.name: Spicy Headbutt
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

data.flavorText: The red head converts spicy chemicals into fire energy and blasts the surrounding area with a super spicy stream of flame.

data.name: Charmander

attacks.name: Heat Tackle
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

data.flavorText: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.

data.name: Charmeleon

attacks.name: Heat Tackle
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 20 damage to itself.

data.flavorText: If it becomes agitated during battle, it spouts intense flames, incinerating its surroundings.

data.name: Vulpix

attacks.name: Confuse Ray
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

data.flavorText: As each tail grows, its fur becomes more lustrous. When held, it feels slightly warm.

data.name: Ninetales

attacks.name: Nine-Tailed Dance
attacks.text: Put 9 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

data.flavorText: Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its many tails could result in a 1,000-year curse.

data.name: Entei

abilities.name: Pressure
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, attacks used by your opponent's Active Pokémon do 20 less damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Blaze Ball
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each Fire Energy attached to this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It is said that when it roars, a volcano erupts somewhere around the globe.

data.name: Numel

attacks.name: Hot Magma
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

data.flavorText: Magma of almost 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit courses through its body. When it grows cold, the magma hardens and slows it.

data.name: Camerupt

attacks.name: Eruption
attacks.text: Discard the top card of each player's deck. This attack does 100 more damage for each Energy card discarded in this way.

data.flavorText: It lives in the crater of a volcano. It is well known that the humps on its back erupt every 10 years.

data.name: Victini ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Strafe
attacks.text: You may switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Victory Flame
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

data.name: Darumaka

attacks.name: Surprise Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

data.flavorText: This popular symbol of good fortune will never fall over in its sleep, no matter how it's pushed or pulled.

data.name: Darmanitan

attacks.name: Damage Counterpunch
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has any damage counters on it, this attack does 60 more damage.

data.flavorText: This Pokémon's power level rises along with the temperature of its fire, which can reach 2,500 degrees Fahrenheit.

data.name: Litwick

attacks.name: Firebreathing
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 more damage.

data.flavorText: The younger the life this Pokémon absorbs, the brighter and eerier the flame on its head burns.

data.name: Lampent

attacks.name: Alluring Fireball
attacks.text: Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot. This attack does 30 damage to the new Active Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It lurks in cities, pretending to be a lamp. Once it finds someone whose death is near, it will trail quietly after them.

data.name: Chandelure

attacks.name: Combustion Chain
attacks.text: This attack does 50 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

data.flavorText: In homes illuminated by Chandelure instead of lights, funerals were a constant occurrence—or so it's said.

data.name: Heatmor

attacks.name: Energy Burner
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

data.flavorText: A flame serves as its tongue, melting through the hard shell of Durant so that Heatmor can devour their insides.

data.name: Larvesta

attacks.name: Take Down
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

data.flavorText: This Pokémon was called the Larva That Stole the Sun. The fire Larvesta spouts from its horns can cut right through a sheet of iron.

data.name: Volcarona

attacks.name: Flame Cloak
attacks.text: Attach a Basic Fire Energy card from your discard pile to this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Its burning body causes it to be unpopular in hot parts of the world, but in cold ones, Volcarona is revered as an embodiment of the sun.

data.name: Eiscue ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.
Tera: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks (both yours and your opponent's).

attacks.name: Scalding Block
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon. During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't attack.

data.name: Charcadet
data.flavorText: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.

data.name: Armarouge

abilities.name: Scorching Armor
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), the Attacking Pokémon is now Burned.

data.flavorText: Armarouge evolved through the use of a set of armor that belonged to a distinguished warrior. This Pokémon is incredibly loyal.

data.name: Lapras

attacks.name: Hail
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.flavorText: Crossing icy seas is no issue for this cold-resistant Pokémon. Its smooth skin is a little cool to the touch.

data.name: Carvanha
data.flavorText: These Pokémon have sharp fangs and powerful jaws. Sailors avoid Carvanha dens at all costs.

data.name: Sharpedo

attacks.name: Aqua Impact
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each Colorless in your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost.

data.flavorText: This Pokémon is known as the Bully of the Sea. Any ship entering the waters Sharpedo calls home will be attacked—no exceptions.

data.name: Buizel

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 more damage.

data.flavorText: It spins its two tails like a screw to propel itself through water. The tails also slice clinging seaweed.

data.name: Floatzel

attacks.name: Swirling Tail
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, put your opponent's Active Pokémon and all attached cards into your opponent's hand.

data.flavorText: With its flotation sac inflated, it can carry people on its back. It deflates the sac before it dives.

data.name: Tympole

attacks.name: Screw Tail
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It uses sound waves to communicate with others of its kind. People and other Pokémon species can't hear its cries of warning.

data.name: Palpitoad
data.flavorText: On occasion, their cries are sublimely pleasing to the ear. Palpitoad with larger lumps on their bodies can sing with a wider range of sounds.

data.name: Seismitoad

abilities.name: Quaking Zone
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, attacks used by your opponent's Active Pokémon cost Colorless more.

attacks.name: Echoed Voice
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon's Echoed Voice attack does 100 more damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

data.flavorText: This Pokémon is popular among the elderly, who say the vibrations of its lumps are great for massages.

data.name: Cubchoo

attacks.name: Trip Over
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

data.flavorText: Many of this species can be found along the shorelines of cold regions. If a Cubchoo lacks dangling snot, there's a chance it is sick.

data.name: Beartic

attacks.name: Frost Purge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, discard all Energy from this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It is a ferocious, carnivorous Pokémon. Once it captures its prey, it will breathe cold air onto the prey to freeze and preserve it.

data.name: Cryogonal

attacks.name: First Freeze
attacks.text: If you go second and it's your first turn, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

data.flavorText: Cryogonal appear during cold seasons. It is said that people and Pokémon who die on snowy mountains are reborn into these Pokémon.

data.name: Froakie

attacks.name: Try Bouncing
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

data.flavorText: It protects its skin by covering its body in delicate bubbles. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.

data.name: Frogadier

attacks.name: Strafe
attacks.text: You may switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Its swiftness is unparalleled. It can scale a tower of more than 600 metres in a minute's time.

data.name: Wiglett
data.flavorText: This Pokémon can pick up the scent of a Veluza just over 65 feet away and will hide itself in the sand.

data.name: Wugtrio

attacks.name: Entwining Entrapment
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

data.flavorText: It has a vicious temperament, contrary to what its appearance may suggest. It wraps its long bodies around prey, then drags the prey into its den.

data.name: Finizen

attacks.name: Valiant Evolution
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. If you do, search your deck for a card that evolves from this Pokémon and put it onto this Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.

data.flavorText: It likes playing with others of its kind using the water ring on its tail. It uses ultrasonic waves to sense the emotions of other living creatures.

data.name: Finizen
data.flavorText: It likes playing with others of its kind using the water ring on its tail. It uses ultrasonic waves to sense the emotions of other living creatures.

data.name: Palafin

attacks.name: Jet Punch
attacks.text: This attack also does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Justice Kick
attacks.text: If this Pokémon didn't move from the Bench to the Active Spot this turn, this attack does nothing.

data.flavorText: This Pokémon's ancient genes have awakened. It is now so extraordinarily strong that it can easily lift a cruise ship with one fin.

data.name: Magnemite
data.flavorText: The electromagnetic waves emitted by the units at the sides of its head expel antigravity, which allows it to float.

data.name: Magneton
data.flavorText: Three Magnemite are linked by a strong magnetic force. Earaches will occur if you get too close.

data.name: Magnezone

attacks.name: Magnetic Repulsion
attacks.text: You may switch out your opponent's Active Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Thunder
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

data.flavorText: As it zooms through the sky, this Pokémon seems to be receiving signals of unknown origin while transmitting signals of unknown purpose.

data.name: Tyranitar ex

Tera: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks (both yours and your opponent's).

attacks.name: Mountain Hurl
attacks.text: Discard the top 2 cards of your deck.

attacks.name: Lightning Rampage
attacks.text: If your Benched Pokémon have any damage counters on them, this attack does 100 more damage.

data.name: Tynamo
data.flavorText: While one alone doesn't have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.

data.name: Eelektrik

attacks.name: Volt Wave
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

data.flavorText: They coil around foes and shock them with electricity-generating organs that seem simply to be circular patterns.

data.name: Eelektross

attacks.name: Suction Shock
attacks.text: Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot. If you do, this attack does 60 damage to the new Active Pokémon, and then flip a coin. If heads, that Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

data.flavorText: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.

data.name: Thundurus

abilities.name: Adverse Weather
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, prevent all damage done to your Benched Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Gigantic Bolt
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 90 damage to itself.

data.flavorText: As it flies around, it shoots lightning all over the place and causes forest fires. It is therefore disliked.

data.name: Toxel

attacks.name: Slight Intrusion
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

data.flavorText: It has no problem drinking dirty water. An organ inside Toxel's body filters such water into a poisonous liquid that is harmless to Toxel.

data.name: Toxtricity

attacks.name: Leer
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Loud Mix
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each different type of Pokémon on your Bench.

data.flavorText: Many youths admire the way this Pokémon listlessly picks fights and keeps its cool no matter what opponent it faces.

data.flavorText: Tadbulb shakes its tail to generate electricity. If it senses danger, it will make its head blink on and off to alert its allies.

data.flavorText: When this Pokémon expands and contracts its wobbly body, the belly-button dynamo in its stomach produces a huge amount of electricity.

attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

data.flavorText: When this Pokémon expands and contracts its wobbly body, the belly-button dynamo in its stomach produces a huge amount of electricity.

data.name: Cleffa

attacks.name: Grasping Draw
attacks.text: Draw cards until you have 7 cards in your hand.

data.flavorText: Because of its unusual, starlike silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.

data.name: Clefairy

attacks.name: Slap Slap
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage for each heads.

data.flavorText: Its adorable behavior and cry make it highly popular. However, this cute Pokémon is rarely found.

data.name: Clefable ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Lunar Zone
abilities.text: All of your Pokémon that have Psychic Energy attached have no Retreat Cost.

attacks.name: Wondrous Moon
attacks.text: You may move any amount of Psychic Energy from your Pokémon to your other Pokémon in any way you like.

data.name: Togepi

attacks.name: Whiny Voice
attacks.text: Choose a random card from your opponent's hand. Your opponent reveals that card and shuffles it into their deck.

data.flavorText: It is considered to be a symbol of good luck. Its shell is said to be filled with happiness.

data.name: Togetic

attacks.name: Shared Peace
attacks.text: Each player draws 3 cards.

data.flavorText: It grows dispirited if it is not with kind people. It can float in midair without moving its wings.

data.name: Togekiss

abilities.name: Precious Gift
abilities.text: Once at the end of your turn (after your attack), you may use this Ability. Draw cards until you have 8 cards in your hand.

attacks.name: Power Cyclone
attacks.text: Move an Energy from this Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Known as a bringer of blessings, it's been depicted on good-luck charms since ancient times.

data.name: Espeon

attacks.name: Psychic Assault
attacks.text: This attack does 10 more damage for each damage counter on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Psy Bolt
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

data.flavorText: The tip of its forked tail quivers when it is predicting its opponent's next move.

data.name: Snubbull

attacks.name: Double-Edge
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

data.flavorText: In contrast to its appearance, it's quite timid. When playing with other puppy Pokémon, it sometimes gets bullied.

data.name: Granbull

attacks.name: Wild Tackle
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

data.flavorText: Although it's popular with young people, Granbull is timid and sensitive, so it's totally incompetent as a watchdog.

data.name: Mawile

attacks.name: Mischievous Crunch
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage for each Psychic Energy attached to this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It chomps with its gaping mouth. Its huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed.

data.name: Spoink
data.flavorText: Spoink will die if it stops bouncing. The pearl on its head amplifies its psychic powers.

data.name: Grumpig

attacks.name: Powerful Steps
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Energy cards and attach them to your Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck.

data.flavorText: It can perform odd dance steps to influence foes. Its style of dancing became hugely popular overseas.

data.name: Lunatone

abilities.name: New Moon
abilities.text: If you have Solrock in play, prevent all effects of any Stadium done to your Pokémon in play.

data.flavorText: It was discovered at the site of a meteor strike 40 years ago. Its stare can lull its foes to sleep.

data.name: Solrock

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

data.flavorText: Solar energy is the source of its power, so it is strong during the daytime. When it spins, its body shines.

data.name: Baltoy

attacks.name: Rapid Spin
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. If you do, switch out your opponent's Active Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.)

data.flavorText: It was discovered in ancient ruins. While moving, it constantly spins. It stands on one foot even when asleep.

data.name: Claydol

attacks.name: Kaboom Doll
attacks.text: Put damage counters on your opponent's Active Pokémon until its remaining HP is 10. If you placed any damage counters in this way, this attack also does 120 damage to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Mind Bend
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

data.flavorText: It appears to have been born from clay dolls made by ancient people. It uses telekinesis to float and move.

data.name: Sinistea

data.flavorText: The soul of someone who died alone possessed some leftover tea. This Pokémon appears in hotels and houses.

attacks.name: Pour Tea
attacks.text: Put 5 damage counters on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

data.flavorText: The tea that composes Polteageist's body has a distinct and enjoyable flavor. Drinking too much, however, can be fatal.

data.name: Greavard
data.flavorText: It is said that a dog Pokémon that died in the wild without ever interacting with a human was reborn as this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It is said that a dog Pokémon that died in the wild without ever interacting with a human was reborn as this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Houndstone spends most of its time sleeping in graveyards. Among all the dog Pokémon, this one is most loyal to its master.

data.flavorText: It lives about one yard underground, where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears aboveground.

data.name: Dugtrio

attacks.name: Dig
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Its three heads bob separately up and down to loosen the soil nearby, making it easier for it to burrow.

data.name: Larvitar
data.flavorText: Born deep underground, this Pokémon becomes a pupa after eating enough dirt to make a mountain.

data.name: Pupitar

attacks.name: Blasting Tackle
attacks.text: This attack also does 20 damage to 1 of your Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.flavorText: This pupa flies around wildly by venting with great force the gas pressurized inside its body.

attacks.name: Iron Collecting

data.flavorText: It hunts without twitching a muscle by pulling in its prey with powerful magnetism. But sometimes it pulls natural enemies in close.

data.name: Barboach

attacks.name: Hide
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Its two whiskers provide a sensitive radar. Even in muddy waters, it can detect its prey's location.

attacks.name: Raging and Rocking

data.flavorText: It is extremely protective of its territory. If any foe approaches, it attacks using vicious tremors.

data.name: Bonsly

attacks.name: Blubbering

data.flavorText: In order to adjust the level of fluids in its body, it exudes water from its eyes. This makes it appear to be crying.

data.name: Drilbur

attacks.name: Rising Lunge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 more damage.

data.flavorText: It's a digger, using its claws to burrow through the ground. It causes damage to vegetable crops, so many farmers have little love for it.

data.flavorText: The fur on its belly retains heat exceptionally well. People used to make heavy winter clothing from fur shed by this Pokémon.

data.name: Crabrawler
data.flavorText: This Pokémon punches trees and eats the berries that drop down, training itself and getting food at the same time.

data.name: Crabominable

attacks.name: Knuckle Impact

data.flavorText: The detached pincers of these Pokémon are delicious. Some Trainers bring Lechonk into the mountains just to search for them.

data.name: Rockruff
data.flavorText: This Pokémon is very friendly when it's young. Its disposition becomes vicious once it matures, but it never forgets the kindness of its master.

data.flavorText: This Pokémon uses its rocky mane to slash any who approach. It will even disobey its Trainer if it dislikes the orders it was given.

data.name: Toedscool
data.flavorText: Toedscool lives in muggy forests. The flaps that fall from its body are chewy and very delicious.

data.flavorText: This intelligent Pokémon has a very daring disposition. It knocks rocks into the sky with its hammer, aiming for flying Corviknight.

data.name: Mankey
data.flavorText: It lives in groups in the treetops. If it loses sight of its group, it becomes infuriated by its loneliness.

attacks.name: Double Stab

data.flavorText: Born deep underground, this Pokémon becomes a pupa after eating enough dirt to make a mountain.

data.name: Pupitar
data.flavorText: This pupa flies around wildly by venting with great force the gas pressurized inside its body.

data.name: Makuhita
data.flavorText: It grows stronger by enduring harsh training. It is a gutsy Pokémon that can withstand any attack.

data.name: Hariyama

data.flavorText: It loves challenging others to tests of strength. It has the power to stop a train with a slap.

data.name: Croagunk

attacks.name: Poison Sting

data.flavorText: Inflating its poison sacs, it fills the area with an odd sound and hits flinching opponents with a poison jab.

data.name: Toxicroak

attacks.name: Knuckle Claws
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

data.flavorText: Swaying and dodging the attacks of its foes, it weaves its flexible body in close, then lunges out with its poisonous claws.

data.name: Rockruff
data.flavorText: This Pokémon is very friendly when it's young. Its disposition becomes vicious once it matures, but it never forgets the kindness of its master.

data.name: Nacli

data.flavorText: This Pokémon dry cures its prey by spraying salt over them. The curing process steals away the water in the prey's body.

attacks.name: Dirty Throw
attacks.text: Discard a card from your hand. If you can't, this attack does nothing.

data.flavorText: It is merciless by nature. It is said that it never forgives the mistakes of its Murkrow followers.

data.name: Sneasel
data.flavorText: This cunning Pokémon hides under the cover of darkness, waiting to attack its prey.

abilities.text: Once during your turn, when this Pokémon moves from your Bench to the Active Spot, you may switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Basic Pokémon to the Active Spot.

data.flavorText: Evolution made it even more devious. It communicates by clawing signs in boulders.

attacks.name: Rout
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dread Mountain

data.flavorText: Extremely strong, it can change the landscape. It is so insolent that it doesn't care about others.

attacks.name: Cross-Cut

data.flavorText: It sharpens its swordlike tail on hard rocks. It hides in tall grass and strikes unwary prey with venomous fangs.

data.name: Deino

attacks.name: Ambush
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

data.flavorText: The two heads do not get along at all. If you don't give each head the same amount of attention, they'll begin fighting out of jealousy.

data.name: Hydreigon

abilities.name: Tri Howl

data.name: Maschiff

attacks.name: Ambush
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

data.flavorText: It always scowls in an attempt to make opponents take it seriously, but even crying children will burst into laughter when they see Maschiff's face.

data.name: Maschiff

data.flavorText: This Pokémon can store energy in its large dewlap. Mabosstiff unleashes this energy all at once to blow away enemies.

data.name: Shroodle

attacks.name: Berry Search
attacks.text: Put a Basic Energy card from your discard pile into your hand.

attacks.name: Spinning Bird
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon.

data.name: Cufant

data.name: Noibat

attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from Basic Pokémon.

data.name: Girafarig

attacks.name: Psy Bolt
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

data.flavorText: Though very small, the brain in its tail is still considered an important organ because it emits powerful psychic energy.

data.name: Farigiraf

attacks.name: Either Face
attacks.text: Choose a player. That player shuffles their hand into their deck and draws 4 cards.

data.flavorText: Now that the brain waves from the head and tail are synced up, the psychic power of this Pokémon is 10 times stronger than Girafarig's.

data.name: Dunsparce

attacks.name: Find a Friend
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed. Shuffle this Pokémon and all attached cards into your deck.

data.flavorText: This Pokémon uses its hard tail to make its nest by boring holes into bedrock deep underground. The nest can reach lengths of over six miles.

data.name: Wingull
data.flavorText: It soars high in the sky, riding on updrafts like a glider. It carries food tucked in its bill.

data.name: Pelipper

data.flavorText: It is a flying transporter that carries small Pokémon in its beak. It bobs on the waves to rest its wings.

data.name: Slakoth

attacks.name: Yawn
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

data.flavorText: It sleeps for 20 hours every day. Making drowsy those that see it is one of its abilities.

data.name: Vigoroth

attacks.name: Sharp Claws
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 60 more damage.

data.flavorText: Its stress level rises if it cannot keep moving constantly. Too much stress makes it feel sick.

data.name: Slaking

attacks.name: Slacker's Headstrike
attacks.text: This Pokémon is now Asleep.

data.flavorText: It is the world's most slothful Pokémon. However, it can exert horrifying power by releasing pent-up energy all at once.

data.name: Fletchling

attacks.name: Nosedive
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

data.flavorText: This Pokémon is normally calm, but once it enters battle, its hormonal balance changes and it becomes aggressive.

data.name: Rookidee

attacks.name: Send Back
attacks.text: Switch out your opponent's Active Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.)

data.flavorText: This Pokémon is brave and reckless. The white markings around a Rookidee's eyes intimidate fainthearted Pokémon.

data.name: Corvisquire

attacks.name: Clutch
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

data.flavorText: It's said that the reason behind Corvisquire's high level of intelligence is the large size of its brain relative to those of other bird Pokémon.

data.name: Tandemaus

attacks.name: Collect
attacks.text: Draw 2 cards.

data.flavorText: Exhibiting great teamwork, they use their incisors to cut pieces out of any material that might be useful for a nest, then make off with them.

data.flavorText: Exhibiting great teamwork, they use their incisors to cut pieces out of any material that might be useful for a nest, then make off with them.

attacks.name: Gnaw Relentlessly
attacks.text: Put 1 damage counter on each of your opponent's Pokémon for each of your Maushold in play.

data.flavorText: They build huge nests with many rooms that are used for different purposes, such as eating and sleeping.

data.flavorText: This Pokémon apparently ties the base of its neck into a knot so that the energy stored in its belly does not escape from its beak.

rules: Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached.

You may play only 1 Stadium card during your turn. Put it next to the Active Spot, and discard it if another Stadium comes into play. A Stadium with the same name can't be played.

You may play only 1 Stadium card during your turn. Put it next to the Active Spot, and discard it if another Stadium comes into play. A Stadium with the same name can't be played.

Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached.

rules: Flip 2 coins. If both of them are heads, search your deck for a card and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

rules: Put a card from your hand on the bottom of your deck. If you do, draw cards until you have 5 cards in your hand. (If you have no other cards in your hand, you can't use this card.)
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

data.name: Falkner
rules: Draw 2 cards. If you have a Stadium in play, draw 2 more cards.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

data.name: Fighting Au Lait
rules: You can use this card only if you have more Prize cards remaining than your opponent.Heal 60 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

data.name: Giacomo
rules: Discard a Special Energy from each of your opponent's Pokémon.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

data.name: Great Ball
rules: Look at the top 7 cards of your deck. You may reveal a Pokémon you find there and put it into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

data.name: Grusha
rules: Draw cards until you have 5 cards in your hand. If none of your Pokémon have any Energy attached, draw cards until you have 7 cards in your hand instead.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

data.name: Iono
rules: Each player shuffles their hand and puts it on the bottom of their deck. If either player put any cards on the bottom of their deck in this way, each player draws a card for each of their remaining Prize cards.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

data.name: Practice Studio
rules: The attacks of Stage 1 Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's) do 10 more damage to the opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).
You may play only 1 Stadium card during your turn. Put it next to the Active Spot, and discard it if another Stadium comes into play. A Stadium with the same name can't be played.

rules: Choose up to 2 of your Pokémon and heal 50 damage from each of them.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

data.name: Jet Energy

rules: As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides Colorless Energy.If you have more Prize cards remaining than your opponent, and if this card is attached to an Evolution Pokémon that doesn't have a Rule Box (Pokémon ex, Pokémon V, etc. have Rule Boxes), this card provides every type of Energy but provides only 3 Energy at a time.

data.name: Therapeutic Energy
rules: As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides Colorless Energy.The Pokémon this card is attached to recovers from being Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed and can't be affected by those Special Conditions.

data.name: Heracross

attacks.name: Smashing Horn
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

data.flavorText: It loves sweet nectar. To keep all the nectar to itself, it hurls rivals away with its prized horn.

data.name: Tropius

attacks.name: Leaf Drain
attacks.text: Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Tropic Breeze
attacks.text: Move all Energy from this Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It lives in tropical jungles. The bunch of fruit around its neck is delicious. The fruit grows twice a year.

data.name: Sprigatito

attacks.name: Gather Sunlight
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

data.flavorText: Its fluffy fur is similar in composition to plants. This Pokémon frequently washes its face to keep it from drying out.

data.name: Floragato

attacks.name: Magic Whip
attacks.text: Switch out your opponent's Active Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.)

data.flavorText: Floragato deftly wields the vine hidden beneath its long fur, slamming the hard flower bud against its opponents.

data.name: Bramblin

attacks.name: Blot
attacks.text: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: A soul unable to move on to the afterlife was blown around by the wind until it got tangled up with dried grass and became a Pokémon.

data.name: Fletchinder

attacks.name: Heat Dive
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

data.flavorText: Fletchinder scatters embers in tall grass where bug Pokémon might be hiding and then catches them as they come leaping out.

data.name: Pyroar

attacks.name: Singe
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

attacks.name: Overrun
attacks.text: This attack also does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.flavorText: The females of a pride work together to bring down prey. It's thanks to them that their pride doesn't starve.

data.name: Fuecoco

attacks.name: Spacing Out
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It lies on warm rocks and uses the heat absorbed by its square-shaped scales to create fire energy.

data.name: Crocalor
data.flavorText: The combination of Crocalor's fire energy and overflowing vitality has caused an egg-shaped fireball to appear on the Pokémon's head.

data.name: Magikarp

attacks.name: Expert Splasher
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. If both of them are heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

data.flavorText: An underpowered, pathetic Pokémon. It may jump high on rare occasions but never more than seven feet.

data.name: Marill

attacks.name: Bubble Drain
attacks.text: Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: The fur on its body naturally repels water. It can stay dry even when it plays in the water.

data.name: Eiscue

attacks.name: Frigid Block
attacks.text: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon. During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 100 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

data.flavorText: On hot days, these Pokémon press their ice cube heads together and pass the time cooling each other down.

data.name: Quaxly

attacks.name: Apply Gel
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, if the Defending Pokémon tries to attack, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack doesn't happen.

data.flavorText: This Pokémon migrated to Paldea from distant lands long ago. The gel secreted by its feathers repels water and grime.

data.name: Quaxwell
data.flavorText: These Pokémon constantly run through shallow waters to train their legs, then compete with each other to see which of them kicks most gracefully.

data.name: Frigibax
data.flavorText: Frigibax absorbs heat through its dorsal fin and converts the heat into ice energy. The higher the temperature, the more energy Frigibax stores.

data.name: Arctibax
data.flavorText: Arctibax freezes the air around it, protecting its face with an ice mask and turning its dorsal fin into a blade of ice.

data.name: Baxcalibur

abilities.name: Super Cold
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn, you may attach a Basic Water Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon.

data.flavorText: This Pokémon blasts cryogenic air out from its mouth. This air can instantly freeze even liquid-hot lava.

data.name: Raichu

attacks.name: Electrocharge
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Lightning Energy cards and attach them to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Thunderbolt
attacks.text: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Its tail discharges electricity into the ground, protecting it from getting shocked.

data.name: Mismagius

abilities.name: Magical Flick
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may move an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon to 1 of their Benched Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Its cry sounds like an incantation. It is said the cry may rarely be imbued with happiness-giving power.

data.name: Gothorita

attacks.name: Mind Bend
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

data.flavorText: This Pokémon will hypnotize children to put them to sleep before carrying them away. Be wary of nights when the starlight is bright.

data.name: Sandygast
data.flavorText: If it loses its shovel, it will stick something else— like a branch—in its head to make do until it finds another shovel.

data.name: Rabsca

attacks.name: Revival Blessing
attacks.text: Put a Pokémon from your discard pile onto your Bench.

attacks.name: Psybeam
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

data.flavorText: The body that supports the ball barely moves. Therefore, it is thought that the true body of this Pokémon is actually inside the ball.

data.name: Tinkatink

attacks.name: Scrap Pickup
attacks.text: Put an Item card from your discard pile into your hand.

data.flavorText: It swings its handmade hammer around to protect itself, but the hammer is often stolen by Pokémon that eat metal.

data.name: Tinkatuff

attacks.name: Play Rough
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

attacks.name: Pulverizing Press
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

data.flavorText: This Pokémon will attack groups of Pawniard and Bisharp, gathering metal from them in order to create a large and sturdy hammer.

data.name: Paldean Tauros

attacks.name: Raging Horns
attacks.text: This attack does 10 more damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Combat Tackle
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

data.flavorText: This kind of Tauros, known as the Combat Breed, is distinguished by its thick, powerful muscles and its fierce disposition.

data.name: Sudowoodo

attacks.name: Hit and Hide
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Although it always pretends to be a tree, its composition appears more similar to rock than to vegetation.

data.name: Nacli

attacks.name: Salt Coating
attacks.text: Heal 20 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It was born in a layer of rock salt deep under the earth. This species was particularly treasured in the old days, as they would share precious salt.

data.name: Paldean Wooper

attacks.name: Find a Home
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Stadium card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

data.flavorText: After losing a territorial struggle, Wooper began living on land. The Pokémon changed over time, developing a poisonous film to protect its body.

data.name: Tyranitar

attacks.name: Rout
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dread Mountain
attacks.text: Discard the top 4 cards of your deck.

data.flavorText: Extremely strong, it can change the landscape. It is so insolent that it doesn't care about others.

data.name: Grafaiai

attacks.name: Spit Poison
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Colorful Graffiti
attacks.text: You may discard as many Basic Energy cards as you like from your hand. This attack does 40 damage for each type of Basic Energy you discarded in this way.

data.flavorText: The color of the poisonous saliva depends on what the Pokémon eats. Grafaiai covers its fingers in its saliva and draws patterns on trees in forests.

data.name: Orthworm

abilities.name: Nutritional Iron
abilities.text: If this Pokémon has 3 or more Metal Energy attached, it gets +100 HP.

attacks.name: Shoot Through
attacks.text: This attack also does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.flavorText: When attacked, this Pokémon will wield the tendrils on its body like fists and pelt the opponent with a storm of punches.

data.name: Rookidee

attacks.name: Send Back
attacks.text: Switch out your opponent's Active Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.)

data.flavorText: This Pokémon is brave and reckless. The white markings around a Rookidee's eyes intimidate fainthearted Pokémon.

data.name: Maushold

attacks.name: Gnaw Relentlessly
attacks.text: Put 1 damage counter on each of your opponent's Pokémon for each of your Maushold in play.

data.flavorText: They build huge nests with many rooms that are used for different purposes, such as eating and sleeping.

data.name: Flamigo

abilities.name: Insta-Flock
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may search your deck for up to 3 Flamigo, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: United Wings
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each Pokémon in your discard pile that has the United Wings attack.

data.flavorText: This Pokémon apparently ties the base of its neck into a knot so that the energy stored in its belly does not escape from its beak.

data.name: Farigiraf

attacks.name: Either Face
attacks.text: Choose a player. That player shuffles their hand into their deck and draws 4 cards.

data.flavorText: Now that the brain waves from the head and tail are synced up, the psychic power of this Pokémon is 10 times stronger than Girafarig's.

data.name: Dudunsparce

attacks.name: Dig Away Flash
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed. Shuffle this Pokémon and all attached cards into your deck.

data.flavorText: This Pokémon uses its hard tail to make its nest by boring holes into bedrock deep underground. The nest can reach lengths of over six miles.

Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may search your deck for up to 5 Basic Grass Energy cards and attach them to your Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck. If you searched your deck in this way, this Pokémon is Knocked Out.

attacks.name: Guard Press
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.text: You may discard any amount of Water Energy from your Pokémon. This attack does 60 damage for each card you discarded in this way.

attacks.name: Jumping Press
attacks.text: This attack does 50 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Paralyzing Ball
attacks.text: You may discard 2 Lightning Energy from this Pokémon to make your opponent's Active Pokémon Paralyzed.

attacks.text: You may search your deck for up to 2 cards and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
