attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon.

data.name: Charizard VMAX
rules: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: G-Max Wildfire
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon.

data.name: Houndoom V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Searing Flame
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

attacks.name: Vengeful Flame
attacks.text: If your Benched Fire Pokémon have any damage counters on them, this attack does 100 more damage.

data.name: Torchic

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

data.flavorText: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.

data.name: Combusken

attacks.name: Heat Beak
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

data.flavorText: During a battle, the hot flame in its body increases. Its kicks have outstanding destructive power.

data.name: Blaziken

abilities.name: Double Type
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is in play, it is Fire and Fighting type.

attacks.name: Turbo Drive
attacks.text: Attach a basic Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

data.flavorText: When facing a tough foe, it looses flames from its wrists. Its powerful legs let it jump clear over buildings.

data.name: Heatran

attacks.name: Fire Fang
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

attacks.name: Raging Flare
attacks.text: This attack does 10 more damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Boiling blood, like magma, circulates through its body. It makes its dwelling place in volcanic caves.

data.name: Pansear
data.flavorText: This Pokémon lives in caves in volcanoes. The fire within the tuft on its head can reach 600 degrees Fahrenheit.

data.name: Simisear

attacks.name: Giga Impact
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

data.flavorText: When it gets excited, embers rise from its head and tail and it gets hot. For some reason, it loves sweets.

data.name: Galarian Darmanitan

attacks.name: Frozen Heat
attacks.text: You may discard all Water Energy from this Pokémon. If you do, this attack does 60 more damage.

data.flavorText: Anger has reignited its atrophied flame sac. This Pokémon spews fire everywhere as it rampages indiscriminately.

data.name: Larvesta

attacks.name: Singe
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

data.flavorText: It protects itself with flame. Long years ago, people believed Larvesta had a nest on the sun.

data.name: Volcarona

attacks.name: Cauterize
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon has no damage counters on it before this attack does damage, this attack does nothing.

data.flavorText: According to legends, it was hatched from a flaming cocoon to save people and Pokémon that were suffering from the cold.

data.name: Fletchinder

attacks.name: Searing Flame
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

data.flavorText: Its speed right after takeoff already puts it in the top speed class of all bird Pokémon.

data.name: Talonflame

abilities.name: Scorching Feathers
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), the Attacking Pokémon is now Burned.

attacks.name: Mach Flight
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

data.flavorText: Bird Pokémon make up most of its diet. It approaches at high speeds and smacks them down to the ground with its powerful kick.

data.name: Centiskorch V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Radiating Heat
attacks.text: You may discard an Energy from this Pokémon. If you do, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

data.name: Centiskorch VMAX
rules: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: G-Max Centiferno
attacks.text: This attack does 40 more damage for each Fire Energy attached to this Pokémon. If you did any damage with this attack, you may attach a Fire Energy card from your discard pile to this Pokémon.

data.name: Galarian Mr. Mime

attacks.name: Reflect
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

data.flavorText: Its talent is tap-dancing. It can also manipulate temperatures to create a floor of ice, which this Pokémon can kick up to use as a barrier.

data.name: Galarian Mr. Rime

abilities.name: Shuffle Dance
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may switch 1 of your opponent's face-down Prize cards with the top card of their deck. (The cards stay face down.)

attacks.name: Mad Party
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each Pokémon in your discard pile that has the Mad Party attack.

data.flavorText: It's highly skilled at tap-dancing. It waves its cane of ice in time with its graceful movements.

data.name: Suicune

attacks.name: Aurora Loop
attacks.text: Put 2 Water Energy attached to this Pokémon into your hand.

data.flavorText: Said to be the embodiment of north winds, it can instantly purify filthy, murky water.

data.name: Feebas

attacks.name: Nap
attacks.text: Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Although unattractive and unpopular, this Pokémon's marvelous vitality has made it a subject of research.

data.name: Milotic

abilities.name: Bright Heal
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may heal 20 damage from each of your Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Milotic has provided inspiration to many artists. It has even been referred to as the most beautiful Pokémon of all.

data.name: Relicanth

attacks.name: Fossil Search
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Rare Fossil cards and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

data.flavorText: The reason it hasn't changed at all in a hundred million years is that it's apparently already a perfect life-form.

data.name: Panpour
data.flavorText: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.

data.name: Simipour

attacks.name: Giga Impact
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

data.flavorText: It prefers places with clean water. When its tuft runs low, it replenishes it by siphoning up water with its tail.

data.name: Galarian Darumaka
data.flavorText: It lived in snowy areas for so long that its fire sac cooled off and atrophied. It now has an organ that generates cold instead.

data.name: Galarian Darmanitan

attacks.name: Blizzard
attacks.text: This attack also does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Crushing Headbutt
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Crushing Headbutt.

data.flavorText: On days when blizzards blow through, it comes down to where people live. It stashes food in the snowball on its head, taking it home for later.

data.name: Vanillite

attacks.name: Ice Over
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

data.flavorText: Unable to survive in hot areas, it makes itself comfortable by breathing out air cold enough to cause snow. It burrows into the snow to sleep.

data.name: Vanillish

attacks.name: Freezing Headbutt
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

data.flavorText: By drinking pure water, it grows its icy body. This Pokémon can be hard to find on days with warm, sunny weather.

data.name: Vanilluxe

abilities.name: Bitter Cold
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

data.flavorText: When its anger reaches a breaking point, this Pokémon unleashes a fierce blizzard that freezes every creature around it, be they friend or foe.

data.name: Cubchoo
data.flavorText: When this Pokémon is in good health, its snot becomes thicker and stickier. It will smear its snot on anyone it doesn't like.

data.name: Beartic

attacks.name: Frozen Slice
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 50 damage to itself.

data.flavorText: It swims through frigid seas, searching for prey. From its frozen breath, it forms icy fangs that are harder than steel.

data.name: Wishiwashi

attacks.name: Deep Sea Swirl
attacks.text: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw 8 cards.

data.flavorText: Individually, they're incredibly weak. It's by gathering up into schools that they're able to confront opponents.

data.name: Mareanie

attacks.name: Regeneration
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Poison Tentacles
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

data.flavorText: The first symptom of its sting is numbness. The next is an itching sensation so intense that it's impossible to resist the urge to claw at your skin.

data.name: Toxapex

attacks.name: Recover
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon and heal all damage from it.

attacks.name: Poisonous Whip
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

data.flavorText: To survive in the cold waters of Galar, this Pokémon forms a dome with its legs, enclosing its body so it can capture its own body heat.

data.name: Dracovish

abilities.name: Primal Law
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, your opponent can't play any Pokémon from their hand to evolve their Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Powerful legs and jaws made it the apex predator of its time. Its own overhunting of its prey was what drove it to extinction.

data.name: Arctovish

attacks.name: Hard Face
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 60 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Cold Breath
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

data.flavorText: Though it's able to capture prey by freezing its surroundings, it has trouble eating the prey afterward because its mouth is on top of its head.

data.name: Mareep
data.flavorText: Rubbing its fleece generates electricity. You'll want to pet it because it's cute, but if you use your bare hand, you'll get a painful shock.

data.name: Flaaffy
data.flavorText: It stores electricity in its fluffy fleece. If it stores up too much, it will start to go bald in those patches.

data.name: Ampharos

attacks.name: Dazzle Blast
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

data.flavorText: Its tail shines bright and strong. It has been prized since long ago as a beacon for sailors.

data.name: Electrike

attacks.name: Thunderbolt
attacks.text: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It stores static electricity in its fur for discharging. It gives off sparks if a storm approaches.

data.name: Manectric

attacks.name: Strafe
attacks.text: You may switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Flash Impact
attacks.text: This attack also does 30 damage to 1 of your Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.flavorText: It stimulates its own muscles with electricity, so it can move quickly. It eases its soreness with electricity, too, so it can recover quickly as well.

data.name: Vikavolt V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Paralyzing Bolt
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, they can't play any Item cards from their hand.

attacks.name: Super Zap Cannon
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon.

data.name: Tapu Koko

attacks.name: Allure
attacks.text: Draw 2 cards.

data.flavorText: The lightning-wielding guardian deity of Melemele, Tapu Koko is brimming with curiosity and appears before people from time to time.

data.name: Toxel
data.flavorText: It stores poison in an internal poison sac and secretes that poison through its skin. If you touch this Pokémon, a tingling sensation follows.

data.name: Toxtricity

attacks.name: Risk Taker
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard the top 5 cards of your opponent's deck. If tails, discard the top 5 cards of your deck.

attacks.name: Thunder Jolt
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

data.flavorText: Capable of generating 15,000 volts of electricity, this Pokémon looks down on all that would challenge it.

data.name: Pincurchin

attacks.name: Double Draw
attacks.text: Draw 2 cards.

attacks.name: Zing Zap
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

data.flavorText: It feeds on seaweed, using its teeth to scrape it off rocks. Electric current flows from the tips of its spines.

data.name: Dracozolt

attacks.name: Amping Up
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon's Amping Up attack does 90 more damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Giga Impact
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

data.flavorText: In ancient times, it was unbeatable thanks to its powerful lower body, but it went extinct anyway after it depleted all its plant-based food sources.

data.name: Arctozolt

abilities.name: Biting Whirlpool
abilities.text: Whenever your opponent attaches an Energy card from their hand to 1 of their Pokémon, put 2 damage counters on that Pokémon.

data.flavorText: The shaking of its freezing upper half is what generates its electricity. It has a hard time walking around.

data.name: Jigglypuff
data.flavorText: The songs they sing are totally different depending on the region they live in. Some even sound like they're shouting!

data.name: Wigglytuff

attacks.name: Sleep Pulse
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Double Smash
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 90 damage for each heads.

data.flavorText: When it gets angry, it inhales with all its might, and its body gradually inflates. Sometimes they can grow 20 times larger!

data.name: Mew V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: X Ball
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage for each Energy attached to both Active Pokémon.

data.name: Snubbull
data.flavorText: In contrast to its appearance, it's quite timid. When playing with other puppy Pokémon, it sometimes gets bullied.

data.name: Granbull

attacks.name: Jaw Lock
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

data.flavorText: Although it's popular with young people, Granbull is timid and sensitive, so it's totally incompetent as a watchdog.

data.name: Lunatone

attacks.name: Future Sight
attacks.text: Look at the top 4 cards of either player's deck and put them back in any order.

attacks.name: Psychic
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

data.flavorText: The phase of the moon apparently has some effect on its power. It's active on the night of a full moon.

data.name: Gothita

attacks.name: Fortunate Eye
attacks.text: Look at the top 5 cards of your opponent's deck and put them back in any order.

data.flavorText: Though they're still only babies, there's psychic power stored in their ribbonlike feelers, and sometimes they use that power to fight.

data.name: Gothorita

attacks.name: Whiny Voice
attacks.text: Choose a random card from your opponent's hand. Your opponent reveals that card and shuffles it into their deck.

attacks.name: Double Spin
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage for each heads.

data.flavorText: It's said that when stars shine in the night sky, this Pokémon will spirit away sleeping children. Some call it the Witch of Punishment.

data.name: Gothitelle

attacks.name: Mind Bend
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Bend
attacks.text: Choose 2 random cards from your opponent's hand. Your opponent reveals those cards and shuffles them into their deck.

data.flavorText: It has tremendous psychic power, but it dislikes conflict. It's also able to predict the future based on the movement of the stars.

data.name: Golett
data.flavorText: They were sculpted from clay in ancient times. No one knows why, but some of them are driven to continually line up boulders.

data.name: Golurk
data.flavorText: Artillery platforms built into the walls of ancient castles served as perches from which Golurk could fire energy beams.

data.name: Dedenne

attacks.name: Mad Party
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each Pokémon in your discard pile that has the Mad Party attack.

data.flavorText: Its upper whiskers are sensors that survey its surroundings. Its lower whiskers are organs that shoot electricity.

data.name: Morelull

attacks.name: Spore
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

data.flavorText: Pokémon living in the forest eat the delicious caps on Morelull's head. The caps regrow overnight.

data.name: Shiinotic

attacks.name: Flickering Light
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't attack.

attacks.name: Fear the Forest
attacks.text: If Glimwood Tangle is in play, this attack does 60 more damage.

data.flavorText: Its flickering spores lure in prey and put them to sleep. Once this Pokémon has its prey snoozing, it drains their vitality with its fingertips.

data.name: Mimikyu

abilities.name: Heal Jamming
abilities.text: Your opponent's Benched Pokémon can't be healed.

data.flavorText: It wears a rag fashioned into a Pikachu costume in an effort to look less scary. Unfortunately, the costume only makes it creepier.

data.name: Sinistea

attacks.name: Furtive Drop
attacks.text: Put 2 damage counters on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

data.flavorText: This Pokémon is said to have been born when a lonely spirit possessed a cold, leftover cup of tea.

data.name: Polteageist

abilities.name: Tea Break
abilities.text: You must discard a Pokémon that has the Mad Party attack from your hand in order to use this Ability. Once during your turn, you may draw 2 cards.

attacks.name: Mad Party
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each Pokémon in your discard pile that has the Mad Party attack.

data.flavorText: This species lives in antique teapots. Most pots are forgeries, but on rare occasions, an authentic work is found.

data.name: Diglett
data.flavorText: If a Diglett digs through a field, it leaves the soil perfectly tilled and ideal for planting crops.

data.name: Dugtrio

attacks.name: Dig
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: A team of Diglett triplets. It triggers huge earthquakes by burrowing 60 miles underground.

data.name: Larvitar
data.flavorText: Born deep underground, it comes aboveground and becomes a pupa once it has finished eating the surrounding soil.

data.name: Pupitar

attacks.name: Rocket Evolution
attacks.text: Search your deck for a card that evolves from this Pokémon and put it onto this Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.

data.flavorText: Even sealed in its shell, it can move freely. Hard and fast, it has outstanding destructive power.

data.name: Tyranitar

attacks.name: Bedrock Breaker
attacks.text: Discard a Stadium in play.

attacks.name: Mountain Swing
attacks.text: Discard the top 5 cards of your deck.

data.flavorText: Its body can't be harmed by any sort of attack, so it is very eager to make challenges against enemies.

data.name: Trapinch

attacks.name: Land's Pulse
attacks.text: If a Stadium is in play, this attack does 10 more damage.

data.flavorText: Its nest is a sloped, bowl-like pit in the desert. Once something has fallen in, there is no escape.

data.name: Vibrava

attacks.name: Sand Pulse
attacks.text: This attack also does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.flavorText: The ultrasonic waves it generates by rubbing its two wings together cause severe headaches.

data.name: Flygon

abilities.name: Labyrinth of Sand
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, your opponent's Active Pokémon can't retreat.

attacks.name: Desert Geyser
attacks.text: If your opponent has a Stadium in play, discard it. If you discarded a Stadium in this way, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: This Pokémon hides in the heart of sandstorms it creates and seldom appears where people can see it.

data.name: Solrock

abilities.name: Resistance Shade
abilities.text: If you have Lunatone in play, your opponent's Pokémon in play have no Resistance.

data.flavorText: When it rotates itself, it gives off light similar to the sun, thus blinding its foes.

data.name: Hippopotas

attacks.name: Double Stomp
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 more damage for each heads.

data.flavorText: It moves through the sands with its mouth open, swallowing sand along with its prey. It gets rid of the sand by spouting it from its nose.

data.name: Hippowdon

attacks.name: Triple Smash
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 80 damage for each heads.

data.flavorText: Stones can get stuck in the ports on their bodies. Dwebble help dislodge such stones, so Hippowdon look after these Pokémon.

data.name: Rhyperior V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Drill Run
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Heavy Rock Artillery
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Heavy Rock Artillery.

data.name: Diggersby
data.flavorText: With power equal to an excavator, it can dig through dense bedrock. It's a huge help during tunnel construction.

data.name: Passimian

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Rock Hurl
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

data.flavorText: Displaying amazing teamwork, they follow the orders of their boss as they all help out in the search for their favorite berries.

data.name: Galarian Sirfetch'd

attacks.name: Meteor Assault
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't use Meteor Assault again until it leaves the Active Spot.

data.flavorText: Only Farfetch'd that have survived many battles can attain this evolution. When this Pokémon's leek withers, it will retire from combat.

data.name: Galarian Slowbro V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Rapid-Fire Poison
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may make your opponent's Active Pokémon Poisoned.

attacks.name: Tripping Shot
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

data.name: Grimer

attacks.name: Stomp Off
attacks.text: Discard the top card of your opponent's deck.

data.flavorText: The wastewater coming from factories is clean these days, so Grimer have nothing to eat. They're said to be on the verge of extinction.

data.name: Muk

attacks.name: Triple Poison
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. During Pokémon Checkup, put 3 damage counters on that Pokémon instead of 1.

data.flavorText: Because they scatter germs everywhere, they've long been targeted for extermination, leading to a steep decline in their population.

data.name: Spinarak
data.flavorText: Although the poison from its fangs isn't that strong, it's potent enough to weaken prey that gets caught in its web.

data.name: Ariados

abilities.name: Spider Net
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Evolution Pokémon with their Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Poison Sting
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

data.flavorText: It spews threads from its mouth to catch its prey. When night falls, it leaves its web to go hunt aggressively.

data.name: Crobat V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Dark Asset
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand. You can't use more than 1 Dark Asset Ability each turn.

attacks.name: Venomous Fang
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

data.name: Darkrai

abilities.name: Darkness Guard
abilities.text: If this Pokémon has any Darkness Energy attached, it takes 20 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Vortex of Darkness
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each Darkness Energy attached to this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It can lull people to sleep and make them dream. It is active during nights of the new moon.

data.name: Purrloin

attacks.name: Fake Out
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

data.flavorText: It steals things from people just to amuse itself with their frustration. A rivalry exists between this Pokémon and Nickit.

data.name: Liepard

abilities.name: Limber
abilities.text: This Pokémon can't be Paralyzed.

data.flavorText: Don't be fooled by its gorgeous fur and elegant figure. This is a moody and vicious Pokémon.

data.name: Deino
data.flavorText: When it encounters something, its first urge is usually to bite it. If it likes what it tastes, it will commit the associated scent to memory.

data.name: Zweilous
data.flavorText: While hunting for prey, Zweilous wanders its territory, its two heads often bickering over which way to go.

data.name: Hydreigon

abilities.name: Dark Squall
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn, you may attach a Darkness Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon.

data.flavorText: There are a slew of stories about villages that were destroyed by Hydreigon. It bites anything that moves.

data.name: Hoopa

attacks.name: Assault Gate
attacks.text: If this Pokémon didn't move from the Bench to the Active Spot this turn, this attack does nothing. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness.

data.flavorText: It gathers things it likes and passes them through its loop to teleport them to a secret place.

data.name: Nickit

attacks.name: Tail Whip
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't attack.

data.flavorText: Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it silently raids the food stores of other Pokémon. It survives off its ill-gotten gains.

data.name: Thievul

attacks.name: Nasty Plot
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 cards and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

data.flavorText: It secretly marks potential targets with a scent. By following the scent, it stalks its targets and steals from them when they least expect it.

data.name: Grimmsnarl V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Spiky Knuckle
attacks.text: Put 2 Darkness Energy attached to this Pokémon into your hand.

data.name: Grimmsnarl VMAX
rules: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: G-Max Drill
attacks.text: This attack does 50 more damage for each extra Darkness Energy attached to this Pokémon (in addition to this attack's cost). You can't add more than 100 damage in this way.

data.name: Eternatus V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Power Accelerator
attacks.text: You may attach a Darkness Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dynamax Cannon
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Pokémon VMAX, this attack does 120 more damage.

data.name: Eternatus VMAX
rules: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Eternal Zone
abilities.text: If all of your Pokémon in play are Darkness type, you can have up to 8 Pokémon on your Bench, and you can't put non-Darkness Pokémon into play. (If this Ability stops working, discard Pokémon from your Bench until you have 5.)

attacks.name: Dread End
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage for each of your Darkness Pokémon in play.

data.name: Scizor V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Hack Off
attacks.text: Discard a Pokémon Tool and a Special Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

data.name: Scizor VMAX
rules: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Hard Scissors
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

data.name: Skarmory

attacks.name: Metal Arms
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool attached, this attack does 40 more damage.

data.flavorText: Its body is draped in steel armor. It looks heavy, but it can fly at speeds of up to 185 miles an hour!

data.name: Aron
data.flavorText: When it evolves, it sheds the steel carapace that covered its whole body and develops a new one.

data.name: Lairon

attacks.name: Knock Away
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

data.flavorText: It habitually shows off its strength with the sparks it creates by ramming its steel body into boulders.

data.name: Aggron

abilities.name: Sturdy
abilities.text: If this Pokémon has full HP and would be Knocked Out by damage from an attack, it is not Knocked Out, and its remaining HP becomes 10.

data.flavorText: While seeking iron for food, it digs tunnels by breaking through bedrock with its steel horns.

data.name: Escavalier

attacks.name: Fury Cutter
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. If 1 of them is heads, this attack does 20 more damage. If 2 of them are heads, this attack does 70 more damage. If all of them are heads, this attack does 140 more damage.

data.flavorText: They use shells they've stolen from Shelmet to arm and protect themselves. They're very popular Pokémon in the Galar region.

data.name: Klink

attacks.name: Call for Backup
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Metal Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

data.flavorText: The two minigears that compose this Pokémon are closer than twins. They mesh well only with each other.

data.name: Klang

attacks.name: Call for Backup
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Metal Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

data.flavorText: When Klang goes all out, the minigear links up perfectly with the outer part of the big gear, and this Pokémon's rotation speed increases sharply.

data.name: Klinklang

attacks.name: Clockwork
attacks.text: If you don't have Klink and Klang on your Bench, this attack does nothing.

data.flavorText: From its spikes, it launches powerful blasts of electricity. Its red core contains an enormous amount of energy.

data.name: Galarian Stunfisk V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Metal Skin
abilities.text: This Pokémon gets +20 HP for each Metal Energy attached to it.

attacks.name: Trapping Bite
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, if this Pokémon is damaged by an attack (even if it is Knocked Out), put 12 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon.

data.name: Meltan
data.flavorText: It dissolves and eats metal. Circulating liquid metal within its body is how it generates energy.

data.name: Melmetal

attacks.name: Energy Link
attacks.text: Attach an Energy card from your discard pile to this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: At the end of its life-span, Melmetal will rust and fall apart. The small shards left behind will eventually be reborn as Meltan.

data.name: Cufant
data.flavorText: It digs up the ground with its trunk. It's also very strong, being able to carry loads of over five tons without any problem at all.

data.name: Copperajah

abilities.name: Antibacterial Skin
abilities.text: This Pokémon can't be affected by any Special Conditions.

attacks.name: Vengeful Stomp
attacks.text: If your Benched Pokémon have any damage counters on them, this attack does 120 more damage.

data.flavorText: They came over from another region long ago and worked together with humans. Their green skin is resistant to water.

data.name: Kangaskhan

attacks.name: Rally Back
attacks.text: If any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon during their last turn, this attack does 90 more damage.

data.flavorText: You shouldn't get close to the child when it's playing outside its mother's pouch. Its mother is always nearby watching over it.

data.name: Tauros
data.flavorText: They live in groups. The one with the longest, thickest, and most-scarred horns is the boss of the herd.

data.name: Sentret

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

data.flavorText: It stands on its tail so it can see a long way. If it spots an enemy, it cries loudly to warn its kind.

data.name: Furret

attacks.name: Feelin' Fine
attacks.text: Draw 3 cards.

attacks.name: Tail Smash
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

data.flavorText: It makes a nest to suit its long and skinny body. The nest is impossible for other Pokémon to enter.

data.name: Dunsparce

abilities.name: Final Dig
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, discard the top 2 cards of your opponent's deck.

data.flavorText: When it sees a person, it digs a hole with its tail to make its escape. If you happen to find one, consider yourself lucky.

data.name: Teddiursa

attacks.name: Baby-Doll Eyes
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

data.flavorText: Before food becomes scarce in wintertime, its habit is to hoard food in many hidden locations.

data.name: Ursaring

attacks.name: Hammer Arm
attacks.text: Discard the top card of your opponent's deck.

data.flavorText: Although it has a large body, it is quite skilled at climbing trees. It eats and sleeps in the treetops.

data.name: Lugia

attacks.name: Energy Loop
attacks.text: Put an Energy attached to this Pokémon into your hand.

data.flavorText: It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.

data.name: Skitty

attacks.name: Drawup Power
attacks.text: Search your deck for an Energy card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

data.flavorText: It shows its cute side by chasing its own tail until it gets dizzy.

data.name: Delcatty

attacks.name: Captivating Tail
attacks.text: Switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon. The new Active Pokémon is now Confused.

data.flavorText: It is highly popular among female Trainers for its sublime fur. It does not keep a nest.

data.name: Salamence V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Swoop Across
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.name: Salamence VMAX
rules: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Sonic Double
attacks.text: This attack does 40 damage to 2 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Max Wings
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Max Wings.

data.name: Starly

abilities.name: Sky Circus
abilities.text: If you played Bird Keeper from your hand during this turn, ignore all Energy in this Pokémon's attack costs.

attacks.name: Keen Eye
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 cards and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

data.flavorText: They flock around mountains and fields, chasing after bug Pokémon. Their singing is noisy and annoying.

data.name: Staravia

attacks.name: Ambush
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

data.flavorText: It lives in forests and fields. Squabbles over territory occur when flocks collide.

data.name: Staraptor

attacks.name: Hurricane Blender
attacks.text: Move any amount of Energy from your Pokémon to your other Pokémon in any way you like.

attacks.name: Brave Bird
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

data.flavorText: When Staravia evolve into Staraptor, they leave the flock to live alone. They have sturdy wings.

data.name: Ducklett
data.flavorText: They are better at swimming than flying, and they happily eat their favorite food, peat moss, as they dive underwater.

data.name: Swanna

abilities.name: Sky Circus
abilities.text: If you played Bird Keeper from your hand during this turn, ignore all Energy in this Pokémon's attack costs.

attacks.name: Feather Slice
attacks.text: You may discard a card from your hand. If you do, this attack does 70 more damage.

data.flavorText: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.

data.name: Bunnelby

attacks.name: Mad Party
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each Pokémon in your discard pile that has the Mad Party attack.

data.flavorText: It excels at digging holes. Using its ears, it can dig a nest 33 feet deep in one night.

data.name: Fletchling
data.flavorText: Its body is always warm. Trainers who live in cold areas apparently sleep with it in their bed.

data.name: Skwovet

attacks.name: Whimsy Tackle
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

data.flavorText: Found throughout the Galar region, this Pokémon becomes uneasy if its cheeks are ever completely empty of berries.

data.name: Greedent

attacks.name: Scrape Off
attacks.text: Before doing damage, discard all Pokémon Tools from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Smack and Run
attacks.text: Put this Pokémon and all attached cards into your hand.

data.flavorText: It stashes berries in its tail—so many berries that they fall out constantly. But this Pokémon is a bit slow-witted, so it doesn't notice the loss.

data.name: Rookidee

attacks.name: Pluck
attacks.text: Before doing damage, discard all Pokémon Tools from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It will bravely challenge any opponent, no matter how powerful. This Pokémon benefits from every battle—even a defeat increases its strength a bit.

data.name: Corvisquire

attacks.name: Fury Attack
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 40 damage for each heads.

data.flavorText: Smart enough to use tools in battle, these Pokémon have been seen picking up rocks and flinging them or using ropes to wrap up enemies.

data.name: Corviknight

abilities.name: Flying Taxi
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may put 1 of your Pokémon, except any Corviknight, and all attached cards into your hand.

data.flavorText: This Pokémon reigns supreme in the skies of the Galar region. The black luster of its steel body could drive terror into the heart of any foe.

data.name: Big Parasol
rules: Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached.

As long as the Pokémon this card is attached to is in the Active Spot, prevent all effects of attacks from your opponent's Pokémon done to all of your Pokémon. (Existing effects are not removed. Damage is not an effect.)
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

data.name: Billowing Smoke
rules: Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached.

If the Pokémon this card is attached to is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, that player discards any Prize cards they would take for that Knock Out instead of putting those cards into their hand.
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

data.name: Bird Keeper
rules: Switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. If you do, draw 3 cards.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

data.name: Cape of Toughness
rules: Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached.
The Basic Pokémon this card is attached to gets +50 HP, except Pokémon-GX.
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

data.name: Familiar Bell
rules: Search your deck for a Pokémon with the same name as a Pokémon in your discard pile, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

data.name: Glimwood Tangle
rules: Once during each player's turn, after that player flips any coins for an attack, they may ignore all results of those coin flips and begin flipping those coins again.
This Stadium stays in play when you play it. Discard it if another Stadium comes into play. If a Stadium with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.

data.name: Kabu
rules: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw 4 cards. If your Active Pokémon is your only Pokémon in play, draw 8 cards instead.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

data.name: Old PC
rules: Flip 2 coins. If both are heads, put a card from your discard pile into your hand.
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

data.name: Piers
rules: Search your deck for an Energy card and a Darkness Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

data.name: Pokémon Breeder's Nurturing
rules: Choose up to 2 of your Pokémon in play. For each of those Pokémon, search your deck for a card that evolves from that Pokémon and put it onto that Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck. You can't use this card during your first turn or on a Pokémon that was put into play this turn.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

data.name: Rare Fossil
rules: Play this card as if it were a 70-HP Basic Colorless Pokémon. At any time during your turn, you may discard this card from play.
This card can't be affected by any Special Conditions, and it can't retreat.
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

data.name: Rose
rules: Attach up to 2 basic Energy cards from your discard pile to 1 of your Pokémon VMAX. If you attached any Energy cards in this way, discard your hand.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

data.name: Rose Tower
rules: Once during each player's turn, that player may draw cards until they have 3 cards in their hand.
This Stadium stays in play when you play it. Discard it if another Stadium comes into play. If a Stadium with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.

data.name: Spikemuth
rules: Whenever a player's Active Pokémon moves to the Bench during their turn, put 2 damage counters on that Pokémon.
This Stadium stays in play when you play it. Discard it if another Stadium comes into play. If a Stadium with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.

data.name: Struggle Gloves
rules: Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached.

You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

data.name: Galarian Cursola

abilities.name: Perish Body
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is Knocked Out by damage from an opponent's attack, flip a coin. If heads, the Attacking Pokémon is Knocked Out.

attacks.name: Corner
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

data.flavorText: Its shell is overflowing with its heightened otherworldly energy. The ectoplasm serves as protection for this Pokémon's core spirit.

data.name: Sigilyph

abilities.name: Counterattack
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon and is damaged by an opponent's attack (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), put 3 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon.

attacks.name: Psychic Assault
attacks.text: This attack does 10 more damage for each damage counter on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Psychic power allows these Pokémon to fly. Some say they were the guardians of an ancient city. Others say they were the guardians' emissaries.

data.name: Sandygast

attacks.name: Sneaky Placement
attacks.text: Put 1 damage counter on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

data.flavorText: If you build sand mounds when you're playing, destroy them before you go home, or they may get possessed and become Sandygast.

data.name: Palossand

attacks.name: Sand Sink
attacks.text: Discard the top card of your opponent's deck. If this Pokémon has a Cursed Shovel attached, discard 2 more cards from the top of your opponent's deck.

attacks.name: Super Absorption
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Once it has whipped up a sandstorm to halt its opponents in their tracks, this terrifying Pokémon snatches away their vitality.

data.name: Hatenna

attacks.name: Find a Friend
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

data.flavorText: Via the protrusion on its head, it senses other creatures' emotions. If you don't have a calm disposition, it will never warm up to you.

data.name: Hattrem

attacks.name: Calm Mind
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Brutal Swing
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

data.flavorText: No matter who you are, if you bring strong emotions near this Pokémon, it will silence you violently.

data.name: Hatterene

abilities.name: Mind Hat
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. Each player discards a card from their hand. (Your opponent discards first.)

attacks.name: Dripping Grudge
attacks.text: Put 1 damage counter on your opponent's Active Pokémon for each Pokémon in your discard pile.

data.flavorText: It emits psychic power strong enough to cause headaches as a deterrent to the approach of others.

data.name: Milcery

attacks.name: Aromatherapy
attacks.text: Heal 10 damage from each of your Pokémon.

data.flavorText: This Pokémon was born from sweet-smelling particles in the air. Its body is made of cream.

data.name: Alcremie

attacks.name: Decorate
attacks.text: Attach any number of basic Energy cards from your hand to your Pokémon in any way you like.

attacks.name: Draining Kiss
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: When it trusts a Trainer, it will treat them to berries it's decorated with cream.

data.name: Indeedee

attacks.name: Replenish Time
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from each of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Psybeam
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

data.flavorText: These intelligent Pokémon touch horns with each other to share information between them.

data.name: Dreepy

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 more damage.

data.flavorText: After being reborn as a ghost Pokémon, Dreepy wanders the areas it used to inhabit back when it was alive in prehistoric seas.

data.name: Drakloak

attacks.name: Summon
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Dreepy and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

data.flavorText: It's capable of flying faster than 120 mph. It battles alongside Dreepy and dotes on them until they successfully evolve.

data.name: Dragapult

abilities.name: Infiltrator
abilities.text: If any damage is done to this Pokémon by attacks, flip a coin. If heads, prevent that damage.

attacks.name: Phantom Force
attacks.text: Put 3 damage counters on your opponent's Benched Pokémon in any way you like.

data.flavorText: When it isn't battling, it keeps Dreepy in the holes on its horns. Once a fight starts, it launches the Dreepy like supersonic missiles.

data.name: Dragapult V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Jet Assault
attacks.text: If this Pokémon moved from your Bench to the Active Spot this turn, this attack does 80 more damage.

data.name: Dragapult VMAX
rules: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Shred
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Max Phantom
attacks.text: Put 5 damage counters on your opponent's Benched Pokémon in any way you like.

data.name: Galarian Farfetch'd

attacks.name: Rock Smash
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

data.flavorText: The Farfetch'd of the Galar region are brave warriors, and they wield thick, tough leeks in battle.

data.name: Galarian Sirfetch'd

attacks.name: Meteor Assault
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't use Meteor Assault again until it leaves the Active Spot.

data.flavorText: Only Farfetch'd that have survived many battles can attain this evolution. When this Pokémon's leek withers, it will retire from combat.

data.name: Nosepass
data.flavorText: It hunts without twitching a muscle by pulling in its prey with powerful magnetism. But sometimes it pulls natural enemies in close.

data.name: Meditite

attacks.name: Yoga Shock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

data.flavorText: It eats just one berry a day. By enduring hunger, its spirit is tempered and made sharper.

data.name: Medicham

attacks.name: Yoga Kick
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance.

attacks.name: Psychic
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Through yoga training, it gained the psychic power to predict its foe's next move.

data.name: Barboach
data.flavorText: Its slimy body is hard to grasp. In one region, it is said to have been born from hardened mud.

data.name: Whiscash

abilities.name: Submerge
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks (both yours and your opponent's).

attacks.name: Earthquake
attacks.text: This attack also does 20 damage to each of your Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.flavorText: It makes its nest at the bottom of swamps. It will eat anything—if it is alive, Whiscash will eat it.

data.name: Galarian Yamask

attacks.name: Reckless Charge
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

data.flavorText: A clay slab with cursed engravings took possession of a Yamask. The slab is said to be absorbing the Yamask's dark power.

data.name: Galarian Runerigus

attacks.name: Spreading Spite
attacks.text: For each damage counter on this Galarian Runerigus, put 2 damage counters on your opponent's Pokémon in any way you like.

attacks.name: Mad Hammer
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

data.flavorText: A powerful curse was woven into an ancient painting. After absorbing the spirit of a Yamask, the painting began to move.

data.name: Binacle

attacks.name: Dual Chop
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 50 damage for each heads.

data.flavorText: After two Binacle find a suitably sized rock, they adhere themselves to it and live together. They cooperate to gather food during high tide.

data.name: Barbaracle

attacks.name: Rock Hurl
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

attacks.name: Hand Press
attacks.text: If you have more cards in your hand than your opponent, this attack does 80 more damage.

data.flavorText: Seven Binacle come together to form one Barbaracle. The Binacle that serves as the head gives orders to those serving as the limbs.

data.name: Rolycoly
data.flavorText: Most of its body has the same composition as coal. Fittingly, this Pokémon was first discovered in coal mines about 400 years ago.

data.name: Carkol
data.flavorText: It forms coal inside its body. Coal dropped by this Pokémon once helped fuel the lives of people in the Galar region.

data.name: Coalossal

abilities.name: Tar Generator
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may attach a Fire Energy card, a Fighting Energy card, or 1 of each from your discard pile to your Pokémon in any way you like.

data.flavorText: It's usually peaceful, but the vandalism of mines enrages it. Offenders will be incinerated with flames that reach 2,700 degrees Fahrenheit.

data.name: Sandaconda V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Sand Eater
attacks.text: Attach a Fighting Energy card from your discard pile to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Sand Breath
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon.

data.name: Falinks

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Team Attack
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage for each of your Benched Pokémon that has "Falinks" in its name.

data.flavorText: Five of them are troopers, and one is the brass. The brass's orders are absolute.

data.name: Falinks V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Iron Defense Formation
abilities.text: All of your Pokémon that have "Falinks" in their name take 20 less damage from your opponent's attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Giga Impact
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

data.name: Stonjourner

attacks.name: Power Press
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has at least 1 extra Energy attached (in addition to this attack's cost), this attack does 60 more damage.

data.flavorText: It stands in grasslands, watching the sun's descent from zenith to horizon. This Pokémon has a talent for delivering dynamic kicks.

data.name: Koffing
data.flavorText: Its body is full of poisonous gas. It floats into garbage dumps, seeking out the fumes of raw, rotting trash.

data.name: Galarian Weezing

abilities.name: Neutralizing Gas
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, your opponent's Pokémon in play have no Abilities, except for Neutralizing Gas.

attacks.name: Severe Poison
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. Put 4 damage counters instead of 1 on that Pokémon during Pokémon Checkup.

data.flavorText: This Pokémon consumes particles that contaminate the air. Instead of leaving droppings, it expels clean air.

data.name: Stunky

attacks.name: Poison Gas
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

data.flavorText: From its rear, it sprays a foul-smelling liquid at opponents. It aims for their faces, and it can hit them from over 16 feet away.

data.name: Skuntank

attacks.name: Poison Ring
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

data.flavorText: In its belly, it reserves stinky fluid that it shoots from its tail during battle. As this Pokémon's diet varies, so does the stench of its fluid.

data.name: Spiritomb

attacks.name: Splitting Spite
attacks.text: Discard the top card of each player's deck.

attacks.name: Dripping Grudge
attacks.text: Put 1 damage counter on your opponent's Active Pokémon for each Pokémon in your discard pile.

data.flavorText: It was bound to a fissure in an Odd Keystone as punishment for misdeeds 500 years ago.

data.name: Trubbish

attacks.name: Venoshock
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Poisoned, this attack does 50 more damage.

data.flavorText: Its favorite places are unsanitary ones. If you leave trash lying around, you could even find one of these Pokémon living in your room.

data.name: Garbodor

abilities.name: Poisonous Puddle
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if a Stadium is in play, you may make your opponent's Active Pokémon Poisoned.

data.flavorText: This Pokémon eats trash, which turns into poison inside its body. The main component of the poison depends on what sort of trash was eaten.

data.name: Vullaby

attacks.name: Pluck
attacks.text: Before doing damage, discard all Pokémon Tools from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It wears a bone to protect its rear. It often squabbles with others of its kind over particularly comfy bones.

data.name: Mandibuzz

attacks.name: Bone Rush
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 30 damage for each heads.

attacks.name: Blindside
attacks.text: This attack does 100 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon that has any damage counters on it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.flavorText: Although it's a bit of a ruffian, this Pokémon will take lost Vullaby under its wing and care for them till they're ready to leave the nest.

data.name: Malamar V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Drag Off
attacks.text: Switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon. This attack does 30 damage to the new Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Brain Shake
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

data.name: Malamar VMAX
rules: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Max Jammer
attacks.text: Your opponent reveals their hand. Choose a card you find there and put it on the bottom of their deck.

data.name: Impidimp
data.flavorText: Through its nose, it sucks in the emanations produced by people and Pokémon when they feel annoyed. It thrives off this negative energy.

data.name: Morgrem

attacks.name: False Surrender
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

data.flavorText: When it gets down on all fours as if to beg for forgiveness, it's trying to lure opponents in so that it can stab them with its spear-like hair.

data.name: Grimmsnarl

abilities.name: Dark Oath
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, your opponent's Active Pokémon's attacks cost Colorless more.

attacks.name: Energy Press
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

data.flavorText: With the hair wrapped around its body helping to enhance its muscles, this Pokémon can overwhelm even Machamp.

data.name: Galarian Meowth

abilities.name: Evolution Roar
abilities.text: You must discard 2 cards from your hand in order to use this Ability. Once during your turn, you may search your deck for a Galarian Perrserker, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

data.flavorText: Living with a savage, seafaring people has toughened this Pokémon's body so much that parts of it have turned to iron.

data.name: Galarian Perrserker

attacks.name: Claw Dagger
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 80 damage for each heads.

data.flavorText: What appears to be an iron helmet is actually hardened hair. This Pokémon lives for the thrill of battle.

data.name: Scizor

attacks.name: Raid
attacks.text: If this Pokémon evolved from Scyther during this turn, this attack does 90 more damage.

attacks.name: Guard Claw
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

data.flavorText: Once it has identified something as an enemy, it will continue beating them with its steel-hard pincers until there's nothing left but scraps.

data.name: Bronzor
data.flavorText: It appears in ancient ruins. The pattern on its body doesn't come from any culture in the Galar region, so it remains shrouded in mystery.

data.name: Bronzong

attacks.name: Gyro Ball
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. If you do, your opponent switches their Active Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Some believe it to be a deity that summons rain clouds. When angered, it lets out a warning cry that rings out like the tolling of a bell.

data.name: Probopass

attacks.name: Gravitational Drop
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each Colorless in your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost.

data.flavorText: It uses three small units to catch prey and battle enemies. The main body mostly just gives orders.

data.name: Durant

attacks.name: Gathering Food
attacks.text: For each Energy attached to this Pokémon, search your deck for a Trainer card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

data.flavorText: They lay their eggs deep inside their nests. When attacked by Heatmor, they retaliate using their massive mandibles.

data.name: Honedge
data.flavorText: Honedge's soul once belonged to a person who was killed a long time ago by the sword that makes up Honedge's body.

data.name: Doublade

attacks.name: Double Slash
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 80 damage for each heads.

data.flavorText: Honedge evolves into twins. The two blades rub together to emit a metallic sound that unnerves opponents.

data.name: Aegislash

abilities.name: Big Shield
abilities.text: All of your Pokémon take 30 less damage from your opponent's attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance). You can't apply more than 1 Big Shield Ability at a time.

data.flavorText: In this defensive stance, Aegislash uses its steel body and a force field of spectral power to reduce the damage of any attack.

data.name: Copperajah V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Adamantine Press
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

data.name: Copperajah VMAX
rules: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Dangerous Nose
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Basic Pokémon, this attack does 100 more damage.

data.name: Duraludon

attacks.name: Metal Sharpener
attacks.text: Attach a Metal Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Its body resembles polished metal, and it's both lightweight and strong. The only drawback is that it rusts easily.

data.name: Zacian

attacks.name: Energy Stream
attacks.text: Attach a Metal Energy card from your discard pile to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Smashing Edge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Now armed with a weapon it used in ancient times, this Pokémon needs only a single strike to fell even Gigantamax Pokémon.

data.name: Zamazenta

attacks.name: Guard Press
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 20 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Power Rush
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this Pokémon can't attack during your next turn.

data.flavorText: Its ability to deflect any attack led to it being known as the Fighting Master's Shield. It was feared and respected by all.

data.name: Snorlax

attacks.name: Collect
attacks.text: Draw 2 cards.

attacks.name: Collapse
attacks.text: This Pokémon is now Asleep.

data.flavorText: It is not satisfied unless it eats over 880 pounds of food every day. When it is done eating, it goes promptly to sleep.

data.name: Chatot

abilities.name: Lucky Match
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may flip a coin. If heads, put a Supporter card from your discard pile into your hand.

data.flavorText: It can learn and speak human words. If they gather, they all learn the same saying.

data.name: Pidove

attacks.name: Chirp
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Pokémon with Fighting Resistance, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

data.flavorText: Where people go, these Pokémon follow. If you're scattering food for them, be careful—several hundred of them can gather at once.

data.name: Tranquill
data.flavorText: It can fly moderately quickly. No matter how far it travels, it can always find its way back to its master and its nest.

data.name: Unfezant

attacks.name: Daunt
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon's attacks do 50 less damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Air Slash
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Unfezant are exceptional fliers. The females are known for their stamina, while the males outclass them in terms of speed.

data.name: Bunnelby

attacks.name: Burrow
attacks.text: Discard the top card of your opponent's deck.

data.flavorText: It excels at digging holes. Using its ears, it can dig a nest 33 feet deep in one night.

data.name: Diggersby

attacks.name: Mining Rush
attacks.text: Discard up to 6 cards from the top of your deck. If you do, this attack does 30 damage for each card you discarded in this way.

data.flavorText: With power equal to an excavator, it can dig through dense bedrock. It's a huge help during tunnel construction.

data.name: Hawlucha

attacks.name: Windfall
attacks.text: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw 5 cards.

data.flavorText: It drives its opponents to exhaustion with its agile maneuvers, then ends the fight with a flashy finishing move.

data.name: Stufful

attacks.name: Jump On
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 40 more damage.

data.flavorText: Its fluffy fur is a delight to pet, but carelessly reaching out to touch this Pokémon could result in painful retaliation.

data.name: Bewear

attacks.name: Hammer Arm
attacks.text: Discard the top card of your opponent's deck.

attacks.name: Big Throw
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard your opponent's Active Pokémon and all attached cards.

data.flavorText: Once it accepts you as a friend, it tries to show its affection with a hug. Letting it do that is dangerous—it could easily shatter your bones.

data.name: Skwovet
data.flavorText: Found throughout the Galar region, this Pokémon becomes uneasy if its cheeks are ever completely empty of berries.

data.name: Greedent

abilities.name: Greedy Tail
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may search your deck for a Pokémon Tool card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

data.flavorText: It stashes berries in its tail—so many berries that they fall out constantly. But this Pokémon is a bit slow-witted, so it doesn't notice the loss.

data.name: Dubwool V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Soft Wool
abilities.text: This Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Revenge Blast
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each Prize card your opponent has taken.

data.name: Boss's Orders
rules: Switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

data.name: Burning Scarf
rules: Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached.
If the Fire Pokémon this card is attached to is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an opponent's attack (even if it is Knocked Out), the Attacking Pokémon is now Burned.
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

data.name: Capacious Bucket
rules: Search your deck for up to 2 Water Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

data.name: Cursed Shovel
rules: Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached.
If the Pokémon this card is attached to is Knocked Out by damage from an opponent's attack, discard the top 2 cards of your opponent's deck.
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

data.name: Dan
rules: Draw 2 cards. You and your opponent play Rock-Paper-Scissors until someone wins. If you win, draw 2 more cards.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

data.name: Full Heal
rules: Your Active Pokémon recovers from all Special Conditions.
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

data.name: Galar Mine
rules: The Retreat Cost of both Active Pokémon is ColorlessColorless more.
This Stadium stays in play when you play it. Discard it if another Stadium comes into play. If a Stadium with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.

data.name: Milo
rules: Discard up to 2 cards from your hand, and draw 2 cards for each card you discarded in this way.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

data.name: Nugget
rules: You can play this card only if you drew it from your deck at the beginning of your turn, before you put it into your hand.
Draw 3 cards.
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

data.name: Oleana
rules: You can play this card only if you discard 2 other cards from your hand.
Your opponent reveals their hand. Put a Trainer card you find there on the bottom of their deck.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

data.name: Poké Ball
rules: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

data.name: Scoop Up Net
rules: Put 1 of your Pokémon that isn't a Pokémon V or a Pokémon-GX into your hand. (Discard all attached cards.)
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

data.name: Skyla
rules: Search your deck for a Trainer card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

data.name: Sonia
rules: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon or up to 2 basic Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

data.name: Tool Scrapper
rules: Choose up to 2 Pokémon Tools attached to Pokémon (yours or your opponent's) and discard them.
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

data.name: Training Court
rules: Once during each player's turn, that player may put a basic Energy card from their discard pile into their hand.
This Stadium stays in play when you play it. Discard it if another Stadium comes into play. If a Stadium with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.

data.name: Turffield Stadium
rules: Once during each player's turn, that player may search their deck for an Evolution Grass Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into their hand. Then, that player shuffles their deck.
This Stadium stays in play when you play it. Discard it if another Stadium comes into play. If a Stadium with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.

data.name: Capture Energy
rules: As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides Colorless Energy.
When you attach this card from your hand to a Pokémon, search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

data.name: Horror Psychic Energy
rules: As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides Psychic Energy.
If the Psychic Pokémon this card is attached to is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an opponent's attack (even if it is Knocked Out), put 2 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon.

data.name: Speed Lightning Energy
rules: As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides Lightning Energy.
When you attach this card from your hand to a Lightning Pokémon, draw 2 cards.

data.name: Twin Energy
rules: As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon that isn't a Pokémon V or a Pokémon-GX, it provides ColorlessColorless Energy.
If this card is attached to a Pokémon V or a Pokémon-GX, it provides Colorless Energy instead.

data.name: Rillaboom V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Forest Feast
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Grass Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Wood Hammer
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

data.name: Eldegoss V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Happy Match
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may put a Supporter card from your discard pile into your hand.

attacks.name: Float Up
attacks.text: You may shuffle this Pokémon and all attached cards into your deck.

data.name: Ninetales V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Nine-Tailed Shapeshifter
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Active Pokémon's attacks and use it as this attack.

attacks.name: Flamethrower
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Being consumed in Chandelure's flame burns up the spirit, leaving the body behind.

data.name: Fletchinder

attacks.name: Flame Charge
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Fire Energy card and attach it to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

data.flavorText: It scatters embers in the tall grass. Then bug Pokémon, frightened by the flames, come flying out, and Fletchinder gobbles them up.

data.name: Talonflame

attacks.name: Heat Wave
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

attacks.name: Flare Raid
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon. This attack does 50 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.flavorText: Its tough wings don't allow fire to pass through them. A long time ago, firefighters' outfits were made from Talonflame wings.

data.name: Salandit
data.flavorText: The males will do whatever the females tell them. They give the females most of their food. Due to malnutrition, the males can't evolve.

data.name: Salazzle
data.flavorText: Salazzle lives deep in caves and forces the Salandit it has attracted with its pheromones to serve it.

data.name: Slowpoke & Psyduck-GX
rules: TAG TEAM rule: When your TAG TEAM is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Ditch and Splash
attacks.text: Discard any number of Supporter cards from your hand. This attack does 40 damage for each card you discarded in this way.

attacks.name: Thrilling Times-GX
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 100 more damage. If this Pokémon has at least 6 extra Water Energy attached to it (in addition to this attack's cost), flip 10 coins instead, and this attack does 100 more damage for each heads. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

data.name: Lapras

abilities.name: Mermaid's Call
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may put a Misty's Favor card from your discard pile into your hand.

data.flavorText: It likes swimming around with people on its back. In the Alola region, it's an important means of transportation over water.

data.name: Snorunt
data.flavorText: It feeds mainly on ice and snow. It's only able to survive in a limited number of places in the warm Alola region.

data.name: Froslass

attacks.name: Spiteful Sigh
attacks.text: Put up to 7 damage counters on this Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage for each damage counter you placed in this way.

attacks.name: Icy Wind
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

data.flavorText: It freezes hikers who have come to climb snowy mountains and carries them back to its home. It only goes after men it thinks are handsome.

data.name: Finneon
data.flavorText: When night falls, their pink patterns begin to shine. They're popular with divers, so there are resorts that feed them to keep them close.

data.name: Lumineon

attacks.name: Neon Trickery
attacks.text: You may move an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon to 1 of their Benched Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Deep down at the bottom of the ocean, prey is scarce. Lumineon get into fierce disputes with Lanturn over food.

data.name: Snover

attacks.name: Powder Snow
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

data.flavorText: During cold seasons, it migrates to the mountain's lower reaches. It returns to the snow-covered summit in the spring.

data.name: Abomasnow

attacks.name: Quick Freeze
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon has any Water Energy attached to it, it is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Wild Tackle
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 20 damage to itself.

data.flavorText: It blankets wide areas in snow by whipping up blizzards. It is also known as "The Ice Monster."

data.name: Basculin

attacks.name: Swarming Bites
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each Basculin you have in play to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.flavorText: Savage, violent Pokémon, red and blue Basculin are always fighting each other over territory.

data.name: Tirtouga
data.flavorText: It was restored from an ancient fossil. Tirtouga lived in the sea but came up onto the land to search for prey.

data.name: Carracosta

abilities.name: Ancient Custom
abilities.text: Pokémon Tool cards attached to your opponent's Pokémon have no effect.

attacks.name: Aqua Impact
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each Colorless in your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost.

data.flavorText: Its jaws are terrifyingly powerful. It could eat Omastar and Omanyte whole and not be bothered in the slightest by their shells.

data.name: Cryogonal

attacks.name: Frozen Lock
attacks.text: Your opponent can't play any Item cards from their hand during their next turn.

data.flavorText: They are born in snow clouds. They use chains made of ice crystals to capture prey.

data.name: Keldeo-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.
