data.flavorText: One of the legendary bird Pokémon. It is said that its appearance indicates the coming of spring.

data.name: Cyndaquil

attacks.name: Smokescreen
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack doesn't happen.

data.flavorText: It has a timid nature. If it is startled, the flames on its back burn more vigorously.

data.name: Cyndaquil
data.flavorText: It has a timid nature. If it is startled, the flames on its back burn more vigorously.

data.name: Quilava

attacks.name: Super Singe
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

data.flavorText: Be careful if it turns its back during battle. It means that it will attack with the fire on its back.

data.name: Typhlosion

abilities.name: Blazing Energy
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may use this Ability. All Energy attached to your Pokémon are Fire Energy instead of their usual type until the end of your turn. (This includes cards that come into play on this turn.)

attacks.name: Lost Flame
attacks.text: Put 2 Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon in the Lost Zone.

data.flavorText: It has a secret, devastating move. It rubs its blazing fur together to cause huge explosions.

data.name: Slugma

attacks.name: Flamethrower
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Its body is made of magma. If it doesn't keep moving, its body will cool and harden.

data.name: Magcargo-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Crushing Charge
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may discard the top card of your deck. If it's a basic Energy card, attach it to 1 of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Lava Flow
attacks.text: Discard any amount of basic Energy from this Pokémon. This attack does 50 more damage for each card you discarded in this way.

attacks.name: Burning Magma-GX
attacks.text: Discard the top 5 cards of your opponent's deck. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

data.name: Houndour

attacks.name: Team Hunt
attacks.text: Draw a card for each of your Houndour in play.

data.flavorText: To corner prey, they check each other's location using barks that only they can understand.

data.name: Houndoom

attacks.name: Nasty Plot
attacks.text: Search your deck for a card and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Attack Operation
attacks.text: If you have more cards in your hand than your opponent, this attack does 80 more damage.

data.flavorText: The flames it breathes when angry contain toxins. If they cause a burn, it will hurt forever.

data.name: Entei

attacks.name: Fire Fang
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

attacks.name: Eruption
attacks.text: Each player discards the top card of their deck. This attack does 60 more damage for each Energy card discarded in this way.

data.flavorText: It is said that when it roars, a volcano erupts somewhere around the globe.

data.name: Heatran

attacks.name: Lava Burn
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Heat Bazooka
attacks.text: Discard the top 5 cards of your deck.

data.flavorText: Boiling blood, like magma, circulates through its body. It makes its dwelling place in volcanic caves.

data.name: Victini

attacks.name: V-Beatdown
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each of your Basic Pokémon in play.

data.flavorText: When it shares the infinite energy it creates, that being's entire body will be overflowing with power.

data.name: Litleo

abilities.name: Wild Dash
abilities.text: If your opponent has any Pokémon-GX or Pokémon-EX in play, this Pokémon has no Retreat Cost.

attacks.name: Take Down
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 10 damage to itself.

data.flavorText: They set off on their own from their pride and live by themselves to become stronger. These hot-blooded Pokémon are quick to fight.

data.name: Pyroar

attacks.name: Crunch
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

data.flavorText: With fiery breath of more than 10,000 degrees Fahrenheit, they viciously threaten any challenger. The females protect the pride's cubs.

data.name: Blacephalon-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Bursting Burn
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned and Confused.

attacks.name: Mind Blown
attacks.text: Put any amount of Fire Energy attached to your Pokémon in the Lost Zone. This attack does 50 damage for each card put in the Lost Zone in this way.

attacks.name: Burst-GX
attacks.text: Discard 1 of your Prize cards. If it's an Energy card, attach it to 1 of your Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

data.name: Alolan Vulpix

abilities.name: Secret Alleyway
abilities.text: If you have any Fairy Pokémon in play, this Pokémon has no Retreat Cost.

data.flavorText: In hot weather, this Pokémon makes ice shards with its six tails and sprays them around to cool itself off.

data.name: Slowpoke

attacks.name: Yawn
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

data.flavorText: Alolan home cooking involves drying Slowpoke tails and then simmering them into a salty stew.

data.name: Slowking

attacks.name: Memory Melt
attacks.text: Look at your opponent's hand and put a card you find there in the Lost Zone.

attacks.name: Psychic
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage times the amount of Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

data.flavorText: This Pokémon is so famed for its intellect that a proverb still persists in some regions: "When in doubt, ask Slowking."

data.name: Lapras

abilities.name: Go for a Swim
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may look at the top 2 cards of your deck and put them back in any order.

attacks.name: Ice Beam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

data.flavorText: These Pokémon were once near extinction due to poaching. Following protective regulations, there is now an overabundance of them.

data.name: Delibird

attacks.name: Happy Delivery
attacks.text: Choose any number of your Benched Pokémon that don't already have a Pokémon Tool attached to them. For each of those Pokémon, search your deck for a Pokémon Tool card and attach it to that Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

data.flavorText: It has a generous habit of sharing its food with people and Pokémon, so it's always scrounging around for more food.

data.name: Mantine

abilities.name: Mantine Surf
abilities.text: If this Pokémon has any Energy attached to it, it has no Retreat Cost.

data.flavorText: While elegantly swimming in the sea, it ignores Remoraid that cling to its fins seeking food scraps.

data.name: Suicune

abilities.name: Frozen Flow
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, you may have your opponent switch their Active Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Aurora Gain
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Said to be the embodiment of north winds, it can instantly purify filthy, murky water.

data.name: Suicune-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Phantom Winds
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if this Pokémon is on your Bench, you may shuffle it and all cards attached to it into your deck.

attacks.name: Cure Stream
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon's attacks do 30 less damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Brinicles-GX
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

data.name: Cubchoo

attacks.name: Secondary Chills
attacks.text: You can use this attack only if you go second, and only on your first turn. Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

data.flavorText: Their snot is a barometer of health. When healthy, their snot is sticky and the power of their ice moves increases.

data.name: Beartic

attacks.name: Resolute Claws
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Pokémon-GX or a Pokémon-EX, this attack does 60 more damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Blizzard Burn
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't attack during your next turn.

data.flavorText: It freezes its breath to create fangs and claws of ice to fight with. Cold northern areas are its habitat.

data.name: White Kyurem

attacks.name: Field Crush
attacks.text: If your opponent has a Stadium card in play, discard it.

attacks.name: Freezing Flames
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has any Fire Energy attached to it, this attack does 80 more damage.

data.flavorText: It generates a powerful, freezing energy inside itself, but its body became frozen when the energy leaked out.

data.name: Popplio

attacks.name: Disarming Voice
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

data.flavorText: This Pokémon snorts body fluids from its nose, blowing balloons to smash into its foes. It's famous for being a hard worker.

data.name: Popplio

attacks.name: Blot
attacks.text: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: This Pokémon can control water bubbles. It practice diligently so it can learn to make big bubbles.

data.name: Brionne

attacks.name: Captivate
attacks.text: Switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It cares deeply for its companions. When its Trainer is feeling down, it performs a cheery dance to try and help.

data.name: Primarina

abilities.name: Harmonics
abilities.text: Whenever you attach an Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon, except with an attack, Ability, or Trainer card, attach up to 2 Energy cards to that Pokémon instead of 1.

attacks.name: Hypno Splash
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

data.flavorText: Its singing voice is its chief weapon in battle. This Pokémon's Trainer must prioritize the daily maintenance of its throat at all costs.

data.name: Mareanie

attacks.name: Spike Cannon
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage for each heads.

data.flavorText: It's found crawling on beaches and seafloors. The coral that grows on Corsola's head is as good as a five-star banquet to this Pokémon.

data.name: Toxapex

attacks.name: Poison Sting
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Venom Fever
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Poisoned, this attack does 50 damage for each damage counter on that Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Those attacked by Toxapex's poison will suffer intense pain for three days and three nights. Post-recovery, there will be some aftereffects.

data.name: Bruxish

attacks.name: Mind Bend
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Follow the Wound
attacks.text: This attack does 60 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon that has any damage counters on it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.flavorText: It stuns its prey with psychokinesis and then grinds them to mush with its strong teeth. Even Shellder's shell is no match for it.

data.name: Electabuzz

attacks.name: Thunder Shock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

data.flavorText: Electricity leaks from it in amounts far greater than the amount of electricity it eats.

data.name: Electivire

attacks.name: Electrocharge
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Lightning Energy cards and attach them to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: High-Voltage Knuckle
attacks.text: Discard 3 Energy from this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: When it gets excited, it thumps its chest. With every thud, thunder roars and electric sparks shower all around.

data.name: Chinchou

attacks.name: Thunder Wave
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

data.flavorText: It lives in the depths beyond the reach of sunlight. It flashes lights on its antennae to communicate with others of its kind.

data.name: Lanturn

attacks.name: Salvage
attacks.text: Shuffle 4 Item cards from your discard pile into your deck.

attacks.name: Signal Beam
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

data.flavorText: This Pokémon flashes a bright light that blinds its prey. This creates an opening for it to deliver an electrical attack.

data.name: Mareep

abilities.name: Fluffy Pillow
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, you may leave your opponent's Active Pokémon Asleep.

data.flavorText: It stores lots of air in its soft fur, allowing it to stay cool in summer and warm in winter.

data.name: Mareep

attacks.name: Thunder Shock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

data.flavorText: It stores lots of air in its soft fur, allowing it to stay cool in summer and warm in winter.

data.name: Flaaffy

attacks.name: Signal Beam
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

data.flavorText: If its coat becomes fully charged with electricity, its tail lights up. It fires hair that zaps on impact.

data.name: Ampharos

abilities.name: Unseen Flash
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may put 2 Lightning Energy cards from your hand in the Lost Zone. If you do, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Split Bomb
attacks.text: This attack does 50 damage to 2 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.flavorText: The tail's tip shines brightly and can be seen from far away. It acts as a beacon for lost people.

data.name: Raikou

attacks.name: Lost Voltage
attacks.text: If you have any Lightning Energy cards in the Lost Zone, this attack does 90 more damage.

data.flavorText: This rough Pokémon stores energy inside its body, then sweeps across the land, shooting off electricity.

data.name: Pachirisu

attacks.name: Overshort
attacks.text: Before doing damage, discard all Pokémon Tool cards from your opponent's Active Pokémon. If you discarded a Pokémon Tool card in this way, this attack does 40 more damage, and your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

data.flavorText: A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity.

data.name: Blitzle
data.flavorText: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use the frequency and rhythm of these flashes to communicate.

data.name: Zebstrika

abilities.name: Sprint
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may discard your hand and draw 4 cards.

data.flavorText: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

data.name: Stunfisk

attacks.name: Flail
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Thunder Blast
attacks.text: Discard a Lightning Energy from this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It conceals itself in the mud of the seashore. Then it waits. When prey touch it, it delivers a jolt of electricity.

data.name: Dedenne

attacks.name: Nuzzle
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Nuzzle Shot
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage for each of your Pokémon in play that has the Nuzzle attack to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.flavorText: It uses its tail to absorb electricity from power plants or from outlets in houses, and then it fires the electricity from its whiskers.

data.name: Tapu Koko

attacks.name: Strafe
attacks.text: You may switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Flashing Bolt
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't use Flashing Bolt during your next turn.

data.flavorText: It confuses its enemies by flying too quickly for the eye to follow. It has a hair-trigger temper but forgets what made it angry an instant later.

data.name: Zeraora-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Thunderclap Zone
abilities.text: Each of your Pokémon that has any Lightning Energy attached to it has no Retreat Cost.

attacks.name: Plasma Fists
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't attack during your next turn.

attacks.name: Full Voltage-GX
attacks.text: Attach 5 basic Energy cards from your discard pile to your Pokémon in any way you like. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

data.name: Natu

attacks.name: Lost March
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each of your Pokémon, except ◇ (Prism Star) Pokémon, in the Lost Zone.

data.flavorText: It usually forages for food on the ground but may, on rare occasions, hop onto branches to peck at shoots.

data.name: Xatu

attacks.name: Energy Gaze
attacks.text: Your opponent reveals their hand. If you find any Energy cards there, this attack does 60 more damage.

data.flavorText: They say that it stays still and quiet because it is seeing both the past and future at the same time.

data.name: Espeon

attacks.name: Allure
attacks.text: Draw 3 cards.

attacks.name: Energy Crush
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage times the amount of Energy attached to all of your opponent's Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It unleashes psychic power from the orb on its forehead. When its power is exhausted, the orb grows dull and dark.

data.name: Unown

abilities.name: DAMAGE
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, and if there are 66 or more damage counters on your Benched Pokémon, you may use this Ability. If you do, you win this game.

data.flavorText: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or Unown came first.

data.name: Unown

abilities.name: HAND
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, and if you have 35 or more cards in your hand, you may use this Ability. If you do, you win this game.

data.flavorText: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or Unown came first.

data.name: Unown

abilities.name: MISSING
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, and if your opponent has 12 or more Supporter cards in the Lost Zone, you may use this Ability. If you do, you win this game.

data.flavorText: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or Unown came first.

data.name: Wobbuffet

abilities.name: Shady Tail
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, ◇ (Prism Star) Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent's) can't attack and have no Abilities.

attacks.name: Knock Away
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

data.flavorText: To keep its pitch-black tail hidden, it live quietly in the darkness. It is never first to attack.

data.name: Girafarig

attacks.name: Get Lost
attacks.text: Put 2 cards from your opponent's discard pile in the Lost Zone.

attacks.name: Mind Shock
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance.

data.flavorText: Its tail has a small brain of its own. Beware! If you get close, it may react to your scent by biting.

data.name: Shedinja

abilities.name: Vessel of Life
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may discard all cards attached to this Pokémon and attach it to 1 of your Pokémon as a Pokémon Tool card. When the Pokémon this card is attached to is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 1 fewer Prize card.

attacks.name: Haunt
attacks.text: Put 3 damage counters on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

data.flavorText: A most peculiar Pokémon that somehow appears in a Poké Ball when a Nincada evolves.

data.name: Sableye

attacks.name: Quick Hunt
attacks.text: If you go first, you can use this attack on your first turn. Search your deck for a card and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Cursed Drop
attacks.text: Put 3 damage counters on your opponent's Pokémon in any way you like.

data.flavorText: This Pokémon is feared. When its gemstone eyes begin to glow with a sinister shine, it's believed that Sableye will steal people's spirits away.

data.name: Giratina

abilities.name: Distortion Door
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if this Pokémon is in your discard pile, you may put it onto your Bench. If you do, put 1 damage counter on 2 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Shadow Impact
attacks.text: Put 4 damage counters on 1 of your Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It was banished for its violence. It silently gazed upon the old world from the Distortion World.

data.name: Sigilyph-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Mirror Counter
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon-GX or Pokémon-EX (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), put damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon equal to the damage done to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Sonic Wing
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

attacks.name: Intercept-GX
attacks.text: This attack does 60 damage times the amount of Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

data.name: Yamask

attacks.name: Haunt
attacks.text: Put 1 damage counter on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Each of them carries a mask that used to be its face when it was human. Sometimes they look at it and cry.

data.name: Cofagrigus

attacks.name: Spirit Juggling
attacks.text: Discard any number of your Benched Pokémon. This attack does 30 more damage for each Benched Pokémon you discarded in this way.

data.flavorText: Grave robbers who mistake them for real coffins and get too close end up trapped inside their bodies.

data.name: Litwick

attacks.name: Haunt
attacks.text: Put 1 damage counter on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Litwick shines a light that absorbs the life energy of people and Pokémon, which becomes the fuel that it burns.

data.name: Lampent

attacks.name: Haunt
attacks.text: Put 3 damage counters on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It arrives near the moment of death and steals spirit from the body.

data.name: Chandelure

attacks.name: Cursed Drop
attacks.text: Put 4 damage counters on your opponent's Pokémon in any way you like.

attacks.name: Vortex of Pain
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each damage counter on all of your opponent's Pokémon.

data.flavorText: The spirits burned up in its ominous flame lose their way and wander this world forever.

data.name: Meloetta

attacks.name: Sing
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Miracle Harmony
attacks.text: Flip a coin for each of your Pokémon in play that has the Sing attack. This attack does 10 damage for each heads to each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.flavorText: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feels of those who hear it.

data.name: Mareanie

attacks.name: Pin Missile
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.

data.flavorText: It plunges the poison spike on its head into its prey. When the prey has weakened, Mareanie deals the finishing blow with its 10 tentacles.

data.name: Nihilego

attacks.name: Nightcap
attacks.text: You can use this attack only if your opponent has exactly 2 Prize cards remaining. Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon's attacks and use it as this attack.

attacks.name: Void Tentacles
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused and Poisoned.

data.flavorText: One of the Ultra Beasts, it's unclear whether or not this Pokémon is sentient, but sometimes it can be observed behaving like a young girl.

data.name: Poipole

attacks.name: Eye Opener
attacks.text: Look at your face-down Prize cards.

data.flavorText: This Ultra Beast is well enough liked to be chosen as a first partner in its own world.

data.name: Naganadel

abilities.name: Charging Up
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may attach a basic Energy card from your discard pile to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Turning Point
attacks.text: If you have exactly 3 Prize cards remaining, this attack does 80 more damage.

data.flavorText: It stores hundreds of liters of poisonous liquid inside its body. It is one of the organisms known as UBs.

data.name: Onix
data.flavorText: It usually lives underground. It searches for food while boring its way through the ground at 50 miles per hour.

data.name: Sudowoodo

attacks.name: Reply Strongly
attacks.text: If this Pokémon was damaged by an attack during your opponent's last turn while it was your Active Pokémon, this attack does 80 more damage.

data.flavorText: Apparently, the larger the green parts of this Pokémon, the more collectors value it. It's a particular favorite among elderly people.

data.name: Phanpy

attacks.name: Last Resort
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

data.flavorText: It is strong despite its compact size. It can easily pick up and carry an adult human on its back.

data.name: Donphan

abilities.name: Sturdy
abilities.text: If this Pokémon has full HP and would be Knocked Out by damage from an attack, this Pokémon is not Knocked Out, and its remaining HP becomes 10.

attacks.name: Rolling Spin
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon's Rolling Spin attack does 70 more damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

data.flavorText: The longer and bigger its tusks, the higher its rank in its herd. The tusks take long to grow.

data.name: Hitmontop

attacks.name: Rapid Spin
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. If you do, your opponent switches their Active Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Triple Kick
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 40 damage for each heads.

data.flavorText: If you are enchanted by its smooth, dance-like kicks, you may get a closer experience with one than you'd like.

data.name: Larvitar

abilities.name: Submerge
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks (both yours and your opponent's).

data.flavorText: Born deep underground, it comes aboveground and becomes a pupa once it has finished eating the surrounding soil.

data.name: Larvitar

attacks.name: Second Strike
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon already has 3 or more damage counters on it, this attack does 70 more damage.

data.flavorText: Born deep underground, it comes aboveground and becomes a pupa once it has finished eating the surrounding soil.

data.name: Pupitar

abilities.name: Hard Shell Evolution
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by your opponent's attacks until the end of your opponent's next turn.

data.flavorText: Its shell is as hard as sheet rock, and it is also very strong. Its thrashing can topple a mountain.

data.name: Carbink

attacks.name: Diamond Gate
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Supporter card and a Stadium card, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Guard Press
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 20 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

data.flavorText: Although this Pokémon is not especially rare, its glittering, jewel-draped body draws attention from people.

data.name: Alolan Meowth

attacks.name: Spoil the Fun
attacks.text: If you go second, this attack does 60 more damage during your first turn.

data.flavorText: When its delicate pride is wounded, or when the gold coin on its forehead is dirtied, it flies into a hysterical rage.

data.name: Alolan Persian

attacks.name: Empty Threat
attacks.text: This attack does 30 less damage times the amount of Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It looks down on everyone other than itself. Its preferred tactics are sucker punches and blindside attacks.

data.name: Umbreon

attacks.name: Retaliate
attacks.text: If any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out by damage from an opponent's attack during their last turn, this attack does 90 more damage.

data.flavorText: With its black fur, it blends into the darkness. It bides its time, and when prey appears, this Pokémon goes for its threat, and then eats it.

data.name: Tyranitar-GX

attacks.name: Whimsy Tackle

data.flavorText: Its long tail often breaks off. It doesn't really feel any pain, though, and the tail grows back, so Slowpoke isn't particularly bothered.

data.name: Machop
data.flavorText: It loves working out. As it gazes at its muscles, which continue to swell day by day, it becomes more and more dedicated to its training.

data.flavorText: It sends out electromagnetic waves, which let it float through the air. Touching it while it's eating electricity will give you a full-body shock.

attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 10 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

data.flavorText: With its steel-hard stone head, it headbutts indiscriminately. This is because of the stress it feels at being unable to fly.

data.name: Bagon

attacks.name: Reckless Charge
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 10 damage to itself.

data.flavorText: With its steel-hard stone head, it headbutts indiscriminately. This is because of the stress it feels at being unable to fly.

data.name: Shelgon

attacks.name: Raging Blade
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has any damage counters on it, this attack does 50 more damage.

data.flavorText: They lurk deep within caves—motionless, neither eating nor drinking. Why they don't die is not known.

data.name: Salamence

abilities.name: Dragon Wind
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, once during your turn (before your attack), you may switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It flies around on its wings, which have grown in at last. In its happiness, it gushes hot flames, burning up the fields it passes over.

data.name: Latias ◇
rules: ◇ (Prism Star) Rule: You can't have more than 1 ◇ card with the same name in your deck. If a ◇ card would go to the discard pile, put it in the Lost Zone instead.

attacks.name: Dreamy Mist
attacks.text: Attach a basic Energy card from your discard pile to each of your Basic Benched Dragon Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It can telepathically communicate with people. It changes its appearance using its down that refracts light.

data.name: Latios ◇
rules: ◇ (Prism Star) Rule: You can't have more than 1 ◇ card with the same name in your deck. If a ◇ card would go to the discard pile, put it in the Lost Zone instead.

attacks.name: Dragon Fleet
attacks.text: This attack does 50 damage for each of your Evolution Dragon Pokémon in play.

data.flavorText: It understands human speech and is highly intelligent. It is a tender Pokémon that dislikes fighting.

data.name: Rayquaza-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Stormy Winds
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may discard the top 3 cards of your deck. If you do, attach a basic Energy card from your discard pile to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dragon Break
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage times the amount of basic Grass and basic Lightning Energy attached to your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Tempest-GX
attacks.text: Discard your hand and draw 10 cards. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

data.name: Dunsparce

attacks.name: Strike and Run
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 3 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck. If you put any Pokémon onto your Bench in this way, you may switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Sudden Flash
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

data.flavorText: It digs into the ground with its tail and makes a mazelike nest. It can fly just a little.

data.name: Wingull
data.flavorText: Fishermen keep an eye out for Wingull in the sky, because wherever they're circling, the ocean is sure to be teeming with fish Pokémon.

data.name: Pelipper

attacks.name: Firefighting
attacks.text: Discard a Fire Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Water Pulse
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

data.flavorText: Gathering food is the work of young males. They store food in their capacious beaks and carry it back to others waiting in the nest.

data.name: Slakoth

attacks.name: Claw
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Slack Off
attacks.text: Heal all damage from this Pokémon. It can't attack during your next turn.

data.flavorText: If it eats just three leaves in a day, it is satisfied. Other than that, it sleeps for 20 hours a day.

data.name: Vigoroth

attacks.name: Fury Swipes
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.

attacks.name: Rage
attacks.text: This attack does 10 more damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Its stress level rises if it cannot keep moving constantly. Too much stress makes it feel sick.

data.name: Slaking

abilities.name: Lazy
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, your opponent's Pokémon in play have no Abilities, except for Lazy.

attacks.name: Critical Move
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon. It can't attack during your next turn.

data.flavorText: It is the world's most slothful Pokémon. However, it can exert horrifying power by releasing pent-up energy all at once.

data.name: Whismur

attacks.name: Bawl
attacks.text: You can use this attack only if you go second, and only on your first turn. Your opponent can't play any Trainer cards from their hand during their next turn.

data.flavorText: If it senses danger, it scares the foe by crying out with the volume of a jet-plane engine.

data.name: Whismur

attacks.name: Wail
attacks.text: Your opponent switches their Active Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Pokémon.

data.flavorText: If it senses danger, it scares the foe by crying out with the volume of a jet-plane engine.

data.name: Loudred

attacks.name: Cracking Voice
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

data.flavorText: The shock waves from its cries can tip over trucks. It stamps its feet to power up.

data.name: Exploud

attacks.name: Dangerous Concert
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon that has any damage counters on it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.flavorText: Its roar in battle shakes the ground like a tremor—or like an earthquake has struck.

data.name: Skitty

attacks.name: Fake Out
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

data.flavorText: It shows its cute side by chasing its own tail until it gets dizzy.

data.name: Delcatty

abilities.name: Search for Friends
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may put 2 Supporter cards from your discard pile into your hand.

data.flavorText: It is highly popular among female Trainers for its sublime fur. It does not keep a nest.

data.name: Kecleon

abilities.name: Unit Color 2
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon has Unit Energy LightningPsychicMetal attached to it, it is a Lightning, Psychic, and Metal Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It changes its shading to match its surroundings so it can sneak up on prey. Only its belly patterns stay fixed.

You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

data.name: Apricorn Maker
rules: Search your deck for up to 2 Item cards that have the word "Ball" in their name, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

data.name: Beast Ball
rules: Look at your face-down Prize cards. You may reveal an Ultra Beast card you find there, put it into your hand, and put this Beast Ball in its place. (If you don't reveal an Ultra Beast card, put this card in the discard pile.) Then, shuffle your face-down Prize cards.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

data.name: Bill's Maintenance
rules: Shuffle a card from your hand into your deck. If you do, draw 3 cards.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

data.name: Copycat
rules: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw a card for each card in your opponent's hand.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

data.name: Energy Recycle System
rules:
Choose 1:
• Put a basic Energy card from your discard pile into your hand.
• Shuffle 3 basic Energy cards from your discard pile into your deck.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

data.name: Energy Switch
rules: Move a basic Energy from 1 of your Pokémon to another of your Pokémon.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

data.name: Fisherman
rules: Put 4 basic Energy cards from your discard pile into your hand.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

data.name: Friend Ball
rules: Search your deck for a Pokémon with the same type as 1 of your opponent's Pokémon in play, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

data.name: Hau
rules: Draw 3 cards.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

data.name: Hiker
rules: Look at the top 5 cards of either player's deck and choose 1 of them. That player shuffles the other cards back into their deck. Then, put the card you chose on top of that deck.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

data.name: Hustle Belt
rules: Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached to it.

If the Pokémon this card is attached to has 30 HP or less remaining and has any damage counters on it, its attacks do 60 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

data.name: Last Chance Potion
rules: Heal 120 damage from 1 of your Pokémon that has 30 HP or less remaining.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

data.name: Life Herb
rules: Flip a coin. If heads, heal 60 damage and remove all Special Conditions from 1 of your Pokémon.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

data.name: Lisia
rules: Search your deck for up to 2 ◇ (Prism Star) cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

data.name: Lure Ball
rules: Flip 3 coins. For each heads, put an Evolution Pokémon from your discard pile into your hand.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

data.name: The Masked Royal
rules: Attach a basic Energy card from your hand to one of your Stage 2 Grass, Fire, or Water Pokémon.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

data.name: PokéNav
rules: Look at the top 3 cards of your deck. You may reveal a Pokémon or Energy card you find there and put it into your hand. Put the other cards back in any order.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

data.name: Rainbow Brush
rules: Choose an Energy card attached to 1 of your Pokémon. Search your deck for a basic Energy card and switch it with that card. Shuffle the first Energy card into your deck.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

data.name: Rare Candy
rules: Choose 1 of your Basic Pokémon in play. If you have a Stage 2 card in your hand that evolves from that Pokémon, put that card onto the Basic Pokémon to evolve it. You can't use this card during your first turn or on a Basic Pokémon that was put into play this turn.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

data.name: Shrine of Punishment
rules: Between turns, put 1 damage counter on each Pokémon-GX and Pokémon-EX (both yours and your opponent's).
This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. If another card with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.

data.name: Sky Pillar
rules: Prevent all effects of the opponent's attacks, including damage, done to Benched Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's).
This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. If another card with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.

rules: Search your deck for up to 3 cards and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. Your turn ends.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

data.name: Super Scoop Up

abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may attach a Grass Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Hypno Hammer
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

data.flavorText: It lives a quiet life on mountains that are perpetually covered in snow. It hides itself by whipping up blizzards.

data.name: Scatterbug

abilities.name: Abnormal Outbreak
abilities.text: You can use this Ability only if you go second. Once during your first turn (before your attack), you may search your deck for a Spewpa and a Vivillon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

data.flavorText: The powder that covers its body regulates its temperature, so it can live in any region or climate.

data.name: Scatterbug

attacks.name: Ultra Evolution
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for Vivillon and put it onto this Scatterbug to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.

data.flavorText: The powder that covers its body regulates its temperature, so it can live in any region or climate.

data.name: Spewpa

attacks.name: String Shot
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

data.flavorText: The beaks of birds can't begin to scratch its stalwart body. To defend itself, it spews powder.

data.name: Vivillon

attacks.name: Vivid Powder
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep and Poisoned.

data.flavorText: The patterns on this Pokémon's wings depend on the climate and topography of its habitat. It scatters colorful scales.

data.name: Skiddo

attacks.name: Growth
attacks.text: Attach a Grass Energy card from your hand to this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: If it has sunshine and water, it doesn't need to eat, because it can generate energy from the leaves on its back.

data.name: Gogoat

attacks.name: Milk Drink
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. For each heads, heal 40 damage from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Double-Edge
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 30 damage to itself.

data.flavorText: They inhabit mountainous regions. The leader of the herd is decided by a battle of clashing horns.

data.name: Pheromosa

attacks.name: White Ray
attacks.text: If you have only 1 Prize card remaining, this attack does 90 more damage.

data.flavorText: One of the Ultra Beasts. It refuses to touch anything, perhaps because it senses some uncleanness in this world.

data.name: Alolan Marowak

attacks.name: Limbo Limbo
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 basic Energy cards and attach them to your Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Alolan Club
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each of your Pokémon in play that has Alolan in its name.

data.flavorText: Its custom is to mourn its lost companions. Mounds of dirt by the side of the road mark the graves of the Marowak.

data.name: Heatran

attacks.name: Guard Press
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Boiling Impact
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Boiling blood, like magma, circulates through its body. It makes its dwelling place in volcanic caves.

data.name: Fennekin

attacks.name: Ember
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: As it walks, it munches on a twig in place of a snack. It intimidates opponents by puffing hot air out of its ears.

data.name: Fennekin
data.flavorText: As it walks, it munches on a twig in place of a snack. It intimidates opponents by puffing hot air out of its ears.

data.name: Braixen

attacks.name: Flamethrower
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: When the twig is plucked from its tail, friction sets the twig alight. The flame is used to send signals to its allies.

data.name: Delphox

abilities.name: Mystical Torch
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may leave your opponent's Active Pokémon Burned.

attacks.name: Fire Spin
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Using psychic power, it generates a fiery vortex of 5,400 degree Fahrenheit, incinerating foes swept into this whirl of flame.

data.name: Litleo
data.flavorText: They set off on their own from their pride and live by themselves to become stronger. These hot-blooded Pokémon are quick to fight.

data.name: Pyroar

abilities.name: Unnerve
abilities.text: Whenever your opponent plays an Item or Supporter card from their hand, prevent all effects of that card done to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dominating Fangs
attacks.text: If Lysandre Labs is in play, this attack does 60 more damage.

data.flavorText: With fiery breath of more than 10,000 degrees Fahrenheit, they viciously threaten any challenger. The females protect the pride's cubs.

data.name: Palkia-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Spatial Control
attacks.text: Move any number of Energy from your Benched Pokémon to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Hydro Pressure
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage times the amount of Water Energy attached to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Zero Vanish-GX
attacks.text: Shuffle all Energy from each of your opponent's Pokémon into their deck. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

data.name: Froakie

abilities.name: Frubbles
abilities.text: If this Pokémon has any Water Energy attached to it, it has no Retreat Cost.

data.flavorText: It protects its skin by covering its body in delicate bubbles. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.

data.name: Froakie
data.flavorText: It protects its skin by covering its body in delicate bubbles. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.

data.name: Frogadier

abilities.name: Gale Shuriken
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may put 2 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Its swiftness is unparalleled. It can scale a tower of more than 2,000 feet in a minute's time.

data.name: Greninja-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Shuriken Flurry
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may put 3 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Haze Slash
attacks.text: You may shuffle this Pokémon and all cards attached to it into your deck.

attacks.name: Shadowy Hunter-GX
attacks.text: This attack does 130 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

data.name: Clauncher
data.flavorText: Through controlled expulsions of internal gas, it can expel water like a pistol shot. At close distances, it can shatter rock.

data.name: Clawitzer

attacks.name: Standing By
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon's Sharpshooting attack does 120 damage instead of 40.

attacks.name: Sharpshooting
attacks.text: This attack does 40 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.flavorText: By expelling water from the nozzle in the back of its claw, it can move at a speed of 60 knots.

data.name: Amaura

attacks.name: Powder Snow
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

data.flavorText: This calm Pokémon lived in a cold land where there were no violent predators like Tyrantrum.

data.name: Aurorus

attacks.name: Frost Wall
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from Evolution Pokémon.

attacks.name: Blizzard Burn
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't attack during your next turn.

data.flavorText: Using its diamond-shaped crystals, it can instantly create a wall of ice to block an opponent's attack.

data.name: Bergmite

attacks.name: Break Open
attacks.text: If your opponent has a Stadium card in play, discard it. If you do, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

data.flavorText: Using air of -150 degrees Fahrenheit, they freeze opponents solid. They live in herds above the snow line on mountains.

data.name: Avalugg

attacks.name: Frozen Ground
attacks.text: Your opponent can't play any Stadium cards from their hand during their next turn.

data.flavorText: The way several Bergmite huddle on its back makes it look like an aircraft carrier made of ice.

data.name: Volcanion ◇
rules: ◇ (Prism Star) Rule: You can't have more than 1 ◇ card with the same name in your deck. If a ◇ card would go to the discard pile, put it in the Lost Zone instead.

abilities.name: Jet Geyser
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may discard a Water Energy card from your hand. If you do, your opponent switches their Active Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Sauna Blast
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.flavorText: It expels its internal steam from the arms on its back. It has enough power to blow away a mountain.

data.name: Dewpider

attacks.name: Spider Web
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

data.flavorText: When it comes across enemies or potential prey, this Pokémon smashes its water-bubble-covered head into them.

data.name: Araquanid

attacks.name: Bubble
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Bubble Trap
attacks.text: If 1 of your Pokémon used Bubble during your last turn, this attack does 80 more damage.

data.flavorText: Despite what its appearance suggests, it cares for others. If it finds vulnerable, weak Pokémon, it protectively brings them into its water bubble.

data.name: Magnemite

attacks.name: Searching Magnet
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 3 Lightning Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

data.flavorText: It sends out electromagnetic waves, which let it float through the air. Touching it while it's eating electricity will give you a full-body shock.

data.name: Magneton

attacks.name: Zap Cannon
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't use Zap Cannon during your next turn.

data.flavorText: It has about three times the electrical power of Magnemite. For some reason, outbreaks of this Pokémon happen when lots of sunspots appear.

data.name: Magnezone

abilities.name: Magnetic Circuit
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may attach a Lightning Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Zap Cannon
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't use Zap Cannon during your next turn.

data.flavorText: As it zooms through the sky, this Pokémon seems to be receiving signals of unknown origin, while transmitting signals of unknown purpose.

data.name: Helioptile
data.flavorText: The frills on either side of its head have cells that generate electricity when exposed to sunlight.

data.name: Heliolisk

attacks.name: Volt Wave
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

data.flavorText: It stimulates its muscles with electricity, boosting the strength in its legs and enabling it to run 100 yards in five seconds.

data.name: Xurkitree

attacks.name: Dazzle Blast
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Cablegram
attacks.text: If you have exactly 3 Prize cards remaining, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

data.flavorText: It appeared from the Ultra Wormhole. It raided a power plant, so people think it energizes itself with electricity.

data.name: Rotom

abilities.name: Roto Motor
abilities.text: If you have 9 or more Pokémon Tool cards in your discard pile, ignore all Energy in the attack cost of each of this Pokémon's attacks.

attacks.name: Plasma Slice
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't attack during your next turn.

data.flavorText: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.

data.name: Uxie

attacks.name: Memory Skip
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Active Pokémon's attacks. That Pokémon can't use that attack during your opponent's next turn.

data.flavorText: It is said that its emergence gave humans the intelligence to improve their quality of life.

data.name: Mesprit

abilities.name: Silent Waves
abilities.text: If you have Azelf in play, your opponent's Pokémon in play have no Resistance.

attacks.name: Mind Splash
attacks.text: If Uxie is on your Bench, this attack does 50 more damage.

data.flavorText: It sleeps at the bottom of a lake. Its spirit is said to leave its body to fly on the lake's surface.

data.name: Azelf

attacks.name: Psychic Abduction
attacks.text: You can use this attack only if you go second, and only on your first turn. Shuffle 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon and all cards attached to it into their deck.

attacks.name: Hypnoblast
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

data.flavorText: It is thought that Uxie, Mesprit and Azelf all came from the same egg.

data.name: Espurr

attacks.name: Energy Teaser
attacks.text: Move an Energy from 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to another of their Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It has enough psychic energy to blast everything within 300 feet of itself, but it has no control over its power.

data.name: Meowstic

attacks.name: Teleportation Burst
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Psychic
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage times the amount of Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

data.flavorText: The eyeball patterns on the interior of its ears emit psychic energy. It keeps the patterns tightly covered because that power is too immense.

data.name: Honedge

abilities.name: Final Hour
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon and is Knocked Out by damage from an opponent's attack, put 3 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

data.flavorText: If anyone dares to grab its hilt, it wraps a blue cloth around that person's arm and drains that person's life energy completely.

data.name: Honedge

attacks.name: Metal Sound
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

data.flavorText: If anyone dares to grab its hilt, it wraps a blue cloth around that person's arm and drains that person's life energy completely.

data.name: Doublade

attacks.name: Curse of the Blade
attacks.text: Put 3 damage counters on each of your opponent's Pokémon that has a Pokémon Tool card attached to it.

data.flavorText: The complex attack patterns of its two swords are unstoppable, even for an opponent greatly accomplished at swordplay.

data.name: Aegislash

attacks.name: Ticking Knock Out
attacks.text: During your next turn, if the Defending Pokémon is damaged by an attack, it will be Knocked Out.

attacks.name: Draining Blade
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Apparently, it can detect the innate qualities of leadership. According to legend, whoever it recognizes is destined to become king.

data.name: Inkay

attacks.name: Hypnosis
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

data.flavorText: It flashes the light-emitting spots on its body, which drains its opponent's will to fight. It takes the opportunity to scuttle away and hide.

data.name: Malamar

abilities.name: Psychic Recharge
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may attach a Psychic Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It lures prey close with hypnotic motions, then wraps its tentacles around it before finishing it off with digestive fluids.

data.name: Skrelp
data.flavorText: It looks just like rotten kelp. It hides from foes while storing up power for its evolution.

data.name: Dragalge

abilities.name: Poison Point
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon and is damaged by an opponent's attack (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), the Attacking Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Twister
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. For each heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon. If both of them are tails, this attack does nothing.

data.flavorText: Tales are told of ships that wander into seas where Dragalge live, never to return.

data.name: Hoopa

attacks.name: Hyperspace Ring
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Item cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Psy Bolt
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

data.flavorText: It gathers things it likes and passes them through its loop to teleport them to a secret place.

data.name: Poipole

attacks.name: Spit Poison
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Knockout Reviver
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, if this Pokémon is Knocked Out, your opponent can't take any Prize cards for it.

data.flavorText: This Ultra Beast is well enough liked to be chosen as a first partner in its own world.

data.name: Naganadel-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Beast Raid
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each of your Ultra Beasts in play.

attacks.name: Jet Needle
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance.

attacks.name: Stinger-GX
attacks.text: Both players shuffle their Prize cards into their decks. Then, each player puts the top 3 cards of their deck face down as their Prize cards. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

data.name: Cubone

attacks.name: Burdensome Bone
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't attack during your next turn.

data.flavorText: The skull it wears on its head is that of its dead mother. According to some, it will evolve when it comes to terms with the pain of her death.

data.name: Torterra

attacks.name: Giga Drain
attacks.text: Heal from this Pokémon the same amount of damage you did to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Earthquake
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage to each of your Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.flavorText: Small Pokémon occasionally gather on its unmoving back to begin building their nests.

data.name: Infernape

abilities.name: Flaming Fighter
abilities.text: Put 6 damage counters instead of 2 on your opponent's Burned Pokémon between turns.

attacks.name: Burst Punch
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

data.flavorText: It tosses its enemies around with agility. It uses all its limbs to fight in its own unique style.

data.name: Gible

attacks.name: Ascension
attacks.text: Search your deck for a card that evolves from this Pokémon and put it onto this Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.

data.flavorText: It skulks in caves, and when prey or an enemy passes by, it leaps out and chomps them. The force of its attack sometimes chips its teeth.

data.name: Gabite

attacks.name: Ascension
attacks.text: Search your deck for a card that evolves from this Pokémon and put it onto this Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.

data.flavorText: Shiny objects are its passion. It can be found in its cave, scarcely moving, its gaze fixed on the jewels it's amassed or Carbink it has caught.

data.name: Garchomp

attacks.name: Quick Dive
attacks.text: This attack does 50 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Royal Blades
attacks.text: If you played Cynthia from your hand during this turn, this attack does 100 more damage.

data.flavorText: The protuberances on its head serve as sensors. It can even detect distant prey.

data.name: Croagunk

attacks.name: Swagger
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Inflating its poison sacs, it fills the area with an odd sound and hits flinching opponents with a poison jab.

data.name: Toxicroak

attacks.name: Poison Jab
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Exact Revenge
attacks.text: If any of your Psychic Pokémon were Knocked Out by damage from an opponent's attack during their last turn, this attack does 70 more damage.

data.flavorText: Its knuckle claws secrete a toxin so vile that even a scratch could prove fatal.

data.name: Pancham

attacks.name: Act Tough
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has any Darkness Energy attached to it, this attack does 30 more damage.

data.flavorText: There's no point to the leaf in its mouth, aside from an effort to look cool. It's mischievous, so it's not well suited to inexperienced Trainers.

data.name: Binacle

attacks.name: Allotment
attacks.text: Draw a card.

data.flavorText: They stretch and then contract, yanking their rocks along with them in bold hops. They eat seaweed that washes up on the shoreline.

data.name: Barbaracle

attacks.name: Seven Shock
attacks.text: If you have exactly 7 cards in your hand, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

data.flavorText: Barbaracle's legs and hands have minds of their own, and they will move independently. But they usually follow the head's orders.

data.name: Tyrunt

attacks.name: Crunch
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Its immense jaws have enough destructive force that it can chew up an automobile. It lived 100 million years ago.

data.name: Tyrantrum

abilities.name: Tyrannical Heart
abilities.text: As long as you don't have more Pokémon in play than your opponent, this Pokémon's attacks do 60 more damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance), and it takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Crunch
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Nothing could stop this Pokémon 100 million years ago, so it behaved like a king.

data.name: Hawlucha

attacks.name: Sky Drop
attacks.text: This attack does 20 less damage for each Colorless in your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost.

data.flavorText: With its wings, it controls its position in the air. It likes to attack from above, a maneuver that is difficult to defend against.

data.name: Zygarde

abilities.name: Earthen Aura
abilities.text: Damage from this Pokémon's attacks isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance.

attacks.name: Peace Maker
attacks.text: If your opponent has an Ultra Beast in play, this attack does 30 more damage.

data.flavorText: This is Zygarde's form when about 10% of its cells have been gathered. It runs across the land at speeds greater than 60 mph.

data.name: Zygarde

attacks.name: Glare
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Calm Strike
attacks.text: If you have used your GX attack, this attack does 60 more damage.

data.flavorText: It's thought to be monitoring the ecosystem. There are rumors that even greater power lies hidden within it.

data.name: Zygarde-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Cell Connector
attacks.text: Attach 2 Fighting Energy cards from your discard pile to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Verdict-GX
attacks.text: Prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from Pokémon-GX and Pokémon-EX during your opponent's next turn. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

data.name: Diancie ◇
rules: ◇ (Prism Star) Rule: You can't have more than 1 ◇ card with the same name in your deck. If a ◇ card would go to the discard pile, put it in the Lost Zone instead.

abilities.name: Princess's Cheers
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, your Fighting Pokémon's attacks do 20 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Diamond Rain
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from each of your Benched Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It can instantly create many diamonds by compressing the carbon in the air between its hands.

data.name: Rockruff

attacks.name: Surprise Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

data.flavorText: This Pokémon has lived with people since times long ago. It can sense when its Trainer is in the dumps and will stick close by its Trainer's side.

data.name: Lycanroc

attacks.name: Dangerous Rogue
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Bathed in the setting sun of evening, Lycanroc has undergone a special kind of evolution. An intense fighting spirit underlies its calmness.

data.name: Buzzwole

attacks.name: Sledgehammer
attacks.text: If your opponent has exactly 4 Prize cards remaining, this attack does 90 more damage.

attacks.name: Swing Around
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 more damage for each heads.

data.flavorText: A mysterious life-form called an Ultra Beast. Witnesses saw it pulverize a dump truck with a single punch.

data.name: Pangoro

attacks.name: Untamed Punch
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has any damage counters on it, this attack does 50 more damage, and both Active Pokémon are now Confused.

attacks.name: Double Stomp
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 40 more damage for each heads.

data.flavorText: From the slight twitches of its bamboo leaf, it deduces its opponent's movements. It's eager to tussle but kindhearted toward its companions.

data.name: Yveltal-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Absorb Vitality
attacks.text: Heal from this Pokémon the same amount of damage you did to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Sonic Evil
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance.

attacks.name: Doom Count-GX
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon has exactly 4 damage counters on it, that Pokémon is Knocked Out. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

data.name: Guzzlord

attacks.name: Lord's Valley
attacks.text: If you have exactly 2, 4, or 6 Prize cards remaining, discard the top 10 cards of your deck.

data.flavorText: A dangerous Ultra Beast, it appears to be eating constantly, but for some reason its droppings have never been found.

data.name: Empoleon

attacks.name: Total Command
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each Benched Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's).

attacks.name: Whirlpool
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

data.flavorText: The three horns that extend from its beak attest to its power. The leader has the biggest horns.

data.name: Dialga-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Overclock
attacks.text: Draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand.

attacks.name: Shred
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Timeless-GX
attacks.text: Take another turn after this one. (Skip the between-turns step.) (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

data.name: Flabébé

abilities.name: Evolutionary Advantage
abilities.text: If you go second, this Pokémon can evolve during your first turn.

data.flavorText: When it finds a flower it likes, it dwells on that flower its whole life long. It floats in the wind's embrace with an untroubled heart.

data.name: Flabébé

attacks.name: Secret Blessings
attacks.text: Shuffle 3 in any combination of Pokémon and basic Energy cards from your discard pile into your deck.

data.flavorText: When it finds a flower it likes, it dwells on that flower its whole life long. It floats in the wind's embrace with an untroubled heart.

data.name: Floette

attacks.name: Swirling Petals
attacks.text: Switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon. If you do, switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

data.flavorText: When the flowers of a well-tended flower bed bloom, it appears and celebrates with an elegant dance.

data.name: Florges

abilities.name: Wondrous Gift
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may flip a coin. If heads, put an Item card from your discard pile on top of your deck.

attacks.name: Mist Guard
attacks.text: Prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from Dragon Pokémon during your opponent's next turn.

data.flavorText: In times long past, governors of castles would invite Florges to create flower gardens to embellish the castle domains.

data.name: Sylveon

data.name: Rowlet
data.flavorText: This wary Pokémon uses photosynthesis to store up energy during the day, while becoming active at night.

data.name: Grubbin
data.flavorText: They often gather near places frequented by electric Pokémon in order to avoid being attacked by bird Pokémon.

data.name: Litten
data.flavorText: While grooming itself, it builds up fur inside its stomach. It sets the fur alight and spews fiery attacks, which change based on how it coughs.

data.name: Popplio
data.flavorText: This Pokémon snorts body fluids from its nose, blowing balloons to smash into its foes. It's famous for being a hard worker.

data.name: Pikachu

attacks.name: Thunder Wave
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

data.flavorText: A plan was recently announced to gather many Pikachu and make an electric power plant.

data.name: Cosmog

attacks.name: Dust Gathering
attacks.text: Draw a card.

data.flavorText: Its body is gaseous and frail. It slowly grows as it collects dust from the atmosphere.

data.name: Crabrawler
data.flavorText: It punches so much, its pincers often come off from overuse, but they grow back quickly. What little meat they contain is rich and delicious.

data.name: Alolan Meowth

attacks.name: Fury Swipes
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.

data.flavorText: This Pokémon was not originally found in Alola. Human actions caused a surge in their numbers, and they went feral. They're prideful and crafty.

data.name: Alolan Diglett

attacks.name: Spelunk
attacks.text: Look at the top 3 cards of your deck and put them back in any order.

data.flavorText: Its head sports an altered form of whiskers made of metal. When in communication with its comrades, its whiskers wobble to and fro.

data.name: Cutiefly

attacks.name: Fly Around
attacks.text: If any damage is done to this Pokémon by attacks during your opponent's next turn, flip a coin. If heads, prevent that damage.

data.flavorText: It feeds on the nectar and pollen of flowers. Because it's able to sense auras, it can identify which flowers are about to bloom.

data.name: Pikipek

attacks.name: Rock Smash
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 more damage.

data.flavorText: This Pokémon feeds on berries, whose leftover seeds become the ammunition for the attacks it fires off from its mouth.

data.name: Yungoos
data.flavorText: With its sharp fangs, it will bite anything. It did not originally live in Alola but was imported from another region.

data.name: Bulbasaur
data.flavorText: A strange seed was planted on its back at birth. The plant sprouts and grows with this Pokémon.

data.name: Ivysaur

attacks.name: Toxic Whip

data.flavorText: There is a plant bulb on its back. When it absorbs nutrients, the bulb is said to blossom into a large flower.

data.name: Venusaur

data.flavorText: By spreading the broad petals of its flower and catching the sun's rays, it fills its body with power.

data.name: Shroomish

attacks.name: Absorb
attacks.text: Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It prefers damp places. By day it remains still in the forest shade. It releases toxic powder from its head.

data.flavorText: Its short arms stretch when it throws punches. Its technique is equal to that of pro boxers.

data.flavorText: Its head sprouts horns as sharp as blades. Using whirlwind-like movements, it confounds and swiftly cuts opponents.

data.name: Volcarona

data.flavorText: A sea of fire engulfs the surroundings of their battles, since they use their six wings to scatter their ember scales.

data.flavorText: This legendary Pokémon can scorch the world with fire. It helps those who want to build a world of truth.

data.name: Litten
data.flavorText: While grooming itself, it builds up fur inside its stomach. It sets the fur alight and spews fiery attacks, which change based on how it coughs.

data.name: Torracat

attacks.name: Swagger

data.flavorText: At its throat, it bears a bell of fire. The bell rings brightly whenever this Pokémon spits fire.

data.name: Incineroar

attacks.name: Flare Blitz

data.flavorText: This Pokémon has a violent, selfish disposition. If it's not in the mood to listen, it will ignore its Trainer's orders with complete nonchalance.

data.name: Totodile
data.flavorText: It is small but rough and tough. It won't hesitate to take a bite out of anything that moves.

data.name: Croconaw

abilities.name: Plunge

data.flavorText: If it loses a fang, a new one grows back in its place. There are always 48 fangs lining its mouth.

data.name: Feraligatr

attacks.name: Crunch
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It usually moves slowly, but it goes at blinding speed when it attacks and bites prey.

data.name: Qwilfish

attacks.name: Poison Sting

attacks.name: Shocking Sting

data.name: Buizel
data.flavorText: It swims by rotating its two tails like a screw. When it dives, its flotation sac collapses.

data.name: Floatzel

attacks.name: Aqua Bomb

data.flavorText: It floats using its well-developed flotation sac. It assists in the rescues of drowning people.

data.name: Palkia

attacks.name: Spiral Drain
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It is said to live in a gap in the spatial dimension parallel to ours. It appears in mythology.

data.name: Manaphy

data.flavorText: It is born with a wondrous power that lets it bond with any kind of Pokémon.

data.name: Keldeo

attacks.name: Resolute Blade
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It crosses the world, running over the surfaces of oceans and rivers. It appears at scenic waterfronts.

data.name: Shining Volcanion

attacks.name: Quad Smash

data.flavorText: It lets out billows of steam and disappears into the dense fog. It's said to live in mountains where humans do not tread.

data.name: Pikachu

attacks.name: Iron Tail
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.

data.flavorText: A plan was recently announced to gather many Pikachu and make an electric power plant.

data.flavorText: It was discovered when Poké Balls were introduced. It is said that there is some connection.

data.flavorText: It explodes in response to even minor stimuli. It is feared, with the nickname of "The Bomb Ball."

attacks.text: Attach a Lightning Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

data.flavorText: The rain clouds it carries let it fire thunderbolts at will. They say that it descended with lightning.

attacks.name: Spark
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Outrage
attacks.text: This attack does 10 more damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: This legendary Pokémon can scorch the world with lightning. It assists those who want to build an ideal world.

data.name: Ekans

attacks.name: Poison Sting
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

data.flavorText: The older it gets, the longer it grows. At night, it wraps its long body around tree branches to rest.

attacks.name: Venomous Fang

data.name: Jynx

attacks.name: Feverish Kiss
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

data.flavorText: It wiggles its hips as it walks. It can cause people to dance in unison with it.

data.name: Latios

attacks.name: Break Through
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.flavorText: A highly intelligent Pokémon. By folding back its wings in flight, it can overtake jet planes.

data.name: Shining Jirachi

data.name: Golett
data.flavorText: The energy that burns inside it enables it to move, but no one has yet been able to identify this energy.

data.name: Golurk

attacks.name: Triple Smash
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 60 more damage for each heads.

data.flavorText: It is said that Golurk were ordered to protect people and Pokémon by the ancient people who made them.

data.name: Marshadow
