attacks.name: Shadow Punch
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

data.flavorText: Able to conceal itself in shadows, it never appears before humans, so its very existence was the stuff of myth.

data.name: Stunfisk

attacks.name: Thunder Shock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

data.flavorText: Its skin is very hard, so it is unhurt even if stepped on by sumo wrestlers. It smiles when transmitting electricity.

data.name: Spiritomb

data.flavorText: A Pokémon that was formed by 108 spirits. It is bound to a fissure in an odd keystone.

data.name: Purrloin

data.name: Liepard

data.flavorText: Their beautiful form comes from the muscles they have developed. They run silently in the night.

data.name: Scraggy

data.name: Scrafty

attacks.name: Dangerous Head

data.flavorText: It pulls up its shed skin to protect itself while it kicks. The bigger the crest, the more respected it is.

data.name: Zorua
data.flavorText: It changes so it looks like its foe, tricks it, and then uses that opportunity to flee.

data.name: Sharpedo
data.flavorText: It pursues its prey at speeds of 75 mph and finishes them off with fangs that can crush iron. It is known as the bully of the sea.

data.name: Wailmer
data.flavorText: It loves to startle people. It fills itself up with seawater and plays by bouncing around like a ball.

data.name: Snorunt
data.flavorText: Their numbers seem to have rapidly increased in Alola. Custom has it that houses where Snorunt live will be prosperous for generations to come.

data.name: Corsola

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

data.flavorText: Pursued by Mareanie for the branches on its head, this Pokémon will sometimes snap its own branches off as a diversion while it escapes.

data.name: Wingull

attacks.name: Roost
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon. It can't retreat during your next turn.

data.flavorText: Fishermen keep an eye out for Wingull in the sky, because wherever they're circling, the ocean sure to be is teeming with fish Pokémon.

data.name: Pelipper

attacks.name: Courier
attacks.text: Put 1 of your Benched Pokémon and all cards attached to it into your hand.

attacks.name: Fly
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing. If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn.

data.flavorText: Gathering food is the work of young males. They store food in their capacious beaks and carry it back to others waiting in the nest.

data.name: Popplio
data.flavorText: This Pokémon snorts body fluids from its nose, blowing balloons to smash into its foes. It's famous for being a hard worker.

data.name: Brionne

attacks.name: Disarming Voice
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

data.flavorText: A skillful dancer, it creates a sequence of water balloons as it dances, and briskly bombards it enemies.

data.name: Primarina

attacks.name: Disarming Voice
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Sparkling Aria
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It controls its water balloons with song. The melody is learning from others of its kind and is passed down from one generation to the next.

data.name: Primarina-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Bubble Beat
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage times the amount of Water Energy attached to your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Roaring Seas
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Grand Echo-GX
attacks.text: Heal all damage from all of your Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

data.name: Crabominable

attacks.name: Avalanche
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.flavorText: It just throws punches indiscriminately. In times of desperation, it can lop off its own pincers and fire them like rockets.

data.name: Wishiwashi

abilities.name: Cowardice
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may discard all cards attached to this Pokémon and return it to your hand. You can't use this Ability during your first turn or on the turn this Pokémon was put into play.

data.flavorText: When it's in trouble, its eyes moisten and begin to shine. The shining light attracts its comrades, and they stand together against their enemies.

data.name: Dewpider

attacks.name: Bubble
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

data.flavorText: It crawls onto the land in search of food. Its water bubble allows it to breathe and protects its soft head.

data.name: Araquanid

abilities.name: Water Bubble
abilities.text: Prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's Fire Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It delivers headbutts with the water bubble on its head. Small Pokémon get sucked into the bubble, where they drown.

data.name: Pyukumuku

abilities.name: Innards Out
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon and is Knocked Out by damage from an opponent's attack, put 6 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon.

attacks.name: Continuous Tumble
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 30 damage for each heads.

data.flavorText: It lives in shallow seas, such as areas near a beach. It can eject its internal organs, which it uses to engulf its prey or battle enemies.

data.name: Bruxish

attacks.name: Vivid Charge
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 3 basic Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Psychic Fangs
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It stuns its prey with psychokinesis and then grinds them to mush with its strong teeth. Even Shellder's shell is no match for it.

data.name: Chinchou

attacks.name: Searching Light
attacks.text: Look at 1 of your face-down Prize cards.

data.flavorText: It lives in the depths beyond the reach of sunlight. It flashes lights on its antennae to communicate with others of its kind.

data.name: Lanturn

attacks.name: Confuse Ray
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Aqua Spark
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has any Water Energy attached to it, this attack does 60 more damage.

data.flavorText: This Pokémon flashes a bright light that blinds its prey. This creates an opening for it to deliver an electrical attack.

data.name: Charjabug

attacks.name: Shocking Jaws
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

data.flavorText: From the food it digests, it generates electricity, and it stores this energy in its electric sac.

data.name: Vikavolt

abilities.name: Strong Charge
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may search your deck for a Grass Energy card and a Lightning Energy card and attach them to your Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Electro Cannon
attacks.text: Discard 3 Energy from this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It produces electricity via an electrical organ in its abdomen. It overwhelms bird Pokémon with shocking beams of electrical energy.

data.name: Togedemaru

attacks.name: Defense Curl
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Discharge
attacks.text: Discard all Lightning Energy from this Pokémon. This attack does 30 damage for each card you discarded in this way.

data.flavorText: The long hairs on its back act as lightning rods. The bolts of lightning it attracts are stored as energy in its electric sac.

data.name: Zubat

attacks.name: Astonish
attacks.text: Choose a random card from your opponent's hand. Your opponent reveals that card and shuffles it into their deck.

data.flavorText: It sleeps in caves during the day. It has no eyes, so to check its surroundings while flying, it emits ultrasonic waves.

data.name: Golbat

attacks.name: Super Poison Breath
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Acrobatics
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 more damage for each heads.

data.flavorText: Its thick fangs are hollow like straws, making them unexpectedly fragile. These fangs are specialized for sucking blood.

data.name: Crobat

attacks.name: Triple Poison
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. Put 3 damage counters instead of 1 on that Pokémon between turns.

attacks.name: Surprise Strike
attacks.text: If this Pokémon was on the Bench and became your Active Pokémon this turn, this attack does 60 more damage.

data.flavorText: Both its legs became wings, and as a result, it can't move well on the ground. All it can do is crawl around.

data.name: Alolan Grimer

attacks.name: Super Poison Breath
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

data.flavorText: The crystals on Grimer's body are lumps of toxins. If one falls off, lethal poisons leak out.

data.name: Alolan Muk

abilities.name: Power of Alchemy
abilities.text: Each Basic Pokémon in play, in each player's hand, and in each player's discard pile has no Abilities.

attacks.name: Crunch
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

data.flavorText: While it's unexpectedly quiet and friendly, if it's not fed any trash for a while, it will smash its Trainer's furnishings and eat up the fragments.

data.name: Drowzee

attacks.name: Psychic Boom
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage times the amount of Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It finds really fun dreams tasty. When it makes friends with people, it may show them the most delicious dreams it's ever eaten.

data.name: Hypno

attacks.name: Meditate
attacks.text: This attack does 10 more damage for each damage counter on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Hypnoblast
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

data.flavorText: As a matter of course, it makes anyone it meets fall asleep and has a taste of their dreams. Anyone having a good dream, it carries off.

data.name: Espeon-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Psybeam
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Psychic
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage times the amount of Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Divide-GX
attacks.text: Put 10 damage counters on your opponent's Pokémon in any way you like. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

data.name: Mareanie

attacks.name: Poison Sting
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

data.flavorText: It plunges the poison spike on its head into its prey. When the prey has weakened, Mareanie deals the finishing blow with its 10 tentacles.

data.name: Toxapex

abilities.name: Toxic Spikes
abilities.text: Whenever your opponent's Active Pokémon retreats, their new Active Pokémon is Poisoned.

attacks.name: Venoshock
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Poisoned, this attack does 50 more damage.

data.flavorText: Toxapex crawls along the ocean floor on its 12 legs. It leaves a trail of Corsola bits scattered in its wake.

data.name: Cosmog

attacks.name: Dust Gathering
attacks.text: Draw a card.

data.flavorText: Its body is gaseous and frail. It slowly grows as it collects dust from the atmosphere.

data.name: Cosmoem

attacks.name: Teleport
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Motionless as if dead, its body is faintly warm to the touch. In the distant past, it was called the cocoon of the stars.

data.name: Lunala-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Psychic Transfer
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may move a Psychic Energy from 1 of your Pokémon to another of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Moongeist Beam
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't be healed during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Lunar Fall-GX
attacks.text: Knock Out 1 of your opponent's Basic Pokémon that isn't a Pokémon-GX. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

data.name: Makuhita

attacks.name: Surprise Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

data.flavorText: It was originally brought in from another region, but now Makuhita from Alola are more famous.

data.name: Hariyama

attacks.name: Push Out
attacks.text: Your opponent switches their Active Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It is known for its fantastic strength, but as it grows older, it focuses more on training Makuhita.

data.name: Roggenrola

attacks.name: Smack Down
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon has Fighting Resistance, this attack does 50 more damage.

data.flavorText: The hexagonal cavity is its ear. It walks in the direction of sounds it hears, but if the sounds cease, it panics and topples over.

data.name: Boldore

attacks.name: Rock Hurl
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

data.flavorText: It explores caves in search of underground water. It's not comfortable around water, so this Pokémon takes great care in lapping it up.

data.name: Gigalith

attacks.name: Rock Artillery
attacks.text: Discard any amount of Fighting Energy from your Pokémon. This attack does 50 damage for each card you discarded in this way.

attacks.name: Rock Tumble
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

data.flavorText: Known for its hefty horsepower, this Pokémon is a popular partner for construction workers.

data.name: Crabrawler
data.flavorText: It punches so much, its pincers often come off from overuse, but they grow back quickly. What little meat they contain is rich and delicious.

data.name: Passimian

attacks.name: Fling
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Team Play
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage for each of your Benched Passimian.

data.flavorText: They form groups of roughly 20 individuals. Their mutual bond is remarkable—they will never let down a comrade.

data.name: Sandygast

attacks.name: Shore Up
attacks.text: Attach a Fighting Energy card from your discard pile to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Sand Tomb
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

data.flavorText: It takes control of anyone who puts a hand in its mouth. And so it adds to the accumulation of its sand-mound body.

data.name: Palossand

abilities.name: Wall of Sand
abilities.text: This Pokémon takes 20 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Absorb Vitality
attacks.text: Heal from this Pokémon the same amount of damage you did to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Buried beneath the castle are masses of dried-up bones from those whose vitality it has drained.

data.name: Alolan Rattata
data.flavorText: When the sun goes down, it becomes active. It runs around town on a chase for good food for the boss of its nest—Raticate.

data.name: Alolan Raticate

attacks.name: Evil Orders
attacks.text: Search your deck for a number of cards up to the number of your Benched Pokémon and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Endeavor
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 more damage for each heads.

data.flavorText: This gourmet Pokémon is particular about the taste and freshness of its food. Restaurants where Raticate live have a good reputation.

data.name: Alolan Meowth

attacks.name: Fury Swipes
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.

data.flavorText: This Pokémon was not originally found in Alola. Human actions caused a surge in their numbers, and they went feral. They're prideful and crafty.

data.name: Alolan Persian

attacks.name: Taunt
attacks.text: Switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Claw Rend
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon already has any damage counters on it, this attack does 30 more damage.

data.flavorText: Its round face and smooth coat—softer than the most high-class velvet—have made this a very popular Pokémon in Alola.

data.name: Umbreon-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Strafe
attacks.text: You may switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Shadow Bullet
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Dark Call-GX
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from your opponent's Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

data.name: Carvanha

attacks.name: Gnaw Through
attacks.text: Discard all Pokémon Tool cards from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

data.flavorText: If they scent the faintest trace of blood, they rush to attack en masse. When alone, they're rather cowardly.

data.name: Sharpedo

abilities.name: Rough Skin
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon and is damaged by an opponent's attack (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), put 3 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon.

attacks.name: Aqua Impact
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each Colorless in your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost.

data.flavorText: It has a sad history. In the past, its dorsal fin was a treasured foodstuff, so this Pokémon became a victim of overfishing.

data.name: Sandile

attacks.name: Crunch
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It submerges itself in sand and moves as if swimming. This wise behavior keeps its enemies from finding it and maintains its temperature.

data.name: Krokorok

attacks.name: Knock Off
attacks.text: Discard a random card from your opponent's hand.

data.flavorText: They move in groups of a few individuals. A female is often the leader of the group, and the males will gather food.

data.name: Krookodile

attacks.name: False Accusation
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each card in your opponent's hand.

attacks.name: Obsidian Fang
attacks.text: Before doing damage, discard all Pokémon Tool cards from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Its unique faculty of sight can detect small prey more than 30 miles away, even in the midst of a sandstorm.

data.name: Alolan Diglett

attacks.name: Spelunk
attacks.text: Look at the top 3 cards of your deck and put them back in any order.

data.flavorText: Its head sports an altered form of whiskers made of metal. When in communication with its comrades, its whiskers wobble to and fro.

data.name: Alolan Dugtrio

abilities.name: Tangling Hair
abilities.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost is Colorless more.

attacks.name: Dig Under
attacks.text: This attack does 50 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance.

data.flavorText: Its shining gold hair provides it with protection. It's reputed that keeping any of its fallen hairs will bring bad luck.

data.name: Skarmory

attacks.name: Metallic Sound
attacks.text: Discard all Special Energy from each Pokémon.

attacks.name: Aerial Ace
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

data.flavorText: Its feathers, which fall off as it grows, are thin and sharp. In times long past, warriors used them as swords.

data.name: Solgaleo-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Ultra Road
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Sunsteel Strike
attacks.text: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Sol Burst-GX
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 5 Energy cards and attach them to your Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

data.name: Snubbull

attacks.name: Reckless Charge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this Pokémon does 10 damage to itself.

data.flavorText: Its growls make its opponents uneasy. This laid-back Pokémon tends to sleep half the day.

data.name: Granbull

attacks.name: Dark Clamp
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Fight Back
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has any damage counters on it, this attack does 80 more damage.

data.flavorText: More timid than Snubbull, this Pokémon is doted on by young people amused at the contrast between its looks and its attitude.

data.name: Cutiefly

attacks.name: Fly Around
attacks.text: If any damage is done to this Pokémon by attacks during your opponent's next turn, flip a coin. If heads, prevent that damage.

data.flavorText: It feeds on the nectar and pollen of flowers. Because it's able to sense auras, it can identify which flowers are about to bloom.

data.name: Ribombee

abilities.name: Curative Pollen
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may heal 20 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It rolls up pollen into puffs. It makes many different varieties, some used as food and others used in battle.

data.name: Dratini

attacks.name: Signs of Evolution
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Dratini, a Dragonair, and a Dragonite, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

data.flavorText: After a 10-hour struggle, a fisherman was able to pull one up and confirm its existence.

data.name: Dragonair

attacks.name: Dragon's Wish
attacks.text: During your next turn, you may attach any number of Energy cards from your hand to your Pokémon.

data.flavorText: From time immemorial, it has been venerated by agricultural peoples as an entity able to control the weather.

data.name: Dragonite

attacks.name: Dragon Wave
attacks.text: Discard a Grass Energy and a Lightning Energy from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Giant Tail
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

data.flavorText: Incur the wrath of this normally calm Pokémon at your peril, because it will smash everything to smithereens before it's satisfied.

data.name: Spearow

attacks.name: Peck Bugs
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Grass Pokémon, this attack does 30 more damage.

data.flavorText: Farmers whose fields are troubled by bug Pokémon appreciate Spearow for its vigorous appetite and look after it.

data.name: Fearow

attacks.name: Devastating Wind
attacks.text: Your opponent shuffles their hand into their deck and draws 3 cards.

attacks.name: Slashing Strike
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't use Slashing Strike during your next turn.

data.flavorText: Drawings of a Pokémon resembling Fearow can be seen in murals from deep in ancient history.

data.name: Kangaskhan

attacks.name: Cross-Cut
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is an Evolution Pokémon, this attack does 30 more damage.

attacks.name: Hurricane Punch
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 50 damage for each heads.

data.flavorText: Kangaskhan's maternal love is so deep that it will brave death to protect its offspring.

data.name: Tauros-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Rage
attacks.text: This attack does 10 more damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Mad Bull-GX
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

data.name: Eevee

abilities.name: Energy Evolution
abilities.text: When you attach a basic Energy card from your hand to this Pokémon during your turn, you may search your deck for a card that evolves from this Pokémon that is the same type as that Energy card and put it onto this Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Quick Draw
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, draw a card.

data.flavorText: Possessing an unbalanced and unstable genetic makeup, it conceals many possible evolutions.

data.name: Eevee

abilities.name: Energy Evolution
abilities.text: When you attach a basic Energy card from your hand to this Pokémon during your turn, you may search your deck for a card that evolves from this Pokémon that is the same type as that Energy card and put it onto this Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Quick Draw
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, draw a card.

data.flavorText: Possessing an unbalanced and unstable genetic makeup, it conceals many possible evolutions.

data.name: Spinda

attacks.name: Teeter Punch
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

data.flavorText: Its steps are staggering and unsteady, but Spinda thinks it's walking in a straight line.

data.name: Lillipup

attacks.name: Work Up
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon's attacks do 20 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

data.flavorText: Because it doesn't yelp, it's extremely popular with Trainers who live in apartment buildings.

data.name: Herdier

abilities.name: Treasure Hunt
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may put an Item card from your discard pile into your hand.

data.flavorText: Its dense black fur grows continuously. The high cost of keeping its hard fur properly groomed make this a troublesome Pokémon to train.

data.name: Stoutland

attacks.name: Ferocious Bellow
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon's attacks do 50 less damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

data.flavorText: Intelligent, good-natured, and valiant, it's a trustworthy partner on rescue teams.

data.name: Pikipek

attacks.name: Rock Smash
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 more damage.

data.flavorText: This Pokémon feeds on berries, whose leftover seeds become the ammunition for the attacks it fires off from its mouth.

data.name: Trumbeak

attacks.name: Bullet Seed
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.

data.flavorText: By bending its beak, it can produce a variety of call and brand itself a noisy nuisance for its neighbors.

data.name: Toucannon

attacks.name: Echoed Voice
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon's Echoed Voice attack does 60 more damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Beak Blast
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

data.flavorText: Within its beak, its internal gas ignites, explosively launching seeds with enough power to pulverize boulders.

data.name: Yungoos
data.flavorText: With its sharp fangs, it will bite anything. It did not originally live in Alola but was imported from another region.

data.name: Gumshoos-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Search the Premises
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may have your opponent reveal their hand.

attacks.name: Gumshoe Chance-GX
attacks.text: This attack does 50 damage times the amount of Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

data.name: Stufful
data.flavorText: Despite its adorable appearance, when it gets angry and flails about, its arms and legs could knock a pro wrestler sprawling.

data.name: Bewear

attacks.name: Bear Hug
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Superpower
attacks.text: You may do 40 more damage. If you do, this Pokémon does 20 damage to itself.

data.flavorText: This immensely dangerous Pokémon possesses overwhelming physical strength. Its habitat is generally off-limits.

data.name: Oranguru

abilities.name: Instruct
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may draw cards until you have 3 cards in your hand.

attacks.name: Psychic
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage times the amount of Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Deep in the jungle, high in the lofty canopy, this Pokémon abides. On rare occasions, it shows up at the beach to match wits with Slowking.

data.name: Big Malasada
rules: Heal 20 damage and remove a Special Condition from your Active Pokémon.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

data.name: Crushing Hammer
rules: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

data.name: Energy Retrieval
rules: Put 2 basic Energy cards from your discard pile into your hand.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

data.name: Energy Switch
rules: Move a basic Energy from 1 of your Pokémon to another of your Pokémon.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

data.name: Exp. Share
rules: Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached to it.
When your Active Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from an opponent's attack, you may move 1 basic Energy card from that Pokémon to the Pokémon this card is attached to.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

data.name: Great Ball
rules: Look at the top 7 cards of your deck. You may reveal a Pokémon you find there and put it into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

data.name: Hau
rules: Draw 3 cards.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

data.name: Ilima
rules: Each player shuffles their hand into their deck and flips a coin. If heads, that player draws 6 cards. If tails, they draw 3 cards.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

data.name: Lillie
rules: Draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand. If it's your first turn, draw cards until you have 8 cards in your hand.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

data.name: Nest Ball
rules: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

data.name: Poison Barb
rules: Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached to it.
If the Pokémon this card is attached to is your Active Pokémon and is damaged by an opponent's attack (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), the Attacking Pokémon is now Poisoned.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

data.name: Poké Ball
rules: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

data.name: Pokémon Catcher
rules: Flip a coin. If heads, switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

data.name: Potion
rules: Heal 30 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

data.name: Professor Kukui
rules: Draw 2 cards. During this turn, your Pokémon's attacks do 20 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

data.name: Rare Candy
rules: Choose 1 of your Basic Pokémon in play. If you have a Stage 2 card in your hand that evolves from that Pokémon, put that card onto the Basic Pokémon to evolve it. You can't use this card during your first turn or on a Basic Pokémon that was put into play this turn.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

data.name: Repel
rules: Your opponent switches their Active Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Pokémon.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

data.name: Rotom Dex
rules: After counting your Prize cards, shuffle them into your deck. Then, take that many cards from the top of your deck and put them face down as your Prize cards.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

data.name: Switch
rules: Switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

data.name: Team Skull Grunt
rules: Your opponent reveals their hand. Discard 2 Energy cards from it.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

data.name: Timer Ball
rules: Flip 2 coins. For each heads, search your deck for an Evolution Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

data.name: Ultra Ball
rules: Discard 2 cards from your hand. If you do, search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

data.name: Rainbow Energy

data.flavorText: A descendant of the legendary animal baku, which is said to eat dreams. It is skilled at hypnotism.

attacks.name: Barrier

data.flavorText: A Pokémon whose genetic code was repeatedly recombined for research. It turned vicious as a result.

data.name: Mew

abilities.name: Neutral Shield
abilities.text: Prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon by your opponent's Evolution Pokémon.

attacks.name: Psy Bolt
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

data.flavorText: So rare that it is still said to be a mirage by many experts. Only a few people have seen it worldwide.

data.name: Sandshrew

attacks.name: Sand Attack
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing.

data.flavorText: It burrows and lives underground. If threatened, it curls itself up into a ball for protection.

data.name: Diglett

abilities.name: Submerge
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks (both yours and your opponent's).

attacks.name: Dig Through
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.flavorText: It burrows through the ground at a shallow depth. It leaves raised earth in its wake, making it easy to spot.

data.name: Dugtrio

attacks.name: Earthquake
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage to each of your Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.flavorText: In battle, it digs through the ground and strikes the unsuspecting foe from an unexpected direction.

data.name: Machop

attacks.name: Dual Chop
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

data.flavorText: Its whole body is composed of muscles. Even though it's the size of a human child, it can hurl 100 grown-ups.

data.name: Machoke

attacks.name: Karate Chop
attacks.text: This attack does 60 damage minus 10 damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Submission
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 20 damage to itself.

data.flavorText: Its formidable body never gets tired. It helps people by doing work such as the moving of heavy goods.

data.name: Machamp

abilities.name: Counterattack
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon and is damaged by an opponent's attack (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), put 3 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Its four ruggedly developed arms can launch a flurry of 1,000 punches in just two seconds.

data.name: Machamp BREAK
rules: BREAK Evolution Rule: Machamp BREAK retains the attacks, Abilities, Weakness, Resistance, and Retreat Cost of its previous Evolution.

attacks.name: Boomerang Lariat

attacks.name: Harden
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, if this Pokémon would be damaged by an attack, prevent that attack's damage done to this Pokémon if that damage is 60 or less.

data.flavorText: It usually lives underground. It searches for food while boring its way through the ground at 50 miles per hour.

data.name: Hitmonchan
data.flavorText: The spirit of a pro boxer has infused this Pokémon. It throws punches that are faster than a bullet train.

data.name: Clefairy

attacks.name: Sing

attacks.name: Metronome

data.flavorText: Its adorable appearance makes it popular as a pet. However, it is rare and difficult to find.

attacks.name: Leek Slap

data.flavorText: It always walks about with a plant stalk clamped in its beak. The stalk is used for building its nest.

data.flavorText: A two-headed Pokémon that was discovered as a sudden mutation. It runs at a pace of over 60 miles per hour.

attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Double-Edge

data.flavorText: It lays several eggs a day. The eggs are apparently rich in nutrients and extremely delicious.

data.name: Flying Pikachu

attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing. If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn.

data.flavorText: By learning how to fly, Pikachu overcame its weakness to Fighting Pokémon.

data.name: Surfing Pikachu
data.flavorText: One summer, a group of Pikachu was found riding the waves at the local beach.

data.name: Imakuni?'s Doduo
rules: (This card cannot be used at official tournaments.)

abilities.text: When this Doduo retreats, hold this card and throw it as hard as you can because Doduo is running away. Throw the card horizontally with a snap to get the farthest distance!

attacks.name: Harmonize
attacks.text: From the moment you use this attack, you must begin to sing a song. (While the song is being sung, the game continues.) When the song is finished, this attack does 30 damage.

data.flavorText: While young, it has six gorgeous tails. When it grows, several new tails are sprouted.

data.name: Torchic

attacks.name: Ember
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, discard a Fire Energy attached to this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.

data.name: Fennekin
data.flavorText: Eating a twig fills it with energy, and its roomy ears give vent to air hotter than 390 degrees Fahrenheit.

data.name: Magikarp

attacks.name: Epic Splash
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. If either of them is tails, this attack does nothing.

data.flavorText: In the distant past, it was somewhat stronger than the horribly weak descendants that exist today.

data.name: Totodile

attacks.name: Fury Strikes
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

data.flavorText: It is small but rough and tough. It won't hesitate to take a bite out of anything that moves.

attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon can't attack during your opponent's next turn.

data.flavorText: It raises its tail to check its surroundings. The tail is sometimes struck by lightning in this pose.

data.name: Scraggy
data.flavorText: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling it skin up to its neck.

data.flavorText: It captivates foes with its huge, round eyes, then lulls them to sleep by singing a soothing melody.

data.name: Togepi

attacks.name: Sweet Kiss

data.flavorText: A proverb claims that happiness will come to anyone who can make a sleeping Togepi stand up.

data.flavorText: Adores round objects. It wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.

data.name: Eevee

attacks.name: Lunge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

data.flavorText: Thanks to its unstable genetic makeup, this special Pokémon conceals many different possible evolutions.

attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.text: Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It tangles any moving thing with its vines. Their subtle shaking is ticklish if you get ensnared.

attacks.name: Leaf Storm

attacks.name: Flog
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

data.flavorText: Its vines grow so profusely that, in the warm season, you can't even see its eyes.

data.name: Hoppip

data.name: Skiploom
data.flavorText: It spreads its petals to absorb sunlight. It also floats in the air to get closer to the sun.

data.name: Jumpluff

attacks.name: Solar Step
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage times the number of your remaining Prize cards.

data.flavorText: Even in the fiercest wind, it can control its fluff to make its way to any place in the world it wants.

data.name: Yanma

attacks.name: Scout
attacks.text: Your opponent reveals his or her hand.

data.flavorText: If it flaps its wings really fast, it can generate shock waves that will shatter windows in the area.

attacks.name: Assault Boom
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool card attached to it, this attack does 70 more damage.

data.flavorText: This six-legged Pokémon is easily capable of transporting an adult in flight. The wings on its tail help it stay balanced.

data.name: Yanmega BREAK
rules: BREAK Evolution Rule: Yanmega BREAK retains the attacks, Abilities, Weakness, Resistance, and Retreat Cost of its previous Evolution.

attacks.name: Barrier Break
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness, Resistance, or any other effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

data.name: Seedot

attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, if this Pokémon would be Knocked Out by damage from an attack during your opponent's next turn, it is not Knocked Out and its remaining HP becomes 10 instead.

data.flavorText: When it dangles from a tree branch, it looks just like an acorn. It enjoys scaring other Pokémon.

data.name: Nuzleaf

attacks.name: Harden
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, if this Pokémon would be damaged by an attack, prevent that attack's damage done to this Pokémon if that damage is 60 or less.

data.flavorText: It lives deep in forests. With the leaf on its head, it makes a flute whose song makes listeners uneasy.

attacks.name: Extrasensory
attacks.text: If you have the same number of cards in your hand as your opponent, this attack does 60 more damage.

data.flavorText: By flapping its leafy fan, it can whip up gusts of 100 ft/second that can level houses.

data.name: Foongus

abilities.name: Play Ball
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench, you may put 3 Poké Ball cards from your discard pile into your hand.

data.flavorText: It lures Pokémon with its pattern that looks just like a Poké Ball then releases poison spores.

attacks.name: Strange Reaction
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Confused, it is now Paralyzed.

data.flavorText: It lures prey close by dancing and waving its arm caps, which resemble Poké Balls, in a swaying motion.

data.name: Larvesta
data.flavorText: The base of volcanoes is where they make their homes. They shoot fire from their five horns to repel attacking enemies.

data.name: Volcarona

attacks.name: Power Hurricane
attacks.text: Discard all Energy attached to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Fire Blast

data.flavorText: It gallops at nearly 150 mph. With its mane blazing ferociously, it races as if it were an arrow.

data.name: Chimchar

attacks.name: Ember
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, discard a Fire Energy attached to this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: The gas made in its belly burns from its rear end. The fire burns weakly when it feels sick.

data.name: Monferno
data.flavorText: It uses ceilings and walls to launch aerial attacks. Its fiery tail is but one weapon.

data.flavorText: It tosses its enemies around with agility. It uses all its limbs to fight in its own unique style.

attacks.name: Flare Blitz

attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

rules: BREAK Evolution Rule: Pyroar BREAK retains the attacks, Abilities, Weakness, Resistance, and Retreat Cost of its previous Evolution.

data.flavorText: When the heavy rainfall season ends, it is drawn out by warm sunlight to dance in the open.

data.name: Tangela

attacks.name: Nap
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Many writhing vines cover it, so its true identity remains unknown. The blue vines grow its whole life long.

data.name: Tangrowth

attacks.name: Hundred Furious Lashes
attacks.text: Does 30 damage times the amount of Grass Energy attached to this Pokémon. This Pokémon can't use Hundred Furious Lashes during your next turn.

attacks.name: Mega Drain
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Even if one of its arms is eaten, it's fine. The Pokémon regenerates quickly and will go right back to normal.

data.name: Scyther
data.flavorText: The sharp scythes on its forearms become increasingly sharp by cutting through hard objects.

data.name: Heracross

attacks.name: Giga Horn
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. If both of them are tails, this attack does nothing.

data.flavorText: No matter how heavy its opponents, it flings them far away with its prized horn.

data.name: Celebi-EX
rules: Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Time Recall
abilities.text: Each of your evolved Pokémon can use any attack from its previous Evolutions. (You still need the necessary Energy to use each attack.)

attacks.name: Wind Whisk
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

data.name: Shaymin

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Leaf Drain
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: The flowers all over its body burst into bloom if it is lovingly hugged and senses gratitude.

data.name: Snivy
data.flavorText: It is very intelligent and calm. Being exposed to lots of sunlight makes its movements swifter.

data.name: Servine

attacks.name: Double Slash
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 40 damage times the number of heads.

data.flavorText: It moves along the ground as if sliding. Its swift movements befuddle its foes, and it then attacks with a vine whip.

data.name: Serperior

attacks.name: Double Slash
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 50 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Mega Drain
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It can stop its opponents' movements with just a glare. It takes in solar energy and boosts it internally.

data.name: Cottonee
data.flavorText: Perhaps because they feel more at ease in a group, they stick to others they find. They end up looking like a cloud.

data.name: Whimsicott

attacks.name: Fluffy Tag
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. During your next turn, the attacks of that Pokémon do 40 more damage to the Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Stun Spore
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

data.flavorText: They appear along with whirlwinds. They pull pranks, such as moving furniture and leaving balls of cotton in homes.

data.name: Petilil

attacks.name: Sleep Powder
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

data.flavorText: The leaves on its head grow right back even if they fall out. These bitter leaves refresh those who eat them.

data.name: Lilligant

attacks.name: Return
attacks.text: Draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand.

attacks.name: Magical Leaf
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage and heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: The fragrance of the garland on its head has a relaxing effect, but taking care of it is very difficult.

data.name: Charmander

attacks.name: Draw In
attacks.text: Attach 2 Fire Energy cards from your discard pile to this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: The fire on the tip of its tail is a measure of its life. If healthy, its tail burns intensely.

data.name: Charmeleon

attacks.name: Raging Claws
attacks.text: Does 10 more damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: In the rocky mountains where Charmeleon live, their fiery tails shine at night like stars.

data.name: Charizard

attacks.name: Split Bomb
attacks.text: This attack does 40 damage to 2 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Scorching Fire
attacks.text: Discard a Fire Energy attached to this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It is said that Charizard's fire burns hotter if it has experienced harsh battles.

data.name: Numel

attacks.name: Flamethrower
attacks.text: Discard an Energy attached to this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: The magma in its body reaches 2,200 degrees F. Its hump gets smaller when it uses Fire-type moves.

data.name: Camerupt

attacks.name: Fire Shard
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Burned. Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is also Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Flamethrower
attacks.text: Discard an Energy attached to this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: The volcanoes on its back have a major eruption every 10 years–or whenever it becomes really angry.

data.name: Victini

attacks.name: Collect
attacks.text: Draw a card.

attacks.name: Relentless Flames
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

data.flavorText: It creates an unlimited supply of energy inside its body, which it shares with those who touch it.

data.name: Tepig
data.flavorText: It blows fire through its nose. When it catches a cold, the fire becomes pitch-black smoke instead.

data.name: Pignite

attacks.name: Firebreathing
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

data.flavorText: Whatever it eats becomes fuel for the flame in its stomach. When it is angered, the intensity of the flame increases.

data.name: Emboar

attacks.name: Firebreathing
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

attacks.name: Fire Blast
attacks.text: Discard an Energy attached to this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It has mastered fast and powerful fighting moves. It grows a beard of fire.

data.name: Darumaka

attacks.name: Reckless Charge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this Pokémon does 10 damage to itself.

data.flavorText: When it sleeps, it pulls its limbs into its body and its internal fire goes down to 1,100 F.

data.name: Darmanitan

attacks.name: Continuous Tumble
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Damage Counterpunch
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has any damage counters on it, this attack does 60 more damage.

data.flavorText: When one is injured in a fierce battle, it hardens into a stone-like form. Then it meditates and sharpens its mind.

data.name: Squirtle

abilities.name: Shell Shield
abilities.text: As along as this Pokémon is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks (both yours and your opponent's).

attacks.name: Water Splash
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

data.flavorText: It shelters itself in its shell then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.

data.name: Wartortle

attacks.name: Withdraw
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks during your opponent's next turn.

data.flavorText: It is said to live 10,000 years. Its furry tail is popular as a symbol of longevity.

data.name: Blastoise

abilities.name: Deluge
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may attach a Water Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Hydro Pump
attacks.text: Does 10 more damage for each Water Energy attached to this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: The jets of water it spouts from the rocket cannons on its shell can punch through thick steel.

data.name: Psyduck

attacks.name: Dazzle Dance
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

data.flavorText: Overwhelmed by enigmatic abilities, it suffers a constant headache. It sometimes uses mysterious powers.

data.name: Psyduck

attacks.name: Firefighting
attacks.text: Discard a Fire Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon.

data.flavorText: When headaches stimulate its brain cells, which are usually inactive, it can use a mysterious power.

data.name: Golduck

attacks.name: Confuse Ray
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

data.flavorText: It is seen swimming dynamically and elegantly using its well-developed limbs and flippers.

data.name: Golduck

attacks.name: Amnesia
attacks.text: Choose 1 of the Defending Pokémon's attacks. The Pokémon can't use that attack during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Aquafall
attacks.text: Discard all Energy attached to this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: When its forehead shines mysteriously, Golduck can use the full extent of its power.

data.name: Marill
data.flavorText: The oil-filled tail functions as a buoy, so it's fine even in rivers with strong currents.

data.name: Azumarill

attacks.name: Deep Dive
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. For each heads, heal 40 damage from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Aqua Sonic
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

data.flavorText: Its long ears are superb sensors. It can distinguish the movements of things in water and tell what they are.

data.name: Delibird

attacks.name: Present
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a card and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Icy Wind
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

data.flavorText: It carries food all day long. When someone is lost in the mountains, it shares that food.

data.name: Oshawott
data.flavorText: It fights using the scalchop on its stomach. In response to an attack, it retaliates immediately by slashing.

data.name: Dewott
data.flavorText: Strict training is how it learns its flowing double-scalchop technique.

data.name: Samurott

attacks.name: Destructive Whirlpool
attacks.text: Discard an Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon.

data.flavorText: One swing of the sword incorporated in its armor can fell an opponent. A simple glare from one of them quiets everybody.

data.name: Ducklett
data.flavorText: They are better at swimming than flying, and they happily eat their favorite food, peat moss, as they dive underwater.

data.name: Swanna

attacks.name: Aerial Ace
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

attacks.name: Defog
attacks.text: You may discard any Stadium card in play. If you do, this attack does 40 more damage.

data.flavorText: Despite their elegant appearance, they can flap their wings strongly and fly for thousands of miles.

data.name: Frillish
data.flavorText: If its veil-like arms stun and wrap a foe, that foe will be dragged miles below the surface, never to return.

data.name: Jellicent

abilities.name: Stickiness
abilities.text: The Retreat Cost of each of your opponent's Pokémon in play is Colorless more.

attacks.name: Eerie Light
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

data.flavorText: Its body is mostly seawater. It's said there's a castle of ships Jellicent have sunk on the seafloor.

data.name: Cryogonal

attacks.name: Ice Edge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

data.flavorText: They are born in snow clouds. They use chains made of ice crystals to capture prey.

data.name: Keldeo

attacks.name: Hydro Pump
attacks.text: Does 10 more damage for each Water Energy attached to this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It crosses the world, running over the surfaces of oceans and rivers. It appears at scenic waterfronts.

data.name: Keldeo

attacks.name: Rising Lunge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

data.flavorText: By blasting water from its hooves, it can glide across water. It excels at using leg moves while battling.

data.name: Keldeo-EX
rules: Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Rush In
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if this Pokémon is on your Bench, you may switch this Pokémon with your Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Secret Sword
attacks.text: Does 20 more damage for each Water Energy attached to this Pokémon.

data.name: Pikachu

attacks.name: Double Voltage
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 40 damage times the number of heads.

data.flavorText: It occasionally uses an electric shock to recharge a fellow Pikachu that is in a weakened state.

data.name: Voltorb
data.flavorText: It looks just like a Poké Ball. It is dangerous because it may electrocute or explode on contact.

data.name: Electrode
data.flavorText: It is known to drift on winds if it is bloated to bursting with stored electricity.

data.name: Electabuzz
data.flavorText: Research is progressing on storing lightning in Electabuzz so this energy can be used at any time.

data.name: Electivire

attacks.name: Electriwave
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Shock Wave
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

data.flavorText: The instant it presses the tips of its tails onto an opponent, it sends over 20,000 volts of electricity into the foe.

data.name: Chinchou

attacks.name: Electripult
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.flavorText: It discharges positive and negative electricity from its antenna tips to shock its foes.

data.name: Blitzle
data.flavorText: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use the frequency and rhythm of these flashes to communicate.

data.name: Zebstrika

attacks.name: Flame Charge
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Fire Energy card and attach it to this Pokémon. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Thunder
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this Pokémon does 30 damage to itself.

data.flavorText: When this ill-tempered Pokémon runs wild, it shoots lightning from its mane in all directions.

data.name: Wobbuffet
data.flavorText: It desperately tries to keep its black tail hidden. It is said to be proof the tail hides a secret.

data.name: Spoink

attacks.name: Flail Around
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

data.flavorText: Using its tail like a spring, it keeps its heart beating by bouncing constantly. If it stops, it dies.

data.name: Grumpig

attacks.name: Psybeam
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Extrasensory
attacks.text: If you have the same number of cards in your hand as your opponent, this attack does 60 more damage.

data.flavorText: It uses black pearls to amplify its psychic power. It does a strange dance to control foes' minds.

data.name: Duskull

attacks.name: Confuse Ray
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

data.flavorText: It loves the crying of children. It startles bad kids by passing through walls and making them cry.

data.name: Dusclops

attacks.name: Astonish
attacks.text: Choose a random card from your opponent's hand. Your opponent reveals that card and shuffles it into his or her deck.

data.flavorText: It seeks drifting will-o'-the-wisps and sucks them into its empty body. What happens inside is a mystery.

data.name: Dusknoir

abilities.name: Sinister Hand
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may move 1 damage counter from 1 of your opponent's Pokémon to another of your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Shadow Punch
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

data.flavorText: It is said to take lost spirits into its pliant body and guide them home.

data.name: Croagunk

attacks.name: Paralyzing Jab
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

data.flavorText: It rarely fights fairly, but that is strictly to ensure survival. It is popular as a mascot.

data.name: Croagunk

attacks.name: Poison Jab
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

data.flavorText: Inflating its poison sacs, it fills the area with an odd sound and hits flinching opponents with a poison jab.

data.name: Toxicroak

attacks.name: Revenge
attacks.text: If any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out by damage from an opponent's attack during his or her last turn, this attack does 70 more damage.

attacks.name: Poison Jab
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

data.flavorText: The croaking that Toxicroak produces before a battle is for churning the poison it has stored in its poison sac.

data.name: Cresselia-EX
rules: Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Sparkling Particles
abilities.text: At any time between turns, heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Psychic Protection
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon has no Weakness.

data.name: Munna

abilities.name: Long-Distance Hypnosis
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep. If tails, your Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

data.flavorText: This Pokémon appears before people and Pokémon who are having nightmares and eats those dreams.

data.name: Musharna

attacks.name: Telekinesis
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance.

attacks.name: Dream Waltz
attacks.text: This attack can be used even if this Pokémon is Asleep. If this Pokémon is Asleep, this attack does 30 more damage.

data.flavorText: The dream mist coming from its forehead changes into many different colors depending on the dream that was eaten.

data.name: Woobat

attacks.name: Scout
attacks.text: Your opponent reveals his or her hand.

data.flavorText: The heart-shaped mark left on a body after a Woobat has been attached to it is said to bring good fortune.

data.name: Swoobat

attacks.name: Jet Woofer
attacks.text: For each Psychic Energy attached to this Pokémon, discard the top card of your opponent's deck.

attacks.name: Acrobatics
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 more damage for each heads.

data.flavorText: It shakes its tail vigorously when it emits ultrasonic waves strong enough to reduce concrete to rubble.

data.name: Venipede

abilities.name: Poison Point
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon and is damaged by an opponent's attack (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), the Attacking Pokémon is now Poisoned.

data.flavorText: Using the feelers on its head and tail, it picks up vibrations in the air to determine its prey's location and state.

data.name: Whirlipede

abilities.name: Poison Point
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon and is damaged by an opponent's attack (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), this Attacking Pokémon is now Poisoned.

data.flavorText: Storing energy for evolution, it sits. But, when predators approach, it moves to stab them with poison spikes.

data.name: Scolipede

abilities.name: Poison Point
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon and is damaged by an opponent's attack (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), this Attacking Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Venoshock
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon is Poisoned, this attack does 40 more damage.

data.flavorText: It clasps its prey with the claws on its neck until it stops moving. Then it finishes it off with deadly poison.

data.name: Gothita
data.flavorText: Their ribbonlike feelers increase their psychic power. They are always staring at something.

data.name: Gothorita

attacks.name: Destructive Beam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon.

data.flavorText: They use hypnosis to control people and Pokémon. Tales of Gothorita leading people astray are told in every corner.

data.name: Meloetta

attacks.name: Psychic
attacks.text: Does 20 more damage for each Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Echoed Voice
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon's Echoed Voice attack does 50 more damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

data.flavorText: The melodies sung by Meloetta have the power to make Pokémon that hear them happy or sad.

data.name: Sandshrew
data.flavorText: It digs deep burrows to live in. When in danger, it rolls up its body to withstand attacks.

data.name: Sandslash

attacks.name: Sand-Attack
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Earthquake
attacks.text: Does 10 damage to each of your Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.flavorText: The spikes on its body are made up of its hardened hide. It rolls up and attacks foes with its spikes.

data.name: Gligar

attacks.name: Wicked Jab
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

data.flavorText: It clamps on to its chosen prey then jabs the stinger on its tail into the prey while it's stunned with surprise.

data.name: Gliscor

attacks.name: Poison Ring
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Night Slash
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It dances silently through the sky. When it approaches prey, it can land a critical hit in an instant.

data.name: Makuhita
data.flavorText: It toughens its body by slamming into thick trees. Many snapped trees can be found near its nest.

data.name: Trapinch

attacks.name: Smithereen Smash
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It makes an inescapable conical pit and lies in wait at the bottom for prey to come tumbling down.

data.name: Dwebble

attacks.name: Flail
attacks.text: Does 10 damage times the number of damage counters on this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: When it finds a stone of a suitable size, it secretes a liquid from its mouth to open up a hole to crawl into.

data.name: Crustle

abilities.name: Sturdy
abilities.text: If this Pokémon has full HP and would be Knocked Out by damage from an attack, this Pokémon is not Knocked Out and its remaining HP becomes 10 instead.

attacks.name: Stone Edge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

data.flavorText: When its boulder is broken in battles for territory, it feels unsure and begins to weaken.

data.name: Mienfoo

attacks.name: Steady Punch
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 more damage.

data.flavorText: In fights, they dominate with onslaughts of flowing, continuous attacks. With their sharp claws, they cut enemies.

data.name: Mienfoo
data.flavorText: It takes pride in the speed at which it can use moves. What it loses in power, it makes up for in quantity.

data.name: Mienshao

attacks.name: Knock Off
attacks.text: Discard a random card from your opponent's hand.

attacks.name: Double Whip
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 70 damage times the number of heads.

data.flavorText: Using the long fur on its arms like whips, it launches into combo attacks that, once started, no one can stop.

data.name: Landorus-EX
rules: Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Hammerhead
attacks.text: Does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Land's Judgment
attacks.text: You may discard all Fighting Energy attached to this Pokémon. If you do, this attack does 70 more damage.

data.name: Purrloin

attacks.name: Captivate
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with the Defending Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Their cute act is a ruse. They trick people and steal their valuables just to see the looks on their faces.

data.name: Liepard

attacks.name: Tail Trickery
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Assist
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 of your Benched Pokémon's attacks and use it as this attack.

data.flavorText: Their beautiful form comes from the muscles they have developed. They run silently in the night.

data.name: Vullaby
data.flavorText: They tend to guard their posteriors with suitable bones they have found. They pursue weak Pokémon.

data.name: Mandibuzz

attacks.name: Dual Cut
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 80 damage times the number of heads.

data.flavorText: It makes a nest out of the bones it finds. It grabs weakened prey in its talons and hauls it to its nest of bones.

data.name: Scizor

attacks.name: Steel Slash
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from Pokémon-EX.

attacks.name: Slashing Strike
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't use Slashing Strike during your next turn.

data.flavorText: It raises its pincers with eyelike markings for intimidation. It also swings them down dangerously.

data.name: Skarmory

attacks.name: Claw
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

data.flavorText: Despite being clad entirely in iron-hard armor, it flies at speed of over 180 mph.

data.name: Skarmory

attacks.name: Metal Sound
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Swift
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness, Resistance, or any other effects on the Defending Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Its heavy-looking iron body is actually thin and light, so it can fly at speeds over 180 mph.

data.name: Klink

attacks.name: Reckless Charge
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 10 damage to itself.

data.flavorText: The two minigears that mesh together are predetermined. Each will rebound from other minigears without meshing.

data.name: Vibrava

attacks.name: Quick Turn
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Sand Pulse
attacks.text: Does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.flavorText: The ultrasonic waves it generates by rubbing its two wings together cause severe headaches.

data.name: Flygon

abilities.name: Sand Slammer
abilities.text: At any time between turns, if this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, put 1 damage counter on each of your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Flying Beatdown
attacks.text: You may discard a Grass Energy and a Fighting Energy attached to this Pokémon. If you do, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

data.flavorText: Known as "The Desert Spirit" this Pokémon hides in the sandstorms it causes by beating its wings.

data.name: Black Kyurem

attacks.name: Dual Claw
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Flash Freeze
attacks.text: Discard an Energy attached to this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: This legendary ice Pokémon waits for a hero to fill in the missing parts of its body with truth or ideals.

data.name: Black Kyurem-EX
rules: Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Dragon Fang
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Freeze Shock
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't attack during your next turn.

data.name: White Kyurem

attacks.name: Damage Rush
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Cold Fire
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 40 more damage.

data.flavorText: This legendary ice Pokémon waits for a hero to fill in the missing parts of its body with truth or ideals.

data.name: White Kyurem-EX
