attacks.name: Sun Flash
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing.

data.flavorText: When it rotates itself, it gives off light similar to the sun, thus blinding its foes.

data.name: Spiritomb

abilities.name: Spooky Whirlpool
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you put Spiritomb from your hand onto your Bench, you may use this power. Your opponent shuffles his or her hand into his or her deck and draws 6 cards.

attacks.name: Color Tag
attacks.text: Choose Grass Fire Water Lightning Psychic Fighting Darkness Metal or Colorless type. Put 1 damage counter on each Pokémon your opponent has in play of the type you chose.

data.flavorText: It was formed by uniting 108 spirits. It has been bound to the Odd Keystone to keep it from doing any mischief.

data.name: Venomoth

abilities.name: Poison Moth Wind
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. If tails, your Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. This power can't be used if Venomoth is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Stun Spore
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

data.flavorText: The powder on its wings is poisonous if it is dark in hue. If it is light in hue, it causes paralysis.

data.name: Victreebel

abilities.name: Tangling Tendrils
abilities.text: As long as Victreebel is your Active Pokémon, your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost is ColorlessColorless more.

attacks.name: Acidic Drain
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Burned and Poisoned. Remove 3 damage counters from Victreebel.

data.flavorText: Acid that has dissolved many prey becomes sweeter, making it even more effective at attracting prey.

data.name: Ambipom

attacks.name: Astonish
attacks.text: Choose 2 cards from your opponent's hand without looking. Look at the cards you chose, then have your opponent shuffle those cards into his or her deck.

attacks.name: Tail Spank
attacks.text: Discard 2 cards from your hand. (If you can't discard 2 cards from your hand, this attack does nothing.)

data.flavorText: They live on large trees. They are said to communicate by connecting their tails to those of others.

data.name: Banette

attacks.name: Lost Crush
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 Energy card attached to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon and put it in the Lost Zone.

attacks.name: Breakdown
attacks.text: Count the number of cards in your opponent's hand. Put that many damage counters on the Defending Pokémon.

data.flavorText: This Pokémon developed from an abandoned doll that amassed a grudge. It is seen in dark alleys.

data.name: Bronzong

attacks.name: Legend Ceremony
attacks.text: Search your deck for both halves of a Pokémon LEGEND, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Reflect Energy
attacks.text: Move an Energy card attached to Bronzong to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Ancient people believed that petitioning Bronzong for rain was the way to make crops grow.

data.name: Carnivine

attacks.name: Saliva Lure
attacks.text: Switch the Defending Pokémon with 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Stick and Absorb
attacks.text: Remove 3 damage counters from Carnivine. The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

data.flavorText: It walks around on its tentacles in search of a tree branch where it can dangle down and ambush prey.

data.name: Ditto

abilities.name: Dittobolic
abilities.text: The number of Benched Pokémon your opponent can have is now 4. If your opponent has 5 Benched Pokémon, your opponent must discard 1 of them and all cards attached to it.

data.flavorText: Its transformation ability is perfect. However, if made to laugh, it can't maintain its disguise.

data.name: Dragonite

attacks.name: Calming Wind
attacks.text: Remove all Special Conditions from Dragonite.

attacks.name: Dragon Stamp
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. If both of them are tails, this attack does nothing. If both of them are heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

data.flavorText: This marine Pokémon has an impressive build that lets it freely fly over raging seas without trouble.

data.name: Dugtrio

attacks.name: Sand Impact
attacks.text: Flip a coin for each Fighting Energy attached to Dugtrio. This attack does 50 damage plus 20 more damage for each heads.

data.flavorText: Extremely powerful, they can dig through even the hardest ground to a depth of over 60 miles.

data.name: Electivire

attacks.name: Plasma
attacks.text: Search your discard pile for a Lightning Energy card and attach it to Electivire.

attacks.name: Thunder Shot
attacks.text: This attack does 50 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon that has any Energy cards attached to it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.flavorText: As its electric charge amplifies, blue sparks begin to crackle between its horns.

data.name: Elekid

abilities.name: Sweet Sleeping Face
abilities.text: As long as Elekid is Asleep, prevent all damage done to Elekid by attacks.

attacks.name: Sparking Ball
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage to that Pokémon. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance. Elekid is now Asleep.

data.flavorText: Even in the most vicious storm, this Pokémon plays happily if thunder rumbles in the sky.

data.name: Golduck

abilities.name: Natural Remedy
abilities.text: Whenever you attach a Water Energy card from your hand to Golduck, remove 2 damage counters from Golduck.

attacks.name: Powerful Splash
attacks.text: Does 30 damage plus 10 more damage for each Water Energy attached to all of your Pokémon.

data.flavorText: When it swims at full speed using its long, webbed limbs, its forehead somehow begins to glow.

data.name: Grumpig

attacks.name: Psychic Lock
attacks.text: Your opponent can't use any Poké-Powers on his or her Pokémon during his or her next turn.

attacks.name: Bench Manipulation
attacks.text: Your opponent flips a coin for each of his or her Benched Pokémon. This attack does 40 damage times the number of tails. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance.

data.flavorText: It can perform odd dance steps to influence foes. Its style of dancing became hugely popular overseas.

data.name: Kricketune

attacks.name: Entrancing Melody
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Fury Cutter
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. If 1 of them is heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 20 more damage. If 2 of them are heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 40 more damage. If all of them are heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 100 more damage.

data.flavorText: By allowing its cry to resonate in the hollow of its belly, it produces a captivating sound.

data.name: Lunatone

attacks.name: Selfdestruct
attacks.text: Does 10 damage to each Benched Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's). (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) Lunatone does 60 damage to itself.

data.flavorText: It was discovered at the site of a meteor strike 40 years ago. Its stare can lull its foes to sleep.

data.name: Machamp

attacks.name: Vital Throw
attacks.text: You may do 40 damage plus 20 more damage. If you do, Machamp does 20 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Hundred Furious Punches
attacks.text: Does 60 damage plus 10 more damage for each Fighting Energy attached to Machamp.

data.flavorText: It quickly swings its four arms to rock its opponents with ceaseless punches and chops from all angles.

data.name: Magmortar

attacks.name: Top Burner
attacks.text: For each Fire Energy attached to Magmortar, discard the top card from your opponent's deck. Then, flip a coin. If tail, discard all Fire Energy attached to Magmortar.

attacks.name: Burst Punch
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Burned.

data.flavorText: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit out of its arms. Its breath also sears and sizzles.

data.name: Nidoqueen

attacks.name: Return
attacks.text: Draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand.

attacks.name: Prize Count
attacks.text: If you have more Prize cards left than your opponent, this attack does 50 damage plus 30 more damage.

data.flavorText: It uses its scaly, rugged body to seal the entrance of its nest and protect its young from predators.

data.name: Pidgeot

attacks.name: Headwind
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the attack cost of each of the Defending Pokémon's attacks is ColorlessColorless more.

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 40 damage plus 30 more damage.

data.flavorText: It spreads its beautiful wings wide to frighten its enemies. It can fly at Mach 2 speed.

data.name: Sharpedo

attacks.name: Strip Bare
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. If both of them are heads, your opponent discards all card from his or her hand.

attacks.name: Rage
attacks.text: Does 50 damage plus 10 more damage for each damage counter on Sharpedo.

data.flavorText: It can swim at speeds of 75 mph by jetting seawater through its body. It is the bandit of the sea.

data.name: Wailord

attacks.name: Underwater Dive
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. For each heads, remove 3 damage counters from Wailord.

attacks.name: Swallow Up
attacks.text: Before doing damage, count the remaining HP of the Defending Pokémon and Wailord. If the Defending Pokémon has fewer remaining HP than Wailord, this attack does 50 damage plus 50 more damage.

data.flavorText: It is the largest of all identified Pokémon. They jump as a pack to herd their prey.

data.name: Dragonair

attacks.name: Search and Invite
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Pokémon, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Slam
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 40 damage times the number of heads.

data.flavorText: Its crystalline orbs appear to give this Pokémon the power to freely control the weather.

data.name: Electabuzz

attacks.name: Shock Bolt
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, discard all Lightning Energy attached to Electabuzz.

data.flavorText: Its body constantly discharges electricity. Getting close to it will make your hair stand on end.

data.name: Electrode

attacks.name: Lightning Strike
attacks.text: You may do 40 damage plus 60 more damage. If you do, discard all Lightning Energy attached to Electrode.

data.flavorText: It is dangerous. If it has too much electricity and has nothing to do, it amuses itself by exploding.

data.name: Haunter

attacks.name: Sneaky Placement
attacks.text: Put 2 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Sleep Poison
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep and Poisoned.

data.flavorText: Its tongue is made of gas. If licked, its victim starts shaking constantly until death eventually comes.

data.name: Kangaskhan

attacks.name: Split Spiral Punch
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Dizzy Punch
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 50 damage times the number of heads.

data.flavorText: If it is safe, the young gets out of the belly pouch to play. The adult keeps a close eye on the youngster.

data.name: Lairon

attacks.name: Take Down
attacks.text: Lairon does 20 damage to itself.

data.flavorText: It loves iron ore. Groups of them fight for territory by bashing one another with their steel bodies.

data.name: Lickilicky

attacks.name: Licking Shot
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 10 damage to that Pokémon for each Energy attached to Lickilicky. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Stick and Absorb
attacks.text: Remove 2 damage counters from Lickilicky. The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

data.flavorText: It has space in its throat to store saliva. It can also roll up its tongue and store it in the same spot.

data.name: Luvdisc

attacks.name: Rendezvous Draw
attacks.text: Each player draws and reveals the top card of his or her deck.

attacks.name: Distorted Wave
attacks.text: Before doing damage, remove 1 damage counter from the Defending Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Its heart-shaped body makes it popular. In some places, you would give a Luvdisc to someone you love.

data.name: Machoke

attacks.name: Knuckle Down
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Poké-Powers, Poké-Bodies, or any other effects on the Defending Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It always goes at its full power, but this very tough and durable Pokémon never gets tired.

data.name: Magby

abilities.name: Sweet Sleeping Face
abilities.text: As long as Magby is Asleep, prevents all damage done to Magby by attacks.

attacks.name: Play with Fire
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Burned. Magby is now Asleep.

data.flavorText: It is found in volcanic craters. Its body temperature is over 1,100 degrees Fahrenheit, so don't underestimate it.

data.name: Magmar

attacks.name: Eruption
attacks.text: Each player discards the top card of his or her deck. This attack does 20 damage times the number of Energy cards discarded in this way.

data.flavorText: The fiery surface of its body gives off a wavering, rippling glare that is similar to the sun.

data.name: Magneton

attacks.name: Tri Attack
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

data.flavorText: The Magnemite are united by a magnetism so powerful, it dries all moisture in its vicinity.

data.name: Marowak

attacks.name: Bonemerang
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 60 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Bone Impact
attacks.text: If there is any Stadium card in play, this attack does 20 damage plus 60 more damage. Discard that Stadium card.

data.flavorText: It has been seen pounding boulders with the bone it carries in order to tap out messages to others.

data.name: Nidorina

attacks.name: Quick Blow
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 10 more damage.

data.flavorText: It has a calm and caring nature. Because its horn grows slowly, it prefers not to fight.

data.name: Nidorino

attacks.name: Lunge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

data.flavorText: Quick to anger, it stabs enemies with its horn to inject a powerful poison when it becomes agitated.

data.name: Pidgeotto

attacks.name: Twister
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. If both of them are tails, this attack does nothing. For each heads, discard an Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It renders its prey immobile using well-developed claws, then carries the prey more than 60 miles to its nest.

data.name: Piloswine

attacks.name: Blizzard
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. If tails, this attack does 10 damage to each of your Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.flavorText: Because the long hair all over its body obscures its sight, it just keeps charging repeatedly.

data.name: Porygon2

abilities.name: Mapping
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you play Porygon2 from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may search your deck for a Stadium card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: 3-D Attack
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

data.flavorText: Further research enhanced its abilities. Sometimes, it may exhibit motions that were not programmed.

data.name: Tentacruel

attacks.name: Tentavolve
attacks.text: If Tentacruel evolved from Tentacool during this turn, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed and Poisoned.

attacks.name: Hyper Beam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon.

data.flavorText: In battle, it extends all 80 of its tentacles to entrap its opponent inside a poisonous net.

data.name: Unown

abilities.name: CURE
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you put Unown from your hand onto your Bench, remove all Special Conditions from your Active Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Its flat, thin body is always stuck on walls. Its shape appears to have some meaning.

data.name: Wailmer

attacks.name: Double Attack
attacks.text: Choose 2 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage to each of them. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.flavorText: It bounces playfully like a ball. The more seawater it swallows, the higher it bounces.

data.name: Weepinbell

attacks.name: Poisonpowder
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Corrode Target
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, look at your opponent's hand, choose 1 card, and discard it.

data.flavorText: Even though it is filled with acid, it does not melt because it also oozes a protective fluid.

data.name: Yanmega

attacks.name: Shoot Through
attacks.text: Does 10 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: U-turn
attacks.text: Switch Yanmega with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

data.flavorText: The beat of its wings is so powerful that it accidentally dislodges full-grown trees when it takes off in flight.

data.name: Aipom

attacks.name: Imitate
attacks.text: Draw cards until you have the same number of cards in your hand as your opponent.

data.flavorText: Its tail is so powerful that it can use it to grab a tree branch and hold itself up in the air.

data.name: Aron

attacks.name: Mountain Eater
attacks.text: Discard the top card of your deck. Then, remove 2 damage counters from Aron.

data.flavorText: When it evolves, it sheds the steel carapace that covered its whole body and develops a new one.

data.name: Bellsprout

attacks.name: Inviting Scent
attacks.text: Switch the Defending Pokémon with 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Careless Tackle
attacks.text: Bellsprout does 10 damage to itself.

data.flavorText: Even though its body is extremely skinny, it is blindingly fast when catching its prey.

data.name: Bronzor

attacks.name: Iron Defense
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Bronzor during your opponent's next turn.

data.flavorText: Ancient people believed that the pattern on Bronzor's back contained a mysterious power.

data.name: Carvanha

attacks.name: Focus Energy
attacks.text: During your next turn, Carvanha's Bite attack's base damage is 40.

data.flavorText: They form packs to attack boats and rip out their hulls to sink them. They live in rivers in the jungle.

data.name: Cubone

abilities.name: Lonely Bone
abilities.text: Any damage done to Cubone by your opponent's attacks is reduced by 20 for each Marowak in your discard pile (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Bone Rush
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

data.flavorText: If it is sad or lonely, the skull it wears shakes and emits a plaintive and mournful sound.

data.name: Diglett

attacks.name: Sand Veil
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Diglett during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Mini Earthquake
attacks.text: Does 10 damage to each of your Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.flavorText: If a Diglett digs through a field, it leaves the soil perfectly tilled and ideal for planting crops.

data.name: Dratini

attacks.name: Gentle Wrap
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

data.flavorText: This Pokémon is full of life energy. It continually sheds its skin and grows steadily larger.

data.name: Gastly

attacks.name: Sneaky Placement
attacks.text: Put 1 damage counter on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Its body is made of gas. Despite lacking substance, it can envelop an opponent of any size and cause suffocation.

data.name: Illumise

attacks.name: Sweet Scent
attacks.text: Remove 3 damage counters from 1 of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Vulcan Beat
attacks.text: Flip a coin for each Volbeat you have in play. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

data.flavorText: Its fragrance attracts a swarm of Volbeat, so they draw over 200 patterns in the night sky.

data.name: Kricketot
data.flavorText: When its antennae hit each other, it sounds like the music of a xylophone.

data.name: Lickitung

attacks.name: Tongue Whip
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. This attack does 30 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.flavorText: Its long tongue, slathered with a gooey saliva, sticks to anything, so it is very useful.

data.name: Machop

attacks.name: Steady Punch
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 10 more damage.

data.flavorText: Always brimming with power, it passes time by lifting boulders. Doing so makes it even stronger.

data.name: Magnemite

attacks.name: Magnetic Switch
attacks.text: Switch Magnemite with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Thundershock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

data.flavorText: The units at the sides of its body generate antigravity energy to keep it aloft in the air.

data.name: Nidoran ♀

attacks.name: Friend Search
attacks.text: Look at the top 5 cards of your deck, choose 1 Pokémon you find there, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.

attacks.name: Double Kick
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

data.flavorText: Although not very combative, it will torment its foes with poison spikes if it is threatened in any way.

data.name: Nidoran ♂

attacks.name: Pheromone Poison
attacks.text: If Nidoran ♀ is on your Bench, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

data.flavorText: It raises its big ears to check its surroundings. It will strike first if it senses any danger.

data.name: Pidgey

attacks.name: Messenger
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Pokémon, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle Pidgey and all cards attached to it back into your deck.

data.flavorText: Common in grassy areas and forests, it is very docile and will chase off enemies by flapping up sand.

data.name: Ponyta
data.flavorText: It is a weak runner immediately after birth. It gradually becomes faster by chasing after its parents.

data.name: Porygon

attacks.name: Recover
attacks.text: Discard an Energy attached to Porygon and remove 4 damage counters from Porygon.

data.flavorText: A manmade Pokémon that came about as a result of research. It is programmed with only basic motions.

data.name: Psyduck

attacks.name: Tripping Headbutt
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. If tails, this attack does 30 damage to 1 of your Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.flavorText: It has mystical powers but doesn't recall that it has used them. That is why it always looks puzzled.

data.name: Shuppet

attacks.name: Disable
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 of the Defending Pokémon's attacks. That Pokémon can't use that attack during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Haunt
attacks.text: Put 1 damage counter on the Defending Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It uses its horn to feed on envy and malice, or so it's said. It's very active at night.

data.name: Skorupi

attacks.name: Paralyzing Clamp
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

data.flavorText: It burrows under the sand to lie in wait for prey. Its tail claws can inject its prey with a savage poison.

data.name: Spoink

attacks.name: Sleep Pearl
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. Switch Spoink with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It bounces around on its tail to keep its heart pumping. It carries a pearl from Clamperl on its head.

data.name: Swablu

attacks.name: Wing Flick
attacks.text: Your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Its wings bring cottony clouds to mind. It grooms with springwater and loves to sit on heads.

data.name: Swinub
data.flavorText: It rubs its snout on the ground to find and dig up food. It sometimes discovers hot springs.

data.name: Tentacool

attacks.name: Gentle Wrap
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

data.flavorText: It drifts aimlessly in waves. Very difficult to see in water, it may not be noticed until it stings.

data.name: Venonat

attacks.name: Leech Life
attacks.text: Remove from Venonat the number of damage counters equal to the damage you did to the Defending Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Poison oozes from all over its body. It catches and eats small bugs at night that are attracted by light.

data.name: Volbeat

attacks.name: Illumisile
attacks.text: If you don't have Illumise in play, this attack does nothing. Choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. This attack does 30 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Firefly Light
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Burned and Confused.

data.flavorText: It emits light from its tail to communicate. It loves the sweet aroma given off by Illumise.

data.name: Voltorb

attacks.name: Magnetic Bomb
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 10 more damage. If tails, Voltorb does 10 damage to itself.

data.flavorText: It rolls to move. If the ground is uneven, a sudden jolt from hitting a bump can cause it to explode.

data.name: Yanma

abilities.name: Free Flight
abilities.text: If Yanma has no Energy attached to it, Yanma's Retreat Cost is 0.

data.flavorText: Its large eyes can scan 360 degrees. It looks in all directions to seek out insects as its prey.

data.name: Black Belt
rules: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

You may use this card only if you have more Prize cards left than your opponent. During this turn, each of your Active Pokémon's attacks does 40 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

data.name: Indigo Plateau
rules: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. If another card with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.
Each Pokémon LEGEND in play (both yours and your opponent's) gets +30 HP.

data.name: Junk Arm
rules: Discard 2 cards from your hand. Search your discard pile for a Trainer card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. You can't choose Junk Arm with the effect of this card.

data.name: Seeker
rules: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.
Each player returns 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon and all cards attached to it to his or her hand. (You return your Pokémon first.)

data.name: Twins
rules: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.
You may use this card only if you have more Prize cards left than your opponent. Search your deck for any 2 cards and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

data.name: Rescue Energy
rules: Rescue Energy provides Colorless Energy. If the Pokémon this card is attached to is Knocked Out by damage from an attack, put that Pokémon back into your hand. (Discard all cards attached to that Pokémon.)

abilities.name: Eye of Disaster
abilities.text: As long as Absol is your Active Pokémon, whenever your opponent puts a Basic Pokémon from his or her hand onto his or her Bench, put 2 damage counters on that Pokémon.

attacks.name: Vicious Claw
attacks.text: Choose 1 Pokémon from your hand and put it in the Lost Zone. (If you can't put a Pokémon in the Lost Zone, this attack does nothing.)

abilities.name: Forest Breath
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if Celebi is your Active Pokémon, you may attach a Grass Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon. This power can't be used if Celebi is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Time Circle
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage done to Celebi by attacks from your opponent's Stage 1 or Stage 2 Pokémon.

abilities.name: Energymite
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may use this power. If you do, Electrode is Knocked Out. Look at the top 7 cards of your deck. data.name: Bellossom

abilities.name: Hustle Step
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may remove 1 damage counter from each of your Pokémon. This power can't be used if Bellossom is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Dance 'til Dawn
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads. Bellossom is now Asleep.

data.flavorText: Bellossom gather at times and seem to dance. They say that the dance is a ritual to summon the sun.

data.name: Espeon

attacks.name: Solar Suggestion
attacks.text: Move up to 4 damage counters from any of your Pokémon to any of your opponent's Pokémon in any way you like.

attacks.name: Psybeam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

data.flavorText: It uses the fine hair that covers its body to sense air currents and predict its enemy's actions.

data.name: Forretress

attacks.name: Mirror Shot
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Everyone Explode Now
attacks.text: Does 30 damage times the number of Pineco and Forretress you have in play. This attack does 30 damage to each of your Pineco and Forretress in play.

data.flavorText: Its entire body is shielded by a steel-hard shell. What lurks inside this shell is a total mystery.

data.name: Gliscor

attacks.name: Ninja Fang
attacks.text: If, before Gliscor does damage, the Defending Pokémon has no damage counters on it and is then damaged by this attack (after applying Weakness and Resistance), the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Poison Jab
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

data.flavorText: Its flight is soundless. It uses its lengthy tail to carry off its prey… Then its elongated fangs do the rest.

data.name: Houndoom

attacks.name: Fire Counterattack
attacks.text: If your opponent has any Fighting Pokémon in play, this attack does 20 damage plus 60 more damage.

attacks.name: Dark Roar
attacks.text: Your opponent discards a card from his or her hand.

data.flavorText: Upon hearing its eerie howls, other Pokémon get the shivers and head straight back to their nests.

data.name: Magcargo

attacks.name: Searing Flame
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Burned.

attacks.name: Lava Flow
attacks.text: You may discard any number of Fire Energy cards attached to Magcargo. If you do , this attack does 60 damage plus 20 more damage for each Fire Energy card you discarded.

data.flavorText: Its brittle shell occasionally spouts intense flames that circulate throughout its body.

data.name: Scizor
data.flavorText: Its wings are not used for flying. They are flapped at high speed to adjust its body temperature.

data.name: Smeargle

abilities.name: Portrait
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if Smeargle is your Active Pokémon, you may look at your opponent's hand. If you do, choose a Supporter card you find there and use the effect of that card as the effect of this power. This power can't be used if Smeargle is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Tail Rap
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

data.flavorText: Once it becomes an adult, it has a tendency to let its comrades plant footprints on its back.

data.name: Togekiss

attacks.name: Blessed Wings
attacks.text: Remove all damage counters from each of your Pokémon. Shuffle Togekiss and all cards attached to it back into your deck.

attacks.name: Air Cutter
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

data.flavorText: As everyone knows, it visits peaceful regions, bringing them gifts of kindness and sweet blessings.

data.name: Umbreon

attacks.name: Moonlight Fang
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects, including damage, done to Umbreon by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon that has any Poké-Powers or Poké-Bodies.

attacks.name: Quick Blow
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 damage plus 30 damage.

data.flavorText: When agitated, this Pokémon protects itself by spraying poisonous sweat from its pores.

data.name: Dodrio

abilities.name: Retreat Aid
abilities.text: As long as Dodrio is on your Bench, your Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost is ColorlessColorless less.

attacks.name: Incessant Peck
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 20 damage plus 20 more damage for each heads.

data.flavorText: It collects data and plans three times as wisely, but it may think too much and fall into a state of immobility.

data.name: Drifblim

attacks.name: Balloon Tackle
attacks.text: Drifblim does 20 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Take Away
attacks.text: Shuffle Drifblim and all cards attached to it back into your deck. Then, your opponent shuffles the Defending Pokémon and all cards attached to it into his or her deck. (You choose your new Active Pokémon first.)

data.flavorText: It can generate and release gas within its body. That's how it can control the altitude of its drift.

attacks.name: Spike Spread
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Gyro Ball

data.flavorText: It remains immovably rooted to its tree. It scatters pieces of its hard shell to drive its enemies away.

data.name: Hariyama

attacks.name: Backward Belt Throw
attacks.text: You may do 80 damage plus 20 more damage. If you do, Hariyama does 20 damage to itself.

data.flavorText: It loves challenging others to tests of strength. It has the power to stop a train with a slap.

data.name: Honchkrow

attacks.name: Whirlwind
attacks.text: Your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Blindside
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon that has any damage counters on it. This attack does 50 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.flavorText: It is merciless by nature. It is said that it never forgives the mistakes of its Murkrow followers.

data.name: Honchkrow

attacks.name: Shadow Bind

attacks.name: Vengeance
attacks.text: Does 10 damage plus 10 more damage for each Darkness Pokémon in your discard pile.

data.flavorText: It is merciless by nature. It is said that it never forgives the mistakes of its Murkrow followers.

attacks.name: Soothing Scent
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

data.flavorText: When you see Leafeon asleep in a patch of sunshine, you'll know it is using photosynthesis to produce clean air.

data.name: Metagross

attacks.name: Quad Smash
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 50 damage times the number of heads.

data.flavorText: It folds its four legs when flying. Its four brains are said to be superior to a supercomputer.

attacks.name: Sleeping Spell
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Poltergeist
attacks.text: Look at your opponent's hand. This attack does 30 damage times the number of Trainer, Supporter, and Stadium cards in your opponent's hand.]

data.flavorText: Its cries sound like incantations to torment the foe. It appears where you least expect it.

data.name: Rotom

abilities.name: Mischievous Trick
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may switch 1 of your face-down Prize cards with the top card of your deck. This power can't be used if Rotom is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Plasma Arrow
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage for each Energy attached to that Pokémon. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance.

data.flavorText: Research continues on this Pokémon, which could be the power source of a unique motor.

attacks.text: Search your deck for a Metal Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Pokémon. Shuffle your deck afterward.

data.flavorText: After nesting in bramble bushes, the wings of its chicks grow hard from scratches by thorns.

data.name: Tropius

attacks.name: Fresh-Picked Fruit
attacks.text: Remove 6 damage counters from 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

data.flavorText: The bunch of fruit around its neck ripens twice a year and is delicious. It's a highly favored tropical snack.

abilities.text: Prevent all damage done to your Benched Grass Pokémon by attacks.

attacks.name: Mach Wind
attacks.text: During your next turn, Vespiquen's Retreat Cost is 0.

data.flavorText: It raises grubs in the holes in its body. It secretes pheromones to control Combee.

attacks.name: Dazzling Pollen
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 50 damage plus 20 more damage. If tails, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

data.flavorText: It has the world's largest petals. With every step, the petals shake out heavy clouds of toxic pollen.

data.name: Weavile

data.name: Flareon

attacks.name: Flamethrower
attacks.text: Discard an Energy attached to Flareon.

data.flavorText: It stores some of the air it inhales in its internal flame pouch, which heats it to over 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.

data.name: Gloom

attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 Special Condition. The Defending Pokémon is now affected by that Special Condition.

data.flavorText: What appears to be drool is actually sweet honey. It is very sticky and clings stubbornly if touched.

attacks.name: Agility
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Jolteon during your opponent's next turn.

data.flavorText: It concentrates the weak electric charges emitted by its cells and launches wicked lightning bolts.

data.name: Lairon

attacks.name: Scrap Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, search your discard pile for a Metal Energy card and attach it to Lairon.

data.flavorText: It loves iron ore. Groups of them fight for territory by bashing one another with their steel bodies.

attacks.name: Double Smash

data.flavorText: When two Beldum fuse together, a magnetic nervous system places their brains in union.

attacks.name: Pester
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon is affected by a Special Condition, this attack does 50 damage plus 30 more damage.

data.flavorText: Its body is made of a powerful poison. Touching it accidentally will cause a fever that requires bed rest.

data.name: Pinsir

attacks.name: Charging Horn
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 20 more damage.

attacks.name: Spark
attacks.text: Does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.flavorText: When its electricity builds, its muscles are stimulated, and it becomes more aggressive than usual.

attacks.name: Gnaw Up
attacks.text: Discard a Special Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Its whiskers help it to maintain balance. Its fangs never stop growing, so it gnaws to pare them down.

attacks.name: Dark Hand
attacks.text: If you have more cards in your hand than your opponent, this attack does 20 damage plus 30 more damage.

data.flavorText: It dwells in the darkness of caves. It uses its sharp claws to dig up gems to nourish itself.

attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, if Scyther would be damaged by an attack, flip a coin. If heads, prevent that attack's damage done to Scyther.

data.flavorText: When it moves, it leaves only a blur. If it hides in grass, its protective colors make it invisible.

attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. If tails, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Fury Swipes
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

data.flavorText: It attacks by spraying a repugnant fluid from its tail, but the stench dulls after a few squirts.

attacks.name: Startling Trip
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused. If tails, Slowbro is now Confused.

data.name: Togetic

attacks.name: Chase Up
attacks.text: Search your deck for any 1 card and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Fly
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing. If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage done to Togetic during your opponent's next turn.

data.flavorText: It grows dispirited if it is not with kind people. It can float in midair without moving its wings.

data.name: Unown

abilities.name: DARK
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you put Unown from your hand onto your Bench, you may search your deck for a Darkness Energy card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

data.flavorText: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets. It is said that the two are somehow related.

data.name: Vaporeon

attacks.name: Spiral Drain
attacks.text: Remove 2 damage counters from Vaporeon.

attacks.name: Dual Splash
attacks.text: Choose 2 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 30 damage to each of them. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.flavorText: When Vaporeon's fins begin to vibrate, it is a sign that rain will come within a few hours.

data.name: Aron

attacks.name: Metal Sound
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

data.flavorText: When it evolves, it sheds the steel carapace that covered its whole body and develops a new one.

data.name: Beldum

attacks.name: Single Smash
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

data.flavorText: The magnetic force generated by its body repels the ground's natural magnetism, letting it float.

data.name: Combee

attacks.name: Enraged Assault
attacks.text: If Vespiquen is on your Bench and has any damage counters on it, this attack does 20 damage plus 60 more damage and the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

data.flavorText: At night, Combee sleep in a group of about a thousand, packed closely together in a lump.

data.name: Doduo

attacks.name: Double Headstrike
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. If either of them is tails, this attack does nothing.

data.flavorText: By alternately raising and lowering its two heads, it balances itself to be more stable while running.

attacks.name: Minimize
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to Drifloon by attacks is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Pull
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, switch the Defending Pokémon with 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It is whispered that any child who mistakes Drifloon for a balloon and holds on to it could wind up missing.

data.name: Eevee
data.flavorText: It has the ability to alter the composition of its body to suit its surrounding environment.

data.name: Eevee

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Tickle
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

data.flavorText: Its irregularly configured DNA is affected by its surroundings. It evolves if its environment changes.

data.name: Gligar

attacks.name: Stun Poison
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed and Poisoned.

data.flavorText: It flies straight at its target's face then clamps down on the startled victim to inject poison.

data.name: Grimer

attacks.name: Sticky Liquid
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon's Retreat Cost is Colorless more.

data.flavorText: Wherever Grimer has passed, so many germs are left behind that no plants will ever grow again.

data.name: Hitmonchan

attacks.name: Detect
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of attack, including damage, done to Hitmonchan during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Sky Uppercut
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

data.flavorText: Its punches slice the air. However, it seems to need a short break after fighting for three minutes.

data.name: Hitmonlee
data.flavorText: If it starts kicking repeatedly, both legs will stretch even longer to strike a fleeing foe.

data.name: Houndour
data.flavorText: It uses different kinds of cries for communicating with others of its kind and for pursuing its prey.

data.name: Houndour

attacks.name: Jump On
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 10 more damage.

data.flavorText: To corner prey, they check each other's location using barks that only they can understand.

data.name: Makuhita

attacks.name: Slap Down
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage plus 10 more damage for each heads.

data.flavorText: It toughens up by slamming into thick trees over and over. It gains a sturdy body and dauntless spirit.

data.name: Mawile

attacks.name: Selfish Draw
attacks.text: Look at the top card of your deck. You may put it into your hand. If not, discard it and draw a card.

attacks.name: Destructive Jaw
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed and discard an Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It chomps with its gaping mouth. Its huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed.

data.name: Misdreavus

attacks.name: Dual Draw
attacks.text: Each player draws 3 cards.

data.flavorText: It loves to bite and yank people's hair from behind without warning, just to see their shocked reactions.

data.name: Murkrow

attacks.name: Astonish
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 card from your opponent's hand without looking. Look at the card you chose, then have your opponent shuffle that card into his or her deck.

data.flavorText: Feared and loathed by many, it is believed to bring misfortune to all those who see it at night.

data.name: Murkrow
data.flavorText: It is said that when chased, it lures its attacker onto dark mountain trails where the foe will get lost.

data.name: Oddish

attacks.name: Find a Friend
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a Grass Pokémon, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

data.flavorText: Awakened by moonlight, it roams actively at night. In the day it stays quietly underground.

data.name: Pikachu

attacks.name: Slam
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

data.flavorText: This intelligent Pokémon roasts hard berries with electricity to make them tender enough to eat.

data.name: Pineco
data.flavorText: It hangs and waits for flying insect prey to come near. It does not move about much on its own.

data.name: Pineco

attacks.name: Focus Energy
attacks.text: During your next turn, Pineco's Surprise Attack attack's base damage is 80.

attacks.name: Surprise Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

data.flavorText: It likes to make its shell thicker by adding layers of tree bark. The additional weight doesn't bother it.

data.name: Rattata
data.flavorText: Living wherever there is food available, it ceaselessly scavenges for edibles the entire day.

data.name: Scyther

attacks.name: Slashing Strike
attacks.text: During your next turn, Scyther can't use Slashing Strike.

data.flavorText: It slashes through grass with its sharp scythes, moving too fast for the human eye to track.

data.name: Slowpoke

attacks.name: Rambunctious Party
attacks.text: Look at the top 5 cards of your deck. Choose as many Basic Pokémon as you like and put them onto your Bench. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.

data.flavorText: A sweet sap leaks from its tail's tip. Although not nutritious, the tail is pleasant to chew on.

data.name: Slugma

abilities.name: Active Volcano
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may discard the top card of your deck. If that card is a Fire Energy card, attach it to Slugma. This power can't be used if Slugma is affected by a Special Condition.

data.flavorText: A common sight in volcanic areas, it slowly slithers around in a constant search for warm places.

data.name: Sneasel

attacks.name: Fury Swipes
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Beat Up
attacks.text: Flip a coin for each of your Pokémon in play. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

data.flavorText: Vicious in nature, it drives Pidgey from their nests and scavenges any leftovers it can find.

data.name: Stunky

attacks.name: Double Scratch
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

data.flavorText: The foul fluid from its rear is so revolting that it can make people feel queasy up to a mile and a quarter away.

data.name: Togepi

attacks.name: Plead
attacks.text: Ask your opponent if you may draw 2 cards. If yes, draw 2 cards. If no, this attack does 20 damage to the Defending Pokémon.

data.flavorText: A proverb claims that happiness will come to anyone who can make a sleeping Togepi stand up.

data.name: Burned Tower
rules: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. If another card with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.

Once during each player's turn, that player may flip a coin. If heads, the player searches his or her discard pile for a basic Energy card, shows it to his or her opponent, and put it into his or her hand.

data.name: Defender
rules: Attach Defender to 1 of your Pokémon. Discard this card at the end of your opponent's next turn. Any damage done to the Pokémon Defender is attached to by an opponent's attack is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

data.name: Energy Exchanger
rules: Choose an Energy card from your hand, show it to your opponent, and put it on top of your deck. Search your deck for an Energy card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

data.name: Flower Shop Lady
rules: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.
Search your discard pile for 3 Pokémon and 3 basic Energy cards. Show them to your opponent and shuffle them into your deck.

data.name: Legend Box
rules: Reveal the top 10 cards of your deck. If you reveal both halves of a Pokémon LEGEND, put those cards onto your Bench and attach all revealed Energy cards to that Pokémon LEGEND. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck. (You can play only 1 Pokémon LEGEND in this way.)

data.name: Ruins of Alph
rules: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. If another card with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.
Each Pokémon in play has no Resistance.

data.name: Sage's Training
rules: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.
Look at the top 5 cards of your deck. Choose any 2 cards you find there and put them into your hand. Discard the other cards.

data.name: Team Rocket's Trickery
rules: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.
Draw 2 cards. Then, your opponent discards a card from his or her hand.

data.name: Darkness Energy
rules: If the Pokémon Darkness Energy is attached to attacks, the attack does 10 more damage to the Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance). Ignore this effect if the Pokémon that Darkness Energy is attached to isn't Darkness. Darkness Energy provides Darkness Energy. (Doesn't count as a basic Energy card.)

data.name: Metal Energy
rules: Damage done by attacks to the Pokémon that Metal Energy is attached to is reduced by 10 (after applying Weakness and Resistance). Ignore this effect if the Pokémon that Metal Energy is attached to isn't Metal Metal Energy provides Metal Energy. (Doesn't count as a basic Energy card.)

abilities.name: Evolution Memories
abilities.text: Espeon can use the attacks of all Pokémon you have in play that evolve from Eevee as its own. (You still need the necessary Energy to use each attack.)

attacks.name: Solar Ray
attacks.text: Remove 1 damage counter from each of your Pokémon.

abilities.name: Fire Breath
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Burned. This power can't be used if Houndoom is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Dark Clamp
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

abilities.name: Voltage Increase
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may move a Lightning Energy attached to 1 of your Pokémon to Raichu. This power can't be used if Raichu is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Mega Thunderbolt
attacks.text: Discard all Energy attached to Raichu.

abilities.name: Red Armor
abilities.text: Prevent all damage done to Scizor by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon that have any Special Energy cards attached to them.

attacks.name: Metal Scissors
attacks.text: Does 30 damage plus 20 more damage for each Metal Energy attached to Scizor.

abilities.name: Opponent's Choice
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may reveal the top 2 cards of your deck and your opponent chooses 1 of them. Put that card into your hand and the other card on the bottom of your deck. This power can't be used if Slowking is affected by a Special Condition.

abilities.name: Cloud-Covered Moon
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if Umbreon is your Active Pokémon, you may flip a coin. If heads, return Umbreon and all cards attached to it to your hand. This power can't be used if Umbreon is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Evoblast
attacks.text: Does 50 damage plus 10 more damage for each of your Pokémon in play that evolves from Eevee.

data.name: Kyogre & Groudon LEGEND
rules: Put this card from your hand onto your Bench only with the other half of Kyogre & Groudon LEGEND.
When this Pokémon has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Mega Tidal Wave
attacks.text: Discard the top 5 cards from your opponent's deck. This attack does 30 damage times the number of Energy cards you discarded to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Massive Eruption
attacks.text: Discard the top 5 cards from your deck. This attack does 100 damage times the number of Energy cards you discarded.

data.name: Kyogre & Groudon LEGEND

When this Pokémon has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Mega Tidal Wave
attacks.text: Discard the top 5 cards from your opponent's deck. This attack does 30 damage times the number of Energy cards you discarded to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Massive Eruption
attacks.text: Discard the top 5 cards from your deck. This attack does 100 damage times the number of Energy cards you discarded.

When this Pokémon has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

rules: Put this card from your hand onto your Bench only with the other half of Rayquaza & Deoxys LEGEND.
When this Pokémon has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

data.name: Alph Lithograph
rules: Return any Stadium card in play to its player's hand!

data.name: Jirachi

abilities.name: Stardust Song
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you put Jirachi from your hand onto your Bench, you may flip 3 coins. For each heads, search your discard pile for a Psychic Energy card and attach it to Jirachi.

attacks.name: Time Hollow
attacks.text: Choose a number of your opponent's Stage 1 or Stage 2 Evolved Pokémon up to the amount of Energy attached to Jirachi. Remove the highest Stage Evolution card from each of those Pokémon and put those cards back into your opponent's hand.

data.flavorText: Generations have believed that any wish written on a note on its head will come true when it awakens.

data.name: Magmortar

attacks.name: Hard Crush
attacks.text: Discard the top 3 cards from your deck. This attack does 50 damage times the number of Energy cards you discarded.

attacks.name: Mantle Bazooka
attacks.text: Discard 2 Fire Energy attached to Magmortar.

data.flavorText: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit out of its arms. Its breath also sears and sizzles.

data.name: Manaphy

attacks.name: Deep Sea Swirl
attacks.text: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw 5 cards.

data.flavorText: It starts its life with a wondrous power that permits it to bond with any kind of Pokémon.

abilities.name: Psychic Float
abilities.text: If you have any Psychic Energy attached to your Active Pokémon, the Retreat Cost for that Pokémon is 0.

attacks.name: Double Leg Hammer
attacks.text: Choose 2 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. This attack does 40 damage to each of them. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.name: Mismagius

abilities.name: Magical Trans
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may move a Psychic Energy attached to 1 of your Pokémon to another of your Pokémon. This power can't be used if Mismagius is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Psychic Pulse
attacks.text: Does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon that has any damage counters on it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.flavorText: Its cries sound like incantations to torment the foe. It appears where you least expect it.

data.name: Octillery

attacks.name: Switch Cannon
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 30 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) Switch Octillery with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Ink Bomb
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing.

data.flavorText: It traps foes with the suction cups on its tentacles, then smashes them with its rock-hard head.

data.name: Politoed

abilities.name: Leap Frog
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may choose a Water Pokémon on your Bench and switch it with your Active Pokémon. This power can't be used if Politoed is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Big Chorus
attacks.text: Flip a coin for each Water Pokémon you have in play. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

data.flavorText: Whenever three or more of these get together, they sing in a loud voice that sounds like bellowing.

data.name: Shaymin

abilities.name: Celebration Wind
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you put Shaymin from your hand onto your Bench, you may move as many Energy cards attached to your Pokémon as you like to any of your other Pokémon.

attacks.name: Energy Bloom
attacks.text: Remove 3 damage counters from each of your Pokémon that has any Energy attached to it.

data.flavorText: The blooming of Gracidea flowers confers the power of flight upon it. Feelings of gratitude are the message it delivers.

data.name: Sudowoodo

attacks.name: Push Over
attacks.text: Does 20 damage times the amount of Fighting Energy attached to Sudowoodo.

attacks.name: Rumble
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

data.flavorText: It disguises itself as a tree to avoid attack. It hates water, so it will disappear if it starts raining.

data.name: Torterra

attacks.name: Giga Drain
attacks.text: Remove from Torterra the number of damage counters equal to the damage you did to the Defending Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Ancient people imagined that beneath the ground, a gigantic Torterra dwelled.

data.name: Xatu

attacks.name: Psywave
attacks.text: Does 20 damage times the amount of Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Confuse Ray
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

data.flavorText: In South America, it is said that its right eye sees the future and its left eye views the past.

data.name: Beedrill

attacks.name: Twineedle
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 50 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Paralyze Poison
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is also Paralyzed.

data.flavorText: It can take down any opponent with its powerful poison stingers. It sometimes attacks in swarms.

data.name: Blastoise

abilities.name: Wash Out
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may move a Water Energy attached to 1 of your Benched Pokémon to your Active Pokémon. This power can't be used if Blastoise is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Hydro Launcher
attacks.text: Return 2 Water Energy attached to Blastoise to your hand. Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 100 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.flavorText: It deliberately makes itself heavy so it can withstand the recoil of the water jets it fires.

data.name: Crobat

attacks.name: Supersonic
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Hurricane Wing
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

data.flavorText: The development of wings on its legs enables it to fly fast but also makes it tough to stop and rest.

data.name: Fearow

attacks.name: Repeating Drill
attacks.text: Flip 5 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

data.flavorText: It shoots itself suddenly high into the sky, then plummets down in one fell swoop to strike its prey.

data.name: Floatzel

abilities.name: Water Acceleration
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may attach a Water Energy card from your hand to Floatzel. This power can't be used if Floatzel is affected by a Special Condition.

data.flavorText: With its flotation sac inflated, it can carry people on its back. It deflates the sac before it dives.

data.name: Kingdra

attacks.name: Water Arrow
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 30 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Stream Pump
attacks.text: You may do 50 damage plus 30 more damage. If you do, return an Energy card attached to Kingdra to your hand.

data.flavorText: It sleeps deep on the ocean floor to build its energy. It is said to cause tornadoes as it wakes.

data.name: Lanturn

attacks.name: Confuse Ray
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Reflect Energy
attacks.text: Move an Energy card attached to Lanturn to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

data.flavorText: The light it emits is so bright that it can illuminate the sea's surface from a depth of over three miles.

data.name: Lucario

attacks.name: Bulk Up
attacks.text: During your next turn, each of Lucario's attacks does 30 more damage to the Defending Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

data.flavorText: It's said that no foe can remain invisible to Lucario, since it can detect auras, even foes it could not otherwise see.

data.name: Ninetales

attacks.name: Heat Acceleration
attacks.text: Search your discard pile for up to 3 Fire Energy cards and attach them to 1 of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Searing Flame
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Burned.

data.flavorText: Some legends claim that each of its nine tails has its own unique type of special mystical power.

data.name: Poliwrath

attacks.name: Steamroll
attacks.text: Does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Dynamic Punch
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 60 damage plus 40 more damage and the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

data.flavorText: Although an energetic, skilled swimmer that uses all of its muscles, it lives on dry land.

data.name: Primeape

attacks.name: Bebop Punch
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 50 damage times the number of heads to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.flavorText: If approached while asleep, it may awaken and angrily give chase in a groggy state of semi-sleep.

data.name: Roserade

abilities.name: Energy Signal
abilities.text: When you attach a Grass Energy card or Psychic Energy card from your hand to Roserade during your turn, you may use this power. If you attach a Grass Energy card, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused. If you attach a Psychic Energy card, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. This power can't be used if Roserade is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Power Blow
attacks.text: Does 20 damage times the amount of Energy attached to Roserade.

data.flavorText: Its sweet aroma attracts prey. Then it spews poison. The more toxic it is, the sweeter its aroma.

data.name: Steelix

attacks.name: Guard Press
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to Steelix by attacks is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Steel Swing
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 80 damage times the number of heads.

data.flavorText: Its body has been compressed deep under the ground. As a result, it is even harder than a diamond.

data.name: Torkoal

abilities.name: Hot Snort
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you put Torkoal from your hand onto your Bench, you may flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Burned.

data.flavorText: You find abandoned coal mines full of them. They dig tirelessly in search of coal.

data.name: Tyranitar

attacks.name: Tail Crush
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 40 damage plus 20 more damage.

attacks.name: Hyper Beam
attacks.text: Discard an Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Extremely strong, it can change the landscape. It has an insolent nature that makes it not care about others.

data.name: Ursaring

attacks.name: Cross Chop
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 50 damage plus 30 more damage.

data.flavorText: With its ability to distinguish any aroma, it unfailing finds all food buried deep underground.

data.name: Cherrim

abilities.name: Sunny Heal
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may remove 1 damage counter from your Active Pokémon. This power can't be used if Cherrim is affected by a Special Condition.

data.flavorText: During times of strong sunlight, its bud blooms, its petals open fully, and it becomes very active.

data.name: Dunsparce

attacks.name: Return
attacks.text: Draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand.

data.flavorText: When spotted, this Pokémon escapes backward by furiously boring into the ground with its tail.

data.name: Golbat

attacks.name: Mean Look
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

data.flavorText: It can drink more than 10 ounces of blood at once. If it has too much, it gets heavy and flies clumsily.

data.name: Grotle

attacks.name: Sleep Powder
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

data.flavorText: A Grotle that lives in the forest is said to have its own secret springwater.

data.name: Kakuna

attacks.name: Speed Evolution
attacks.text: Search your deck for a card that evolves from Kakuna and put it onto Kakuna. (This counts as evolving Kakuna.) Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Poison Sting
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

data.flavorText: Although it is a cocoon, it can move a little. It can extend its poison barb if it is attacked.

data.name: Metang

attacks.name: Energy Crane
attacks.text: Search your discard pile for up to 2 Psychic Energy cards and attach them to your Pokémon in any way you like.

data.flavorText: When two Beldum fuse together, a magnetic nervous system places their brains in union.

data.name: Minun

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Tag Team Boost
attacks.text: If Plusle is on your Bench, this attack does 10 damage plus 20 more damage.

data.flavorText: Exposure to electricity from Minun and Plusle promotes blood circulation and relaxes muscles.

data.name: Numel

attacks.name: Flare Bonus
attacks.text: Discard a Fire Energy card from your hand. Then, draw 3 cards.

data.flavorText: The flaming magma it stores in the hump on its back is the source of its tremendous power.

data.name: Plusle

attacks.name: Collect
attacks.text: Draw 2 cards.

attacks.name: Thunder Jolt
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, Plusle does 10 damage to itself.

data.flavorText: It absorbs electricity from telephone poles. It shorts out its body to create crackling noises.

data.name: Poliwhirl

attacks.name: Hypnoblast
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

data.flavorText: The skin on most of its body is moist. However, the skin on its belly spiral feels smooth.

data.name: Pupitar

abilities.name: Boost Gas
abilities.text: If Pupitar has any Energy attached to it, the Retreat Cost of Pupitar is 0.

attacks.name: Rage
attacks.text: Does 20 damage plus 10 more damage for each damage counter on Pupitar.

data.flavorText: Its shell is as hard as sheet rock, and it is also very strong. Its thrashing can topple a mountain.

data.name: Pupitar
data.flavorText: Even sealed in its shell, it can move freely. Hard and fast, it has outstanding destructive power.

data.name: Seadra

attacks.name: Muddy Water
attacks.text: Does 10 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.flavorText: Its fin tips leak poison. Its fins and bones are highly valued as ingredients in herbal medicine.

data.name: Tauros

attacks.name: Crimson Bull
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads. Tauros is now Confused.

data.flavorText: They fight each other by locking horns. The herd's protector takes pride in its battle-scarred horns.

data.name: Wartortle

attacks.name: Water Arrow
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.flavorText: It is a well-established symbol of longevity. If its shell has algae on it, that Wartortle is very old.

data.name: Aipom

attacks.name: Tail Code
attacks.text: Move an Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon to another of your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Tail Smash
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

data.flavorText: It lives atop tall trees. When leaping from branch to branch, it deftly uses its tail for balance.

data.name: Beldum

attacks.name: Reaction
attacks.text: You may switch Beldum with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

data.flavorText: The magnetic force generated by its body repels the ground's natural magnetism, letting it float.

data.name: Buizel

attacks.name: Muddy Water
attacks.text: Does 10 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.flavorText: It inflates its flotation sac, keeping its face above water in order to watch for prey movement.

data.name: Carnivine

attacks.name: Drawup Power
attacks.text: Search your deck for an Energy card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

data.flavorText: It walks around on its tentacles in search of a tree branch where it can dangle down and ambush prey.

data.name: Cherubi
data.flavorText: It evolves by sucking the energy out of the small ball where it had been storing nutrients.

data.name: Chinchou
data.flavorText: It shoots positive and negative electricity between the tips of its two antennae and zaps its enemies.

data.name: Horsea

attacks.name: Fin Smack
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

data.flavorText: Its big, developed fins move rapidly, allowing it to swim backward while still facing forward.

data.name: Larvitar

attacks.name: Mountain Eater
attacks.text: Discard the top card of your opponent's deck. Then, remove 2 damage counters from Larvitar.

attacks.name: Reckless Charge
attacks.text: Larvitar does 10 damage to itself.

data.flavorText: It feeds on soil. After it has eaten a large mountain, it will fall asleep so it can grow.

data.name: Larvitar
data.flavorText: It is born deep underground. It can't emerge until it has entirely consumed the soil around it.

data.name: Magmar
data.flavorText: It dislikes cold places, so it blows scorching flames to make the environment suitable for itself.

data.name: Mankey

attacks.name: Karate Chop
attacks.text: Does 40 damage minus 10 damage for each damage counter on Mankey.

data.flavorText: It is extremely ill-tempered. Groups of them will attack any handy target for no reason.

data.name: Misdreavus

attacks.name: Sharpshooting
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 10 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.flavorText: It likes playing mischievous tricks such as screaming and wailing to startle people at night.

data.name: Natu

attacks.name: Teleport
attacks.text: Switch Natu with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It usually forages for food on the ground but may, on rare occasions, hop onto branches to peck at shoots.

data.name: Onix

abilities.name: Energy Healer
abilities.text: Whenever you attach an Energy card from your hand to Onix, remove a damage counter from Onix.

attacks.name: Boundless Power
attacks.text: Onix can't attack during your next turn.

data.flavorText: It rapidly bores through the ground at 50 mph by squirming and twisting its massive, rugged body.

data.name: Onix

attacks.name: Swing Around
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage plus 20 more damage for each heads.

data.flavorText: It twists and squirms through the ground. The thunderous roar of its tunneling echoes a long way.

data.name: Poliwag

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward.

data.flavorText: The direction of its belly spiral differs by area. The equator is thought to have an effect on this.

data.name: Remoraid

attacks.name: Water Arrow
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.flavorText: It has superb accuracy. The water it shoots out can strike even moving prey from more than 300 feet.

data.name: Riolu

attacks.name: Double Chop
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

data.flavorText: They communicate with one another using their auras. They are able to run all through the night.

data.name: Roselia

attacks.name: Petal Dance
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads. Roselia is now Confused.

data.flavorText: Roselia that drink nutritionally rich springwater are said to reveal rare coloration when they bloom.

data.name: Spearow

attacks.name: Roost
attacks.text: Remove 4 damage counters from Spearow. Spearow can't retreat during your next turn.

data.flavorText: It flaps its short wings to flush out insects from tall grass. It then plucks them with its stubby beak.

data.name: Squirtle
data.flavorText: The shell is soft when it is born. It soon becomes so resilient, prodding fingers will bounce off it.

data.name: Stantler

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Mystifying Horns
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

data.flavorText: The curved antlers subtly change the flow of air to create a strange space where reality is distorted.

data.name: Teddiursa

attacks.name: Take Down
attacks.text: Teddiursa does 10 damage to itself.

data.flavorText: Before food becomes scarce in wintertime, its habit is to hoard food in many hidden locations.

data.name: Tropius

attacks.name: Green Call
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. For each heads, search your deck for a Grass Pokémon, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. If you do, shuffle your deck afterward.

data.flavorText: The bunch of fruit around its neck ripens twice a year and is delicious. It's a highly favored tropical snack.

data.name: Turtwig

attacks.name: Leech Seed
attacks.text: If this attack does any damage to the Defending Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance), remove 1 damage counter from Turtwig.

data.flavorText: Photosynthesis occurs across its body under the sun. The shell on its back is actually hardened soil.

data.name: Vulpix

attacks.name: Fireworks
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, discard a Fire Energy attached to Vulpix.

data.flavorText: As it develops, its single white tail gains color and splits into six. It is quite warm and cuddly.

data.name: Weedle

attacks.name: Speed Evolution
attacks.text: Search your deck for a card that evolves from Weedle and put it onto Weedle. (This counts as evolving Weedle.) Shuffle your deck afterward.

data.flavorText: Its poison stinger is very powerful. Its bright-colored body is intended to warn off its enemies.

rules: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.
