data.name: Level Max
rules: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a Pokémon LV.X that levels up from 1 of your Pokémon, and put it onto that Pokémon. (This counts as leveling up that Pokémon.) Shuffle your deck afterward.

data.name: Life Herb
rules: Flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 of your Pokémon, and remove all Special Conditions and 6 damage counters from that Pokémon (all if there are less than 6).

data.name: Looker's Investigation
rules: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.
Look at your opponent's hand, then choose you or your opponent. That player shuffles his or her hand into his or her deck and draws up to 5 cards.

data.name: Memory Berry
rules: Attach Memory Berry to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached to it. If that Pokémon is Knocked Out, discard this card.
The Pokémon this card is attached to can use any attack from its Basic Pokémon or its Stage 1 Evolution card. (You still have to pay for that attack's Energy cost.)

data.name: Miasma Valley
rules: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. If another card with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.
Whenever any player puts a Basic Pokémon (excluding Grass or Psychic Pokémon) from his or her hand onto his or her Bench, put 2 damage counters on that Pokémon.

data.name: PlusPower
rules: Attach PlusPower to 1 of your Pokémon. Discard this card at the end of your turn.
If the Pokémon PlusPower is attached to attacks, the attack does 10 more damage to the Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

data.name: Poké Ball
rules: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a Pokémon, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

data.name: Pokédex HANDY910is
rules: Look at the top 2 cards of your deck, choose 1 of them, and put it into your hand. Put the other card on the bottom of your deck.

data.name: Pokémon Rescue
rules: Search your discard pile for a Pokémon, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand.

data.name: Team Galactic's Invention G-101 Energy Gain
rules: Attach Team Galactic's Invention G-101 Energy Gain to 1 of your Pokémon SP that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached to it. If that Pokémon is Knocked Out, discard this card. When the Pokémon this card is attached to is no longer a Pokémon SP, discard this card.
As long as Team Galactic's Invention G-101 Energy Gain is attached to a Pokémon, the attack cost of that Pokémon's attacks is Colorless less.

data.name: Team Galactic's Invention G-103 Power Spray
rules: You may play this card during your opponent's turn when your opponent's Pokémon uses any Poké-Power. Prevent all effects of that Poké-Power. (This counts as that Pokémon using its Poké-Power.) If you have 2 or less Pokémon SP in play, you can't play this card.

data.name: Team Galactic's Invention G-105 Poké Turn
rules: Return 1 of your Pokémon SP and all cards attached to it to your hand.

data.name: Armor Fossil

Armor Fossil can't be affected by any Special Conditions and can't retreat. At any time during your turn before your attack, you may discard Armor Fossil from play. (This doesn't count as a Knocked Out Pokémon.)

abilities.name: Armor Stone

data.name: Conductive Quarry
rules: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. If another card with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.

Once during each player's turn, the player may flip a coin. If heads, that player searches his or her discard pile for a Lightning or Metal Energy card, shows it to the opponent, and puts it into his or her hand.

data.name: Energy Link
rules: Attach Energy Link to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached to it. If that Pokémon is Knocked Out, discard this card.

As long as Energy Link is attached to a Pokémon, you may move an Energy card attached to that Pokémon to another of your Pokémon that has Energy Link attached to it. You may use this effect as often as you like during your turn.

data.name: Energy Switch
rules: Move a basic Energy card attached to 1 of your Pokémon to another of your Pokémon.

data.name: Great Ball
rules: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward.

data.name: Luxury Ball
rules: Search your deck for a Pokémon (excluding Pokémon LV.X), show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. If any Luxury Ball is in your discard pile, you can't play this card.

data.name: Marley's Request
rules: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

Search your discard pile for 2 different Trainer, Supporter, or Stadium cards, show them to your opponent, and your opponent chooses 1 of them. Put that card into your hand, and discard the other card. (If all Trainer, Supporter, and Stadium cards in your discard pile have the same name, choose 1 of them. Show that card to your opponent and put it into your hand.)

data.name: Poké Blower +
rules: You may play 2 Poké Blower + at the same time. If you play 1 Poké Blower +, flip a coin. If heads, put 1 damage counter on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. If you play 2 Poké Blower +, choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon and switch it with 1 of your opponent's Active Pokémon.

data.name: Poké Drawer +
rules: You may play 2 Poké Drawer + at the same time. If you play 1 Poké Drawer +, draw a card. If you play 2 Poké Drawer +, search your deck for up to 2 cards, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

data.name: Poké Healer +
rules: You may play 2 Poké Healer + at the same time. If you play 1 Poké Healer +, remove 1 damage counter and a Special Condition from 1 of your Active Pokémon. If you play 2 Poké Healer +, remove 8 damage counters and all Special Conditions from 1 of your Active Pokémon.

data.name: Premier Ball
rules: Search your deck or your discard pile for a Pokémon LV.X, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. If you search your deck, shuffle your deck afterward.

data.name: Potion
rules: Remove 2 damage counters from 1 of your Pokémon (remove 1 damage counter if that Pokémon has only 1).

data.name: Switch
rules: Switch 1 of your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

data.name: Cyclone Energy
rules: Cyclone Energy provides Colorless Energy. When you attach this card from your hand to your Active Pokémon, switch 1 of the Defending Pokémon with 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. Your opponent chooses the Benched Pokémon to switch.

data.name: Warp Energy
rules: Warp Energy provides Colorless Energy. When you attach this card from your hand to your Active Pokémon, switch that Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

data.name: Dusknoir LV.X
rules: Put this card onto your Active Dusknoir. Dusknoir LV.X can use any attack, Poké-Power, or Poké-Body from its previous level.

abilities.name: Ectoplasm
abilities.text: If Dusknoir is your Active Pokémon and would be Knocked Out by damage from your opponent's attack, you may discard all cards attached to Dusknoir LV.X and put Dusknoir LV.X as a Stadium card into play instead of discarding it. This counts as Dusknoir being Knocked Out and your opponent takes a Prize card. As long as you have Dusknoir LV.X as a Stadium card in play, put 1 damage counter on each of your opponent's Pokémon between turns. If another Stadium card comes into play or Dusknoir LV.X is discarded by the effects of any attacks, Poké-Powers, Poké-Bodies, Trainer, or Supporter cards, return Dusknoir LV.X to your hand.

data.name: Heatran LV.X
rules: Put this card onto your Active Heatran. Heatran LV.X can use any attack, Poké-Power, or Poké-Body from its previous level.

abilities.name: Heat Metal
abilities.text: Your opponent can't remove the Special Condition Burned by evolving or devolving his or her Burned Pokémon. (This also includes putting a Pokémon Level-Up card onto the Burned Pokémon.) Whenever your opponent flips a coin for the Special Condition Burned between turns, treat it as tails.

abilities.name: Heat Wave
abilities.text: Once at the end of your turn, if Heatran is on your Bench, you may use this power. If you discarded basic Energy cards attached to your Fire or Metal Active Pokémon by using that Pokémon's attack this turn, attach up to 2 of those Energy cards to that Pokémon.

data.name: Machamp LV.X

abilities.name: No Guard
abilities.text: As long as Machamp is your Active Pokémon, each of Machamp's attacks does 60 more damage to the Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance) and any damage done to Machamp by your opponent's Pokémon is increased by 60 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Strong-Willed
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, if Machamp would be Knocked Out by damage from an attack, flip a coin. If heads, Machamp is not Knocked Out and its remaining HP becomes 10 instead.

data.name: Raichu LV.X

abilities.name: Link Lightning
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you put Raichu LV.X onto Raichu and use Voltage Shoot, you may use another attack of Raichu afterward. This power can't be used if Raichu is affected by a Special Condition.

abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may choose 1 of your Pokémon in play and that Pokémon is Knocked Out. This power can't be used if Regigigas is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Frog Hop
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 40 damage plus 40 more damage.

data.flavorText: It gathers groups of others as their leader. Its cries make Poliwag obey.

data.name: Probopass

abilities.name: Steel Coating
abilities.text: Any damage done to Probopass by your opponent's attacks is reduced by 10 for each Metal Energy attached to Probopass (after applying Weakness and Resistance). You can't reduce more than 20 damage in this way.

attacks.name: Metal Bomber
attacks.text: Choose a number of your opponent's Benched Pokémon up to the amount of Metal Energy attached to Probopass. This attack does 20 damage to each of them. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.flavorText: It exudes strong magnetism from all over. It controls three small units call Mini-Noses.

data.name: Rayquaza

abilities.name: Speed Gain
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may flip a coin until you get tails. For each heads, search your discard pile for a basic Fire Energy card or a basic Lightning Energy card and attach it to Rayquaza. This power can't be used if Rayquaza is affected by a Special Condition or if you have another Rayquaza in play.

attacks.name: Sky Judgement
attacks.text: Discard all Energy attached to Rayquaza.

data.flavorText: It lives in the ozone layer far above the clouds and cannot be seen from the ground.

data.name: Regigigas

abilities.name: Slow Start
abilities.text: Regigigas can't attack until your opponent has 3 or less Prize cards left.

attacks.name: Crush Grip
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon already has any damage counters on it, this attack's base damage is 40 instead of 120.

data.flavorText: There is an enduring legend that states this Pokémon towed continents with ropes.

data.name: Spiritomb

abilities.name: Curse Breath
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you put Spiritomb from your hand onto your Bench, you may put 1 damage counter on all Pokémon that already have any damage counters on them (both yours and your opponent's). You can't use more than 1 Curse Breath Poké-Power each turn.

attacks.name: Transfer Pain
attacks.text: Move 1 damage counter from 1 of your Pokémon to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

data.flavorText: A Pokémon that was formed by 108 spirits. It is bound to a fissure in an odd keystone.

data.name: Yanmega

attacks.name: Sonic Wave
attacks.text: Does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) Your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Pursue and Turn
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon already has 2 or more damage counters on it, this attack does 60 damage plus 20 more damage and switch Yanmega with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

data.flavorText: By churning its wings, it creates shock waves that inflict critical internal injuries to foes.

data.name: Armaldo

abilities.name: Fossil Armor
abilities.text: If Armaldo would be damaged by an attack, prevent that attack's damage done to Armaldo if that damage is 60 or less.

attacks.name: Crush Claw
attacks.text: During your next turn, if an attack does damage to the Defending Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance), that attack does 40 more damage.

data.flavorText: It went ashore after evolving. Its entire body is clad in a sturdy armor.

data.name: Azelf

abilities.name: Time Walk
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you put Azelf from your hand onto your Bench, you may look at all of your face-down Prize cards. If you do, you may choose 1 Pokémon you find there, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Then, choose 1 card in your hand and put it as a Prize card face down.

attacks.name: Lock Up
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

data.flavorText: Known as "The Being of Willpower." It sleeps at the bottom of a lake to keep the world in balance.

data.name: Bellossom

attacks.name: Parallel Gain
attacks.text: Remove 1 damage counter from each of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Blend Pollen
attacks.text: Does 40 damage plus 20 more damage for each Vileplume and each Bellossom you have in play. Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Burned.

data.flavorText: When the heavy rainfall season ends, it is drawn out by warm sunlight to dance in the open.

data.name: Cradily

attacks.name: Drain Down
attacks.text: Before doing damage, you may switch 1 of the Defending Pokémon with 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. If you do, this attack does 30 damage to the new Defending Pokémon. If the Defending Pokémon would be Knocked Out by this attack, you may remove all damage counters from Cradily.

attacks.name: Acid
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

data.flavorText: It lives in the shallows of warm seas. When the tide goes out, it digs up prey from beaches.

data.name: Crawdaunt

attacks.name: Gripthrow
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent returns the Defending Pokémon and all cards attached to it to his or her hand.

attacks.name: Prop-up Pinchers
attacks.text: If Crawdaunt has a Technical Machine card attached to it, this attack does 50 damage plus 30 more damage.

data.flavorText: It is a ruffian that uses its pincers to pick up and toss out other Pokémon from its pond.

data.name: Delcatty

abilities.name: Attracting Body
abilities.text: If Delcatty is your Active Pokémon and is damaged by an opponent's attack (even if Delcatty is Knocked Out), flip a coin. If heads, the Attacking Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Energy Assist
attacks.text: Search your discard pile for a basic Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It is highly popular among female Trainers for its sublime fur. It does not keep a nest.

data.name: Deoxys Attack Forme

abilities.name: Form Change
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may search your deck for any Deoxys and switch it with Deoxys Attack Forme. (Any cards attached to Deoxys Attack Forme, damage counters, Special Conditions, and effects on it are now on the new Pokémon.) If you do, put Deoxys Attack Forme on top of your deck. Shuffle your deck afterward. You can't use more than 1 Form Change Poké-Power each turn.

attacks.name: Psychic Boost
attacks.text: During your next turn, Deoxys's Psychic Boost attack's base damage is 20.

data.flavorText: An alien virus that fell to earth on a meteor underwent a DNA mutation to become this Pokémon.

data.name: Deoxys Defense Forme

abilities.name: Form Change
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may search your deck for any Deoxys and switch it with Deoxys Defense Forme. (Any cards attached to Deoxys Defense Forme, damage counters, Special Conditions, and effects on it are now on the new Pokémon.) If you do, put Deoxys Defense Forme on top of your deck. Shuffle your deck afterward. You can't use more than 1 Form Change Poké-Power each turn.

attacks.name: Psychic Defense
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of an attack, and any damage done to Deoxys by attacks is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

data.flavorText: An alien virus that fell to earth on a meteor underwent a DNA mutation to become this Pokémon.

data.name: Deoxys Speed Forme

abilities.name: Form Change
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may search your deck for any Deoxys and switch it with Deoxys Speed Forme. (Any cards attached to Deoxys Speed Forme, damage counters, Special Conditions, and effects on it are now on the new Pokémon.) If you do, put Deoxys Speed Forme on top of your deck. Shuffle your deck afterward. You can't use more than 1 Form Change Poké-Power each turn.

attacks.name: Speed Shot
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 30 damage to that Pokémon. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness, Resistance, Poké-Powers, Poké-Bodies, or any other effects on that Pokémon.

data.flavorText: An alien virus that fell to earth on a meteor underwent a DNA mutation to become this Pokémon.

data.name: Ditto

abilities.name: Ditto DNA
abilities.text: As long as Ditto is your Active Pokémon, its maximum HP is the same as your opponent's Active Pokémon. Ditto can use the attacks of that Pokémon as its own. (You still need the necessary Energy to use each attack.) If that Pokémon is no longer your opponent's Active Pokémon, choose 1 of your opponent's Active Pokémon for Ditto to copy.

data.flavorText: It has the ability to reconstitute its entire cellular structure to transform into whatever it sees.

data.name: Forretress

abilities.name: Iron Shell
abilities.text: Whenever you attach a basic Energy card from your hand to Forretress (excluding effects of attacks), you may flip a coin. If tails, put 2 damage counters on each Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's) (excluding any Forretress).

attacks.name: Explosion
attacks.text: Forretress does 40 damage to itself.

data.flavorText: It is encased in a steel shell. Its peering eyes are all that can be seen of its mysterious innards.

data.name: Groudon

attacks.name: Drought
attacks.text: Choose up to 2 basic Fighting Energy cards from your hand and attach them to 1 of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Major Earthquake
attacks.text: Discard 2 Fighting Energy attached to Groudon and this attack does 10 damage to each of your Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.flavorText: It had been asleep in underground magma ever since it fiercely fought Kyogre long ago.

data.name: Heatran

abilities.name: Smelt
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may move a Metal Energy attached to 1 of your Pokémon to Heatran. This power can't be used if Heatran is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Heavy Metal
attacks.text: Flip a coin for each Metal Energy attached to Heatran. This attack does 40 damage plus 20 more damage for each heads.

data.flavorText: It dwells in volcanic caves. It digs in with its cross-shaped feet to crawl on ceilings and walls.

data.name: Jirachi

attacks.name: One Desire
attacks.text: Search your deck for any 1 card. Shuffle your deck, then put that card on top of your deck.

attacks.name: Doom Desire
attacks.text: Discard all Energy attached to Jirachi. The Defending Pokémon is Knocked Out at the end of your opponent's next turn.

data.flavorText: It is said to have the ability to grant any wish for just one week every thousand years.

data.name: Kyogre

attacks.name: Drizzle
attacks.text: Choose up to 2 basic Water Energy cards from your hand and attach them to 1 of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: High Tide
attacks.text: Discard 2 Water Energy attached to Kyogre. This attack does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.flavorText: It is said to have widened the seas by causing downpours. It had been asleep in a marine trench.

data.name: Lopunny

abilities.name: Healing Tail
abilities.text: As long as Lopunny is your Active Pokémon, remove 1 damage counter from each of your Benched Pokémon between turns.

attacks.name: Collect
attacks.text: Draw 3 cards.

attacks.name: Cross-Cut
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon is an Evolved Pokémon, this attack does 30 damage plus 30 more damage.

data.flavorText: An extremely cautious Pokémon. It cloaks its body with its fluffy ear fur when it senses danger.

data.name: Mesprit

abilities.name: Psychic Bind
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you put Mesprit from your hand onto your Bench, you may use this power. Your opponent can't use any Poké-Powers on his or her Pokémon during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Extrasensory
attacks.text: If you have the same number of cards in your hand as your opponent, this attack does 20 damage plus 50 more damage.

data.flavorText: Known as "The Being of Emotion." It taught humans the nobility of sorrow, pain, and joy.

data.name: Poliwrath

attacks.name: Focus Punch
attacks.text: If Poliwrath was damaged by an attack during your opponent's last turn, this attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Submission
attacks.text: Poliwrath does 20 damage to itself.

data.flavorText: With extremely tough muscles, it can keep swimming in the Pacific Ocean without resting.

data.name: Regice

abilities.name: Regi Move
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may use this power. Discard 2 cards from your hand and choose 1 of your opponent's Active Pokémon that isn't an Evolved Pokémon. Then, your opponent switches that Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon. This power can't be used if Regice is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Ice Reflect
attacks.text: If Regice was damaged by an attack during your opponent's last turn, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

data.flavorText: Its body is made of ice from the ice age. It controls frigid air of -328 degrees Fahrenheit.

data.name: Regigigas

abilities.name: Recover Mechanism
abilities.text: When you attach an Energy card from your hand to Regigigas, remove all Special Conditions from Regigigas.

attacks.name: Gigaton Punch
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 60 damage plus 20 more damage and does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.flavorText: There is an enduring legend that states this Pokémon towed continents with ropes.

data.name: Regirock

abilities.name: Regi Cycle
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if you have a Fighting Energy card in your discard pile, you may discard 2 cards from your hand. Then, attach a Fighting Energy card from your discard pile to Regirock. This power can't be used if Regirock is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Stone Edge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 40 damage plus 30 more damage.

data.flavorText: Its entire body is made of rock. If any part chips off in battle, it attaches rocks to repair itself.

data.name: Registeel

abilities.name: Regi Heal
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may discard 2 cards from your hand. Then, remove 3 damage counters from Registeel. This power can't be used if Registeel is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Rotating Claws
attacks.text: You may discard an Energy card attached to Registeel. If you do, search your discard pile for an Energy card (excluding the one you discarded) and attach it to Registeel.

data.flavorText: Tempered by pressure underground over tens of thousands of years, its body cannot be scratched.

data.name: Shedinja

abilities.name: Resent
abilities.text: Once during your opponent's turn, if Shedinja would be Knocked Out by damage from an attack, you may put 4 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon and each of the opponent's Pokémon that has the same name as the Attacking Pokémon.

attacks.name: Curse and Deceive
attacks.text: Put 3 damage counters on the Defending Pokémon. If Shedinja has any damage counters on it, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

data.flavorText: A discarded bug shell that came to life. Peering into the crack on its back is said to steal one's spirit.

data.name: Torkoal

abilities.name: White Smoke
abilities.text: As long as Torkoal is your Active Pokémon, prevent all effects, including damage, done to your Benched Pokémon by your opponent's attacks.

attacks.name: Black Soot
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Burned and Paralyzed.

data.flavorText: It burns coal inside its shell for energy. It blows out black soot if it is endangered.

data.name: Unown [!]

abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you put Unown ! from your hand onto your Bench, you may flip a coin. If heads, put 2 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. If tails, put 2 damage counters on 1 of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Hidden Power
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 10 more damage. If tails, Unown ! does 10 damage to itself, and this attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance.

data.flavorText: Shaped like an ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or Unown came first.

data.name: Uxie

abilities.name: Set Up
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you put Uxie from your hand onto your Bench, you may draw cards until you have 7 cards in your hand.

attacks.name: Psychic Restore
attacks.text: You may put Uxie and all cards attached to it on the bottom of your deck in any order.

data.flavorText: Known as "The Being of Knowledge." It is said that it can wipe out the memory of those who see its eyes.

data.name: Victreebel

attacks.name: Burning Scent
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Burned and Poisoned. Before applying these effects, you may switch 1 of the Defending Pokémon with 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. The new Defending Pokémon is now Burned and Poisoned.

attacks.name: Energy Dissolve
attacks.text: Discard an Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon at the end of your opponent's next turn.

data.flavorText: It pools in its mouth a fluid with a honeylike scent, which is really an acid that dissolves anything.

data.name: Vileplume

abilities.name: Energy Reaction
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), when you attach a Grass or Psychic Energy card from your hand to Vileplume (excluding effects of attacks or Poké-Powers), you may use this power. If you attach a Grass Energy card, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. If you attach a Psychic Energy card, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. This power can't be used if Vileplume is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Disturbing Pollen
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent can't play any Trainer, Supporter, or Stadium cards from his or her hand during your opponent's next turn.

data.flavorText: Its petals are the largest in the world. As it walks, it scatters extremely allergenic pollen.

data.name: Anorith

attacks.name: Guard Claw
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to Anorith by attacks is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: X-Scissor
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 damage plus 20 more damage.

data.flavorText: A Pokémon ancestor that was reanimated from a fossil. It lived in the sea and hunted with claws.

data.name: Camerupt

attacks.name: Eruption
attacks.text: Each player discards the top of his or her deck. This attack does 30 damage plus 30 more damage for each Energy card discarded in this way.

attacks.name: Take Down
attacks.text: Camerupt does 20 damage to itself.

data.flavorText: It has volcanoes on its back. If magma builds up in its body, it shudders, then erupts violently.

data.name: Castform

abilities.name: Temperament
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may search your deck for any Castform and switch it with Castform. (Any cards attached to Castform, damage counters, Special Conditions, and effects on it are now on the new Pokémon.) If you do, put Castform on top of your deck. Shuffle your deck afterward. You can't use more than 1 Temperament Poké-Power each turn.

attacks.name: Weather Ball
attacks.text: If you have a Stadium card in play, remove 3 damage counters from Castform. If your opponent has a Stadium card in play, this attack does 30 damage plus 30 more damage.

data.flavorText: Its appearance changes with the weather. Recently, its molecules were found to be just like water.

data.name: Castform Rain Form

abilities.name: Temperament
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may search your deck for any Castform and switch it with Castform Rain Form. (Any cards attached to Castform Rain Form, damage counters, Special Conditions, and effects on it are now on the new Pokémon.) Shuffle Castform Rain Form back into your deck. You can't use more than 1 Temperament Poké-Power each turn.

attacks.name: Water Pulse
attacks.text: The defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

data.flavorText: Its appearance changes with the weather. Recently, its molecules were found to be just like water.

data.name: Castform Snow-Cloud Form

abilities.name: Temperament
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may search your deck for any Castform and switch it with Castform Snow-cloud Form. (Any cards attached to Castform Snow-cloud Form, damage counters, Special Conditions, and effects on it are now on the new Pokémon.) Shuffle Castform Snow-cloud Form back into your deck. You can't use more than 1 Temperament Poké-Power each turn.

attacks.name: Hail
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.flavorText: Its appearance changes with the weather. Recently, its molecules were found to be just like water.

data.name: Castform Sunny Form

abilities.name: Temperament
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may search your deck for any Castform and switch it with Castform Sunny Form. (Any cards attached to Castform Sunny Form, damage counters, Special Conditions, and effects on it are now on the new Pokémon.) Shuffle Castform Sunny Form back into your deck. You can't use more than 1 Temperament Poké-Power each turn.

attacks.name: Ember
attacks.text: Discard a Fire Energy attached to Castform Sunny Form.

data.flavorText: Its appearance changes with the weather. Recently, its molecules were found to be just like water.

data.name: Dragonair

attacks.name: Wrap
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Rising Lunge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 damage plus 20 more damage.

data.flavorText: If its body takes on an aura, the weather changes instantly. It is said to live in seas and lakes.

data.name: Drifblim

attacks.name: Expand
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to Drifblim by attacks is reduced by 10 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Whirlwind
attacks.text: Your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It's drowzy in daytime, but flies off in the evening in big groups. No one knows where they go.

data.name: Exeggutor

attacks.name: Psychic Strategy
attacks.text: Each player counts the number of cards in his or her opponent's hand. Each player shuffles his or her hand into his or her deck. Then, each player draws a number of cards up to the number of cards his or her opponent had. (You draw your cards first.)

attacks.name: Super Eggsplosion
attacks.text: Discard as many Energy cards as you like attached to your Pokémon. For each Energy card you discarded, flip a coin. This attack does 50 damage times the number of heads.

data.flavorText: It is called "The Walking Jungle." If a head grows too big, it falls off and becomes an Exeggcute.

data.name: Gliscor

attacks.name: Poison Jab
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Sharp Tail
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 damage plus 40 more damage.

data.flavorText: It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!

data.name: Grumpig

attacks.name: Magical Step
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Confused. Put 6 damage counters instead of 3 on the Confused Pokémon.

attacks.name: Grind
attacks.text: Does 20 damage times the amount of Energy attached to Grumpig.

data.flavorText: It uses black pearls to amplify its psycho-power. It does an odd dance to gain control over foes.

data.name: Houndoom

abilities.name: Revenge Fang
abilities.text: If you have less Benched Pokémon than your opponent, each of Houndoom's attacks does 40 more damage to the Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Burning Sensation
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon already has any damage counters on it, the Defending Pokémon is now Burned.

attacks.name: Bright Flame
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, discard 2 Fire Energy attached to Houndoom.

data.flavorText: Long ago, people imagined its eerie howls to be the call of the grim reaper.

data.name: Lanturn

attacks.name: Rushing Water
attacks.text: Move an Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon to another of your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Confuse Ray
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

data.flavorText: Lanturn's light can shine up from great depths. It is nicknamed "The Deep-Sea Star."

data.name: Lanturn

attacks.name: Energy Split
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon that has any Energy cards attached to it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Aqua Bolt
attacks.text: Does 60 damage plus 10 more damage for each Water Energy attached to Lanturn.

data.flavorText: Lanturn's light can shine up from great depths. It is nicknamed "The Deep-Sea Star."

data.name: Ledian

attacks.name: Comet Punch
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Baton Pass
attacks.text: You may switch Ledian with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. If you do, move as many Energy cards attached to Ledian as you like to the new Active Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It uses starlight as energy. When more stars appear at night, the patterns on its back grow larger.

data.name: Lucario

attacks.name: Focus Blast
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 30 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Spike Lariat
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon already has any damage counters on it, this attack does 60 damage plus 20 more damage.

data.flavorText: It has the ability to sense the auras of all things. It understands human speech.

data.name: Luxio

attacks.name: Spark
attacks.text: Does 10 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Thunderous Claw
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, discard all Lightning Energy attached to Luxio.

data.flavorText: Its claws loose electricity with enough amperage to cause fainting. They live in small groups.

data.name: Marowak

attacks.name: Heavy Bone
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, Marowak can't use Heavy Bone during your next turn.

attacks.name: Bone Rush
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 50 damage times the number of heads.

data.flavorText: From its birth, this savage Pokémon constantly holds bones. It is skilled in using them as weapons.

data.name: Metang

attacks.name: Agility
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of an attack, including damage, done to Metang during your opponent's next turn.

data.flavorText: It is formed by two Beldum joining together. Its steel body won't be scratched if it collides with a jet.

data.name: Metang

attacks.name: Psyshock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Bullet Punch
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 40 damage plus 20 more damage for each heads.

data.flavorText: It is formed by two Beldum joining together. Its steel body won't be scratched if it collides with a jet.

data.name: Mightyena

attacks.name: Bite On
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon isn't an Evolved Pokémon, that Pokémon can't attack, retreat, or use any Poké-Powers during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Harass
attacks.text: Does 10 damage times the number of Pokémon you have in play.

data.flavorText: It chases down prey in a pack. It will never disobey the commands of a skilled Trainer.

data.name: Ninjask

abilities.name: Cast-off Shell
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you play Ninjask from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon and if your Bench isn't full, you may put Shedinja onto your Bench as a Basic Pokémon from your hand or your discard pile.

attacks.name: Chip Off
attacks.text: If your opponent has 6 or more cards in his or her hand, discard a number of cards without looking until your opponent has 5 cards left in his or her hand.

data.flavorText: Because it moves so quickly, it sometimes becomes unseeable. It congregates around tree sap.

data.name: Persian

attacks.name: Feint Attack
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 30 damage to that Pokémon. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness, Resistance, Poké-Powers, Poké-Bodies, or any other effects on that Pokémon.

attacks.name: Fasten Claws
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 40 damage plus 10 more damage.

data.flavorText: A very haughty Pokémon. Among fans, the size of the jewel in its forehead is a topic of much talk.

data.name: Piloswine

attacks.name: Charge Dash
attacks.text: You may do 30 damage plus 30 more damage. If you do, Piloswine does 30 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Icy Wind
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

data.flavorText: Its shaggy coat makes it unable to see. It checks surroundings with its sensitive nose instead.

data.name: Seadra

attacks.name: Aqua Pump
attacks.text: You may discard up to 2 Water Energy cards from your hand. If you do, this attack does 30 damage plus 10 more damage for each Energy card you discarded.

data.flavorText: Its spines provide protection. Its fins and bones are prized as traditional medicine ingredients.

data.name: Starmie

attacks.name: Star Boomerang

data.name: Dawn Stadium

data.name: Dusk Ball
rules: Look at the 7 cards from the bottom of your deck. Choose 1 Pokémon you find there, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Put the remaining cards back on top of your deck. Shuffle your deck afterward.

data.name: Energy Restore
rules: Flip 3 coins. For each heads, put a Basic Energy card from your discard pile into your hand. If you don't have that many basic Energy cards in your discard pile, put all of them into your hand.

data.name: Fossil Excavator
rules: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

Search your deck or discard pile for a Trainer card that has Fossil in its name or a Stage 1 or Stage 2 Evolution card that evolves from a Fossil. Show it to your opponent and put it into your hand. If you searched your deck, shuffle your deck afterward.

data.name: Mom's Kindness
rules: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.
Draw 2 cards.

data.name: Old Amber
rules: Play Old Amber as if it were a Colorless Basic Pokémon. (Old Amber counts as a Trainer card as well, but if Old Amber is Knocked Out, this counts as a Knocked Out Pokémon.) Old Amber can't be affected by any Special Conditions and can't retreat. At any time during your turn before your attack, you may discard Old Amber from play. (This doesn't count as a Knocked Out Pokémon.)

abilities.name: Hard Amber
abilities.text: As long as Old Amber is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to Old Amber by attacks (both yours and your opponent's).

data.name: Poké Ball
rules: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a Pokémon, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

data.name: Quick Ball
rules: Reveal cards from your deck until you reveal a Pokémon. Show that Pokémon to your opponent and put it into your hand. Shuffle the other revealed cards back into your deck. (If you don't reveal a Pokémon, shuffle all the revealed cards back into your deck.)

data.name: Super Scoop Up
rules: Flip a coin. If heads, return 1 of your Pokémon and all cards attached to it to your hand.

data.name: Warp Point
rules: Your opponent switches 1 of his or her Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon, if any. You switch 1 of your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon, if any.

data.name: Dome Fossil
rules: Play Dome Fossil as if it were a Colorless Basic Pokémon. (Dome Fossil counts as a Trainer card as well, but if Dome Fossil is Knocked Out, this counts as a Knocked Out Pokémon.) Dome Fossil can't be affected by any Special Conditions and can't retreat. At any time during your turn before your attack, you may discard Dome Fossil from play. (This doesn't count as a Knocked Out Pokémon.)

abilities.name: Rock Reaction
abilities.text: When you attach a Fighting Energy card from your hand to Dome Fossil (excluding effects of attacks or Poké-Powers), search your deck for a card that evolves from Dome Fossil and put it onto Dome Fossil (this counts as evolving Dome Fossil). Shuffle your deck afterward.

data.name: Energy Search
rules: Search your deck for a basic Energy card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

data.name: Helix Fossil
rules: Play Helix Fossil as if it were a Colorless Basic Pokémon. (Helix Fossil counts as a Trainer card as well, but if Helix Fossil is Knocked Out, this counts as a Knocked Out Pokémon.) Helix Fossil can't be affected by any Special Conditions and can't retreat. At any time during your turn before your attack, you may discard Helix Fossil from play. (This doesn't count as a Knocked Out Pokémon.)

abilities.name: Aqua Reaction
abilities.text: When you attach a Water Energy card from your hand to Helix Fossil (excluding effects of attacks or Poké-Powers), search your deck for a card that evolves from Helix Fossil and put it onto Helix Fossil (this counts as evolving Helix Fossil). Shuffle your deck afterward.

data.name: Call Energy
rules: Call Energy provides Colorless Energy. Once during your turn, if the Pokémon Call Energy is attached to is your Active Pokémon, you may search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. If you do, shuffle your deck and your turn ends.

data.name: Darkness Energy
rules: If the Pokémon Darkness Energy is attached to attacks, the attack does 10 more damage to the Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance). Ignore this effect if the Pokémon that Darkness Energy is attached to isn't Darkness. Darkness Energy provides Darkness Energy. (Doesn't count as a basic Energy card.)

data.name: Health Energy
rules: Health Energy provides Colorless Energy. When you attach this card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon, remove 1 damage counter from that Pokémon.

data.name: Metal Energy
rules: Damage done by attacks to the Pokémon that Metal Energy is attached to is reduced by 10 (after applying Weakness and Resistance). Ignore this effect if the Pokémon that Metal Energy is attached to isn't Metal. Metal Energy provides Metal Energy. (Doesn't count as a basic Energy card.)

data.name: Recover Energy
rules: Recover Energy provides Colorless Energy. When you attach this card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon, remove all Special Conditions from that Pokémon.

data.name: Garchomp LV.X

abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), when you put Garchomp LV.X from your hand onto your Active Garchomp, you may flip 3 coins. For each heads, put 1 damage counter on each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Restore
attacks.text: Search your discard pile for a Pokémon (excluding Pokémon LV.X) and put it onto your Bench as a Basic Pokémon. Then, you may search your discard pile for up to 3 basic Energy cards and attach them to that Pokémon.

attacks.name: Singe

data.name: Amulet Coin
rules: Attach Amulet Coin to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached to it. If that Pokémon is Knocked Out, discard this card.
If the Pokémon Amulet Coin is attached to is your Active Pokémon at the end of your turn, draw a card.

rules: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.
Discard up to 2 cards from your hand. If you discard 1 card, draw 3 cards. If you discard 2 cards, draw 4 cards.

rules: Attach Leftovers to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached to it. If that Pokémon is Knocked Out, discard this card.
If the Pokémon Leftovers is attached to is your Active Pokémon at the end of your turn, remove 1 damage counter from the Pokémon.

rules: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. If another card with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.

rules: Put this card onto your Active Cresselia. Cresselia LV.X can use any attack, Poké-Power, or Poké-Body from its previous level.

attacks.name: Cluster Bolt
attacks.text: You may discard all Lightning Energy attached to Ampharos. If you do, this attack does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon that has any Energy cards attached to it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.flavorText: The tip of its tail shines brightly. In the olden days, people sent signals using the tail's light.

data.name: Blastoise

abilities.name: Waterlog
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may attach as many basic Water Energy cards from your hand to any of your Pokémon in any way you like. If you do, your turn ends. This power can't be used if Blastoise is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Hydro Pump
attacks.text: Does 50 damage plus 20 more damage for each Water Energy attached to Blastoise but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. You can't add more than 40 damage in this way.

data.flavorText: The jets of water it spouts from the rocket cannons on its shell can punch through thick steel.

data.name: Charizard

abilities.name: Fury Blaze
abilities.text: If your opponent has 3 or less Prize cards left, each of Charizard's attacks does 50 more damage to the Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Blast Burn
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard 2 Energy cards attached to Charizard. If tails, discard 4 Energy cards attached to Charizard. (If you can't, this attack does nothing.)

data.flavorText: It is said that CHARIZARD's fire burns hotter if it has experienced harsh battles.

data.name: Entei

abilities.name: Burning Coat
abilities.text: Whenever 1 of your opponent's Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from Entei's attacks, discard the top 3 cards from your opponent's deck.

attacks.name: Blaze Roar
attacks.text: Does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) Flip a coin. If tails, discard 2 Fire Energy attached to Entei.

data.flavorText: It is said that when it roars, a volcano erupts somewhere around the globe.

data.name: Flygon

abilities.name: Irritating Buzz
abilities.text: As long as Flygon is your Active Pokémon, put 1 damage counter on each of your opponent's Active Pokémon between turns, excluding Fighting Pokémon.

attacks.name: Sand Sonic
attacks.text: If you attach a Fighting Energy card from your hand to Flygon during this turn, this attack does 60 damage plus 20 more damage.

data.flavorText: It whips up sandstorms with powerful flaps of its wings. It is known as "The Desert Spirit."

data.name: Gallade

attacks.name: Sonic Blade
attacks.text: Put damage counters on the Defending Pokémon until it is 50 HP away from being Knocked Out. If you do, your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Psychic Cut
attacks.text: You may choose as many of your face-down Prize cards as you like and put them face up. If you do, this attack does 60 damage plus 20 more damage for each Prize card you chose. (These cards remain face up for the rest of the game.)

data.flavorText: A master of courtesy and swordsmanship, it fights using extending swords on its elbows.

data.name: Gardevoir

abilities.name: Telepass
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may search your opponent's discard pile for a Supporter card and use the effect of that card as the effect of this power. (The Supporter card remains in your opponent's discard pile.) You can't use more than 1 Telepass Poké-Power each turn. This power can't be used if Gardevoir is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Psychic Lock
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, your opponent can't use any Poké-Powers on his or her Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It will try to guard its trusted Trainer with its life. It has the ability to see the future.

data.name: Gastrodon East Sea

abilities.name: Osmotic Pressure
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if you have Gastrodon West Sea in play, you may move up to 3 damage counters from Gastrodon East Sea to 1 of your Gastrodon West Sea.

attacks.name: Dwindling Wave
attacks.text: Does 80 damage minus 10 damage for each damage counter on Gastrodon East Sea.

data.flavorText: It has a pliable body without any bones. If any part of its body is torn off, it grows right back.

data.name: Gastrodon West Sea

attacks.name: Raging Flood
attacks.text: Does 20 damage plus 10 more damage for each damage counter on Gastrodon West Sea. Then, remove 2 damage counters from Gastrodon West Sea.

attacks.name: Wild Waves
attacks.text: Put 1 damage counter on each Benched Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's).

data.flavorText: It has a pliable body without any bones. If any part of its body is torn off, it grows right back.

data.name: Ho-Oh

abilities.name: Phoenix Turn
abilities.text: Once during your opponent's turn, if Ho-Oh would be Knocked Out by damage from an attack, you may flip a coin. If heads, Ho-Oh isn't discarded. Instead, remove all damage counter, Special Conditions, and other effects from Ho-Oh. Then, discard all cards attached to Ho-Oh (except for Energy cards). This counts as Ho-Oh being Knocked Out and your opponent takes a Prize card.

attacks.name: Rainbow Wing
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage times the number of different types of basic Energy cards attached to Ho-Oh.

data.flavorText: Its feathers are in seven colors. It is said that anyone seeing it is promised eternal happiness.

data.name: Jumpluff

abilities.name: Cotton Spore
abilities.text: Whenever Jumpluff would be damaged by your opponent's attack, flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to Jumpluff by that attack.

attacks.name: Cottonweed Punch
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. For each heads, this attack does 30 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.flavorText: Blown by seasonal winds, it circles the globe, scattering cotton spores as it goes.

data.name: Lickilicky

attacks.name: Tongue Reel
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. If you choose a Benched Pokémon, switch the Defending Pokémon with that Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage to the Pokémon you chose. Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Boundless Power
attacks.text: During your next turn, Lickilicky can't attack.

data.flavorText: It wraps things with its extensible tongue. Getting to close to it will leave you soaked with drool.

data.name: Ludicolo

abilities.name: Rain Dish
abilities.text: At any time between turns, remove 1 damage counter from Ludicolo.

attacks.name: Nature Power
attacks.text: If you have a Stadium Card in play, this attack does 60 damage plus 20 more damage. If your opponent has a Stadium card in play, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

data.flavorText: If it hears festive music, all its muscles fill with energy. It can't help breaking out into a dance.

data.name: Lugia

attacks.name: Silver Wing
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, choose an Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon and return it to your opponent's hand.

attacks.name: Psychic Destruction
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon has any Energy cards attached to it, this attack's base damage is 40 instead of 120.

data.flavorText: It sleeps in a deep-sea trench. If it flaps its wings, it is said to cause a 40-day storm.

data.name: Mew

attacks.name: Psychic Balance
attacks.text: If you have less cards in your hand than your opponent, draw cards until you have the same number of cards as your opponent. (If you have more or the same number of cards in your hand as your opponent, this attack does nothing.)

attacks.name: Re-creation
attacks.text: Choose an attack on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon in his or her discard pile. Re-creation copies that attack except for its Energy cost. (You must still do anything else required for that attack.) Mew performs that attack.

data.flavorText: Because it can use all kinds of moves, many scientists believe MEW to be the ancestor of Pokémon.

data.name: Raikou

abilities.name: Thunder Rumble
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), when you attach a Lightning Energy card from your hand to Raikou, you may put 1 damage counter on 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Thunder Climb
attacks.text: Discard 3 cards from the top of your deck. This attack does 50 damage plus 10 more damage for each Lightning Energy card you discarded. Then, attach those Lightning Energy cards to 1 of your Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It is said to have fallen with lightning. It can fire thunderbolts from the rain clouds on its back.

data.name: Roserade

attacks.name: Sleep Poison
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep and Poisoned.

attacks.name: Magical Leaf
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 40 damage plus 30 more damage and remove 3 damage counters from Roserade.

data.flavorText: It attracts prey with a sweet aroma, then downs it with thorny whips hidden in its arms.

data.name: Salamence

attacks.name: Direct Hit
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness, Resistance, Poké-Powers, Poké-Bodies, or any other effects on the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dragon Finish
attacks.text: Discard 2 basic Fire Energy cards or 2 basic Water Energy cards attached to Salamence. If you discarded 2 basic Fire Energy cards, this attack does 100 damage to the Defending Pokémon. If you discarded 2 Basic Water Energy cards, this attack does 100 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) (If you can't discard cards, this attack does nothing.)

data.flavorText: As a result of its long-held dream of flying, its cellular structure changes, and wings grew out.

data.name: Suicune

abilities.name: Aqua Recover
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you put Suicune from your hand onto your Bench, you may search your discard pile for up to 3 Water Pokémon, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand.

attacks.name: Cure Stream
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done by attacks from the Defending Pokémon is reduced by 20 (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

data.flavorText: It races around the world to purify fouled water. It dashes away with the north wind.

data.name: Venusaur

abilities.name: Miracle Aroma
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may flip a coin. If heads, choose either Asleep, Burned, or Poisoned. The Defending Pokémon is now affected by that Special Condition. This power can't be used if Venusaur is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Giant Bloom
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, remove 4 damage counters from Venusaur.

data.flavorText: After a rainy day, the flower on its back smells stronger. The scent attracts other Pokémon.

data.name: Absol

attacks.name: Baleful Wind
attacks.text: Choose a card from your opponent's hand without looking and discard it. If you discarded a Trainer, Supporter, or Stadium card, choose 1 more card from your opponent's hand without looking and discard it.

attacks.name: Raid
attacks.text: If you played Absol from your hand during this turn, this attack's base damage is 40 instead of 10.

data.flavorText: It senses disasters coming and appears before people only to warn them of impending danger.

data.name: Arcanine

abilities.name: Flame Dash
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you play Arcanine from your hand to evolve 1 of your Benched Pokémon, you may switch Arcanine with 1 of your Active Pokémon. If you do, you may move any number of Energy cards attached to that Pokémon to Arcanine.

attacks.name: Inferno Onrush
attacks.text: Arcanine does 40 damage to itself.

data.flavorText: Its proud and regal appearance has captured the hearts of people since long ago.

data.name: Banette

attacks.name: Ghost Head
attacks.text: Put as many damage counters as you like on Banette. (You can't put more than Banette's remaining HP.) Put that many damage counters on the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Spiteful Pain
attacks.text: If Banette is in your discard pile, this attack does 40 damage plus 40 more damage, then search your discard pile for Banette, show it to your opponent, and shuffle it into your deck.

data.flavorText: A doll that became a Pokémon over its grudge from being junked. It seeks the child that disowned it.

data.name: Dugtrio

attacks.name: Dig Trap
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing. If heads, prevent all effects of an attack, including damage, done to Dugtrio during your opponent's next turn. If Dugtrio is your Active Pokémon at the end of your opponent's next turn, put 6 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Pit Trap
attacks.text: Your opponent flips a coin. If tails, this attack does 50 damage plus 50 more damage.

data.flavorText: Its three heads moves alternately, driving it through tough soil to depths of over 60 miles.

data.name: Electivire

abilities.name: Motor Drive
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may search your discard pile for a Lightning Energy card and attach it to Electivire. This power can't be used if Electivire is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Discharge
attacks.text: Discard all Lightning Energy attached to Electivire. Flip a coin for each Lightning Energy you discarded. This attack does 50 damage times the number of heads.

data.flavorText: It pushes the tips of its two tails against the foe, then lets loose with over 20,000 volts of power.

data.name: Electrode

abilities.name: Energy Shift
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if Electrode would be Knocked Out by damage from an attack, you may use this power. Electrode isn't discarded. Instead, attach it as an Energy card to 1 of your Pokémon. While attached, this card is a Special Energy card and provides every type of Energy but provides only 1 Energy at a time. (Has no effect other than providing Energy.)

attacks.name: Ion Blast
attacks.text: You may do 40 damage plus 60 more damage. If you do, Electrode does 100 damage to itself.

data.flavorText: It is known to drift on winds if it is bloated to bursting with stored electricity.

data.name: Furret

attacks.name: Keen Eye
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 cards and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Baton Pass
attacks.text: You may switch Furret with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. If you do, move as many Energy cards attached to Furret as you like to the new Active Pokémon.

data.flavorText: The mother puts its offspring to sleep by curling up around them. It corners foes with speed.

data.name: Golduck

attacks.name: Encore
attacks.text: Choose 1 of the Defending Pokémon's attacks. That Pokémon can use only that attack during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Break Beam
attacks.text: You may do 40 damage plus 20 more damage. If you do, Golduck is now Confused.

data.flavorText: A Pokémon that lives in lakes. It swims faster than any human swimming champion.

data.name: Golem

attacks.name: Double Throw
attacks.text: Choose 2 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 30 damage to each of them. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Megaton Rock
attacks.text: You may do 40 damage instead of 80 to the Defending Pokémon. If you do, during your opponent's next turn, any damage done to Golem by attacks is reduced by 40 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

data.flavorText: It sheds its hide once a year. Its boulderlike body is so tough, even dynamite can't harm it.

data.name: Jynx

attacks.name: Icy Kiss
attacks.text: If Jynx was damaged by an attack during your opponent's last turn, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Lovely Kiss
attacks.text: Move 2 damage counters from Jynx to the Defending Pokémon. If Smoochum is anywhere under Jynx, move 4 damage counters instead.

data.flavorText: It cries sound like human speech. However, it is impossible to tell what it is trying to say.

data.name: Magmortar

abilities.name: Flame Body
abilities.text: When you attach a Fire Energy card from your hand to Magmortar, remove 2 damage counters from Magmortar.

attacks.name: Flame Blast
attacks.text: Does 20 damage times the number of Fire Energy attached to Magmortar.

attacks.name: Fireball Bazooka
attacks.text: Does 20 damage to 2 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.flavorText: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees F from the ends of its arms. It lives in volcanic craters.

data.name: Minun

abilities.name: Minus Charge
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if any Pokémon were Knocked Out during your opponent's last turn, you may draw 2 cards. You can't use more than 1 Minus Charge Poké-Power each turn. This power can't be used if Minun is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Tag Play —
attacks.text: If you have Plusle on your Bench, you may move an Energy card attached to Minun to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

data.flavorText: It cheers on friends. If its friends are losing, its body lets off more and more sparks.

data.name: Mothim

attacks.name: Silver Wind
attacks.text: During your next turn, if an attack does damage to the Defending Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance), that attack does 40 more damage.

attacks.name: Raging Scales
attacks.text: If Mothim has any damage counters on it, this attack does 30 damage plus 40 more damage.

data.flavorText: It loves the honey of flowers and steals honey collected by COMBEE.

data.name: Nidoking

attacks.name: Poison Rub
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. Before doing damage, you may switch 1 of the Defending Pokémon with 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. The new Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Pride Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin for each Nidoqueen on your Bench. This attack does 60 damage plus 30 more damage for each heads.

data.flavorText: One swing of its mighty tail can snap a telephone pole as if it were a matchstick.

data.name: Pidgeot

attacks.name: Mirror Move
attacks.text: If Pidgeot was damaged by an attack during your opponent's last turn, this attack does the same amount of damage done to Pidgeot to the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Whirlwind
attacks.text: Your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.

data.flavorText: By flapping its wings with all its might, PIDGEOT can make a gust of wind capable of bending tall trees.

data.name: Plusle

abilities.name: Plus Charge
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out during your opponent's last turn, you may search your discard pile for up to 2 basic Energy cards, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand. You can't use more than 1 Plus Charge Poké-Power each turn. This power can't be used if Plusle is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Tag Play +
attacks.text: If you have Minun on your Bench, you may do 20 damage to any 1 Benched Pokémon instead. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.flavorText: It cheers on friends with pom-poms made of sparks. It drains power from telephone poles.

data.name: Sharpedo

abilities.name: Rough Skin
abilities.text: If Sharpedo is your Active Pokémon and is damaged by an opponent's attack (even if Sharpedo is Knocked Out), put 2 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon.

attacks.name: Strike Wound
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon has 2 or more damage counters on it, this attack does 60 damage plus 20 more damage. This attack damage isn't affected by Weakness, Resistance, Poké-Powers, Poké-Bodies, or any other effects on that Pokémon.

data.flavorText: Its fangs rip through sheet iron. It swims at 75 mph and is known as "The Bully of the Sea."

data.name: Sunflora

abilities.name: Grass Whistle
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may remove 1 damage counter from each of your Grass Pokémon. You can't use more than 1 Grass Whistle Poké-Power each turn. This power can't be used if Sunflora is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Petal Dance
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads. If you get 2 or more heads, Sunflora is now Confused.

data.flavorText: It gets energy from warm sunlight and is known for its habit of moving in pursuit of it.

data.name: Unown [S]

abilities.name: Set
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if you have Unown S, Unown E, and Unown T on your Bench, you may flip a coin. If heads, search your discard pile for an Energy card, show it to your opponent, and put it on top of your deck.

attacks.name: Hidden Power
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

data.flavorText: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

data.name: Weavile

abilities.name: Dark Engage
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may use this power. Each of your Active Pokémon's type is Darkness until the end of your turn. If that Pokémon is no longer your Active Pokémon, this effect ends.

attacks.name: Shadow Charge
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Darkness Energy cards and attach them to any of your Pokémon in any way you like. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Chip Off
attacks.text: If your opponent has 6 or more cards in his or her hand, discard a number of cards without looking until your opponent has 5 cards left in his or her hand.

data.flavorText: They live in cold regions, forming groups of four or five that hunt prey with impressive coordination.

data.name: Wormadam Plant Cloak

abilities.name: Plant Cloak
abilities.text: If Wormadam Plant Cloak has 2 or more Grass Energy attached to it, Wormadam Plant Cloak gets +40 HP.

attacks.name: Leaf Hurricane
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon has fewer remaining HP than Wormadam Plant Cloak, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

data.flavorText: When BURMY evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon's body. The cloak is never shed.

data.name: Wormadam Sandy Cloak

abilities.name: Sandy Cloak
abilities.text: Prevent all effects of attacks, excluding damage, done to Wormadam Sandy Cloak.

attacks.name: Push Over
attacks.text: Does 40 damage plus 10 damage for each Fighting Energy attached to Wormadam Sandy Cloak.

data.flavorText: When BURMY evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon's body. The cloak is never shed.

data.name: Wormadam Trash Cloak

abilities.name: Trash Cloak
abilities.text: If Wormadam Trash Cloak has a Pokémon Tool card attached to it, any damage done to Wormadam Trash Cloak by attacks is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Iron Tackle
attacks.text: Wormadam Trash Cloak does 20 damage to itself.

data.flavorText: When BURMY evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon's body. The cloak is never shed.

data.name: Xatu

abilities.name: Psychic Shift
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if Xatu is on your Bench, you may choose 1 Special Condition from 1 of your Active Pokémon and remove that Special Condition. Then, 1 of the Defending Pokémon is now affected by that Special Condition that you chose.

attacks.name: Energy Singe
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage plus 10 more damage for each Energy attached to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.flavorText: This odd Pokémon can see both the past and the future. It eyes the sun's movement all day.

data.name: Breloom

attacks.name: Drain Punch
attacks.text: Remove from Breloom a number of damage counters equal to the amount of Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Homing Uppercut
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon's Retreat Cost is 0, this attack does 60 damage plus 60 more damage.

data.flavorText: Its short arms stretch when it throws punches. Its technique is equal to that of pro boxers.

data.name: Charmeleon

attacks.name: Fire Fang
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Burned.

attacks.name: Flare Tail
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard a Fire Energy attached to Charmeleon and this attack does 50 damage plus 20 more damage.

data.flavorText: In the rocky mountains where CHARMELEON live, their fiery tails shine at night like stars.

data.name: Cloyster

attacks.name: Withdraw
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to Cloyster by attacks during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Spine Missile
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. For each heads, choose an opponent's Pokémon in play and this attack does 20 damage to those Pokémon. (You may choose the same Pokémon more than once.) (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.flavorText: It fights by keeping its shell tightly shut for protection and by shooting spikes to repel foes.

data.name: Donphan

attacks.name: Rapid Spin
attacks.text: Your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon, if any. You switch Donphan with 1 of your Benched Pokémon, if any.

attacks.name: Bash In
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool card attached to it, this attack does 70 damage plus 60 more damage.

data.flavorText: It attacks by curling up, then rolling into its foe. It can blow apart a house in one hit.

data.name: Farfetch'd

attacks.name: Swords Dance
attacks.text: During your next turn, Farfetch'd's Leek Slap attack's base damage is 60.

attacks.name: Leek Slap
attacks.text: During your next turn, Farfetch'd can't use Leek Slap.

data.flavorText: It can't live without the stalk it holds. That's why it defends the stalk from attackers with its life.

data.name: Flaaffy

attacks.name: Attract Current
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Lightning Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Pokémon. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Electromagnetic Kick
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, Flaaffy does 10 damage to itself.

data.flavorText: If its coat becomes fully charged with electricity, its tail lights up. It fires hair that zaps on impact.

data.name: Ivysaur

attacks.name: Leech Seed
attacks.text: Remove 1 damage counter from Ivysaur.

data.flavorText: When the bud on its back starts swelling, a sweet aroma wafts to indicate the flower's coming bloom.

data.name: Kecleon

abilities.name: Camouflage
abilities.text: If any basic Energy card attached to Kecleon is the same as the Attacking Pokémon's type, any damage done by attacks from the Pokémon to Kecleon is reduced by 40 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Blind Scratch
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does no damage to the Defending Pokémon. Instead, this attack does 20 damage to 1 of your Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

data.flavorText: It can freely change its body's color. The zigzag pattern on its belly doesn't change, however.

data.name: Kirlia

attacks.name: Psychic Research
attacks.text: Search your discard pile for a Supporter card and use the effect of that card as the effect of this attack. (The Supporter card remains in your discard pile.)

attacks.name: Telekinesis
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 40 damage to that Pokémon. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance.

data.flavorText: It is highly perceptive of its Trainer's feelings. It dances when it is feeling happy.

data.name: Lombre

attacks.name: Torment
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent can't play any Supporter cards from his or her hand during his or her next turn.

attacks.name: Absorb
attacks.text: Remove 2 damage counters from Lombre.

data.flavorText: It has a mischievous spirit. If it spots an angler, it will tug on the fishing line to interfere.

data.name: Miltank

attacks.name: Healing Milk
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. For each heads, remove 3 damage counters from 1 of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Continuous Tumble
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

data.flavorText: It is said that kids who drink MILTANK's milk grow up to become hearty, healthy adults.

data.name: Muk

abilities.name: Toxic Sludge
abilities.text: At the end of each player's turn, each of your opponent's Active Pokémon that has any Grass Energy attached to it is now Poisoned. If that Pokémon is already Poisoned, Toxic Sludge Poké-Body does nothing to that Pokémon.

attacks.name: Panic Liquid
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Confused and can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

data.flavorText: A toxic fluids seeps from its body. The fluid instantly kills plants and trees on contact.

data.name: Nidorino

attacks.name: Spirited Drill
attacks.text: During your next turn, each of Nidorino's attacks does 20 more damage to the Defending Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Poison Horn
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

data.flavorText: It has a violent disposition and stabs foes with its horn, which oozes poison upon impact.

data.name: Pidgeotto

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 damage plus 30 more damage.

data.flavorText: It flies over its wide territory in search of prey, downing it with its highly developed claws.

data.name: Pinsir

attacks.name: Grip and Squeeze
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Power Guillotine
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. If either of them is tails, this attack's base damage is 10 instead of 100.
